Precioso los monumentos y la ciudad pero horrible y patético el trato de la gente de comercios de allí con los españoles y bares nadie sabe español y trato como ganado . Luego vienen a aqui y quieren todo a pedir de boca 
Además de ciudad llena de basura las zonas más famosas y todo abarrotado a todas hora imposible ver algún monumento tranquilo y con sitio .

title: Very hyped - poorly run, expected more ?!
text:
Yes, the colosseum is spectacular BUT on site chaos and people milling everywhere rather ruins ( excuse the pun) first impressions. Very poor signage - many nationalities visit from all over the world - not always clear information given in English for where to 1) buy tickets , 2) enter 3) order an audio tour on site ? 4) buy an illustrated map of the site or indeed a pamphlet or booklet 5) exits not clear - same ‘map boards ‘ shown all over this site. VERY VERY LITTLE SIGNAGE TO EXPLAIN AREAS & WHAT YOU’RE LOOKING AT! Coming from UK most historical site’s & information boards to read. 

- Toilets - very few - not well sign posted 
- Cafe - drinks, food etc hidden in a few vending machines not sign posted 
- Shop / information centre saw one hidden away - INSIDE the colosseum but not sign posted - shown on any literature 
- TICKETS ( we paid 40€) each - absolutely nothing to show for them - not even a plan of the whole site with basic information 

By the time you’ve made it to the colosseum- travelled from your country / hotel / bought a ticket - YOU SHOULD EXPECT MORE. 

Shambolic - we visited N Cyprus & Salamis was more professionally run - nice map / free leaflet with tickets. Plenty of nice cafes & toilets available and clean. Can’t say the same as this for Rome’s centre stage WORLD UNESCO SITE.

Very sad & disappointing. Took the shine off so much excited anticipation. 

Go to the amphitheatre in Verona !

Beware- steps up to higher levels VERY DEEP & VERY STEEP - again no warnings from outside / before your visit or on the tickets’

title: CONSEJO: NO CONTRATEN
text: Contraté servicio de traslado desde aeropuerto de Roma al hotel. Nos citaron en una puerta de una terminal que estaba cerrada al público y después de llamar al tf de contacto me dijo que se retrasaban tres horas. Después de decirle que no me parecía normal que no me hubieran avisado ellos ni el tiempo de espera, me colgó el teléfono sin más.

title: Colloseum guidad tur
text: Kände mig en aning dragen vid näsan när en guide dök upp och påstod (sant eller falskt) att biljetterna till Colloseum var helt slut flera dar i rad, men att vi hade tur och kunde haka på en grupp med engelsktalande guide, så i stället för 16 Euro per skalle blev det 35. Guiden var dock lite smårolig och vi slapp köa både vid Colosseum och Forum Romanum. Han levererade en del matnyttigt information så det var väl okej ändå.

title: Obskure Tickethamsterer
text:
Überbewertet, lieber bei gutem Wetter den Palatin und das Forum besuchen, da hat es weitaus weniger Leute.
Wer nicht schon Tage vorher Tickets kauft, kommt ohne Gruppe nicht rein. Obskure Führer kaufen die Kontinente auf und man müsste sich diesen anschliessen. Ob das gut ist, kann ich nicht beurteilen, haben das nicht gemacht. Wir unterstützen solche Aktionen nicht. Sollte auch unterbunden werden, indem man nur eine bestimmte Anzahl kaufen kann oder die Tickets nicht weiterverkaufen darf.

title: Ok
text: Det skulle ha räckt med att se colluseum från utsidan. Det var ok innuti men tveksamt om det var värt pengarna. Forum romanum ingick i biljettpriset och det var mycket mer intressant. Så allt som allt var det en juste upplevelse

title: Not original and have a lot not access point
text: I feel I went to Rome to see this coliseum and received a commercial image from something that you need to pay every step for see something like fixed and is almost new

tickets can no longer be booked online for the entire week.  ticket offices do not sell tickets, although there is no queue and it would be possible to enter.  the museum loses money and the tourist does not return

title: More literature would have been nice
text: I am not too happy that there are no explanatory plaques at all anywhere. They want you to take guided tour at all cost.

title: En gång, aldrig igen.
text: Tråkigt, ombyggnad pågick och vi förstod inte alls charmen med stället. Historia, absolut, men inget värt att betala multum för att titta på.

title: Extérieur assez joli
text:
Extérieurement, le Colisée est assez joli et assez bien restauré.
Intérieurement, j'ai trouvé la visite sans aucun intérêt et les restaurations plus que douteuses !

title: l'ultima volta
text:
onestamente mai più, il prezzo cresce ed è parzialmente inaccessibile. la visita alle fondamenta solo con tour guidati.
audio guida pagata extra che funziona a malapena con un audio pessimo.
Guardartelo da fuori che risparmiate.

title: Colosseo di notte
text: Visitato di notte sotto un cielo smog(ato), ma le stelle non sono nulla in confronto a qursto monumento che ha più buchi di un cielo stellato notturno, pieno di spifferi e gli infissi son da rifare, imponente ma purtroppo dovrebbero dargli un aggiustatina

title: Mais propaganda que qualidade
text: Esperava mais. Entrada confusa para estrangeiros e sem sinalização. Os seguranças são grosseiros e sem paciência para dar informações. Após a entrada passamos por detectores de metais e seguimos sem informação alguma. Pouca sinalização e não há informação alguma ao percorrer o monumento. O passeio tornou se uma experiência visual e intuitiva. Com excesso de pessoas e sem controle algum. Ao sair não há informação alguma de como acessar o fórum romano e neste entramos por acaso.

title: Tourist Attraction you should see.
text:
This was, of course, a must do while in Rome.  That being said.  As any tourist attraction it is packed and not as exciting as you might expect.  I'd prefer to just wander around looking but we signed up with one of the walking tours outside of the Colosseum which included the forum.  That was pretty cool, and far more interesting to wander around.

All in all, glad we did it, never need to do it again.

title: Colosseo bello! Attenti alle guide!
text:
Il Colosseo ha un grande fascino.
La guida che ci ha accompagnato, Davide è molto preparato, anche se nelle sue spiegazioni traspare un forte anti-clericalismo che rende la spiegazione poco oggettiva. 
Il Colosseo va visto con una guida, ma la guida dovrebbe spiegare la storia non esporre un suo pensiero soggettivo. Ciò ha reso meno piacevole la visita.

title: Local imperdível, mas a guia...
text: Minha nota é razoável não pelo local - Coliseu - que é fantástico e obrigatório para qualquer turista. Essa foi nossa segunda visita e ainda me impressiono com a grandiosidade do local. A minha nota razoável é pela excursão que comprei, denominada " Coliseu, Fórum e Palatino + Arena de gladiadores - Civitatis.com", nossa guia era confusa, apesar de ter escolhido português ela falava um portunhol misturado com italiano, horrível de entender, houve também confusão nos tickets, parece que ela estava com menos entradas do que a quantidade do grupo, por isso deu confusão tanto para entrar no fórum quanto no coliseu.

title: Majestuoso pero burcocratico con niños
text: Ojo que los niños no se incluyen en los qr de ticket  y hay que hacerlo en el mismo coliseo lo que es tedioso. Sería ideal que estuvieran incluidos como parte de las actividades si ya van sus padres con ellos.

title: Decepcionada
text: Llegamos a las 9h cuando abrian... y "la mafia" habia comprado todas las entradas. La unica manera de entrar era pagando 40€ por persona y t ofrecen entrada+guia les dijimos q no keriamos guia y nos ofrecieron la entrada a 30€ (en la web 18€)  No hemos aceptado pero miles de personas lo hacen y acabará siendo la unica manera de visitar el coliseo... a no ser q consigas entradas anticipadas en la web oficial (os animo a que lo intenteis unos dias antes) muy triste con esta situación.  Fui a informacion y el Sr. Me contestó de muy malas maneras: mi problema es lo que pasa dentro del coliseum lo que pasa con esos, ni lo se... ni quiero saberlo.

title: Esperaba mas
text: De semejante monumento esperaba una mejor conservación. Es impactante y contiene la historia de Roma, pero es uno de esos lugares que parecen mejor en fotos que personalemte. Los horarios de la tarde te limitan el recorrido

title: Only go with a guided tour

text:

title: Non sono entrato
text: Biglietti solo online. Biglietti non acquistabili sul sito e neppure con la app. Decine di sedicenti guide che ti offrono la visita senza coda a prezzi folli dicendo che è l’unico modo di entrare. Ed io non sono entrato. Per ora godo ancora di buona salute. Vedremo in futuro. Tornerò per l’inaugurazione della nuova stazione della metropolitana.

title: Incontournable… mais trop de monde !
text: Réservation en ligne impérative. Acheter un Rome Pass 48 ou 72h sur le site officiel coopculture.it permet d’obtenir une réservation au dernier moment.

title: Quite nice but too crowded
text: In general the experience is nice and worth to visit, but the amount of people is insane. Very crowded and you need to stay in line for good 5 minutes to see something.

title: Bien de l'extérieur
text: Le voir de l'extérieur m'a suffit car l'entrée est payante et longue. C'est un bon monument. Desservie par la station de métro colleseao

title: Roman Collesium
text: Fire the guide! On November 10, we met at the assigned place. We were given listening devices the the signal was fuzzy, at best. I wish I knew the name of our guide, but he was too far ahead to read his name tag. With a group of at least 20, he never took a headcount. At the first photo op inside the Colessium, we stopped for a photo and when we looked up, our guide was nowhere to be found.  Even other guides from your company couldn't find him.  We went back to the meeting place without seeing any of our tour.  I got no satisfaction from your person on site. Calls to your office went   unanswered and no apology was given. Gerald Holmes Please check your lists from that day, and indicate any information you can.

title: Engaño excursiones bedsonline
text: Las excursiones no explican bien lo que vamos a ver mi ejemplo con bedsonline excursión foro coliseo y arena en el foro no pasamos por la vía sacra ni por la ruinas llevándonos por la otra parte, cosa que en la descripción no avisaba (sino no la.cogiamos ) y una vez dentro 10 minutos en la arena y el.coliseo por nuestra cuenta . title: Réservation obligatoire !
text: A savoir : il n’y a pas de billetterie sur place… il faut impérativement prendre ces places sur internet… c’est limite!!! Conséquence si vous ne programmer pas toutes vos visites, vous ne pouvez pas tout faire… et la partie Colisée, mont palatin et forum romain… sous la pluie c’est pas top et c’est gâché !

title: Llegar tarde todo perdido, nadie se pone en contacto con nosotros
text: Llegar 30 min antes de la citación, por que si no encuentras el punto de encuentro, y os retraseis perdeis la reserva y el dinero, nadie se pone en contacto con vosotros y os dejan tirados, eso me pasó en el Coliseo de Roma y estan de obras por todas partes y no encontramos el punto de encuentro.

title: Very poor purchasing experience.
text:
Ticket office directs you to use website instead of supplying tickets. Lots of wandering ticket touts trying to sell at inflated prices. 
Numourous 3rd party websites selling ticket slots then sending email to confirm they are fully booked with no way to contact. Need to get funds reversed from bank. 

Avoid:
colosseum-tickets.org

title: Absolute chaos even in the low season
text:
Considering this is one of Italy’s main attractions, the organisation is non-existent. There is no central official place to buy tickets online, there are a million third parties all selling different things. 

After reading horror stories of people being denied entry even after pre booking tickets, we decided not to book online and to try to get official tickets at the ticket office.

When we arrived it was swarming even in mid-November. Hundreds of scalpers trying to sell tickets and they all wear homemade “Tourist Information” badges. There is clearly zero regulation by the Italian authorities or official owners of the site.

There is one very small row of (what appear to be) official ticket booths which were all closed when we arrived.

I’ve come to the conclusion there’s no right way to do this - pay your money and hope for the best. If you choose a guided tour, it’s completely up to chance if you have a good or bad time.

We paid the scalpers for a guided tour which was so-so. The guide was a real Italian but he was a terrible tour guide. And he tried to leave us at the Colosseum even though all entry tickets include the Forum and Palatine Hill too.

title: Don't bother booking a tour
text: We did the full experience, going down under with a tour and then to the main area regular tickets allow you into. It was interesting to see but don't bother with any of the tours. Pay the 16 euro and see all of it from the main area.

title: Beware guided tour scammers
text:
Beware scammers!
As we approached the entry a very insistent guy conned us into a guided tour, said it was about to leave that tickets were sold out online and we paid 40 euro each and were given an ear peice and off we went for our tour, it lasted about 1 hour and then we were rushed out and dumped at the gate of the forum, because we did not hold a physical ticket we were unable to spend more time in the colosseum. Had we had a ticket we could have checked out the forum on another day, as doing both in one day is a lot.
Basically have nothing to do with any insistent person who approaches you.
Do a self guided tour and take your time.
Of course the sites themselves are incredible.

title: Bien mais plus jolie en photo
text: Beaucoup plus jolie en photo que en vrai, à faire mais avec un guide pour que la visite soit plus intéressante. Le parcours est assez long, commencer tôt le matin pour avoir le temps de tout voir

title: Felt disingenuous but tour was good
text: We bought these tickets last minute after following signs for the ticket booth. We paid €40 each for a guided tour, other reviews have stated different prices for the same tour so be careful for that. Before the tour started we were told some story about how the police had contacted them the previous day saying they found some of the tour radios in the bin. So, for us to get the head sets we had to give a form of ID for the tour guide to keep as “precaution” so we wouldn’t steal the radios. This felt really disingenuous as we overheard someone say they needed to take ID from one of the other language groups with a different story. We should have been told this before paying the money for the tour as one couple didn’t have ID and were refused a headset. Inside the colosseum is obviously very busy and the tour guide had nothing to hold up so we couldn’t identify her, so many of us were lacking behind from the group struggling to find the guide. The tour itself was good and the tour guide was very knowledgeable. All in all 3* is generous as from the get go the whole thing felt a bit disingenuous but as we were last minute buying tickets this was our only way inside. We did get our ID back but be aware they will ask for this.

title: Entradas al coliseo ,foro Romano y monte palatino
text:
Quería hacer un comentario sobre los tickets que compramos en coopculture.
Cuidado con la hora de entrada al coliseo y demás ya que cuándo compras a las 2-45 no te da tiempo de verlo todo
Después de pagar 29€ por persona no pudimos ver el foro romano ni el monte palatino ya que cierran a las 4-30 y no dejan entrar a nadie más tarde de las 3-30 .
UNA ESTAFA!!!

title: attention arnaque => guide à rome
text:
j'avais booké un guide via le site "guide à rome" qui n'est jamais venu ! 
Aucune possibilité de se faire rembourser et des justifications alambiquées.

title: Beware of Covid
text:
Just tested positive for covid and tried to amend dates then received this

Dear Sir/Madam,
we are sorry to inform you that it is not possible to amend a reservation beyond 24 hours after the payment.  As stated in the conditions of purchase, services are not changeable or refundable except for reasons directly attributable to Coopculture.
Best regards.

Money wasted, surely they should change their t and c’s and not encourage people with covid to attend and spread the infection.

title: Appericate the history, rude tourists, not so much
text:
The Colosseum is beautiful, it really is and has amazing history, you can not take that away from there.

However, tours guides and people on tours do not care for you, they will block entrances/exits, they will blank you, shove you, my son got hit in the face with someone's backpack, no sorry, nothing, it was crazy in there and seemed more of a fight to find a space to appericate the history!

I am unsure why tours could not have a board up with images like the Vatican to explain parts, why there isn't staff around making sure that crowds more along or least not block places and why people are allowed massive backpacks in there and use them as a way to shove adults and children out their way! 

The queues were also confusing with people randomly lining up outside and not actually queuing for anything it turned out (lol), everyone seemed to join them.

We went during the evening in the end but not inside and it was stunning! Lite up, quiet, just lovely so I would recommend a night tour or be prepared even when you book in the late afternoon, its still very busy! 

I would definitely come back but not for a tour or to go inside, the outside around there is beautiful!

title: Inkompetentes Personal, nutzlose Website
text: Das was man hier sieht ist natürlich einmalig. Meine Bewertung bezieht sich auch nicht auf die eigentlichen Sehenswürdigkeiten, sondern auf das inkompetente Personal, die nutzlose Website und das intransparente Ticketangebot. Vor dem Colosseo Super Site Ticket kann man nur warnen. Man zahlt extra, aber die Sites sind entweder geschlossen oder nur mit langen Extrawartezeiten zu besuchen. Die Erläuterungen auf der Website dazu sind unbrauchbar und das Personal vor Ort ahnungslos.

title: Sito con la peggiore organizzazione in Italia
text: Abbiamo prenotato i biglietti sul sito ufficiale (molto confusionario e poco chiaro). Attenzione perché a differenza di tutti gli altri musei statali italiani, non è previsto l’accesso a 2 euro fino a 25 anni compiuti ma bensì fino a 24 compiti. Poco prima dell’ingresso ci sono numerosi rivenditori non ufficiali di biglietti (come è possibile che nessuno limiti questa cosa?!). Consiglio di visitarlo solo da fuori e dedicare questa ora di visita ad altro, in quanto all’interno c’è troppo gente e la visita diventa spiacevole.

title: Always book ahead.
text: I bought a 3 day Roma Pass. I was told that included entry into the Colosseum. When I got to the colosseum, I was denied entry because I had not booked. At no time was I informed that I had to book. I carefully checked for any conditions to entry. All time slots were taken up for that day and I was leaving Rome the next day.  As a result, I never got inside the Colosseum. Very disappointing.

title: Gestione folle, delusione.
text: Prenotiamo i biglietti con due settimane di anticipo online pagando la visita del Colosseo e dei fori imperiali. In due 36 euro. Arriviamo davanti l'ingresso 25 minuti prima dell'orario stabilito dal biglietto e ci fanno attendere. Nel frattempo entrano senza criterio gruppi a oltranza di più di 20 persone (ne ho contati davanti a me almeno 20). Finalmente entriamo. Controllo biglietto e via. Ma non si entra. Prima metal detector. Passata questa coda interminabile altra coda per controllare di nuovo i biglietti, mi sembra assurdo. Poi in coda per il percorso dove travolti da gruppi su gruppi non riusciamo a vedere quasi nulla. Stupore nella parte alta solo piccole porzioni aperte il resto tutto chiuso con transenne o cordoni. Per vedere dall'alto la parte bassa con tutti i gruppi a occupare le balaustre è stato impossibile. Scendiamo e finalmente riusciamo a fatica a guardare la parte sotto e scopriamo che siamo già fuori perché il percorso ci indica l'uscita. Totale visita con rispettive code 25 minuti. Le foto allegate parlano.

title: Excellent site. Terrible website and organization.
text:
We were really excited with the actual site, words are not enough.
But...
We got our tickets from the website and it was obvious kids do not have to pay. So we bought 2 tickets for adults priced for 36 euros, and 1 ticket for our daughter priced for 0 euros. We received the ticket on line, but there was no mention about the ticket of our daughter.
We went to the actual site and we were refused entrance because our daughter had no ticket.
We had to buoy line via a smart phone a new ticket, again for 0 euros, just to get a fresh bar code for our daughter, and then we were allowed to entry.
Indeed silly.

title: attention ce sont des voleurs
text:
Bonjour 
voici mon experience avec cette societe de voleurs.

J'ai commandé 2 fois 2 billets pour florence pour un montant de 100€ au total. Pour des raisons dont seule cette société est responsable ces billets ne m'ont jamais étés livrés mais mon compte lui à bien été débité de cette sommet. L'erreur etant humaine naivement je les ai contacté afin qu'ils me remboursent puisque la défaillance est de leur faute.

autrement dit "votre remboursement vous pouvez vous le carrere ans le c...."
Donc le terme voleur ou escroc si vous préférez est tout à fait approprié.
dommage que l'on ne puisse pas mettre une note en dessous de zéro.

A fuir absolument.

title: Do it on your own
text: Tour organisation was catastrophique. Bazar, different prices for the same service. Chaos. Don‘t  buy your ticket on the exit of the Metro station, it is more expensive.

title: Colosseum and Forum Tour
text: It’s worth seeing, along with the Forum but the crowds, even in mid-October, were horrendous. In fact, all of Rome was overrun with tourists.

title: Völlig überbewertet (falsche Reisezeit)
text:
Im Oktober nach Rom zu reisen erschien zunächst als gute Idee. Bereits früh morgens hatten wir 20 Grad und strahlenden Sonnenschein. Gegen späten Vormittag wurde die ewige Stadt von Touristen überschwemmt. Wir hatten ca. einen Monat zuvor Eintrittskarten für das Kolosseum gebucht. Es gab zu diesem Zeitpunkt lediglich Tickets für 14:45 Uhr. Leider war dieses stolze Denkmal des römischen Imperiums zu dieser Zeit derart überlaufen, dass man es nicht erleben, geschweige denn genießen konnte. Durch die Massen wurde jegliches Romgefühl zertrampelt. 
Das Furchtbarste waren dann aber diese Instagramtussen, die permanent und ohne Rücksicht ihre Haare durch die Gegend wirbelten und den Ort durch irrationale Posen ins Lächerliche ziehen.
Schade! War vor 20 Jahren mein Rom-Highlight.

title: Underwhelming despite it being the #1 thing I wanted to see in Rome.
text: Worth visiting, but meh. Underground is not worth it. Nothing much to really see that you can't see from above.

title: Marabunta de turistas
text: Junio  de 2022, ticket de entrada para visitar el anfiteatro a las 10:30 de la mañana y una marabunta de turistas,incluidos nosotros. A  parte de las visitas guiadas con cientos de personas que colapsan una auténtica maravilla de visita.

title: Crazy busy and chaotic
text:
Getting tickets is a nightmare and basically you cannot get them on the same day unless you pay twice as much and get scammed by GetYourGuide  - 79Euro instead of 32…well…
At least we got in - beautiful historic place, no question but I would not come during a weekend again…

title: Great venue, Dreadful ticket process.
text: While staying in Rome, I booked and paid online for two tickets to the Colosseum. Basic entry tickets - no guide. I received a text directing me to a website and this then presented me with a voucher. Staff at the Colosseum entrance told me that the voucher was not valid for entry and I had to find a GetYourGuide representative to convert this into the actual ticket. I spent an hour looking for this non-existent person. The directions from your website were completely useless. Eventually a ticket including a valid barcode appeared on my phone and I was able to visit the Colosseum over an hour after our allotted time slot (15:30). The whole process was extremely stressful and nearly ruined our day. How can you treat customers like this? An explanation would be welcome.

title: GRANDIOSE EXTERIEUREMENT
text: Très beau monument en extérieur, majestueux, l intérieur pourrait mieux être mis en valeur, avec toutes les nouvelles technologies, le film proposé est sans intérêt, dommage. Pas de plan donné aux guichets,

title: Disappointed no tickets
text: WE did not book in advance and there were no tickets when we wanted to visit. Very disappointing ! They sayy tickets sell out more than 30 days before your visit !!!

title: Visita male organizzata
text: Ho prenotato online la visita completa. Non vedendo nessun altro al punto di raccolta indicato e dopo aver chiesto conferma per ben due volte, sono arrivati a prendermi di corsa e in ritardo dicendomi che mi  avevano dimenticato. Vengo unita ad un gruppo con una guida in inglese, per fortuna che parlo la lingua, per poi scoprire che erano un tour privato e io quindi un’intrusa?  Mi aspettavo decisamente di meglio

title: Just like you expected (but a bit smaller)
text: Basically it’ll be exactly as you expected but surrounded by looky looky guys and maybe a bit smaller. The entrance is super hard to find, you randomly have to go into the metro, but entrance itself is refreshingly efficient. All completely fine once you get in, but nothing special either really. It’s essentially derelict but I’m sure it was lovely.

title: Great
text: Great place to go to but over crowded and uncomfortable. Found it hard to pay attention to the history and keep up with my tour guide.

title: It is ok to purchase tickets and negate getting tour guide unless you know someone trusted and well informative
text:
Buy for yourself tickets or get a trusted and only trusted tour guide. 
You can get inside the colosseum with your family (if you have kids or yourself is under 25, perhaps you would be requested to show your identity at the hut for the security), you would enjoy the scenery. There are projectors and other signs and boards which can give you a comprehensive overview about what you you are looking for in informative way. Of course, if you like the Roman history, then better off getting for yourself a trusted tour guide or Google or read some books.
If you don't feel that you got robbed off, then I wouldn't recommend to ask for any tour guide waiting at the gate, sometimes they are available online as well.
First, these people are sure that you wouldn't be able to review their performance which is terrible.
Second, they offer you the same price as any verified tour guide, which is unfair.
Third, these people wouldn't really care about you, only they mind the money, once you reach the gates of the garden, they will disappear.
Eventually, I wasn't happy with the attitude of the tour guide, he was showing off a lot, not well presented,  no manners at all.
Apologies, I didn't want to say it but the Egyptian tour guide was not the best choice today, I think his name is Amir, with somw help from indians ans romanians plus italian manager.
I don't know their names so I mentioned their nationalities hopefully you would find better.

title: No prebooked tickets vell in advance , no Colosseum
text: WE only learned too late that you have to book tickets on line and tickets sell out days before you visit. We only had one Saturday afternoon, probably the busiest moment to visit and the tickets were long gone. WE visited from outside. Whart a pity !

title: i miss him
text: I am extremely disheveled. Went to Rome, and the colosseum was broken. it’s been this way for years, and they still haven’t fixed it. i don’t understand why, and it makes me very upset. secondly, they killed my great great great great great great great great great great great great great great grandfather, julius caesar, here. i have decided to haunt cassius’ ghost, because they behavior was simply unacceptable. on top of that, they killed my other greta great great great great great great great grandfather here, pompeii here as well. on top of that, there was no roof, and the ghost of napoleon bone apart mugged me here. no one did anything. the people here throw mustard at you, and try to jill you with javelins. very disappointed.

title: Great historical value. The rest is awful
text: This is history! The big one! Hence 3 points out of 5. Would have given all marks, but there is only one and need to include all aspects. So 5 for great historical interest. I mean, you need to see it! After you've read about it. All the rest is bad. The long lines of tourists, inside and outside, police, no parking. Actually the building itself is somewhat of a disappointment, as some restauration would really do it good. Look at St Maria in Firenze...

title: Amazing structure
text:
Incredible structure but the overall experience was not brilliant. We unfortunately hasn’t booked tickets in advance and despite queuing for some time it sold out - our own fault. Numerous ticket tours outside the coliseum and pushy street sellers. The area itself is full of graffiti and rubbish and the smell of sewage was completely over powering. I do think this would all be worth it to see inside and round it though, but it worth being aware of the issue we faced so you don’t have the same ones.

We got the train from Naples and the train was fantastic - clean, punctual and easy to book

title: Kaartje coloseum
text:
Het coloseum is zeker het bezoeken waard
Maar kijk waar jeje tickets haald via tripadviser zijn ze 2x zo duur je kunt ze beter via de officiële site bestellen.

title: Disappointing
text: Entry by q code only which for some reason we were not able to access. Also tour guides can be quite insistent that we join their tour. Gave up eventually and had a walk round the outside before moving on. Disappointing

title: Nice and interesting place with zero sales culture
text:
The 24h ticket is not true, you have certain time to enter. 
Don’t buy the last admission ticket if you don’t want to run through the place without any deeper interest. 
We have been pushed through the place and forced out by armed police officers even before the actual closing time. 
Very bad experience with a small child. 
However the place is nice and interesting, another extra half hour (1.5 in total) would be enough to see. 
Understand the rules of the place but really badly communicated to the public

title: Truffa legalizzata
text: Ho prenotato la visita ai sotterranei pagando una generosa cifra per cosa? La visita non è con una guida ma con un accompagnatore che si limita a dirti di scaricare l’app e arrangiarti ( nei sotterranei internet non prende). Credetemi ve la sconsiglio vivamente. Fatevi un biglietto normale per vedere il Colosseo senza full Experience o proposte simili.

title: Trash can
text: This place is trash. Why couldn't they just fix it. It has a big break which is just unacceptable!!!

title: A mob scene
text: Too many tourists allowed in at one time.  Only 1 guide for 20 tourists.  Little accommodation for those w mobility limitations; only 1 elevator for the entire site.

title: Really?
text: It's obviously impressive from the outside, but I can't say the same for the inside. Maybe I did something wrong. I had a much better time strolling around the Agora.

title: Joli sans plus
text:
C'est un monument historique mais dommage que les billets sont chers 
Donc j'ai admiré ce monument que de l'extérieur 
Je conseille tout de même ça serait dommage de le rater

title: Miseria e Nobiltà
text:
Il sito archeologico è ovviamente ricco di storia e di fascino. Sembra di sognare.
Chi ti riporta bruscamente nella più miserabile realtà sono le torme di abusivi che cercano di venderti di tutto. Fastidiosi, molesti, aggressivi, soprattutto i bagarini che fingono di aiutarti con promesse di entrata garantita rifilandoti inevitabili "sòle" a prezzi triplicati. Davvero non so come il Comune e l'Organizzazione del Parco possano tollerare una simile situazione.

title: Servicio deficiente en la edición. De los ticket
text: Están las Ventanillas para emitir los ticket pero no funcionan; incluso esta el perdinal para venderlas al precio oficial del gobierno , pero te hacen sacarlas por la web en donde la página funciona mal!  está congestionada y no logras poder emitir la compra de los ticket , terminado por comprarla a los revendedores que son se agencia de turismo al doble del precio oficial.

title: Oui mais…
text:
Si vous souhaitez avoir les prix réels de cette visite, rendez vous sur le site officiel. Beaucoup de sites internet sont des arnaques avec de grosses différences de prix avec le prix réel. 
La visite en elle même est super. Audio guide nuls.

userLocation.name: Pointe Noire, Republic of the Congo

title: ***Avoid if you look visibly muslim!***
text:
We did the tour of the colleseum a while ago now. The tour was fab. However what spoilt it and what remains my memory of Rome is the racist men dressed as gladiators outside the colloseum. 

We finished our tour and were taking photos outside when one of the above mentioned men asked my husband what he was doing there, calling him "Bin Laden" and that the US were after him. It makes me sick. We were so shocked at the time we didn't even think to answer back, never mind complain to authorities!

The recent rumours about racism here are true. Thought I would add my 2 pence.

title: Pas possible de visiter 😒
text:
Lors de notre arrivée des files d’attente, pas de guichet pour acheter des billets.
Le personnel vous indique qu’il faut acheter les billets en scannant un QR code et acheter en ligne sauf qu’on ils sont déjà tous vendu 😬
A ce moment là un rabatteur nous a dit qu’il pourrait nous faire entrer pour le prix de 100€ (deux adultes et un adolescent).
Sa sentait l’arnaque, nous avons décliné l’offre.
Il y a au pied du Colisée des tas de vendeurs à la sauvette et des rabatteurs, pas de service d’ordre pour surveiller tout ce mic mac, dommage 😤.
Déçu de ne pas pouvoir visiter le Colisée, nous sommes allés visiter le Forum, très belle visite et plein de choses à voir.

title: Bad experience with Viatar!  They canceled 30 min before the experience!
text: I purchased a “skip the line tour” that started  at 9:30… Viator, booked thru trip advisor canceled at 8:50am as I was standing in front of the building to pick up my ticket!  -  I walked across the street and bought a new ticket.  They then tried to rebook me- TOO LATE!

title: Only with a guide
text:
Ok. Colosseum? Absolutly ! 
BUT, if your already coming to Rome, do yourself a favour and book a tour in advance , with a guide, with skip the line, with the underground. Why? Because otherwise the "skip the line ticket is not skip the line". You are walking around educating yourself with google or a book you have and it's just not the same. Spend that money and later eat a big Mac to compensate for the expense. You will not be sorry.

title: Día perdido
text: Muy mal servicio. Hicimos la reserva del tour an español y nos anotaron en i goles. Y no lo pudimos hacer . Sigo esperando una devolución y no me a llegado

title: Bella scoperto
text:
Visita effettuata domenica approfittando anche della gratuità del biglietto.
Attesa lunga che però è valsa la vista di questo colosso!

title: A must see at least once in your life.
text: The "underground" tour area was closed during our visit. It would have added to our experience to have been able to go there.

title: Attention à la réservation en ligne
text: Entrée refusée après l'heure réservée. Certes 1 h de retard mais un peu de discernement et d'apathie avec les touristes étrangers qui ne connaissent pas les transports pour s'y  rendre ou qui perdent du temps dans une visite précédente serait le minimum.

title: Deludente
text: Se devo valutare la visita al Colosseo, diciamo fra il cinque e il sei. Consiglio vivamente risparmiare i soldi e vederlo da fuori perché dentro non è niente di che. Se vuoi vedere i camerini e gli spogliatoi devi pagare un biglietto aggiuntivo che non spesso trovi.  Con le audioguide non ci capisci niente e come ho detto senza questo pass aggiuntivo fai il giro circolare dell'anfiteatro e stop. Da fuori però è uno spettacolo per gli occhi.

title: déçue
text: Je trouve que le colisée ne vaut pas sa réputation, il est mal entretenu, ses abords sont sales et il faut être très vigilants aux gens qui vous accostent car il y a beaucoup de pique pocket.

title: The doormen at the entrance were rude, unhelpful racist and misogynistic.
text: Once upon a time this place was filled with brave Gladiators.  As a visitor, today you will find incompetence racist, misogynist, undertrained, aggressors targeting British visitors.  One particular doorman threatened  a brown woman with his martial arts!! He should be sacked. Unfortunately when I raised this with his supervisor he was just as inclined as his subordinate. We won’t be back. But will anybody care enough to investigate? No, nothing has changed.  Many fear change and some fear more than most.

title: ''A monument with bad memories from the city's past''
text: The visiting was easy. But it seems that the profit of the tickets let the people (huge numbers) to wait in queue. To many tickets in the same hour!!!

title: Só para conhecer.
text:
Uma obra que vale a pena conhecer, devido a história que guarda o local. 
Um pouco cansativo no calor devido ao percurso de andar e subir.

title: Pesima
text:
Por favor tener cuidado con esta empresa Headout, yo compré entrada coliseo + acceso arena+ foro romano y monte paliatino , solo entre al coliseo , ya que la agencia que nos hacia el tour no hacía acceso a la Arena , fue a reclamar a la taquilla como me dijo la guía, en la taquilla me dijeron que era cosa de Headout, entre unos y otros llamando ,por chat etc , perdí más de una hora, cuando después quise entrar a las otras atracciones no me dejaron entrar porque mi grupo ya había entrado , le envío correo a Headout para que por lo menos me reembolse lo no utilizado y esta es su respuesta: yo pagué 114 euros y me devuelven 30 dólares + 50% en vales de descuentos para comprar a través de ellos , esto es una vergüenza. AUNQUE NO ME DEVUELTAN NADA PIR FAVOR NO COMPRAR NADA A TRAVÉS DE ELLOS, SON UN TIMO
. Gracias

title: Aldri mer Italia
text: Vi trodde vi hadde kjøpt 24 timers pass fra klokken 15:00 søndag til 15:00 mandag. Vi kom 20 minutter for sent (altså 15:20, vi trodde vi kunne komme når vi ville) og ble avvist, selv om vi hadde betalt nesten 1000 kroner for å komme forbi køen! Det var lite eller ingen skilting ved Colosseum og vi brukte lang tid på å orientere oss og komme oss til riktig inngang (de 1000 kronene var ikke vel anvendt), da vi likevel ble stående i en laaang kø i 35 grader! Vår erfaring er at Italienerne snakker dårlig eller ingen engelsk, de ønsker ikke å hjelpe og når man spør om hjelp til å tolke menyer som KUN står på italiensk, så får man beskjed om at «det står jo i menyen». Folkens, ikke dra til Italia! Bruk pengene på andre og mer turistvennlige land!!

title: Elendig service
text:
Kjøpte inngangspass for 24 timer( trodde vi)
Vi fikk ikke engang komme inn, det viste seg at det sto et klokkeslett på billetten vi hadde kjøpt online vi visste ikke dette og møtte 25 min senere enn hva det sto der.( vi trodde vi hadde 24 timers pass)
Denne skylden legger jeg på reisebyrået getyourtickets samt vaktene på colosseum, arrogant og fryktelig lite serviceminded! Aldri mer Roma

title: July visit
text: We found this was badly organised inside it but it is worth seeing.  Also looks great from the outside !

title: Not mad but disappointed
text: Not sure what all the hype was about bc we waited in line for 30 minutes and were patted down twice just to see a bunch of broken rocks. There was no AC and not a single person would share their water after we found out there were no fountains. Although, the tour wasn’t a complete flop, we were able to see a young child fight his mother as she took away his iPad. It wasn’t the gladiator vs lion action we were looking for but was the most exciting part of the trip. Overall, the place was filthy, crusty, and dusty. Could use maintenance and a good deep clean. Would give 1/5 but the child was entertaining. 2/5 final review.

title: Kind of boring
text: It's not necessary to see this from the inside -- if you've seen a roman arena before, you've seen this one...

title: Do not buy Viator tickets or guide
text:
We reserved Viator guide for colosseum and pantheon. The guide did not show up. It was our last day in Rome, we were lucky to get tickets without guide. We had to run around Rome to get these tickets, ruined our day. 
DO NOT BUY THINGS FROM VIATOR, UNRELIABLE!!

title: Great guide, awful audio equipment
text: Our guide was great, but the quality of the equipment was awful. Changed our headphones 2 times and we still were not able to get a good audio during the tour. We struggled to follow many of the stories from the guide. We won't be recommending it to anyone

title: Very bad experience with Headout Rome!!
text:
We took tickets for the Colosseum and the Roman forum with the audio guide option. When we arrived at the Colosseum, they told us our tickets do not include audioguides and that we should pay them extra.
The only information mentioned in Headout’s website was that the audio guide is offered by Headout and not the Colosseum, and THAT WAS IT. There was utterly no other information where to find this audioguide, not in the website, nor on their app, nothing! 
Even the people who work at the Colosseum had no idea where to find them. 
Eventually we took the tour without the audioguides even though we paid for three! 
We were extremely disappointed by this scam!

title: Pas à la hauteur
text: Le système audio guide est une véritable supercherie on vous remet un appareil inutile qui fonctionne mal avec des grésillements

title: Απογοήτευση
text: Απογοήτευση δεν αξίζει το εισιτήριο του ούτε τον χρόνο του , έχει αλλά τόσα υπέροχα αξιοθέατα που αξίζουν πραγματικά να επισκεφτείς , μόνο από έξω κ τελος

title: Abbastanza un cantiere a cielo aperto!
text:
Emozionante da visitare, ma molte impalcature.
Troppa gente seppur con visite su prenotazione.
Colle Palatino e Fori Romani (inclusi nel biglietto) da sponsorizzare meglio ma meritano!

title: Orari non specificati al momento della prenotazione
text: Specificare orari di ingresso nel sito coopculture. Visita al Colosseo e via dei fori imperiali programmata con i biglietti on line. Biglietto difficile da trovare, ultimo orario disponibile ore 18 peccato che alle 18.15 chiudono. Quindi ho pagato 18€ per una visita completa Colosseo e fori imperiali ma non ne ho potuto usufruire. Domani si torna a casa quindi del biglietto 24 ire non me ne faccio niente

title: Très bel endroit mais beaucoup de monde, c'est la folie !
text: Du monde, du monde et encore du monde! J'ai pas l'habitude des endroits hyper touristique, c'est un peu épuisant mais le lieux est assez fou tout de même !

title: Está bien, pero decepciona un poco.
text: Sinceramente, algo decepcionante, quizás por todo el bombo que se le da. Está bien, es bonito, pero en mi opinión hay cosas mucho mejores en Roma.

title: Confusing official park website, denied Colosseum entry despite park membership purchased.
text:
We purchased a PARCO Membership for the family for Euro 80 that, according to their official park website wwwcoopcultureit , would provide "Unlimited admission for 12 months from the date of activation to the Palatine, Roman Forum and Colosseum area". To our surprise, this wasn't the case. The ticket office denied us entry to the Colosseum. Even with park membership, we still would need a reservation. So no Colosseum for us. We could still visit the forum and Palatine, but the experience remained frustrating.

They need to update their website providing clear information to travelers.

title: Wäre sehr schön
text: Es wäre sehr schön, wenn nicht überall Bauabschrankungen stehen würden. Diese verschandeln das ganze Bild.

title: Worth seeing outside, inside a little less so
text: The outside of the Colosseum is very impressive: it's imposing, it's a symbol of ancient Rome, and you can't quite get a sense of it unless you visit. The inside, however, didn't seem worth the money paid to get in: the interior looks like a large football stadium

title: Person with disabilities
text: The view is impressive and the information provided by the guide is very good.  but there is no good communication between the guide and the window.  The window told us that the person in a wheelchair does not pay entrance and that the tickets will be provided by the guide.  It wasn't like that, the group stopped because they wouldn't let us pass without the tickets.  the group wasted time waiting for the matter to be resolved.  At one point they picked up the headphones of the person in a wheelchair and a helper so that they would leave the group and the others would continue on their way.  Thank God it didn't go too far because the group decided to wait to resolve the situation instead of continuing.  bad time that could have been avoided

title: Rimasto molto deluso,e pertanto x poterlo visitare avrei dovuto aspettare 2 giorni anche con la prenotazione on-line...tutto al
text: Mi dispiace dirlo ma purtroppo non è più come una volta il degrade circostante il monuments ne deturpa notevolmente il fascinating,e poi...I biglietto solo on-line

title: This is the biggest disappointment of my life.
text: Inside, that Colosseum was renovated million times. Here is just nothing special or historical. That place is filthy. I am wounder that this touristic place which nobody cleans appropriately. It is just crap. When you are inside, you do not feel anything. You do not feel that it is something great and historical. You feel that it is some kind of tourist shop. That's all.

title: magnifique mais quelle saleté !
text: monument magnifique, magique mais hélas gaché par la saleté des lieux, poubelles qui débordent, papiers, plastiques, bouteilles ! indigne d'un endroit aussi touristique, avec en plus les vendeurs à la sauvette malgré la Police qui patrouille bien au frais dans leurs véhicules !!!

title: Huge historical site
text: Definitely this place has great place in Rome history, but it was completely ruined by the Romans. For me "Arena de Verona" looks more interesting than "Colosseo"

title: Roma
text:
Caldo e fila.  Bellissimo ma
Lunghe file sotto il dile esperienza media mi aspettavo di più. Consiglio in estate portare acqua da bere

title: Tour of the colessuem and palatine hill
text: The guide was very hard to understand because her English was poor. The website said there were going to be 16 people in pur group. Instead we had 40. Big difference! I don't suggest this. Look into something else. Plus we didn't get to see as much as we'd like at the Colessiem. Not worth the high price.

title: Un tanto decepcionante
text: Como suele ocurrir cuando algo te ilusiona mucho,cuando lo vi me pareció más feo de lo que esperaba.Al entrar también lo esperaba más grande.Mejor ir con guía ,que te explica muchos detalles ,y te dice como era originalmente.Fuimos en junio ,y hace bastante calor ,mejor contratar con tiempo y elegir las horas más tempranas.

title: No comprar en HEADOUT
text: Hemos comprado entradas al coliseo Romano con audioguia, me confirmaron las entradas y que enviaban la audioguia por correo antes de entrar, JAMÁS llegó el correo y nunca me respondieron cuál fue la causa , nos tocó volver a comprar dentro del coliseo.  Muy mal servicio HEADOUT

title: Rome -  not for everyone
text: Gross, dirty, bathrooms not suitable for a dog. Hustlers on every corner. Look at it driving by. Do not go in. If people only knew - broken down building, best seen on tv.

title: Dissapointed , discusted and not worth it !
text: The most TRASH place on the planet ! Coloseum is fantastik but the trash around it ?! Nobody can clean that trash ? Biggest attraction in Rome with so many turists and nobody to clean all the botles and trash everywere ? Not worth my money and my time ! Go to Tenerife people ! Cheaper and much much better !

title: Don’t be even a min late
text: I read there’s only one due to the fact that the people that are running these tours are incredibly rude. We got there late and we still try to go and see if there was possibly another tour we could join later even if our group had to be split up. She was so unhelpful and told us that we are out of luck we waste their money and there’s nothing she can do for us..

title: Not worth your time
text: As with most popular attractions you expect it to be busy; it was during our visit but was made worse by all the scaffolding for the on going work which hid a lot of the site. Don’t waste your time and money. Not much to see.

title: DONT BOOK WITH MEA TOURS
text: Booked skip the line to colosseum forum and pantheon. Sounded good when we arrived we were expected to pay €25 for ticket to colosseum even though had confirmation saying it was included wasted 1.5 hours while guide tried to say 12 people booked on tour couldn’t go without paying this MEA TOURS RIP OFF DONT BOOK they don’t even have an office and no one will speak to me very surprised Tripadvisor have this on site

title: Tour of the colosseum
text: I visited the colosseum around midday with my friend, having booked the guided tour the day before through the 'Parco Colosseo' app.  Once we entered the colosseum through the main entrance, we were given a wristband and headset and directed to the tour meeting point. The guided tour felt quite brief and more detail could have been provided, but it did enable us to visit the underground system.

title: Colosseum beskrivelse
text: Historisk og spændende. Enormt interessant og enormt omfattende byggeri, men lidt forfalden og ødelagt. Så en gennemsnitlig oplevelse

title: Très déçus...
text:
Évidemment, restez insensible devant un tel édifice paraît inenvisageable...
Environ 2000 ans et toujours debout !!!
Malheureusement, le génie humain doit faire face au mauvais côté de notre espèce, à savoir les incivilités !!!
Les alentours du Colisée sont un véritable dépotoir !!!! Navrant.

title: So badly organised
text: I walked to the colosseum and tourist guides directed me the completely wrong way to the entrance making me panic I would be late for my Headout guided tour. Luckily I was on time so I asked a member of staff where Headout tours meeting point was. His attitude was horrible basically saying “I don’t know & I don’t care”. To add to this I couldn’t find the Headout tour guide anywhere so they didn’t even check their list of people booked on for the day and just started without me despite me being there on time. The colosseum must not have a maximum capacity because it is heaving and hard to enjoy any spots. Headout is a scam!

title: Visite décevante
text: Le Colisée est un monument incontournable mais sans visite guidée les explications et les panneaux sont sommaires. Inutile de prendre un billet « full expérience «  avec accès à l’arène car on voit tout aussi bien celle ci en suivant le parcours classique. De manière générale les options sur les billets comme l’option « super »ne valent pas la peine : soit les sites additionnels sont fermés soit ils sont accessibles avec un billet classique.

title: Pagare per non vedere nulla
text: La gestione di questo tesoro storico e veramente pessima, ti obbligano a prenotare e pagare in anticipo tramite internet quindi ti aspetti che ci sia un accesso regolamentato nel numero sapendo quanti biglietti sono stati venduti ma purtroppo non è cosi. Masse di persone stipate come sardine che ti spingono da ogni parte. L'impossibilita di poter ammirare e apprezzare questo storico monumento fa male al cuore. Abbiamo monumenti bellissimi ma se vengono gestiti in questa maniera dobbiamo vergognarci.

title: bello
text:
l antica Roma è sempre affascinante e stupenda.
purtroppo la mia esperienza diventa molto negativa perchè il traffico, i continui omini a offrirti qualunque cosa, i costi alti, le buche!!!

title: Not as expected
text:
When i arrived they mentioned that I should by my ticket online, the office ticket unfortunately can’t help you by buying the ticket even if you have problem in their website.

I tried to buy the ticket around 5 times and each time i got blank page when i chose pay button. I explained the issue to the guy in the gate and he directed me to the ticket office.
But the ticket officer provide me phone number that I should contact to solve the issue. 

For me it was wasting time, try to book your ticket before you come since there’s no technical support and the place so crowded  by the people.

title: nice
text: nice to see all the thoughts that went into making the colosseum. we had a tour, not sure with wich company. i saw several documentaries before comming... so i was excited to see the lift... or the drainage for when arena was filled with water, or pipe lines for water... that was not included. so i am not sure if its the tourist company issue... or the open areas of the colosseum.

title: May the 4th not be with you (in Rome)
text:
Booked a tour package to see the Vatican and Colosseum in one day. We went to see the Vatican early in the morning and didn’t have any issues getting in. However, when we went to the Colosseum later that afternoon we were turned away at the gate because our tickets read the wrong date….a date that was a week past our departure from Rome. We made sure to book both tickets for the same day, as why would I would to waste 120€ to see the Colosseum AFTER we returned home. My friends had also double checked the date to confirm everything was in order. I emailed them and they refused to cancel, or even amend our tickets for the following day. They were completely apathetic to our situation. It’s a shame that a tour company who represents such a historic part of Roman history refuses to assist in situations such as this. Now these tickets will go to waste, as four less people will be able to see the Colosseum on May 4th at  2:45 PM. Look a little empty? It’s because we’re not there. 

Make sure you triple check everything before booking with this company.

title: Mala organización, buen guía de Tour
text:
Muy mala la organización del check in, nos daban mal la información yendo de un lado al otro (gente del mismo tour). La chica del check in, nos trató de muy mala forma.
El guía Max 10 puntos.

title: Bof
text:
Nou avons êtes très déçus. Certes c’est magnifique. Mais très mal organisé, trop de monde. 
Aucune explication si nous ne prenez pas de guide.

title: Cancelled
text: Arrived this morning Colosseum only to be told there was no guide to give us the tour so we missed out on both tours with no guide . hoping now to get a full refund from TripAdvisor and the third party city tours.

title: Vergogna!
text:
Tralasciando l'indiscutibile importanza del monumento, resto allibito dall' IGNOBILE gestione del parco Colosseo.
Acquisto i biglietti 3 settimane prima e organizzo il viaggio in famiglia con mio figlio.
Incredulo, mi ritrovo l'accesso interdetto per la Via Crucis di 6 ore dopo senza che nessuno si sia degnato di avvisare e senza aver nessuna possibilità di riprogrammare la visita per la totale assenza di contatti disponibili.
Seguono informazioni contradittorie su ipotetici rimborsi biglietti, mail di reclamo rimbalzate più volte. Una VERGOGNA.
Probabile che i bagarini che operano indisturbati in loco (!!!) siano più onesti.

title: Visita al Colosseo...allucinante.
text:
Visita all'interno del Colosseo. I biglietti non si possono acquistare in loco, ma solo on line e non c'è mai disponibilità, ci sono dei tizi che ti offrono un tour guidato con delle agenzie al doppio del prezzo. Loro hanno i biglietti evidentemente già comperati. Abbiamo subito il ricatto, e la guida ci ha portato dentro e ci ha mollato praticamente all'ingresso. Nome Stefano, un serbo vestito di bianco. L'agenzia che ha comperato il biglietto si chiama WALKS SIGHTSEEING LTD.
Complimenti a Della Valle e Franceschini che gli ha regalato il Colosseo.

title: “Ojo con la entrada de  experiencia completa”
text: Si compras la entrada de experiencia completa de dos días que te incluye el Coliseo, Palatino, Foro Romano, Foros imperiales, etc..  Tienes que saber que puedes entrar al Coliseo y al Palatino en un día y al otro visitar el resto de lugares. Porque no da tiempo a visitar todo en el mismo día y adentro no hay ningún lugar para poder comer por lo que estás obligado a salir y una vez que te lean el código de barra en algún lugar que no sea Coliseo ya no puedes volver a entrar al resto de monumentos. Esto no lo explican cuando compras las entradas y me imagino que sea motivo de mala experiencia de muchos visitantes.

title: Pessima organizzazione
text:
Prenotare un mese in anticipo la visita tramite  coopculture per poi arrivare a Roma  nell'orario stabilito e scoprire che era chiuso e visita annullata perché dovevano sgomberare l'area per la viacrucis di 6 ore dopo è stato assolutamente deludente. 
Che fregatura!
Che brutta figura di fronte ai tanti turisti stranieri increduli!
Bastava non emettere prenotazioni per quella data/fascia oraria, e non ci credo non lo sapessero prima.
Ovviamente il Colosseo rimane un qualcosa di incredibilmente affascinante e unico,
peccato per l'organizzazione deludente.

title: Exceptionnel, agoraphobes s'abstenir
text:
Le lieu, l'histoire, les expositions sont exceptionnels. Prévoir d'y aller à l'ouverture tôt le matin pour avoir un peu moins de monde.
Attention aux escaliers marches hautes, pour les jambes et genoux fragiles il y a un ascenseur, Prenez-le pour ne pas vous faire mal.
Veillez aux enfants pour ne pas les perdre.
Vu exceptionnelle sur le forum romain.

title: Poorly organized.
text:
Schlecht aufbereitet und organisiert bzw. gekennzeichnet, Audioguide funktionierte nicht und Mitarbeiter konnten nicht helfen. Schade, das ein so spannender Ort nicht besser dargestellt wird. 
Am Ende haben uns youtube-Videos zum gesehenen mehr erhellt.

title: Un incontournable peu mis en valeur
text: Un incontournable mais qui pourrait être nettement mieux mis en valeur. Le nombre de touristes n'aide pas. Il vaut mieux prendre un guide pour vraiment apprécier l'endroit.

title: 2-day Colosseum Forum Palatine pass-buyer beware!
text:
The Colosseum, the Forum, and the Palatine Hill are remarkable sites in Rome and well worth your time and money.
That said, my wife and I bought 2-day "Full Experience" tickets including visits to the Colosseum, the Forum, and the Palatine. We visited the Colosseum and the Forum on the first day. 
We returned the second day to visit the Palatine Hill and  were astonished to be denied admission. We learned that our ticket covered ONE entrance to the Colosseum (which we knew) and ONE entrance to the COMBINED Forum and Palatine. The second day of our ticket was useless. Pleading ignorance and seeking accommodation for our misunderstanding with the person attending the gate was useless.
What this means is the only schedule for which a 2-day ticket makes sense is if you intend to visit the Colosseum on one day and the Forum and Palatine together on another.
Even the language on the Coopculture website is confusing. It reads "One entrance to the Colosseum..." (ok) and "An open entrance to the...Roman-Palatine Forum...". 
This is just outrageously stupid packaging by the management of the sites and pointlessly bureaucratic behavior by the gate attendant. Needless to say, we left that second day both disappointed and furious.

title: Manic!
text: A must see in Rome and last time we visited was great however…..too many tour groups and too many guides sending you this way and that, The Colosseum itself is amazing but the experience is baffling, the guides send you through the bookshop presumably to spend more money? My own personal experience was ruined by a very rude and aggressive tall guy at the bottom of the elevators. Shouting “wait!”, rolling his eyes and then adding “I am talking to you”….he also directed us out of The Colosseum when we in fact had more to see. Avoid the elevator and this guy….

title: Bit disappointed
text: I was looking forward to this visit but he sheer volume of people at the site was almost overwhelming which couple with pandemic and security measure made the entry very protracted. The building itself is spectacular - but visit off peak !

title: Head Out are rip-offs
text:
This is a warning to AVOID THE COMPANY HEAD OUT when buying tickets to the Colosseo. They come to the top of Google searches - and you pay more than the set price, with a promise to 'Skip' the queue. But there are hardly any queues in Covid times. And the extra charge is exorbitant.

Another thing - the audio tour promised as part of the package never came through, and I ended up using the one provided by the Colosseo. 

The Colosseo is an incredible place, and a must-see, but go in the morning so you have time to see Palatine Hill and the Fori Romani as well because these are also must-sees, and you cannot buy a ticket separately. And do NOT book with Head Out. Tickets should only be €16. Be sure to go directly to the link for Parco Colosseo. 

Head Out also promise a discount on your next trip with them - but this never materialised. Go to The Vatican Museums to see my review of what happened with them there. Truly professional scammers. Very sophisticated - a different website for each monument, in multiple languages.

title: Desagradable
text: Tras contratar un tour con Guía sufrimos enormes colas con el  personal que trabaja en el Coliseo desagradable, prepotentes y  muy incómodos para el turista,  lo peor fue el personal de la empresa de seguridad tratando a gritos y agresividad a los turistas solo por no entenderles.

title: Non fate la full experience
text:
Abbiamo prenotato per la full experience con i sotterranei e alla fine ci hanno detto di no perché sul sito pc (che è diverso dal cellulare) dovevi selezionare se vedere solo l'arena o anche i sotterranei.
Inizia la giornata con grossa delusione.
Finita la visita si passa ai fori anche qui altra delusione.
A quanto pare la lista dei posti experience è tutta fuffa e tutti entrano ovunque, che abbiano pagato più o meno.
I posti sono entrambi meravigliosi ma questa cosa ci ha lasciati veramente delusi.

title: Vergogna
text:
Vendere SOLO i biglietti online con DIRITTO DI PRENOTAZIONE di 2 Euro a testa quando sono già con un piede dentro al Colosseo è vergognoso. Prenotazione di che? Che sono già qui davanti? E se non ho la carta di credito ? E se ho il telefono scarico ? Alla fine, dopo un’ora sotto la pioggia, con una bambina, me li ha fatti l’addetto alla biglietteria mosso a compassione…
Sul fascino del luogo nulla da dire ovviamente…

title: Poor organisation Collosseum
text:
Pff what a poor organisation around the collosseum. Hundreds of people asking  ;do you have a ticket?? 
Just get some ticketoffices around the stadium and let the police get rid of all these idiots!

title: Pas de coupe circuit sauf pour la visite des arènes mais décevant.
text:
Il était dit 13h pour le démarrage de la visite en fait on a du rejoindre 3/4 d'heure plus tard un guide qui n 'a pas semblé très à l'aise. On regrette son manque de précisions sur l histoire des monuments,  la visite du mont Palatin a été écourtée peut être pour rattraper le temps perdu...l option visite de l'arène n'a servi à  rien. On voit aussi bien depuis le 1er étage. Un groupe espagnol qui avait démarre à  l'heure est resté bien plus tard que notre groupe de français..
Donc regret 'avoir opter pour cette visite. J'ai la conviction que le guide vert aurait été plus informatif. Est ce que le guide officiel était défaillant et du coup on a eu une visite allégée?

title: Tanta storia
text: Abbiamo prenotato i biglietti on line per le 11,30 ma giunti al Colosseo ci hanno detto di fare la fila con tutti gli altri e che l'orario di prenotazione non garantisce l'ingresso all'ora indicata. Dopo la fila per l'ingresso e quella per green pass e sicurezza, siamo entrati in quello che sicuramente è uno dei monumenti più belli e pieni di storia della nostra bella Italia. Purtroppo però, il mancato rispetto degli orari di prenotazione crea una calca che non garantisce il rispetto delle norme covid e neppure un'esperienza di visita ottimale. Con il biglietto è incluso l'ingresso ai fori Romani (non Imperiali) che richiedono almeno 3 ore per la visita. Buon viaggio

title: Absolutely Dictatorship
text: Purchased my ticket for 23rd and although it says, valid for 24 hours from first time use, I wasn't allowed to enter at first. That their website doesn't permit date and time changes, based on availability is also quite insane. Truth to be told, I had to do a PCR test and this was confirmed after the ticket has been booked. Member of staff asked me to book it again, and pay again. I moved my PCR test and entered, but this is rather unacceptable for those with unforseen circumstances during COVID-19 pandemics.

title: Spoiled with ticket sellers and tour companies
text: Unbelievable structure, unfortunately the experience is a bit tarnished with all the tours and ticket sellers outside of it trying to coax you in making it very unattractive. I would advise anyone to book a ticket in advance online (if able to find where to go).

title: Διαβάστε αυτό πριν αποφασίσετε να πάτε
text:
Λοιπόν αρχικά να τονίσω ότι εάν θέλει κάποιος να επισκεφτεί το Κολοσσαίο καλό θα ήταν να κλείσει τα εισητήρια online, ξέρω ότι η σελίδα tiqets και η αυθεντική ιστοσελίδα του μνημείου είναι οκ για να κλείσεις από εκεί και δεν πρόκειται περί απάτης, για να αποφύγει τυχόν ουρές. Ωστόσο μην κάνεις το λάθος και κλείσεις audio guide, εμείς το κάναμε και απλά μας έδωσαν μια συσκευή ΧΩΡΙΣ ακουστικά απλά σαν μεγάφωνο και είχε μόνο 3 περιγραφές για το μνημείο και τίποτα άλλο επίσης δεν μας άφησαν από το μουσείο του βατικανού να πάρουμε τα audio guides μαζι μας στο foro romano. οπότε εκεί δεν είχαμε καμία πληροφορία και απλά κάναμε το εξης, μπηκαμε στο youtube και βρήκαμε βίντεο που εξηγούσαν τι είναι το κάθε μνημείο. 
Να πω ότι για μένα δεν άξιζε που μπήκαμε στο Κολοσσαίο, γιατί πραγματικά δεν είναι κάτι μπορεις σίγουρα να το δείς και μάλιστα με περισσότερη επεξήγηση στο youtube. Άξιζε όμως η επίσκεψη στο Foro Romano, που είναι κοντά στο Κολοσσαίο και είναι ουσιαστικά η Ρωμαική Αγορά, εκεί νιώθεις όντως δεος. Επίσης μπορεί να αξίζει και η ξενάγηση με κάποιο tour guide αλλά δεν μπορώ να σχολιάσω καθώς δεν το επέλεξα.

title: Fuyez coopculture
text: Colisee super mais ne réservez pas la visite des sous terrains avec coopculture car la dame qui nous "guide" sans explication ne parle qu'italien ou anglais. Elle nous fait télécharger une application d'explication en anglais et surtout nous précise qu'elle n'est pas guide et nous engueule quand on va trop vite à son goût..

title: Should have been 10 in the group - ended up at 19!
text:
This could and should have got a five star review - the one reason it did not is the original blurb quite clearly stated no more than 10 in the group. We started with 12 of us plus the guide but on entering the Colosseum we were joined by another 7 so 19 in total. 

The guides were fantastic and getting to go into the depths of The Colosseum was an experience - shame that we paid for a small intimate group and ended with a crowd - a bit of a rip off really.

title: Enjoyed the rugby and took in a bit of the tourist nonsense but not too much.
text: Seriously I wouldn't bother too much. Place is overrun with ticket touts, pushy sales people, queues, zillions of tourists and piles of litter. Most of Rome is ruins, so just wander round a bit, you can see plenty from the streets for free. Then avoid the tourists hotspots and take in some tucked away squares and back street trattorias and get into some conversations with locals. Generally very friendly. Then that's that done.

title: Nice place to Visit but the staff are  unfriendly
text: It was a good experience to visit. But the staff were unfriendly they do not assist you in anyways for whatever reason they did not attend to help when we asked and they charge you too much for an entry

title: Goede service via Headout.
text: Geboekt via Headout, TOP SERVICE. Het Colosseum zelf.. tjaaa.. Bezoek biedt weinig meerwaarde.. Te weinig geïnvesteerd in het verduidelijken naar hoe het was.. Te weinig voeling met het verleden hierdoor. Ik zou het niet meer doen. Ik had meer info inzake de brood en spelen verwacht.. de inrichting van het Colosseum.. ik miste heel wat. Een wandeling rond de buitenzijde had volstaan..

title: Covid Crazy
text: The place is amazing but they are very wound up about Covid.  They demand proof of vaccines before you buy a ticket.  We decided not to go inside due to this.

title: Un gran coloso en ruinas
text: Un lugar emblemático, histórico, majestuoso però todo está muy sucio. Además ahora está en obras y no se ve del todo bien

title: Bezoek niet de moeite waard
text: Ik zou zeker naar het colloseum gaan, maar van buiten zie je eigenlijk hetzelfde als van binnen. De informatie binnen voegt weinig toe. Bespaar jezelf de rij en de kosten en lees de Wikipedia pagina terwijl je van buiten naar binnen kijkt.

title: Je ne ferai jamais affaire avec eux
text: Je suis allé voir à Milan, La Cène- de Leonardo Da Vinci, guide en retard, des gens frustrés, prix à la caisse 15 euro payé avec guide 44 euro. J'ai envoyé des remarques à la compagnie,  mais aucune réponse. Bien une arnaque.

title: Ikke verdt inngangsbilletten
text: Et veldig kult bygg. Sett fra utsiden. Inne er de først og fremst en ruin. Ikke verdt pengene å gå inn.

title: Bof
text: la vision de l’extérieur du bâtiment est la plus  intense. beaucoup d'autres monuments de Rome sont bien plus inintéressants

title: Iconic symbol of Rome
text:
It was a bit hard getting into the Colosseum, even though my boyfriend and I had already purchased a Roma pass. No one told us we had to book the time of our visit in advance (because of all the COVID restrictions etc), needless to say the whole process was very confusing - plus the website for booking the time of the visit kept crashing.
It is definetely something interesting and a must- see but to be honest, I don't know if I would go back to visit again.

title: Voto non al sito ma alla organizzazione
text:
Lungi da me non apprezzare il valore di questo sito eccezionale ed unico al mondo. Ma il mio giudizio, così come quello sul Foro Romano, è influenzato dallo scarsissimo livello di organizzazione. Mancanza di chiarezza sull'itinerario da seguire. Il sistema audioguida funziona ma anzichè dettagliare con precisione la storia del Colosseo dedica un gran tempo a presentare i numerosi film realizzati sui gladiatori e spettacoli romani. Inoltre una migliore organizzazione comporterebbe una più razionale gestione dei flussi di gente evitando affollamenti e garantirebbe di poter visitare anche parti del monumento che altrimenti si è costretti a perdere. 
Ma imparare da come sono gestiti i Musei Vaticani no?

title: Pas top!!
text: Parmi les sites incontournables de Rome  le fameux colisée,  vous devez acheter votre entrée sur internet avec réservation  obligatoire et une fois sur place, vous n avez pas accès à certaines zones car non comprises dans votre billet alors qu'il ne vous est rien proposer de plus que l entrée au colisée. Pour quoique ce soit en plus il faut payer, comme les trois quarts des sites de Rome et le personnel n est pas accueillant. Pour moi, la majorité des sites sont des pompes à fric trop touristiques,  on en apprend davantage en regardant des reportages sur Arte :p

title: Le SCANDALE de Rome
text: Après avoir fait la quête pendant plus d’une demi-heure et avoir été importuné par des rabatteurs d’agences touristsques on constate qu’il n’y a qu’un guichet d’ouvert qui ne vend pas de billets d’entrée pour le Colisée mais donne seulement des tickets en échange d’une réservation par internet. Il y a de plus un employé qui nous demande de réserver les billets sur internet. Mais voilà les prochains jours ne sont possibles que dans au minimum trois jours soit après notre départ.  Voyant cela les rabatteurs se font plus pressants et évidemment avec l’assentiment de ces employés.  Aucun service d’ordre à l’horizon. Voyant cela nous décidons de quitter les lieux et une dame parlant très bien français nous avoue être une employée d’une agence et nous propose de nous faire la visite du Colisee. Nous en apprenons un peu plus et nous déclare être Algérienne et que cette procédure à été mise en place suite a la Covid pour éviter les quels, qui sont toujours présentes !!!!Je n’ai rien contre mais une Algérienne nous faire visiter le Colisee, je pense que les Italiennes au chômage devraient être pleinement satisfaites surtout celles qui auraient fait des études d’histoire...Un grand merci au service touristique de la ville de Rome et à sa municipalité pour ces conditions d’accueil qui me permettent de dire que je ne remettrai plus jamais les,pieds à  Rome.

title: Grande monumento mas mal aproveitado
text: É sem dúvida enorme este monumento, que se destaca de tudo o resto. No entanto, o seu interior é pobre e o circuito péssimo. Paguei para ver a arena mas não consegui ver pois ninguém nem nada explica que esta tem de ser vista primeiro e que o circuito fechado não permite voltar atrás. Staff não quer saber do turista

title: Ok
text: Wartezeit war ok! Vorher Kontrollen über 3G (greenpass) eingeschränkte Tour! Leider sehr wenig! Kolosseum sehenswert! 16€ Eintritt incl Forum Romanum!

title: Plus cher de la moitié !
text:
J'ai pris un billet coupe-file pour ma petite-fille et moi aux Musées du Vatican. J'espère ne pas avoir de mauvaise surprise une fois sur place, mais déjà, la mauvaise surprise a été de voir le prix marqué sur le billet : 25€ en tout, alors que tiqets m'a fait payer 36,80€, soit près de 50% plus cher.
Conclusion : n'achetez pas sur tiqets.com

title: un "must do" décevant
text:
Je me faisais une joie d'y retourner après de nombreuses années, mais quelle déception !  Est-ce que mes souvenirs étaient à ce point faux ???

Entre les travaux de rénovation, les zones non accessibles, les zones accessibles avec supplément, le nombre de groupes présents sur le site, ... la magie n'a plus opéré.

title: En rénovation
text: Le secteur du Colisé est en plein travaux ce qui ne donne pas une bonne image de ce monument emblématique. A revoir dans quelques mois

title: Overrated
text: A terrible tourist attraction.  A disaster for Rome.  Find something else to spend your time on. Not a place for people with just a little self-respect.

title: COOPCULTURA DISPONIBILITA' ZERO!!!
text:
Coopcultura disponibilità zero!!!
Prenoto online visita colosseo e palatino per il pomeriggio,  purtroppo in mattinata mio marito viene derubato di documenti , carte di credito e cellulare, di conseguenza oltre al danno ci è toccato trascorrere diverse ore fra denuncia , blocco carte etc etc, Provo a telefonare a coopcultura per spostare l'orario ingresso colosseo in avanti  ma dopo le 13 non risponde nessuno, provo via mail ma ancora nessuna risposta.  Fortunatamente gli addetti all'ingresso sono stati disponibili e ci hanno fatti entrare comunque noostante la mezz'ora di ritardo con cui siamo arrivati. La risposta da coopcultura è arrivata solo il giorno successivo:  "Gentile Cliente,
siamo spiacenti per l’accaduto, siamo a comunicarLe che non è possibile modificare una prenotazione già pagata."  
Per fortuna siamo riusciti ad entrare che già la giornata era iniziata "storta"  , segnalo comunque a chi della cooperativa ha risposto fuori tempo massimo  alla mia mail che invece il REGOLAMENTO della cooperativa stessa prevede al punto  1 " I servizi acquistati non sono rimborsabili se non per casi eccezionali"  e il mio era un caso eccezionale che avrei potuto dimostrare con copia denuncia furto. 
Una cooperativa che gestisce una struttura come il Colosseo e relativo parco dovrebbe essere contattabile durante tutto l'arco della giornata di apertura, non può permettersi di non essere raggiungibile se non fuori tempo massimo.

title: NIEMALS über Viator buchen. Nur über Origianle Seiten buchen ....haben wir für den Vatikan gemacht und hat super geklappt.
text: Wir haben über Tripadvisor gebucht die wiederum über viator gebucht haben. Es waren die einzigen Tickets, in der mail stand ein Standort wo man seine echten Tickets abholen kann. An diesem waren wir eine Stunde vorher jedoch standen wir vor einem verschlossenen Rolltor. Es kamen immer mehr Gruppen die auch dort gebucht hatten. Es öffnete keiner, es kam keiner, es schickte keiner die Tickets, es ging keiner ans Telefon.  Unser Tag war zur hälfte gegessen und das Collosseum sahen wir nur von außen.

title: Bello...ma
text: Sito archeologico interessante niente da dire ma troppa gente molta sporcizia, trascurato nei dintorni...ma funziona il comune per mantenere Roma pulita?

title: Headout Bookings charge more than the official homepage
text: Don't use Headout Bookings - they charge around 6 Euros more than the official homepage. I thought it was the official, but they tricked me!

title: Worth a visit, but not my favourite stop in Rome
text: It is hard to visit Rome without visiting the Colosseum, but don't have too high expectations. The permanent exhibition is quite interesting.

title: Réservation en ligne obligatoire !
text:
Grosse déception à l'arrivée , nous pensions pouvoir prendre nos entrées sur place sauf que non pas de guichets! 
Les réservations se font en ligne sur coopculture.it en fonction des disponibilités. Par ailleurs, les audio guides sont accessibles à des guichets à l'intérieur. Pour 6 euros. 
En revanche, l'accès au forum et au palatin est accessible sans restrictions horaires, nous y sommes donc allée avant. 
Visite intéressante et explications suffisantes

title: Κολοσσαίο
text: Ωραίο κτίσμα, εντυπωσιακο εκ πρώτης όψεως. Ωστόσο, οι κτηνώδεις που λάμβαναν μέρος μέσα Σ αυτό σε αποτρέπουν από το να το επισκεφτείς κι εντός του. Είναι όμως μοναδικής ομορφιας.

title: Rozczarowanie
text: Połowa pozostawiana rusztowaniami i pozasłaniana informacjami o pracach archeologicznych. Resztę można w zasadzie jednym rzutem oka ogarnąć.

title: Meriterebbe più rispetto
text: Ci troviamo dinanzi ad uno dei luoghi simbolo di Roma nel mondo e già questo vale il viaggio. Ahimè, è gestito malissimo, lunghe code per entrare, attese, file ecc tutto sotto il sole.

title: Ça ne vaut pas forcément son prix
text: Un incontournable de Rome bien sûr ! Très très beau, surtout le soir avec le couché du soleil. Cependant petit bémol sur le prix. Nous avons payé 23€ en réservation obligatoire sur internet par personne pour la visite, sans guide et sans audio guides. De mon point de vue l’intérieur n’est pas renversent, énormément de monde donc peu d’accès sur les expositions et les explications sont qu’en italien et anglais. Les groupes prennent beaucoup de place donc la circulation est compliquée. Pensez à prendre une casque et de l’eau, il fait très chaud ! Nous aurions sans doute dû prendre les audio guides mais la note commençait à etre salée.. Nous sommes un peu déçue mais c’est à faire 1 fois dans sa vie !

title: Sempre bellissimo!!
