title: Coliseo 0 Foro y Palatino 10
text: La fama la tiene el Coliseo pero lo que de verdad tiene valor es el FORO ROMANO Y EL PALATINO. Las ruinas que aun quedan en el Foro son impresionantes. El Coliseo esta plagado de vendedores ambulantes que te acosan vendiendote agua (las fuentes de Roma dan agua potable fresquisima), fulares (que no necesitaras), sombrillas o entradas (que no te serviran porque solo las oficiales del Ministerio de Cultura on line te sirven). Merece la pena pagar la entrada afternoon a partir de 14:30 q te permite entrar al Coliseo (se ve en 5 minutos) al Foro (tardaras mas de 1 hora)  y el Palatino. Ahora no hay colas. Lo incomprensible es el maltrato al turista: no hay marquesinas ni toldos para proteger del sol

title: Décevant
text:
Clairement c est le minimum syndical du tourisme...aucune explication et aucun amenagement pour expliquer la vie du monument
Franchement les arènes de Nîmes sont bien mieux conservées et bien mieux aménagées

title: Still worth a visit
text:
Our trip to Rome was very impromptu so I did my planning in the car on the way from Tuscany. We booked the day before we went and had an idea that we’d want to get there early to avoid the worst of the heat (remember this was August). We arrived 45 minutes before it opened and the line was already 30 people long. My first criticism is that no one was sure where to line up, there were no signs and no clear place to go if you had booked a ticket or needed to book a ticket. There ended up being two long snaking lines of people really not sure which line they had to be in and switching lines when they heard someone say they might be in the wrong line. 
Going inside felt like a bit of a free for all as you were let in and then everyone just kind of rushed forward not really knowing what they were looking for or where they needed to be but wanting to be the first to get there. 
There is a museum type setup on the inside which is really interesting and shows small models of the colosseum, statues they found, mosaics partly destroyed and stone work recreated. 
We paid extra for the headset with the tour, although we went the wrong way so it wasn’t relevant to anything we were looking at but was still interesting and informative. 
It was super busy, but then it was August so I did expect the crowds. What I didn’t expect was all the litter that was left around and even cigarette ends just thrown on the floor. 
I liked the fact you could move from the inside to the outside at intervals so you could be out of the scorching sun and have a bit of a rest. 
In my head I’d imagined that you could walk on the ground area (where mock battles and fights would have been) but there was work going out so it looked more like an archeological dig rather that a sand area like it though it would. You could pay extra and stand on the lower lever, something we didn’t pay extra for. 
All that being said, you can’t help but be awed at the sheer sight and scale of the colosseum or the history that goes along with it. 
I would go again but not I’m August and with more research!

title: Han subido la tarifa y la mayor parte no se puede ver!!!
text: Normalita tirando a decepcionada!! La entrada cuesta 18€por persona, la mayor parte no se puede ver porque está acordonada. Debido al Covid han subido el precio y reducido la zona visitable. Mejor verlo una vez que pase todo, porque salvo la foto del recuerdo no he podido ve mucho. Además, un rollo las varias entradas que puedes comprar para acceder a un sitio u a otro. Informarse para no llevarse sorpresas.

title: Colisseo
text: Impression bien que fort dégradé par le temps. Pendant une année ´normale’, prévoir une longue attente sous le soleil... mais en 2020 tout y est plus facile et plus rapide

title: Meraviglioso! Ma solo in italiano....
text: Il Colosseo è sempre una meraviglia e non ha bisogno di recensioni. La visita è organizzata con accompagnatori che invitano a scaricare una app per lei spiegazioni di quanto si trova lungo il percorso. Peccato che questa app sia SOLO IN ITALIANO!!!! VERGOGNA ! Siti di minore importanza sono riusciti a offrire il mutilingue sulla app. E questo che è il simbolo dell'Italia nel mondo non è descritto in almeno 10 idiomi diversi?

title: Delusione
text:
Dopo aver speso 18€ a testa, il giro obbligato è di mezzo anfiteatro senza possibilità di salire ai livelli superiori che necessitano di altro biglietto di 24 €.
Lungo il percorso non c’è alcun cartello che identifichi ciò che stai vedendo nè tantomeno indicazioni storiche. Svogliati custodi ogni tanto escono da sotto gli archi dove godono di un po’ d’ombra per redarguire chi non indossa la mascherina.
Riassumendo : 18 € sprecati ma soprattutto delusione perché un monumento tanto conosciuto nel mondo non ha nessuna valorizzazione.

title: Beware ticket scam on official website
text:
I wanted to just see the Coliseum from the inside so I purchased the 11.5 euros ticket at the official website. The ticket says is valid in for the Coliseum visit (not the Forum) and only for PM time visits. So I purchased the ticket and booked my entrance time also online.
On arrival I was told the ticket is only valid for me to wonder around the ground floor level (arena level) of the coliseum and I was not allowed to go to the upper levels. 
The staff mentioned this happens everyday and suggested going to a governmental office to file a complain
There is no information about this when you purchase the ticket so it's absolutely misleading and frustrating experience
If you wish to go to the upper levels then purchase the full ticket which will also give you access to the Forum

title: Bad Vibes
text:
If the review was just for the place, it would be 5 stars - I have been here 4 times! BUT - it is now approached through a horrible building site, basically, for the new underground that's being built next to it. You even have to walk on the road, trying to avoid cars and loads of electric scooters.
 ALSO - the underground corridors are CLOSED, no matter what the touts say, and you MUST have an online reservation - the days of just walking up to the entrance and buying a ticket are gone for a long time to come.  
I can imagine being very disappointed if I was a first-time visitor, which is sad. Not that the locals seem to give a hoot...

title: Mitigé
text: Nous avons pris les billets sur leur site internet, mais pour visiter la totalité du Colisée :arène et gradins (le souterrain est fermé), vous devez acheter deux billets. Et tout cela pour moins de trente minutes de visite. Même les locaux s’en sont plaints.

title: abusée
text: Obligation de réserver au moins la veille cause covid. Ce qui permet de ne pas avoir de file d attente. Prise de température a l entree. Nous n avons pas pu visiter tout le colisee car apparemment pour accéder au niveau des arènes, il faut acheter une autre entrée.  C est abusée vu les prix....d autant plus que l on est obligé de réserver mais c est 2€ supplémentaire pour la réservation, par ticket......en tous les cas avec les omnia card....

title: Intéressant mais...
text:
Nous avons visité le colisée en période post covid.
Le site est magnifique, l’exposition a l’étage est intéressante mais... 
Petit bémol, avec la situation actuelle nous n’avons pas pu visiter les souterrains ni l’arène...

title: Pas simple d y aller
text: Vu que depuis l extérieur a cause du monde, c est pas simple. Billet couplé avec le forum mais nous n avons là où car le monument fermait:

title: Interesting night tour
text: I will recommend taking the late night private tour to Colosseum. A great place to visit and learn about the roman history around this place.

title: VIATOR took our money but did not deliver the tickets
text:
After finishing elementary school my young daughter wished to see Rome with her daddy with as highlight to visit the Colosseum. Booked flights, hotel and long in advance tickets with audio guide via Viator to be sure I could fulfil my daughters dream. As per the instructions in the email we went to the address (Via Capo d'Africa 15A) prior to the actual visit to redeem the voucher for real entry tickets. At 09:30 we arrived, nobody there, a closed roller shutter. I tried to call the service number, many times, no answer, until today (1,5 days later) no return call. I waited for close to 30 minutes outside with my young girl in the scorching heat. We were about to lose our time slot. We walked to the Colosseum, the people there were friendly and could see we had purchased entry tickets for € 65,- for 10:00 but could not help us without the 'real tickets'. We walked back, still closed. Still no answer on the phone (+390693574837). There is a chat page, I chatted and chatted, zero reactions. Impossible to get in touch or to get tickets....we lost our slot, we lost the money and worst of all we spent more than an hour is the heat and I had to suffer the silent disappointment of my young daughter, her father could not give her what he had promised....and we left. Still until now, I have not heard not did get a reply on anything. They have my phone number, my email, nothing. Not even an apology. SCANDALOUS!!!!
I bought new tickets online for a new date/time slot for only € 20,-
DO NOT USE VIATOR! The take your money and disappear. That is called theft where I come from.

title: Colosseo.... Ma ai tempi del corona virus
text:
Nulla da dire per la magnificenza del Colosseo. Miracolo che sia sopravvissuto fino ad oggi.
Ma la gestione dell'affluenza visitatori, delle biglietterie, delle informazioni al turista lasciano a desiderare.
Per essere Roma caput mundi dovrebbe essere un po' meglio organizzata.
Ad esempio il biglietto si fa solo on-line ma non c'è nessuna indicazione in merito intorno al sito archeologico e questo e questo disorienta il turista.

title: Sole Official Ticketing Agency at Colosseum inefficient and unhelpful - cash taken, no tickets issued.
text: 2 July 2020 - A disappointing experience - which can be laid at the door of the official ticketing agency COOPCULTURE.  There is virtually not a tourist to be seen in Rome at the moment, so a great opportunity to visit key attractions, normally a nightmare for the crowds.  Despite standing around in the hot sun trying to download their app (only way to book tickets) we never got in. Their system malfunctioned - despite the cash being taken off my card and getting a confirmation email confirming a successful transaction, they refused to give us tickets and allow entry. When the crowds come back it will be a nightmare.  In addition they were advertising reduced ticket price in the afternoons - which they refused to honour. What a bad experience.....Never got to see the Colosseum from the inside ......

title: Impossible to get tickets via official site
text: We tried to book tickets well in advance of our trip. Tickets via the official site were hard to get or on dates after our trip. There are tickets via booking offices available for 3 or 4 times the normal rate!

title: Colosseum
text: All my life I always wanted to visit the colosseum but to tell you the truth I didn’t enjoy it much. I think it might of been the guide that we got that we didn’t understand anything and plus we were constantly in a rush and hurry. I love the rich history this site has to offer but I was unable to enjoy it. I may have a different view when I return but for now that is what we took home an unpleasant experience unfortunately.

title: Guide apatiche
text: Ci vuole passione in ogni lavoro qui alcuni dipendenti non sono all'altezza ed eseguono il compitino per arrivare a fine mese.....

title: W il colosseo
text: Il colosse è stato ristrutturato e rappresente non solo la città di Roma ma L’ Italia intera. I centurioni sono un po’ ridicoli ma la struttura ha fatto passi da gigante rispetto a 20-30 anni fa !

title: s stunning sight to see
text: it was good. the guide was confusing, mainly because i don't know how to speak Italian but the room was great, especially I was through into a cell for stealing a old gladiator armor.

title: Wird überbewertet
text: Wurde zu der Zeit gerade renoviert. Deshalb war viel mit Gerüsten zugestellt. Die Treppen sind sehr steil und es ist sehr voll...Am besten zuvor reservieren. Selbst mit Reservierung gibt es eine Wartezeit von ca. 30 Minuten

title: visita
text: colosseo file interminabili gente che ti gira intorno per biglietti polizia che non controlla abusivi insoma un vero schifo

title: There is no easy way to see the Colosseo.
text:
The first time I visited was in the 70's and it was a very different place. People didn't travel as much and having to share it with hundreds was the norm. 
The next time was in the 80's and again, a similar experience. I felt like I was getting to know the feature.
About 20 yrs later though, I shared my experience with thousands and the opportunity to learn from my visit was being lost. 
5 years ago was unpleasant with military guards posted everywhere.
Last year we were part of 2 private tours : one of the structure itself and the forum which I found particularly interesting, but again, far from being interruption free. You see, due to the sheer number of visitors our tour guide was only permitted a certain number of minutes at each of the checkpoints before the staff moved us along.
The 2nd private tour was of the underground area. This was by far the best experience I'd had of il Colosseo. Informative, unrushed, a real wow factor.

title: Absolutely Absurd!
text: It is absolutely absurd Constantine. Once I was revived into the 21st century, I visited Rome and heard of your deeds. All is lost. My efforts.. My hope. My empire. Everything that I had ever worked for has been for nothing. You must understand that I did not break the edicts of 303 - 304 for no reason. Yes I understand, from your perspective I looked like a cruel and harsh leader, but give me a chance to look at it differently will you. My miserliness and cruelty was only due to the fact that I loved the empire, and I wanted the empire to prosper. Why else do you think I put an end to domestic anarchy, why else would I defeat the revolt in Gaul of Bagaudae. My persecutions were the SAME. I did it so Rome would not fall from that country-ending religion. But one man… One man ruined it all. CONSTANTINE. ANSWER ME. Why did thee issue the Edict of Milan? The Edict of Milan allowed the rise of that despicable religion, which eventually resulted in the fall of Rome. How you ask? How else? With your edict of Rome ending the persecutions of the Christians, you also ended the traditional Roman values system. The polytheistic Roman religion was displaced, thus the emperors were no longer as divine as they were. Furthermore the glory was no longer of the state but rather their deity. It also complicated the governance as popes and church leaders also took an increased role in political affairs. THINK CONSTANTINE. THINK. A MERE CLOUD THE SHAPE OF A CROSS IS NOT A SIGN.

title: Tipica ipocrisia italiana
text: Non sono presenti i centurioni perché, a dire dei pubblici ufficiali in zona, sono abusivi... i venditori di calamite, bottigliette d’acqua, biglietti per i mezzi pubblici e bastoni per i selfies invece no???

title: Italienere er IKKE servicevenlige
text:
Detaljer udeladrs, da Trip ikke betaler for professinel detaljerede anmeldelser. Bestil for guds skyld billet i forvejen. Selv i februar var der nok 200 m kø til både colosseum og ruinparken overfor var den på 300 m, men 1!!!!!!! Person til at gennemlyse, kropsvisitere m. v. Mage til dårlig service og uigennemtænk og direkte tåbelig håndtering har jeg kun set enkelte tilfælde af tilnærmelsesvist i Grækenland. Helt ufatteligt dårligt og vagterne kan/gider ikke informere. Du får bare en overlegen flad stop-hånd, men ingen forklaring. Vi havde bestilt biletter forud, men man kommer kun ind på sekundet til den tid der står, selvom det ikke giver nogen som helst mening. Det er nok noget de fleste vil se, men er man ikke særligt interesseret så se det udefra. Bare en masse ruiner og det ser mere storslået ud udefra. Men i det hele taget var vi meget rystede over den dårlige behandling og info til turister. Næsten alt er på italiensk. Og bor man i omkring busterminalen er der mange tiggere og for nogle et noget utrygt miljø. Jeg har ihvertfald ikke nogen som helst lyst til at gentage mit besøg i Rom eller anden større by i Italien.
Selv i februar var der ekstremt lange køer til seværdigjeder. Slet ikke noget for mig.

title: An amazing venue that is not respected by tourists!
text: We loved the Colosseum however were very disappointed by how filthy it was.  I am so disappointed by the lack of respect that tourists and tourist operators have for this beautiful structure.  We were distressed to see tour bus operators throw all of the rubbish from their tours out onto the streets around the area.  As our hotel was located a short walk from the Colosseum we witnessed this practice day after day. The cost of entry into the Colosseum is also reasonalble compared to that of other tourist destinations in Rome.  Overall we loved the experience however would like to see people treat the area with more respect.

title: Impressive, but crowded
text: This is probably the most famous place to visit in Rome and it is worth visiting for its historical significance alone.  We were able to "skip the line" however this doesn't help with the security line.  While it is overall an impressive structure, I didn't find myself in awe.  Perhaps it is because it is so well know.  Perhaps I was in a tourist mode of seeing to many old structures, or maybe I was hungry.  Regardless, I came, I saw, I left.  Go see it yourself.

title: ABSURDO: Coliseu fechado, valor não reembolsável
text: Eu e meu marido compramos o passeio completo para o Coliseu, agendado para 13/04, porém com a crise do Codiv as viagens estão suspensas. O site oficial do Coliseu informa que não fará o reembolso, isso é uma falta de respeito!

title: Un peu déçu
text:
J'ai été un peu déçu par la visite car je m'attendais à beaucoup plus...
Cela reste cependant un monument exceptionnel, pour lequel j'ai apprécié d'avoir un billet coupe-file !

title: O lugar é histórico! Muito bonito!
text: Eu adorei o passeio, achei muito divertido e interessante. É um ótimo lugar para tirar fotos e se divertir com os amigos, mas achei a organização deles ruim. Chegamos cedo para conseguir ficar na frente da fila de entrada e quase não conseguimos porque ninguém sabia informar onde seria a entrada de quem já tinha ingresso e onde era a fila para quem ainda iria comprar ingressos. Muitas pessoas também estavam confusas e vieram me perguntar a mesma coisa. Eles só anunciaram na hora de abrir e teve muita confusão desnecessariamente, pois muitas pessoas estavam revoltadas por ter ficado na fila errada e 'perder a vez'. Com exceção disso, o local é histórico e belíssimo. Vale a pena visitar se tiver a oportunidade.

title: Pas si joli qu'imaginé
text: Si depuis l'extérieur c'est majestueux, c'est en revanche très décevant à l'intérieur. Je m'attendais à voir des arènes comme à Nîmes avec de belles pierres, mais pas du tout, c'est de la petite briquette rouge, et pas grand chose d accessible. A part les fous du Selfie, pas mal de gens semblaient déçus. A j'oubliais, que ce soit avec billet pris en avance ou sur place, les files sont longues....

title: Museu  fechado e eles não  devolvem o dinheiro para os clientes
text: Meus ingressos são  para o dia 21 de março  estou a semanas tentando  cancelar  , o mais incrível  que o coliseu vai estar fechado  e o site coopculture nao se responsabiliza para devolver os dinheiro  das pessoas

title: A mediocre experience.
text: Many may not agree with my review, But i felt that the Colloseum is overated. The queues are just too long, and the interior is smth you can get out of a Nat Geo Documentary.

title: Cold
text: I went on a college trip and it was freezing. There’s no coffee shops and all of it is mostly outside. The toilets were porter cabins and they were horrible. I would suggest maybe having a inside bit of museum and cafe as well as the shop but it is a must see attraction.

title: Nog nooit zo rustig
text:
Voor de derde keer in Rome bij het Colosseum geweest. Dit keer was het wel heel bijzonder. Slechts 5 mensen en handjevol politie aanwezig. Ook wij werden nadat we paar foto's gemaakt hadden van een leeg plein, weggestuurd. Bizarre ervaring. 
Bovendien staat Colosseum flink in de steigers en staan er schuttingen omheen in verband met de bouwwerkzaamheden van een nieuw metrostation. Advies: wacht tot corona-crisis achter de rug is en bouwwerkzaamheden achter de rug zijn,  voordat je indrukwekkend Colosseum bezoekt.

title: EXCELENTE CON MATICES
text: excelente monumento, pero con una "muy rara" organización. Las entradas las sacamos online, aún ais tuvimos que ir a una taquilla, guardar cola,...

title: A Minor Disappointment.
text: On my trip to Rome, I visited tons of fantastic sites. The Spanish Steps, Pantheon, and Trevi Fountain were all incredible, albeit somewhat crowded, sites. The Colosseum was quite different. It did not seem to have as many people inside, which was a good thing. However, the architecture was not very impressive. The history surrounding the site is cool, but the architecture did not really impress me that much. The white, marble colors in the photos are far more brown in real life. The center of the Colosseum  also had a lot of stuff covering the grounds due to construction. Overall, I'm glad I visited and there were some cool exhibits, but this, for me anyway, is the least interesting site in Rome. Granted, it is still worth getting an early ticket for.

title: Non capisco.
text: Non ha neanche le finestre, tra l’altro la sera quando vanno a dormire lasciano tutte le luci accese, in barba alla piccola Greta. Vergogna.

title: Nice - but a must
text:
chose the right timing (bet bevore the busses arrive) or try to pay for a shorter line if available. It's of course a must visting Rome but for me it was difficult to imagene how the games really happened, I missed a structural help or modells to explain.
It's a preferable place when the sun is to hot cause of enough shadow areas.

title: E' più bello dall'esterno
text:
Da visitare almeno una volta nella vita ci sta. 
Visitato la prima domenica di marzo con l'intento di approfittare dell'ingresso gratuito, ma niente da fare, iniziativa annullata in virtù dell'emergenza coronavirus e quindi biglietti a pagamento; un pò carucci.
Se visiti la struttura senza una guida è una visita a metà.
Non è stato il massimo della giornata.

title: Colosseum
text: It was an interesting place to visit.  We had a tourist guide and gave a very good tour and information.  It rained a little, but only for a short time.

title: No  peace
text: Went to see the coliseum but the ticket touts are everywhere and you don't get any peace to just take in the grandeur of the place being bombarded to have a tour guide eventually we didn't even bother going into the coliseum it just changed our mood completely

title: Constantly under refurbishment
text: I’ve been here 7 year ago and this year I decried to come back and it’s always under refurbishment. It’s sad

title: Visite de rome
text: Au cœur de la ville très bien desservi par les transports Plusieurs édifices magnifiques à proximité

title: Great attraction but hours and hours to get in
text: When I went, much of its essentially was a building site. It took hours to get in, and I mean so long I lost track of how long, not to mention the will to live. My advice is go and have a look at it from the outside and then go on to the gladiator fighting school around the corner, which you can get into immediately and has a great re-enactment thing going on as well.

title: Muy lindo por fuera
text: Naturalmente hoy hacer turismo es entregarse al excesivo abuso del neoliberalismo empresarial, mas que una manera de conocer la cultura, costumbres, paisajes,etc de un lugar. El coliseo no es la excepcion, es demasiado caro, las colas son interminables, y realmente por dentro no es tan excepcional. Creo que con recorrerlo por fuera ya estaría muy bien pero si tenes mucho dinero, pague y haga lo que quiera.

title: “Delusione”
text:
Sono tornato dopo alcuni anni, ma sono rimasto deluso dai prezzi e dall’alto numero di venditori ambulanti che non ti permette di godere la tua visita
in tranquillità

title: Indrukwekkend amfitheater
text: We konden zo doorlopen bij de rij, een kaartje aangeschaft en het Colosseum is de moeite waard om te bezoeken. Het is groot en indrukwekkend, volg de paden door het Colosseum en je kijkt je ogen uit. Er zijn wel veel nep verkopers aanwezig rondom het Colosseum. Het gemakkelijk met de metro te bereiken.

title: Sightseeing
text:
Fantastisk historia har denna byggnad. Kanske inte så mycket att se på som turist
Roligast var att se restaurörerna i arbete, pillrigt jobb.

title: 去過就好
text: 羅馬競技場、古羅馬廣場、palatino其實就是廢墟了，競技場還可以去看看，其他兩個真的可以不用去，把時間拿去逛別的還比較好。路很難走，記得一定要穿好走的鞋。

title: Niet duidelijk
text: De prijzen waren niet duidelijk en waar je je ticket moest kopen daar waren ze nog minder duidelijk. In het hotel moesten we €35 betalen, daar zelf was het €16 voor de hele ervaring en uiteindelijk hebben we maar €4 betaald. We snapte er niets meer van

title: Doslova velký cirkus
text: Colosseum je sice ikonickou stavbou, nicméně bohužel je dnes pouze a jen tahákem peněz z turistů. Musíte koupit vstupenku (pouze do Collosea neexistuje, vždy je kombinovaná ještě s něčím) a vystát dlouhou frontu u vchodu. Pokud nechcete trávit minimálně hodinu ve frontě, existuje řešení, vlastně legální korupce. Prostě si koupíte dražší lístek a můžete všechny ostatní předběhnout. Tak na to jsme neměli žaludek a proto jsme si Colloseum obešli pouze zvenčí. :(

title: Bof
text:
Heureusement que c 'est groupé avec la visite du forum autrement j'aurais vraiment regretté. 
Petite anedocte cette visite est gratuite le premier dimanche du mois mais le 1/3 On a du payer à cause du coronavirus

title: Bucket list check off
text: The Colosseum inside is almost what you expect it to be - all in ruin. It was being vandalized and robbed for centuries and there isn't really much to see inside if you re not a history geek. Base structural walls with barely any decorations remaining. We took the guided english tour through their coop website, visited the underground so that added a little bit of excitement. Good views to Palatine hill and Roman forum if you take the all experience tour with access to the 3rd level. Guide was very  informative and on point.

title: Not worth the money
text: The Colosseum is a better view on the outside , was disappointed with the inside , not much of it left to be honest but that’s my opinion

title: Don't follow the crowds  - Book though the official site.
text: We prebooked tickets but was approached by LOADS of people trying to sell us tickets which gave use the hump in the end. We had pre-booked video tickets but the queue was so long to collect them that we went without them. We spent about 45 minutes inside. The stairs are really, really steep. Nice place to see though.

title: Amazing place, how did they build it?
text: I was told if we had to build this today, from stone, it would still take 9 years, the same as the original! We didn't  want to do the full inside tour, it was too long. Found a little cafe just opposite at the top where the taxi dropped us off, had a coffee and grappa after a walk round the outside, that was enough for us.

title: Sopravvalutato
text: Più celebre che bello, più famoso che pulito, sepolto nel caotico traffico romano. Molto meglio l'Arena di Verona.

title: Expectation is the mother of frustration
text:
Don´t get me wrong, of course if your are in Rome Colosseum is a Must Go! However, when you get there you see that the arena where the gladiators used to "work" is pretty average. 
I was expecting to get totally fascinated by the tour, but outside the monument is more beautiful than inside, the audio tour is not so interesting and the crowd is absolutely insane.
Yes, if your are in Rome go there, but don´t create so many expectations.

title: Un peu décevant
text: Plus joli de l’extérieur que de l’intérieur. Reste néanmoins intéressant à voir, surtout avec le tarif étudiant européen. Suivant le moment de l’année et l’heure, pensez à réserver pour éviter une longue attente.

title: The Colosseum was not that colossal.
text:
Like many attractions in Rome, I felt the history and art books made the Colosseum seem larger. IRL, the Colosseum was smaller than I thought and was in really poor shape. Not sure why since the tourists pay to enter, yet a private donor is paying for restoring the Colosseum. 

What's sad was seeing all the vandalism in the Colosseum when it was open to the public with no security. Seeing all the stones carved with tourist's names was really sad. 

Like most of Rome, there isn't a no smoking policy and you have to use your imagination to imagine what the Colosseum must have looked like in its glory... or you can re-watch Gladiator.

title: Llenisimo
text: Está DEMASIADO lleno. Recomiendo pagar un extra para ir con guía y no hacer tanta cola. Claro que no podrás quedarte tanto como quieras. Pero, está tan lleno que no apetece tanto. Mejores fotos afuera. Bordearlo

title: Colosseum's toilet problem
text: There are no toilets in the vicinity of Colosseum! We stopped at the tourist information centre right next to Colosseum to use bathroom. It's a big information centre with small bar and other services. However, only 1 (one) toilet! It was off-season and there was a line (for women), to use toilet you have to purchase token in the bar (wait in another line!). Then, in Colosseum itself, there is a facility with only 7 toilets, and huge line to wait. Badly done, Italy!

title: Visita por Roma
text:
Bastante interesante la visita 
Aconsejable contratar visita sin colas , si no esperar 2 h para entrar ( eso en febrero con poca afluencia )

title: Good history but not my type of attraction
text: The history is fascinating as well as the builiding itself but I cringe when thinking about it's use in those days.

title: Giornata stressante
text:
Appena arrivato a Roma, la vivacità della città mi ha subito trascinato, purtroppo verso un quartiere malfamato della capitale dove ho dovuto sfoggiare i miei molti anni di karate per arrivare puntuale all'appuntamento con la mia signora. Giunto nei pressi della mastodontica struttura romana, la mia non italianità ha lasciato il segno:
- Comprato due biglietti da un venditore ambulante per vedere un combattimento tra gladiatori (convinto che l'interno del Colosseo fosse stato restaurato e modernizzato).
- Pagato 30 euro per una guida turistica che ci ha mostrato i bagni pubblici.
- Hotel ottimo, peccato che la camera fosse comune con altre 4 coppie.

Detto ciò, purtroppo non voglio lasciare commenti su Roma, perché non oserei mai oltraggiare il quantitivo di storia che la circonda, ma, per quanto riguarda la giornata trascorsa, da dimenticare...

title: Normal
text: Como dice el título normal, hay otros monumentos más impactantes en la ciudad. No es necesario el pago de los diferentes tipos de entrada.

title: Skip it
text: Of course we headed to the Colosseum ! But once I got there i was inundated with people taking selfies and I then realized I was looking at the location where numerous human and animal atrocities took place . i decide to hop back on the bus ! Much more creative and artistic places to take in !

title: Great place! However that que is bad!!
text:
Honestly Great peace of history and amazing view which is insane. However the authorities are purposely made the queuing worst to invent the skip the line tour operators who charge you crazy money. Please dont buy from people who ask you which country and promise you slip que..
Please only buy online from a registered company.... 

Everyone there is looking to cheat toy including the authorities...such a wonderful site which is made so bad for people to visit.

title: Sympa, mais...
text: Les endroits pour le rendez-vous des groupes est mal fléché, les audio-guides proposent des informations parfois imprécises, beaucoup de travaux au moment de notre visite. Mais ça reste le Colisée avec tout le prestigieux passé qui l'accompagne.

title: Attention au choix du prestataire
text:
Attention lors de votre achat en ligne
assurez vous de recevoir directement les billets...
Nous n'avons jamais reçu les notres...malgré plusieurs échanges par mail ...et bien sûr nous les avions payés
Viator n'est pas responsable et nous a remboursé les billets 
La société en cause s'appelle Audiotour Coliseum.
Personne sur place ne connaissait ce prestataire et nous ne l'avons jamais trouvé...Perte de temps (2 heures a attendre en vain)...Perte d'énergie....

title: meh
text: I was expecting more to be honest. Maybe it was my expectations but it didnt struct me as a WOW... i know this sounds stupid but oh well

title: La vue extérieur est suffisante
text:
Faire la queue 
Voilà à quoi je résume mon expérience 
Le monument est grandiose et magique mais masqué par une organisée catastrophique ! Une billetterie mal indiquée !! Des fils d’attentes interminable !!
Des explications inexistantes,., 
Dedans c’est pire ... un monde pas possible ! Anglais ou italien pour les informations ! Sachez que vous avez d’autres touristes ! 
Et des travaux par tout !!
La beauté de l’extérieur est bien suffisante ! Gardez votre temps pour d’autres expériences

title: Leuk maar niet meer dan dat.
text: Men zegt dat als je hier niet bent geweest, ben je niet in Rome geweest. Ik vind het persoonlijk wat tegen vallen. Wel erg druk dus tickets voor die tijd kopen is slim. Eenmalig bezoek, zou er niet een tweede keer heen gaan. Je wordt hier gek van die lui die je proberen water, powerbanks en selfiesticks te verkopen

title: Altfor mye folk
text: Altfor mye folk. Må nesten kjøpe guidet tur for å ikke stå i kø hele dagen, men ville heller brukt pengene mine på noe annet.

title: Uitbuiters!!!!
text: Samen met een vriend allebei een ticket gekocht voor op de zondag. Eenmaal bij aangekomen bij het colloseum met onze ticket, mogen wij niet maar binnen. Ons ticket zou verlopen zijn. Of te wel we hadden volgens hun om 1400 aanwezig moeten zijn. Ipv 3 uur. Dit stond nergens aangegeven!!! We wouden graag wel een kijkje nemen en moesten nog een keer 32 euro afrekenen

title: Ganz okay
text:
Ich habe mir das Kolosseum angesehen , weil mein Mann sehr gerne dahin wollte.
Für mich war es leider nicht wirklich interessant.
Wir hatten uns nur ein Audiogerät geholt , ohne Videofunktion. 
Die Wartezeit war nicht sehr lang gewesen.

title: Bucket list trip
text: We pre purchased the skip the lines ticket for this visit and are really glad we did.  We visited on a Friday and the line was easily a 1/2 mile long.  The colosseum is beautiful with a lot of history.  The downside to this visit are the vendors walking around constantly trying to sell things.  They will do their best to force a bracelet on you as a “gift” and then demand money.  If you say “no” they will follow you.  One grabbed my sons arm and we had to physically pull my son away from him.  I wish the police could get a better handle on these activities.

title: I guess you have to do it when you're in Rome...
text:
... of course you do, and you would regret it if you hadn't, but be aware it is really badly organised, so don't do it on yourself, take a guided tour with skip the line. If you don't you will have to queue for an hour minimum due to security checks, then you can buy a ticket for Forum Romanum und Colosseum, which means after you visited the Colosseum you leave it, go to the Forum Romanum directly next door and spend another hour or more for the next security check. No skip the line here without guide though.

TIP: make sure you have no bigger bags with you as they'll just send you away after queuing for hours. There is no place to store your luggage !!!

SKIP THE LINE: you can book skip the line tickets even with Google, but there are certain entry time so make sure you do that on advance.

title: Шляпка
text:
Были для галочки, ничего особенного, толпы туристов, узкие дороги, везде попрошайки, просто не понимаю почему это топ2 место
Не тратите время, исследуйте Рим по узким улочкам этого города :)

title: Не впечатлило
text: Снаружи красивее чем внутри,  можно покататься на big bus и поставить галочку что видел. Билеты не резервировали, на окресностях не нашли где купить билеты full experience ( он включает вход колизея и  римский форум), когда прошли металоискатели взяли только в колизей , по сравнению с простыми билетами с Ватиканом билеты завышены. Гиды будут предлагать билеты за 40 €- оно того не стоит

title: Très joli
text:
Rien à dire sur cet édifice qui est juste merveilleux et géant 
Nous nous sommes régalés lors de notre visite de ces lieux 
Seul bémol : vous vous faites agresser par les vendeurs à la fauvette qui n’hésitent pas à insister pour vendre leur gadget !!!!!
A la longue c’est usant

title: Reservatiesysteem
text: Dit was mijn tweede bezoek aan het Colosseum. In het verleden nam ik een standaard ticket. Ditmaal koos ik voor een uitbreiding met de arena. Voordeel van dit duurder ticket is het feit dat je in kleinere groepen binnen kan gaan en in rust kan genieten van het arena gedeelte. Nadeel: op zich zie je niet zo veel meer en de meerprijs is toch best groot.

title: Nice visit
text: Unfortunately there was a lot of repairs going on so there was scaffolding and building machinery all around. All in all though it was a nice visit to one of the seven wonders of the world

title: Tour europeo
text: Las boleterias al coliseo cierran a las 2 pm. No pudimos entrar, nuestra agenda estaba recargada. Hay tanto que conocer que no queda tiempo.

title: Never visit Italy
text: If you don't enjoy eating well, if you don't like to be well treated. . then ..give it a try.  Go to Italy

title: Too packed!
text: Inspite of its majestic outer structure, this attraction is not enjoyable.. too many persons outside and inside, too long lines, even the skip the line entrance was packed with people. Maybe the winter season is a much better choice. The inside is interesting but needs imagination.

title: Billeterie mal indiquee
text: Colisée visite tot le Matin pour eviter la foule et la queue 1h30. Des panneaux indiquent une billeterie en face du colisée qui est en fait le lieu du retrait si vous avez pris le roma pass ou pour les groupes. En realite vous pouvez prendre Vos bullets directement a l entree du colisée. Perso nous avons reserve directement nos billers pour le colisée le for un et le mont palatino ce qui nous a permis d enter plus rapidement et sans faire la queue

title: Colisée
text: Impressionnant de l'extérieur mais pas de l'intérieur. Il y a comme même une espèce  de musée intérieur pour ne pas s'ennuyer

title: Intressant
text: Häftigt att ha sett detta stora byggnadsverk. Vi köpte kombinationsbiljetter med Forum Romanus och Palatinen.

title: Looooooooooooooongest Line
text:
My friend and I were at the colosseum and we just saw the line outside the place and gave up on entering the site.

We were hanging around the site and it was beautiful and unique.

title: Do not fall in the trap
text:
My wife and I arrived at 11:10 to the cashier across the square. Paid at the cashier at 11:13 by card for the ticket entrance including colosseum and the fort.
There is something that you folks must be aware from our very bad experience : read the time beside on the right that shows you when you have to show up at the colosseum AND FIRST AT THE COLOSSEUM !!!

The lady at the casher desk NEVER told us that we must show up at the time which is on the ticket entrance !!! (11:20 for us) and it is so close to the credit card recipe, so we thought it was both the same time (or a small difference between the too clocks, (credit card machine and tickets printer)).

When we saw the line we did prefer to go and visit the fort first and then come back during lunch time which is less crowded. This was the worst decision we ever made in this town. When we came back 2 hrs after, they totally refused to let us get in, and told us we must spent another ticket entrance 16€ each for the second time !!!

To finally see something that is beautiful, but, honestly, not exceptional.

The worst experience was certainly the complain desk who told us that we were not the first and at least not the last guest of his day.

Rome is a great city to spend your time and visit, but if you are short of time, skip the inside visit of the colosseum. We should spend 32€, we paid 64€.
This was a robbery !!! Scam attraction !!!

title: Queues!
text: The massive and complicated queueing system ruined the experience, as left us feeling irritated and annoyed by the time we got in - we had a quick look over the fence and headed straight for the exit. I think  just as impressive seeing this site from the outside.

title: Be prepared to line up for a very long time.
text: Most of the interior was covered in scaffolding when we visited and was certainly not worth the wait to get in. Entry took 3 hours and once inside we spent little more than 30 mins. The structure is far more impressive externally in my opinion. There are far better ways to spend 3hrs in Rome than lining up here.

title: Reservar con tiempo la guia
text: Compramos la entrada sin problema en el momento pero con audio guía no vale la pena.. no se entiende bien en qué momento escuchar los audios porque no localizamos los números. Si vas con guía debe ser mucho más interesante porque accedes a la catacumbas y a la arena.. sale lo mismo pero se reserva con tiempo.

title: Mmmmmmm
text:
Wear sensible shoe.
Lots off standing outside.
Guide very informative.
Didn't live up to expectations.

title: Ok
text: Bit of a let down but was worth doing for 17 euro 30 minute walk from our hotel so wasn't bad and the weather was nice so that helped

title: spoilt visit
text:
I booked the tour in advance and was so excited
as I was walking in 3 or 4 African chaps were very aggressive and pulled my arm out of my pocket to force a shake of my hand. Very heavy handed. I tried to pull back and shouted that I had dislocate my shoulder 3 days before 
I was upset and angry. they accused me of been racist because they were black. we turned around and left. They are an obstruction.

title: Druk, druk, druk
text: Druk en duur. Hierdoor vervalt de historische context een beetje. Het forum romanum is wat mij betreft interessanter.

title: Vivicos
text: We bought a tour. Worst experience of my life, because of the very bad customer service of vivicos. They ruined colosseum for us. My girlfriend literally cryed!

title: Colosseum underground teleurstellend
text: Tickets gekocht via ticketsrome.com, €40 pp voor 1u15. Het ging al verkeerd met de tickets zelf. Deze kwamen maar niet in onze mailbox. Blijkbaar hadden ze, nadat wij met hen contact hadden opgenomen ook nog onze geboortedatum nodig, waarom??? Geen uitleg en gebrekkig Engels aan de telefoon. Tickets besteld voor 13.20. Tickets gekregen voor 14.30. Een half uur op voorhand was nodig. Dus om 14u langs, ok we kregen een sticker en melding terugkomen tegen 15u. Dus daar al veel nutteloze tijd verloren. We dachten terwijl al eens te horen voor Forum romanum of platinum want inbegrepen in de prijs. Bleek dat te sluiten om 15.30u. Dit konden we dus niet meer doen, ook dag erna niet vermits we terugvlogen. Had handig geweest indien dat op de tickets of op de website had gestaan (idem ivm noodzakelijke info geboortedatum). Uiteindelijk onze rondleiding gekregen, gids was min of meer ok maar wel slecht Engels. Underground was ok maar niet de meerprijs waard. Na onze rondleiding hadden we graag nog wat verder rondgekeken maar toen zaten we tegen het sluitingsuur van 16.30u en werden alle bezoekers door de bewakers naar buiten gebracht. Dus Colosseum, ja zeker en vast maar dan met gewoon ticket en vroeg genoeg naar binnen. Underground niet aan die meerprijs.

title: Fint
text: Man kan sagtens se det ude fra, og det ville være fint. Der er ikke meget at se inde i Colosseum. Anbefaler at man spare billetten og går en tur rundt om det.

title: Roma
text: Roma! Dopo aver letto molti libri e visto certi film, già il nome dovrebbe incutere timore, quando arrivi di sera poi, ha un fascino che ti mette i brividi!! Arriva il giorno e purtroppo vedi il caos e la sporcizia di questa città!! Il Colosseo monumento per eccellenza, dovrebbe essere un simbolo di ordine e pulizia, rappresenta quello che abbiamo ereditato e viene mantenuto perché fonte di guadagno, vedasi i finti e ridicoli legionari.

title: algunas advertencias
text:
Como ya fue dicho, es un lugar que emana historia, aparece representado en muchas películas, etc. etc.

En invierno no conviene comprar el ingreso anticipadamente. Las filas son de 5 a 7 minutos como máximo. Existen muchas advertencias sobre el tema de las demoras en la fila para generar una demanda y  cobrar por ese servicio (compra anticipada) mucho más allá del precio de las entradas que de por sí son caras.

Tenga cuidado con sus pertenencias. Existen mujeres jóvenes en las filas y dentro del reciento, intentándo pasar por turistas que son pungas, pickpockets, amigas de lo ajeno, o de la forma que desee llamarlo. Están sólas o de a dos mirando y marcando a los desprevenidos visitantes. Si nosotros percibimos ésto, la seguridad debe conocerlo de memoria.

Compramos la visita guiada que disponibiliza el lugar. El guía no tenía ni un mapa para decir estamos aquí o allá. Si bien las vistas son muy interesantes, la explicación no iba acompañada por una visión de perspectiva. La  observación, la visualización in situ fue fundamental, pero el plus por visita guiada no correspondió a una argumentación más allá de lo que dice cualquier guía de turismo en papel.

Los baños están localizados en unos containers cercanos a las billeterías. Son escasísimos en proporción a la cantidad de personas en el lugar y llegado determinado momento se saturan y se ensucian irremediablemente.

Insisto, los ingresos son muyyyy caros como para pasar por situaciones así.

title: No puedes dejar de visitarlo
text: Es una parada obligatoria en Roma. Pero es un poco decepcionante por dentro. Por fuera te deja si  palabras. Muchiiiisima gente aunque leyendo un poco las opiniones lo bueno que nos paso edq para comprar la entrada no esperamos apenas ni 10 min. Las compramos en el momento en el palatino. La entrada incluyendo el coliseo sin guia, 17 euros. Y no esperamos tampoco mucho para entrar, un miercoles claro. Esta en general un poco descuidado pero tiene su encanto.

title: Nice place
text: We booked the guided tour direct for this trip the tour guide lacked english communication and language and showed us like 3 things then said you can now do what you want it was a waste of time booking the guided tour directly.we was told we had to pay more if wanted to go to the ground floor and view more which we wasnt aware of. Nice place to visit though and you can get some great photos.

title: Don’t get the audio tour guide
text:
Obviously it’s a magnificent Roman building, so you can’t not visit when in Rome 

But it could be sooo much better organised. 

We paid for the audio tour and 3 of the 6 recordings were in closed off areas ! We searched and couldn’t find them. When we complained at the end the guy just said ‘ oh we didn’t know they were closed’ 

The lady in the ticket booth was lovely, but everybody else we spoke to was rude and unbelievably unhelpful. We felt like a huge inconvenience for them.

title: Бестолковая трата денег
text:
Снаружи интересней чем внутри. Бестолковая трата денег и времени. 
Ценник в 16 евро явно больше того что получаешь взамен.

title: Rome
text:
Came by Cruise ship, port was some distance away, lots of ‘bus’ time.  Lovely scenery, but....
Rome proper in June should be avoided.
My opinion, way to many people at all of the attractions.  Not a very clean large city.

title: Be wary of entrance
text: Beautiful piece of ancient Rome. However, at the outside entrance there are many African immigrants accosting you.  They are very aggressive! How about some police presence???

title: A faire mais pas ouf
text:

Attention: ne surtout pas prendre l'audio guide. C'est nul et vous payez 5,5 euros.

title: Beau
text: Un emblème de rome a aller voir sans pour autant y entrer ... beaucoup de monde et de marchants à la sauvette... 16 euros le tickets d entrée qui comprend aussi le forum palatin

title: Site to see but spoilt for me
text: What a site to see!! History buffs delight but modern day touts and con artists spoil this beautiful place literally every 10 paces somebody trying to scam you!! It detracts from the sights as you feel in guard constantly, it’s a serious problem here that the local police do not give a damn about!!

title: Pre book your tickets!!
text: Well all I can say is the coloseum is beautiful but the hassle you get outside of it is terrible, it really ruined our visit. We were constantly hassled to buy tickets, lucky lucky men in your faces everywhere to another level and the pirate who stands nearby is rude avoid him at all costs or he will not leave you alone wanting money from you. It just ruins the beautiful place the coloseum is by these rude individuals. You can't stop and take it in as another one is in your face, they literally dont leave you alone. This is the only place we got harrassed. The other main attractions were a delight to visit.

title: Timing is everything!!
text:
We booked a full experience ticket, guided tour in English, for 14.45pm.  The tour was late and we were then ushered out of the attraction by over zealous guards as it was half an hour to closing time. 16.30pm was closing time. These guards would not let my elderly and disabled mother use the lift.  She was forced to exit by the stairs. 

The extra money paid for the tour and to access downstairs was certainly not worth it, albeit not a great amount.  In hindsight we would have booked just normal entrance and walked around ourselves.  Although the underground does need a tour guide but does not really add to the visit.

title: Long lines, expensive tix
text: Long lines and expensive tickets to see a major historical site built by slave labor. Advance purchase helps reduce the wait and sometimes the price.

title: Not much to see compared to the Vatican
text: Glad we went to see it but I didn't think it was anything special, we also did the Roman Forum and the Hill of Palantine the same day as they are all beside each other. Lots of walking and history to see.

title: Colosseum nightmare
text: Unreal building completely ruined by people on every corner trying to sell anything and everything they can. Beggars crawling at your feet. Tours pester the life out of you to purchase tickets to skip the lines. The local authorities should remove all these unwanted people and let the tourists enjoy these treasured buildings

title: ein Amphitheater...
text:

Die Reservierung für das Kolosseum ist an eine Eintrittszeit gebunden. Die Eintrittskarte ist aber auch für das Forum Romanum und das Palatin gültig. Hierfür hat man dann ins gesamt 48 Stunden Zeit, bevor die Karten ihre Gültigkeit verlieren.
Vom Kolosseum selber war ich etwas enttäuscht. Alles wird nur noch durch Beton und Gerüste zusammengehalten. Der eigentliche Eindruck eines Amphitheaters kommt nicht so richtig rüber...
Das muss aber jeder für dich selber aus machen.

title: Feel cheated
text: I booked a full-experience tour online beforehand which is supposed to include the underground and arena. However, the so-called underground is only a 20 square metre space surrounded by construction sites and almost the whole colosseum is covered with scaffolding. The arena and underground are allocated for 20 mins stay each, with no guide. The staff just led you in and stood aside, letting you view by yourselves. Personally, I found it definitely not worth the time and money so just book the regular ticket if you want to see this monument.

Effectivement, des '' vendeurs à la sauvette'' essayent de nous vendre des places à des prix exorbitants. Des vendeurs très lourds et très nombreux. Certains ont même des badges TripAdvisor !!! Ne leur faites pas confiance et redirigez vous vers les guichets officiels. Pour les moins de 26 ans de l' UE, c'est 2 euros pour le Coliseum, mont palatin et forum romain : ne vous faites pas avoir.

title: Niente di particolare
text: Mi aspettavo di più, niente di particolare, una gran parte non è accessibile, piccolo giro, nie te di così eclatante rispetto alla struttura esterna.

title: Как не стоять в очереди и как посетить бесплатно
text: Посетили с мужем Колизей в январе 2020г. Брали аудиогид на русском языке. Особого восторга не испытали, но нам понравилось. Самый главный ужас с которым сталкиваются желающие посетить Колизей это очередь, но я хочу поделиться опытом как ее избежать. Покупайте билеты в Колизей возле Римского форума и берите билет "Full experience" (22 евро с человека)- включено посещение Римского Форума+Палатина+Колизея и действует в течении 2 дней. Есть билет простой за 16 евро с человека и включено все тоже самое, но разница состоит в том, что за 22 евро вы заходите без очереди (не в главный вход) и вас заводят на арену Колизея (по простым билетам захода на арену нет). На арене, кроме осмотра, вы можете сделать фото без толп туристов. Если вы хотите посетить Колизей ( или Римский Форум и Палатин) бесплатно, то это можно сделать в каждое первое воскресенье каждого месяца, но очередь в Колизей будет огромная.

title: Τζαμπα ταλαιπωρία

title: Domenica gratis
text: La prima domenica del mese si entra gratis sia al Colosseo che al Palatino e ai Fori Imperiali. Noi abbiamo scelto un tour a a pagamento per fare meno fila ( 40 euro in 4 con due audioguide per i bambini). La fila era tanta principalmente per il metal detector ma è veloce. Da vedere e con la spiegazione è ancora più affascinante. Molto lungo però il giro se si considerano anche il Palatino e i Fori imperiali. Conviene portare qualcosa da mangiare ma nella pausa tra Colosseo e fori imperiali. Dentro non penso proprio si possa mangiare. Noi ci siamo allontanati per mangiare e abbiamo perso il gruppo dopo la visita al Colosseo!

title: Dont rush in!
text: Ok it is a very large construction with a lot of history but i dont think worth's the money to go inside. the surroundings of the Colosseum are very beautiful. Walk up the road behind it and visit two very small but very very beautiful churches.

title: maestoso
text: sempre visto dall'esterno per via delle code per entrarci ma fa sempre colpo la sua maestosità. Molto sorvegliato, quindi sicuro, il sito però a causa dei lavori non è facile girarlo dalle persone disabili

title: I’ve seen better...
text:
When in Rome you must see the Colosseum, is what I thought. Well... maybe I’m spoilt but I’ve seen much better archeological sites, in Turkey (Epheses), Iran (Persepolis) and even in Morocco. The thing here is: they’ve stripped the whole site from all its features. There are no reliefs, no mosaics left. There’s only stone left.
The scale though is impressive, and so are the views.
If you haven’t seen any Greek or Roman sites you will enjoy it; if you have, reconsider going.
If you go, be sure to buy a ticket online. You will have to spend some time queuing anyhow but far less if you’ve got a reservation.
The audio tour is allright. A visit won’t take longer than an hour.

title: Comprare biglietti online
text:
Impossibile visitarlo se non si prenota online. 
Abbiamo provato a fare la fila ma in un'ora ci siamo mossi di 10 passi. 
Il consiglio migliore che ho letto è quello di prendere i biglietti (biglietto unico per colosseo, fori e palatino) alla biglietteria dei fori che ha una coda molto più corta, peccato che quando siamo andati noi alle 11 quei biglietti fossero finiti. 
In ogni caso la fila va fatta e conviene andarci molto presto la mattina prima dell'apertura.

title: Déçu
text:
Incontournable à Rome, C’est l’une des attractions à faire à Rome. Nous avions pris un coupe files, mais ce n’est pas pour autant que nous sommes passés rapidement. 1h30 d’attente pour rentrer, après le monument est unique mais il n’y a pas de plan, pas d’explication, pas de description, heureusement qu’internet existe ! 
En revanche le mont palatin était plus beau !

title: Tour guide scamsters.
text: Long queues in cold weather. Tour guides trying to con you into buying tours or skip the line tickets. The lines are exceptionally long and there is a clear lack of organization. The employees have no empathy and clearly lack experience dealing with large crowds. We felt like animals being horded into the arena. Whilst the Colosseum is impressive, the experience is dampened by the over crowding and poor organization.

title: Code interminabili
text: Andare a Roma e non riuscire ad entrare al Colosseo in 4 gg di tentativi a causa delle ore di coda da fare è veramente scandaloso

title: Разочарован.
text: 32 евро на двоих и два часа потраченного времени только за то, чтобы увидеть такие же руины внутри Колизея, как и снаружи. Будете в Риме - не ходите в Колизей!

title: Non pervenuto
text: Stupendo si... ma circondato da transenne per i lavori infiniti della metro ... appena arrivi l'impatto d' pessimo... superato questo vale comunque la pena... ma non ai puo' martoriare cosi un luogo simbolo di Roma

title: good experience
text: Queue system is very bad. Better avoid the group guide that too with extra payment for skipping queue. See by your own, it is the best thing so that you can go everywhere without hurry.

title: Coliseo
text: Tenía más espectativas del Coliseo... Si bien compramos la entrada en el momento (15 min de fila), te dan muy poca información para hacer el recorrido, ningún mapa ni folleto, hay ciertos lugares a los que no puedes ingresar si haces el recorrido solo(a), así que recomiendo contratar un tour ahí mismo en la boletería...

title: Dispensável
text: Lindo por fora e bom pra tirar fotos. Mas a muvuca do lado de fora, filas gigantescas, ingressos caríssimos... não vale a pena! Pura perda de tempo.

title: Visitatore!
text: Tutto aperto...troppo freddo! Si consiglia di mettere finestre e termosifoni! Per info: conosco un amico che lavora in una ditta di infissi! Contattatemi in privato per maggiori informazioni!

title: you will be pick pocked
text: It is sad that pickpocket is prevalent in Rome so much and the city is not doing anything about it. My wife lost the credit card, money and insurance card. Fortunately for us my wallet was not stolen we came back home in one piece. I will really advise against travelling to the dreadful city in the name of history.

title: Chaos indescriptible pour les billets
text:
La prise des billets pour la visite du Colisée et du Forum s’effectue dans un chaos indescriptible. Des centaines voire milliers de touristes se retrouvent vers 9 où 10 heures pris dans la cuvette près du Colisée, à la merci des vendeurs à la sauvette de billets, d’escrocs en tous genres, de guides non déclarés avec une signalétique défaillante ou inexistante. Une inorganisation remarquable.
Beaucoup renoncent ou se font arnaquer. On ne voit plus cela nulle part, surtout plus dans des pays européens. C’est la honte !

title: HEADOUT in ROME -----    DO NOT BUY TICKETS HERE!!!
text:
December 29th, 2019.   Unpleasant customer service. We arrived in time, on the dot.  The group had left without us, they were very unkind the way they treated us, the lady at the front desk yelled at us, her supervisor did not blink an eye, listening to all the conversation at a desk behind.  Even when we requested to come and speak to us, she did not move. Tickets bought online and completely lost, they were unable or better still not wanting to reallocate us or even assist us kindly. The lady was rude and very unpleasant.
They do not know how to treat customers at all. The ticket point to get your tickets is extremely far away from subway, around 20 minutes walk.  Once you buy it online they give you all the information on where to pick up your tickets, so you pay first and then you get the surpise about the distance. Awful customer service. Money lost for three party members. We did not see the coliseum, a complete rip-off. Not recomendable at all.

title: עדיף היה להישאר בחוץ
text: תור ארוך מאוד, גם עם הקנייה מראש של הכרטיסים. הבחוץ הרבה יותר מרשים. הכי מומלץ להקדים קום ולעשות ריצת בוקר, כך אפשר לראות את הקולי אום במלאו תפארתו בלי עמולה מסביב

title: Only amazing from outside
text:
This building is totally overwhelming! It looks amazing from outside. The composition with modern building is really interesting. It’s nice to walk around and see it from different perspective also at different time of the day. 
Complete not worth to go inside. First too many people, everybody are pushing to the photo spots. And second there is even no info what is what if you don’t have guide. Better to stay outside and safe some money.

title: Colosseo tra le transenne
text: Visita tra transenne e ambulanti che volevano venderci di tutto, io sono abbastanza tollerante ma dopo un po vuoi solo scappare via per non essere infastidito, capisco i lavori ma non devono essere "eterni".

title: Muy lleno antes de Año Nuevo.
text:
Es demasiado bello. Lamentablemente, elegimos ir el día 29 de diciembre cuando hay más gente por las vacaciones. A mi familia le vendieron un paquete de entrada rápida por 30 euros; pero al final tuvieron que esperar lo mismo para entrar y el guía les dijo “es algo que normalmente no se ve” (yo digo que es un truco).

Cuidado con los vendedores de souvenirs que se te acercan. Te ponen cosas en las manos diciendo que son gratuitas y después te hacen que les des dinero.

title: Déçue
text: Le monument est magnifique mais quand nous sommes arrivés il était pleins d’échafaudages et nous sommes tombés sur des guides pitoyables en dehors du dernier que nous avons eu pour le mont palatin

title: No hay baños
text:
Colas y ausencia de servicios.Hay 6 cabinas horribles para todo el gentio que entra en el coliseo, además  de una cola enorme.
Un desastre. No hay servicios en la zona

title: Grandioso!
text: Una magnifica obra maestra para la diversión de los Romanos. Una estructura magestuosa que es impresionante. Cuando estas dentro y te van explicando lo que hacían, para que servia entiendes que era exclusivamente para la diversión del pueblo y que no pensaran en nada mas. Muy recomendable coger audio guía o guía que te de las explicaciones pertinentes y que te lo enseñe todo. No puedes ir a roma y no ver el coliseo.

title: Neither that colossal, nor that grand!
text: It's a nice monument but to see from the outside it is its best feature! It looses all that mystery and admiration as soon as you step inside mainly because it offers of nothing to revive that wonder of the time!

title: Mi aspettavo di più
text: organizzati, file immense, confusione ai controlli, poche indicazioni e il monumento ci ha colpito di più visto da fuori che all'interno. Non è ben tenuto, ci aspettavamo di rimanere senza parole........... Ci ha lasciato con l'amaro in bocca........ Visto una volta e mai più

title: 駅前にドーン。
text:
とそびえ立っています。
ツアーに申し込んでいたので入場はスイスイ。
中で作業されている方々がいらっしゃいます。

title: Great when inside
text:
Hopeless organisation when trying to work out about lining up to get in. No staff around to ask but lots of sellers there trying to upsell their particular tour.
Once inside it is a perfect place to visit

title: Money-grabbing management
text: The Colosseum itself is great - this 1-star is for the management. The ticket is €16 each as a combined ticket for the Colosseum, the Roman Forum and the Palatine Hill (no individual ticket option available), but if you don’t wish to pay extra to pre-book your ticket or join a guided tour that their staff members were trying to sell to you outside the site for €40/person, you are the least welcome visitor at the site. Others are filing in, but your turn never comes. When I tried to book tickets about a month before my visit, the official site showed that no ticket was available for the dates I planned to stay in Rome. But when I checked the websites of travel agencies, there were plenty of tickets apparently, price starting from €25 each. I believe we all know what’s happening here. Profiteers.

title: Fantastic Sights, but be aware of the tourist scam
text: I love Colosseo, and also went in to enjoy the majestic awe-inspiring historical sights. But be aware of the scammers who dressed up in historic outfit and trapped you for pictures even if you were just passing by. They will trap you, ask you to take a photo and charge you for 20 Euros right after.

title: Amazing sight, badly organised
text: The colosseum itself is outstanding to see and wander around. However it can be complicated to see where the correct place to buy tickets is online. The best way to do it is to ignore all the tour guides and people who approach you outside trying to sell you tickets and tours and go in yourself to the official ticket office. The audio guide is good but can be a little hard to follow.

title: Miss Ruth Ashdown
text:
Again a must see!!! 
I’ve been once before in summer and was full of tourists and street sellers. This time raining and lots of building work...
Loads to see around it, on a nice day loads to do!

title: Incontournable
text: Visite incontournable de Rome. Seul bémol, le vidéo-audio guide est de très moyenne qualité :c'est un smartphone avec une prise Jack qui grésille, et un contenu digne d'un documentaire des années 80

title: Beau monument
text: Très beau monument, beau décor qui fait rêver. Toutefois, la construction d'une ligne de métro autour gâche le paysage : on dirait notre dame.

title: Some Good but Some Very Bad
text: The Colosseum is a "must see" attraction in Rome.  However prepare yourself for some very large crowds.  DO NOT WAIT until you are in Rome to buy your admission tickets.  All of the limited admission tickets may already be sold.  Buy your tickets well in advance of your trip.  Aditionally, go for the Underground Tour.  You will get a good understanding of what this amazing structure was designed to do.

title: Malheureusement, il y a toujours trop de monde
text:
Dans les années '60/'70, je pouvais visiter le Colisée, il n'y avait ni billet à payer ni aucun contrôle. Mais maintenant, les files d'attente sont tellement longues que toute envie de le revisiter. J'y passe devant souvent, mais il y a toujours trop de monde et surtout ces gens qui ne cherchent qu'à vous arnaquer.  

😡

title: Scammers ruin it for tourists
text:
The actual archeological site of the Colosseum is amazing. It’s a must do while in Rome and it’s so fascinating to hear about the ancient history. 

The poor rating reflects the hoardes of scammers and aggressive “tour guides” (unofficial guides/everyday folk who really really really want you to buy a tour from them and promise that you’ll get to skip the line). 

We attended today (14th Dec) and found it hard to get near the Colosseum to line up because of the sheer amount of people who try to stop you, and sometimes even grab you, trying to sell you cheaper tickets, take you for tours, ask for ‘gifts’ for their family back home, push items into your hands to then ask for money, and who try to ask you if you speak English to them scam money out of you. 

I estimate in 10 minutes that we directly encountered around 30-40 scammers. It’s quite stressful as well with the fear of being pick pocketed and targeted, so it wasn’t the greatest experience overall.

title: Old building
text: I wasn't so impresed about Colosseum. Yes, it's an old building with history, but now there are just walls. Inside the building it's nothig, only stones and walls, nothig special and the entrance ticket are expensive.

title: Turistfälla :-)
text: Kollade runt endast från utsidan. Pampigt. Lång kö för att komma in. Pratade med folk som tagit en visning av allt och de var mycket nöjda.

title: Meest indrukwekkend aan de buitenkant
text: Wij bezochten het Colosseum met een skip the line ticket begin december in de voormiddag. Er was geen line om te skippen dus die kost hadden we ons kunnen besparen. Voor mij was het indrukwekkender om te zien langs buiten dan langs binnen.

title: Crowded...
text: Happy to have seen it... Must see, but so many people it is not fun. The personnel are not kind and tired of tourist. So, yes it is worth seing but unpleasant... Make sure to buy tickets online to avoid line up.

title: Si può fare di più
text: Visita al colosseo consigliata  ,monumento meraviglioso ,peccato che dopo esserci inoltrati in una confusionaria fila di persone ,ordine questo sconosciuto ,abbiamo pagato 16 euro a testa per vedere una piccola parte della struttura,più della metà è chiusa per lavori ...il resto si può visitare pagando di più. Speriamo che in un futuro prossimo sia più valorizzato e magari che il biglietto sia adeguato a quanto è possibile vedere.

title: Zur Hälfte eine Baustelle (Renovierung)
text: Zum Glück war (1. Sonntag im Monat) kein Eintritt, wir hätten uns sonst sehr geärgert, da das halbe Kolosseum in Gerüst gehüllt ist.

title: Disappointing
text: I have to start by admitting that myself and my friends did not have a guided tour and if we had perhaps my review may be higher. However as beautiful as the Colosseum is I found it rather underwhelming. A good point is that if you prove you are from an EU country entry is just €2. However apart from walking around and using the opportunity for photo’s there isn’t much else you can do.

title: Stay outside guys. It's not worth the price nor the weight to get in.
text:
I know it's difficult to hear that the Colosseum isn't great but listen to me! We've all ruined it.

From the outside, the building looks spectacular, leave it at that and move on.

The scaffolding and new arena floor completely ruin any stunning views you'd hope to find inside so stay out.

We spent longer getting through security than we did walking around the amphitheatre and for good reason, the view from all angles is exactly the same; charming ancient rubble covered over with rickety scaffolding and lazy temporary staging.

I don't recommend. It's a real let-down.

title: Una meraviglia
text: Le 5 stelle che si possono mettere sarebbero poche per la meraviglia di questo monumento della Roma Imperiale. È da 3 esagerando per la poca cortesia ed educazione di chi ci lavora. Chi era alla biglietteria non degna nemmeno di un accenno di saluto e se scocciano se fai delle domande,

title: Ok for a visit
text: Not much to see inside as most of it has collapse. We downloaded audio guide  from the internet because they were selling it for 5,5€.

title: Supervalorizado
text: Fiz a reserva on line e cheguei bem cedo, por isso não peguei fila, mas, logo que abriu já tinha uma fila bem grande. Local interessante de se conhecer, porém supervalorizado, pois Roma tem outros lugares mais interessantes e com menos turistas.

title: History under reconstruction
text: It is definitely worth visiting once in a lifetime, but the place seems to be under reconstruction and I could not feel the magic of the ancient walls. I believe a solution for this would be to temporary close it and open it when it’s ready. Also, there are not enough signs or they are not very clear to tell you which queue or path you should follow.

title: A voir mais sans plus
text: A voir, c est une incontournable de Rome mais sans plus et en plus énormément de mondes à réserver absolument vos places

title: Ruins
text: The whole place is in ruins. It is much prettier outside than inside. So don't bother to go in. If there would be less people, the place could be better.

title: Free sunday
text:
How can you come to rome and not see the Colosseum?
1st Sunday in the month free (basic) entry, was more than adequate. Yes it would have been nice to have seen this monument from on high but would we have appreciated it any more? Unlikely!
More than happy to be able to say "We've been there!"

title: 訪問
text: 昨日、訪問しました。外からの観光です。4回目の訪問です。今回は、雨が降ってきました。写真も撮れました。

title: Viator tour in Rome by Tour in the city
text: Our tour was going to start at 9.30am we reached the office at at 9.37tour office was just opposite to Colosseumoffice person could have done something to direct us to reach to guide but he never helped we lost our tour and without refund please be careful

title: Visite hop on hop off
text: Visite de la ville en bus touristique, mis à part la vétusté du bus, la visite est intéressante, nous faisons le tour des monuments historiques , vous pouvez descendre du bus pour visiter la journée le bus passe toutes les 30 minutes à des arrêts précis

title: When in Rome...
text:
...Go back home.    Nah kidding the rain did spoil the experience but we got flogged an unbrella and then able to stay a bit longer.  Its not as big as i thought nor glamourous as they make it appear on the TV but its something you have to see atleast once when in Rome.  

I suppose it would be better if you go inside but we gave that a miss due to the weather.

You know when you watch those Youtube videos and after every 5 mins theres an advert, well its a bit like that, you check out the colloseum for a few mins then get approached by bengali unbrella babu, then walk on and check out more of the colloseum then get approached by bengali ponch babu.

theyre not aggressive, or too pushy but can get annoying

title: Pur sempre il colosseo
text: Abbiamo prenotato la visita all’interno del Colosseo, che prevede l’ingresso ai fori romani. Il Colosseo di sera, illuminato, è bellissimo. La visita all’interno purtroppo non è stata possibile farla poiché aveva una bottiglia di vino, comprata come souvenir, nello zaino e non ci hanno fatto entrare. Il che è giustissimo, ma almeno riservate un qualcosa come ad esempio armadietti per il deposito oggetti invece che mandare fuori in modo scontroso e basta.

title: Long Lines
text:
So the Colosseum, yes it is mandatory but is it worth it? I don't think so.
The arena at Pozoullli is better.
The lines were long and the touts were plentiful. The ticketing only had two ticket sellers in the windows which is appalling for the length of the line. They are deliberately trying to push tourists into using the tour companies.
If you go there after about 2:30 the lines are short and you can do this joint in about 2 hours.
We were certainly under impressed, the exterior would have been good enough to be honest.

title: Grêve en Italie et non-remboursement OPODO
text:
Bonjour
Tout est dans le titre. Et ceci malgré une souscription assurance toutes causes, OPODO et/ou VUELING ont refusés de me rembourser mon trajet MRS-ROME.
Cordialement

title: Only if you've pre booked
text: Hopefully we had booked on line and we skiped the enormous line! The Palatine hill was very beautiful and worth visiting. The Colosseum was ok but under any circumstances I would wait for hours in the line. Definitely buy your tickets online!

title: Pomeriggio difficile
text: Insieme a 4 amici per vedere il Colosseo, il monumento regge l'assalto di tante persone, ma la situazione intorno é pessima sporco e nessuna area per poter sostare e riposarsi. Tornare a Roma con queste premesse é difficile!!!!!!

title: Obra de engenharia ferrada
text: Você deve visitar o coliseu com a ótica da engenharia e arquitetura, nesse quesito e na época, leva nota 10 com louvor, no entanto, historicamente falando, o lugar é só desgraça, diversas vidas ceifadas para a diversão das pessoas, é algo terrível de se pensar e tentar imaginar como era na época.

title: Overrated Colosseum
text: Very crowded, lots of construction, danger of pick pockets outside. It is a must-see, however do not expect to spend too much time and watch your back.

title: Crowded!
text:
Crowded place and looks good from outside. Did not go in due to the crowd!

If you are really interested in going in, do book your tickets online in advance so you can beat the rush!

title: Takes lots of imagination
text: If you go, do yourself a favor and use a very knowledgeable guide.  Without her, it would have been very difficult to extract a worthwhile tour.

title: Touri hotspot
text: Eben das Kolosseum. Viele Touristen, viele Strassenhändler, letztlich nicht viel zu sehen. Eintritt (16€) kann man sich sparen. Metro B Station ist in der Nähe.

title: ローマと言えばここ？
text: ローマの観光スポットとして定番中の定番のこちらへお伺いしました。お昼の12時ごろに到着したのですが、やはり観光客が多く身動きを取るのもやっとなほどです。訪れる際には、朝一での訪問をお勧めします。時間があれば、内部の観光も良いかもしれませんが、私の感想としては外観を見るだけでも充分だと思いました。

title: Incontournable mais décevant
text:
Surtout acheter des billets coupe-file , quelque soit la saison, sous peine de faire au moins une heure de queue!!
a visiter meme si l'intérieur n 'est pas à la hauteur de l'extérieur.

title: Guided tour
text: First visit to the Collosseum from the inside. The tour guide we hired off the street was atrociously bad -fatal error - we learnt our mistake the hard way and ya only to blame. Notwithstanding same, going through the interior was not any more special and we could have got a good gist from outside itself.

title: Bra besøk, med latterlig kø ordning
text: Alle bør ta turen, men italienerne kan definitivt ikke organisere en kø. Den gikk ikke fremover, mens de med «skip the line» billetter kom relativt raskt inn. Opplegget virket å være at svartebørssalget solgte de samme billettene mange ganger og utrolig nok kom vi forbi køen med en slik billett til 10e (etter å ha stått en time i den vanlige køen..).

title: Une attraction touristique mais incontournable
text: Un incontournable de Rome, peut-être gâché par autant touristes. Réservation des billets à l’avance sur coopculture.it, très facile d’accès et agréable de ne pas faire la queue. Audioguide très décevant. Nous l avons fait par temps de pluie, il y a quelques endroits pour s’abriter malgré tout. Pas mal d’échafaudages mais c est normal pour un monument de cet âge.

title: very interesting place but not worth the money
text:
I was so thrilled to see it for the first time outside
I took a ticket from of websites online of 30 EUR that includes (skip the line), the ground floor and ancient Rome city access
Was surprised that big part of it is under construction
was surprised that we are not allowed to go inside it where the fighters used to go from
surprised that you do not need more than 10 min inside as there is nothing important to stand for, specially with the construction
the audience stairs are almost totally demolished
you can find free water taps inside :)

title: Be prepared for queues
text:
Very very busy. 4 to 5 hour wait to get in so we left the queue in the end. Lots of people pestering to by skip the line tickets but other reviews say they are a rip off so we didn’t do it. 

We had a stroll around the outside which was pleasant

title: Otra maravilla desprestigiada por la multitud
text: Es sin duda una de las maravillas del mundo. Asombrosa y bien de la historia, pero es tanto el público que recibe que pierde el inreres. Colar muy largas para entrar y mercantilismo a su alrededor. Te cobran por saltarte la cola. La oferta de guías es enorme y te quieren vender de todo alrededor. Sin hablar de que vas con el temor de que te tomen en cualquier esquina. No fue mi caso. Pero es un stress hacer esta visita.

title: Bardziej imponujące z zewnątrz
text: Symbol Rzymu więc trzeba zobaczyć ale nie jest to rewelacja. Ciekawsze z zewnątrz. Bilet jest w zestawie z Forum Romanum, więc warto zainwestować.

title: Looks better from the outside
text:
