Really disappointed in the Colosseum. Looks great from the outside, but little remains on the inside and there is no signage to show what it used to look like. Not worth the €16 to get in, although to be fair the ticket gets you into the Forum too.
Save yourself some money and go to Nimes in France instead where you can see a smaller, but mostly intact Roman amphitheatre.

title: En travaux, dommage
text: Pas mal. En travaux, dommage, entrée un peu chère pour voir des échafaudages. Pas de station de taxi à proximité ? Métro devant l’entrée

title: Interesting
text: We managed to get tickets for €2 as we took our passports to show that we were 18-25 and lived in part of the eu. So an absolute bargain. The place itself is interesting, its mad to think what when on there whilst you walk around. We arrived at 10am and managed to get inside within 40minutes and this was when the weather was nice, as we had expected to be in line for at least double the time.

title: Too many people!
text: This is a beautiful place but the crowds ruined our experience.  We had tickets but when we went to get a tour we were told we couldn't get a tour until Christmas.  We did the walking tour but felt like we didn't learn alot.  The site was so pretty in the night, but be careful about what you are getting with your ticket!  And buy them ahead of time.  We were told tickets were sold out for weeks.

title: Muss man wenn in Rom gesehen haben
text:
Leider ist das Kolosseum voll überlaufen und wirklich Spaß macht das nicht. Zu jeder Zeit hängen einem Emigrierte Straßenhändlern an den Beinen und belästigen regelrecht die Besucher. 
Wir würden da nicht wieder hingehen.

title: Interessante, mas dá pra deixar passar.
text: Apesar de ser lindo, o Coliseu não nos surpreendeu . Num primeiro momento ficamos sem ar com a vista, mas depois do primeiro minuto perde a graça, acho que dá pra incluir no roteiro se tiver tempo de sobra. Oferecem audioguide que pode ser adquirido já na compra do ingresso. Chegue cedo, pois a fila é grande.

title: Skip-the-line Colosseum (incl. arena floor) / Forum /Palatine
text:
I booked three tickets online in March 2019 though City Wonders for this excursion whilst visiting Rome with my archaeological colleagues. The ticket price was EUR 36.00 each which Viator handled for City Wonders. One of our number had to cancel which he did several days in advance of the scheduled visit. I contacted City Wonders to claim a refund under their +24 hour policy and eventually a refund of just EUR 26.46 was issued via Viator! When queried they said that the ticket price was a special discount price to their handler, Viator and said that they, Viator, should repay the difference. Viator have said that City Wonders should pay......and so back and forth we go! Neither company wanted to, nor has, honoured their customer policy, clearly stated on each of their websites, that they refund in full any cancellation before 24 hours of the scheduled visit. Viator have only, on behalf of City Wonders, refunded EUR 26.46. Despite several emails seeking a full refund, they have not responded in offering the difference.

I would strongly recommend that you book any excursion through a company that does not use a third-party payment company.

Of the Colosseum experience, we were allowed only 20 minutes on the arena floor and just 40 minutes within the monument!!!! Book an individual combined ticket in advance (as recommended above), obtain a 'paper' guide and enjoy the monuments at your leisure not in a tour or group led.

title: Post cruise
text:
Should have ordered skip the line tickets cause waiting in line was such a waste of precious vacation time and the ticket line is poorly organized. 
Once inside was disappointed by all the scaffolding and construction going on inside and the regular entry ticket doesn’t give you access to all levels. Spent more time in the ticket line than actually touring the location.

title: Personaje de seguridad despreciable.
text:
El pasado 17 de octubre tuvimos una experiencia muy desagradable con una persona de seguridad de la entrada reservada a las escuelas y a los que tenemos las entradas adquiridas por la web en COOPCULTURE. El sujeto en cuestión estaba trabajando en esa puerta sobre las 14 horas, justo antes del cambio de turno, puesto que cuando entramos sobre las 15:15 ya había otros operarios de seguridad trabajando. Se trata de un varón de unos 40 años y con la cabeza totalmente afeitada. El sujeto en cuestión, al intentar preguntarle simplemente si esa era la entrada correcta, se dio la vuelta hacia el grupo que hacía cola en el otro lado de la entrada diciendo “ NO ME INTERESA” y esbozando una irónica sonrisa.

Me parece intolerable que haya gente que trabaje de cara al público y que, aunque su función no sea la de informar, se comporte de esta manera, despreciando a la gente que le requiere con educación. Este tipo de sujetos son los que con su actitud provocan que una experiencia tan bonita como la visita al Coliseo se convierta en un episodio muy desagradable para los visitantes, a la postre, clientes de un servicio.Requerida la empresa COPCULTURE al respecto del incidente, el silencio es su respuesta. LAMENTABLE.

title: Privilégiez les commandes
text:
Plus de 2 heures de queue si vous n'êtes pas munis d'un pass... 
Identique aux arènes d'Arles ou de Nîmes 
Majestueux et impressionnant malgré tout ! 
Un incontournable dans la ville

title: Ok. But trash, long queues and pickpockets detract
text:
It a very interesting building and an important part of Roman history. But we endured long queues, pickpockets and lots of trash on the ground. These all detract from the experience.

Also, why after all these years have they still not finished building it ?

title: Short visit
text: We visited here but found the ques way too long and busy. So we walked around the outside only, which to be fair is still stunning.

title: Pior experiência em Roma
text: Fizemos a compra de tickets fast pass com mais de 2 dias de antecedência para evitar filas e tentar aproveitar ao máximo o dia (também iríamos visitar o Foro Romano e Paladino). Cada ticket custou 29 euros (58 euros no total). Chegamos 8h00 e surpreendentemente a fila do "fast pass" estava maior que a fila de comprar bilhete na hora. Ficamos na fila e ao chegar nossa vez um segurança disse que não poderíamos entrar. Demos mais uma volta no Colisseu, aguardamos mais uma hora, tentamos entrar novamente e novamente fomos barrados. Dessa vez o segurança explicou que como estava marcado 10h30 no nosso ticket, o sistema da catraca dentro do Colisseu não iria liberar aquele horário (9h30). Então aguardamos mais 30 minutos próximo da entrada e às 10h00 fizemos a terceira tentativa explicando que dentro do colisseu já estava formando fila e que provavelmente só chegaríamos na catraca às 10h30. Pois bem não só nos barraram a terceira vez como um segurança barbudo careca (pena q n tirei foto para vcs evitarem falar com ele) foi super ignorante, praticamente nos expulsando de lá. Então esperei até 10h25 (haviam me dito que com 10 minutos de antecedência poderíamos entrar) e fiz questão de perguntar ao segurança ignorante se com 5 minutos de antecedência estava ok? Fiz essa pergunta 5 vezes, ele não respondeu nenhuma, só ficou perguntando a hora do meu ticket (como se nao tivesse me barrado 3 vezes) e qndo eu mostrei (pela quarta vez) e só fez um gesto de "pode passar" com a mão. Então depois de 2 horas e 25 minutos de espera pudemos finalmente pegar a fila (isso mesmo fila) de detector de metais para só então validar o ticket (já havia passado de 10h30) e ainda pegar outra fila pelo audioguia (de má qualidade, o da minha esposa estava até quase descarregado). E qndo finalmente entramos no coliseo: reforma, andaimes, telas, operarios em obra. Além da espera (mesmo tendo pago quase 60 euros num ticket expresso) e da ignorância do segurança eu me decepcionado com o que eu vi. Sinceramente, não gaste seu dinheiro entrando no Coliseu. Se quiser muito entrar, chegue 8h00 que vc vai pagar mais barato, não vai pegar fila e nem lidar com segurança careca ignorante. Quer ver um Coliseu bonito? Vá em Verona! Lá a entrada custa só 10 euros, não tem fila e é muito mais bonito. É uma pena que a administração do Coliseu de Roma contrate um funcionário tão ignorante quanto aquele careca barbudo logo para atender quem paga mais caro para não pegar fila.

title: Doble entrada Coliseo, Foro Romano, Palatino, Visita subterránea español.
text:
¡Hola! Acabo de hacer una doble compra de entradas al Coliseo Romano 
ya que el primero no me fijé en mi vuelo de regreso a Madrid y no podré asistir el 28-Nov. Quise hacer el cambio o extorno pero bien claro dice en su página que no es reembolsable :( Por ello lo estoy poniendo en venta para 02 personas, los únicos creo que quedan para el 28 de noviembre al medio día. Dejo mi WhatsApp: +51 986688988 (Sandra Contreras). Cualquier duda o consulta me pueden escribir.

title: Prendete il salta fila: ne vale la pena!
text: Siamo stati ad agosto 2019 ed avevo letto molte recensioni qui che parlavano di un salta file inutile, che poi bisogna cmq cambiare il biglietto alla cassa, che si farebbe cmq la fila ai controlli, che non si capisce in che fila bisogna andare...io non ho avuto manco mezzo di questo problemi. Ho preso i biglietti sul sito dell'unico rivenditore ufficiale, scegliendo la stampa dei biglietti da casa, siamo passati dalla biglietteria solo per avere il terzo biglietto gratis perchè minorenne. Una volta arrivati al Colosseo, si vede chiaramente quale sia la fila per chi ha comperato il biglietto online, entrati si vede chiaramente dov'è la cassa e quale sia la fila per chi ha acquistato l'ingresso prioritario...La visita in sè mi è piaciuta ma sono rimasta un pò delusa perchè pensavo fosse un anfiteatro ancora in piedi diciamo, io sono abituata all'Arena, lì i gradoni ci sono, ti puoi sedere, è sfruttabile, il Colosseo no...ma immagino sia un gusto soggettivo.

title: El coliseo es hermoso e imponente, la higiene no.
text: Para ser el lugar más visitado de Roma y cobrando lo que cuesta el ticket de entrada, los baños son la cosa más asquerosa que haya visto jamás!!! Deberían poner más atención en la higiene de los mismos.

title: Headout est une grosse arnaque
text: 2 tickets achetés sur headout pour visiter le Colisée et le forum romain, arrivés sur place le guide nous dit que les tickets que nous avons achetés n'auraient pas du être vendus car il ny a plus de place. Nous sommes 10 personnes à se retrouver dans ce cas .. le guide , bien gentil et embarrassé nous a quand même rassemblé en un 2ème groupe pour commencer la visite du Colisée 1h plus tard, sans la visite du forum romain bien sur.. quand vous contactez headout pour demander à être remboursé vous tombez sur un teleoperateur qui vous dit en boucle que vous avez reçu le ticket et qui ne trouve pas de solutions, donc pas de remboursement... A EVITER A TOUT PRIS !!! A vous dégoûter du tourisme, même en egypte on ne se fait pas autant arnaquer...

title: Aucune organisation
text:
Site merveilleux et à voir. 
Mais pour y accéder, il faut savoir ruser ou être d’une patience ... 
Ayant décidés de débuter par le Forum, la billetterie sur place nous envoie au Colisée pour une « réservation » à  11h25 « car c’est maintenant ou jamais ». Arrivés sur place, nous devons faire la queue durant 1 heure pour passer les contrôles de sécurité ! 
Bref, comme tout à Rome vous passez votre week-end à faire la queue, même hors saison.

title: Visita nocturna
text: Visité el Coliseo muchas veces, por lo que esta vez decidí realizar la visita nocturna. Se debe reservar con antelación, seleccionando día, hora e idioma. Son grupos reducidos. Acompaña un guía todo el circuito, de duración aproximada de 1:30. En nuestro caso fue una arqueóloga, excelente, dinámica, que transmitió mucha información interesante. Si bien fue una experiencia interesante, no cumplió con mis expectativas. El circuito completo se hace en conjunto, se va a cierto ritmo que no permite disfrutar mucho el momento. Si alguien va por primera vez, considero que esta no es la primera opción. No se llega a apreciar la maravilla de está construcción.

title: Algo decepcionante
text: Si vas con poco tiempo, creo que este es uno de los monumentos que se pueden disfrutar viéndolo desde fuera y con la multitud de fotos que hay por Internet es suficiente. Me parece que el precio de la entrada es abusivo, y para colmo la audio guía 5,50 € por 6 audios ( muy mal indicados, también). La visita resulta ser un caos si no llevas guía. Hay muchísimo más que ver en Roma!!!

title: Looked past it's best!!
text:
Place was falling down and looked like an olde ruin :)

We visited 21 years ago and they haven't done much since then.

title: Monument impressionnant mais fuyez les audioguides!
text:
Monument impressionnant et riche d'histoire, impossible de ne pas le dire et le constater.
Par contre 2h d'attente en venant le matin en semaine au mois de novembre. Nous sommes clairement du bétails pour l'équipe qui gère le flux de visiteurs. Nous avions eu envie de tester un audioguide pour apprendre plus de choses sur ce monument... une HORREUR!!!! Nous avons tournés en rond pendant environ 1h je pense, personne n'a su nous indiquer le départ du circuit n°1 et nous le cherchons toujours. Un plan très très mal fait où tout à la même couleur et rien n'est lisible. au final nous avons perdu notre temps et notre énergie positive! 
Nous avons finit par écouter les infos de façon décousue quand nous tombions sur d'autres numéros. Les infos données n'étaient pas folles non plus, bref... TRES DECUS de cette expérience dont nous attendions beaucoup et qui nous a coûté 20€ tête.

title: Flot bygningsværk.
text: Romerne festede og blev underholdt. Slaver er på den tid normalt. Men som bygningsværk er det imponerende.

title: Les interesa tu dinero pero no tu comodidad
text: Me sentí mal, si preguntaba algo a algún guía te contestaba con condescendencia, para mi hubiese sido suficiente verlo por fuera.

title: Thieves and rubbish
text: Thousands of tourists crowd in so you will find it difficult to get photos at ground level.Beware thieves! Thieves are everywhere here so keep your valuables safe. All this detracts from what you are trying to do. Filth and rubbish everywhere too. Touts buy the score trying to get your money offering bogus tickets to something you don't need or junk you don't want.

title: Beaucoup d'échafaudages
text:
Certes ce lieu est mythique, tout est dit sur l'histoire et la beauté de ce monument. C'est émouvant mais vraiment entre les travaux du métro, ses barrières qui entravent la visibilité et les échafaudages de part et d'autre tant pour les travaux en sous sol que pour maintenir les édifices, la visibilité est un peu gâchée.
C'est impensable de ne pas y aller mais le clou du spectacle est  ailleurs.

title: Touts spoiled the visit
text:
As a family we had a short visit to Rome, so decided to walk around the city to see the architecture instead of queuing for tickets. We found many wonderful churches that we could visit for free and enjoyed seeing the sights at a pace to suit ourselves. In this way, we walked around the outside of the Colosseum and admired the renovations and understood the history of what we could see. 

What spoiled this place for us above all other places we visited were the people hassling us to buy bracelets etc. They make a point of shaking your hand, asking where you're from and trying to give you free stuff whilst telling you a happy story about their lives. They don't listen to 'no thank you' and keep running after you to ask about your family etc. My teenage daughter was physically touched by them too. We didn't see this level of harassment anywhere else, other sellers were polite but these people were unbelievable and spoiled that visit for us.

title: A great monument that is not well kept
text: The colosseum was one of the sites I have always wanted to see. I went there with my wife and we found a crumbling site that has not been restored at all and looks the same in pictures from 1900... that was a disappointment for us as this is one of the interesting sites to see and we literally couldn't see almost anything because most of it is closed and look quite ruined...

title: Ik had meer verwacht
text: Mijn gezin en ik hadden er meer van verwacht! Maar toch blij dat we het bezocht hebben. toch een must in rome

title: 是非ガイド付きで
text:
ガイドを付けて見学して良かったです。
当日チケット売り場も沢山の人が並んでいました
ガイド付きであればチケットも込みなので並ばずにすみますよ

title: Cliche
text: Worst experience on our trip. We had prepaid tickets which did not give you any benefit. Just a tourist attraction, not worth the 3 hour queue

title: Unbelievable lack of anything resembling organisation
text:
Our visit today has left me gobsmacked at the utter uselessness (and bad temper and rudeness) of the Colosseum website / ticket offices / queue guides / security. Ditto the Palatine and Forum entrance, and speechless as a result of an interaction with two ‘guides’ or ‘security staff’ at the Museo Palatine, who did not even know where or how one could buy tickets! 
It is as if everyone connected to this area is conspiring to prevent visitors entering! And please don’t ask questions or expect decent signage as to how to gain access or which queue to join for what - no-one knows anything and you end up with contradictory information! Even the audio guides blether on at times about thing that obviously are not there! And after paying for the audio guides in the Palatine/Forum, you get told they must be returned by a certain time! 
I did make my way around, I did enjoy the vast historical architectural sights, but would I seriously recommend as a ‘must see’? Hmmm.... not unless you do a great deal of research beforehand and probably spend even more on a good quality private guide. I have no problem with paying to see and support the ongoing works of such a historical sight, but this definitely felt like a rip-off - and especially as a two day ticket means nothing! You have to use it on one day only! 
Will I be back? Definitely not!

title: Nice
text:
Good to see
A long long long queue for SKIP THE LINE TOO
a lot many agents moving around and confusing us
Very frankly LOOKING AT A LONG QUEUE ONE EVENING WE TRIED NEXT MORNING AT @ 9.30 am buttttt no change
We had to leave it aside to visit from inside as we had planned our further tour
NOT TOURIST FRIENDLY SYSTEM

title: Rom reise
text: Gut. Kontrolle mit Ausweis ist Pflicht. Gut erhalten. Zu der jahreszeit nicht zu voll. Kann man besuchen

title: Снаружи гораздо лучше, чем внутри
text: На мой взгляд, снаружи Колизей выглядит гораздо интереснее и величественнее лучше, чем внутри. Так что оптимально сфотографироваться и пройти мимо. Как вариант - ночная экскурсия, возможно ночью не будет огромных очередей и толп туристов.

title: Colloseum visit
text: All felt as expected and as per pictures... got there 30 mins before opening at 8.30 and still queue had started.. suggest get there 8 and no later or else queues too long.

title: Not too impressed.
text:
The Colosseum was far less complete than many others we have visited and I was dissappointed that you could not walk around the centre as it was being excavated. You could only walk around at level 1 and could not even get near to view the centre unless on a guided tour.
 The toilets were completely insufficient for the numbers of visitors.

title: Mixed Experience!
text: Visited October Half Term 2019. The queuing situation was completely ridiculous and unacceptable - two hours from 11am. Not sure why it is so poorly organised and chaotic!!  Recommend you do your homework to find the best way to pre-book and "skip the line".

title: Beaucoup trop de monde
text:
Dommage car c'est complètement désorganisée avec un monde de dingue.
Mais bon il faut le faire une fois dans sa vie mais il faut être patient dans les nombres file d'attente

title: Totally amazing but let down by queues
text:
Completely blown away to visit here and see it for real rather than in photographs. We didn't do a tour and took an hour to go round it all. My whole family enjoyed it.

Negatives that need addressing : queuing very confusing. There was a long queue to pick up our prebooked tickets, then two queues to get in (one for prebooked and one for people to buy) Noone knew what was going on. We were 9am and have to say once the place opened, the queue to actually get in moved quickly but didn't expect to stand 45 minutes in queues from 8.15am!!!!

title: Pas mal
text:
Beaucoup de difficultés pour accéder au colisée.
Pas toujours facile de s'y retrouver au milieu de cette cohue entre vendeur à la sauvette et vendeur de multiple babiole.
Le colisée est en perpétuelle restauration.
Forum palintin très sympa.

title: Imponerande men trångt
text: Kanske man måste besöka detta en gång i livet? Det är stort, intressant men ändå svårt att föreställa sig hur det såg ut en gång. Ganska tråkig guidning.

title: Prompt Admission but Little Else
text: It was somewhat difficult to find the vendor for this even.  There was no voucher exchange for a ticket  as advised in the voucher, We   were only given one hour to visit the colosseum and then meet the vendor who led us to the Palentine Hill and Forum (With no ticket we could not visit independently after seeing the colosseum ). All we received from the vendor was a sticker. The vendor did not show up until 15 minutes prior to our admission time while we were cautioned that if we were late we would miss our visit.  We were "dumped" at the Palentine Hill with not even an offer of a map of the site.  Only benefit was prompt admission.  Awesome site.

title: Great place to check out if you have time!
text: For one, too many renovations have been done to reconstruct it and the Roman Government is in the process of reconstructing the structure some more. You barely get a chance to go near it especially during the So in the long run, not much history will be preserved. If I were you, I would visit it before it becomes too modern.

title: Holiday
text: Even though we had tickets the waiting in line killed us. Really spoilt our time. We are talking hours of waiting. The crowds OMG

title: È tutto rotto
text: Che delusione, mi aspettavo un edificio funzionante e mi sono ritrovato a visitare un mucchio di macerie. Anche lo spettacolo dei gladiatori previsto dal tour non ha avuto luogo, e al suo posto mi hanno mostrato un signore sessantenne con la spada di plastica che sembrava una comparsa di Asterix. Ma dai, poi si lamentano che i turisti preferiscono andare in Francia. Almeno lì la baguette è vera!

title: 30th Birthday Weekend
text:
A wonderful historical building and a lovely morning to wander around. 

We purchased our tickets from the official website before travelling and we are glad we did as the queue to get tickets was very long and would be hours worth of waiting. 

I believe we were about €28 in total for 2 adults this was excluding audio guides. It did include entry to the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. 

You can download audio guides on your phone for free if you want to save some pennies.

The experience outside the Colesseum is slightly ruined by the pestering sellers for tickets, selfie sticks and phone charging banks. Do not give you phone yo anyone like this.

title: Beeindruckend
text: Wir haben die Tickets als Gruppe online gekauft, Preis war ok! Das Kolosseum war von innen wie auch von außen traumhaft und sehr beeindruckend. Im gekauften Ticket waren das Forum Romanum und Palatin inklusive. Doch die letzteren durften wir nicht besuchen, da das Ticket auf 15:30 Uhr belief und um 15:30 die letzteren bereits schlossen. Eine Frechheit, umsonst bezahlt. Ansonsten war es ein toller Kurztrip in die ewige Stadt.

title: Görülmesi gereken yer. Ama ücret ödeyip içeriye girilmez
text: Büyük heyecanla gidip içeri girerken ödeyeceğiniz 20 euroya değmeyen yer. Içerisi o kadar talan edilmiş ki içeriye girince  bir şey kalmadığını göreceksiniz.  Bu nedenle çevresinde gezinseniz yeter.

title: I came. I saw. I left.
text: If you see pictures and read all the history hype, you can avoid a long wait line, huge crowds, a port a john bathroom, and a big disappointment.

title: Nice to see
text: Really nice to see from outside, but worth the wait in line or skip line though. Inside was plain and nothing special

title: Colas interminables para entrar
text:
Colas interminables para entrar
Además todo llena de andamios que hace perder el encanto de la visita

title: Monumento espetacular
text: Lindo por fora, mas o valor pra entrar não compensa, além da fila. O skip the line é caríssimo e também não recomendo. Mas pela importância histórica, é interessante. Mas contemplar por fora vale mais a pena.

title: תקראו על המקום קצת לפני שאתם מצטלמים/נכנסים אליו
text:
כשהבנתי מה קרה במקום הזה,פתאום הרגשתי נורא ואיום להצטלם שם..
מרום נוראי אמנם נראה יפה ומרשין מבחוץ,אבל כל ההיסטוריה שהיתה בתוכו איומה.

title: Part of the “hop on and off bus routes.
text:
It is of course one of the sights of Rome that is a “must see”.

However, on a hot day it may be easier to remain on the open topped bus and rely on the photo opportunities from there. The crowds ,like anywhere in Rome, make a short visit very tiring and a disappointment since we were returning with fonder memories of quieter times in the eternal city. Unless you want to do an in depth tour of previously viewed sights we suggest the open buses are a perfect way to see the many tourist places on offer, then return to those that you feel worthwhile for a less busy run around.

We found the  need to see everything again became less critical as our aching bones increased and our wallets got thinner. We did make sure we went to the Sistine Chapel, this we had missed on our last visit to the Vatican some thirty years ago. That was worthwhile but the walk to the Trevi Fountain was sadly over crowded to the extent that even waiting for hours it is unlikely to allow a good photo opportunity, just as well we had some from our last trip.

Staying at the Bernini Bristol was a great choice as it was so central to the many places we wanted to see. It also was ideally placed for a couple of bistro pubs where a snack and a beer was all we needed to see us through the long day or upon a late night return or a pre dinner “happy hour” beer or wine.

title: Holiday
text: I thought visiting the colosseum, was one of the most interesting sites in Rome, and it has a very important role in the history of Italy, and for generations of people throughout the world, it has become a must see attraction, I would recommend to anybody who has this site on their visit plan to pay for a fast pass, to avoid huge queues, as they are worth it.

title: Amazing site
text: Wonderful site with phenomenal history. Only problem, street vendors who refuse to let you go and make every Effexor to sell you bracelets (placing them on your wrist as a “gift” and refuse to take them back until you agree to give money).  Beware the line of “nice shoes” as soon as you respond, they are there for a sale, and can be abusive when you continue to say no.

title: Mafia capitale
text: Il più grande museo all’aperto del mondo in mano ad una gestione di privati. Andate a vedervi quante e quali tipi di code ci sono. Se paghi bene, altrimenti finisci in una cosa di comitive giapponesi o coreane che come pazienti formichine attendono il loro turno. Ovviamente spennati per ogni servizio. Il degrado che ha colpito la capitale in questi anni è visibile ovunque. Risorse boldriniane si avventano su ignari passanti alla ricerca di denaro e mentre facevamo la coda per entrare siamo stati avvicinati da male intenzionati. Chiudiamo i porti della invasione o ci troveremo a parlare e mangiare arabo.

title: Pre book
text:
Nice place but remember to pre book your tickets before to avoid the queue. LOTS of people.
Difficult to get space.

title: Tricky
text: Bought a Roma Pass.  Had trouble finding the outlet to get a time to visit.  Guards at gate said go up the hill!! Don't.  It's next door just take time to look through all the tourists and romans. Not hard and don't believe what they tell you.  Felt very sad and cluttered with tourist and pimps  shoving and wanting that photo shot of them in the background.  Not sure it's a must. A place of no rest. I'm a tourist and couldn't wait to leave.  The people who died ....  dignity and death. ...not sure what to say   Didn't feel right.....  From the outside I said a few words.  That was enough for me.

title: ביקור יקר ומיותר
text:
לדעתי להידחס עם עוד מיליוני תיירים בתוך אוסף של אבנים ישנות זה ממש לא שווה את מחיר הכרטיסים. 
מספיק להצטלם מבחוץ או להגיע בערב/בבוקר כששקט יותר. 
לא לקחנו סיור ואני לא בטוחה שזה היה משפר את המצב- ככ רועש ודחוס שם שאי אפשר לעקוב אחרי המדריך

title: 2000 anni
text: 2000 anni di storia racchiusi in un Colosseo. Bellissimo. Unica pecca.la fila enorme. E bagni non adeguati

title: Ice but too croweded
text: Super crowded a bit like the Vatican - very nice in itself but too many people for our liking. Not something I think old go back to. We did the audio tour which was nice but again it’s a bit overwhelming.

title: Unable to get in
text: Length of time in queue was not tolerable ， take your photos and leave , it will soak up half a day.

title: Mucha gente
text: Tuvimos algunos problemas logísticos para ingresar. Falta algo de logistica y las audio guías muy difíciles de obtener

title: Not Worth Your Precious Time!
text: Far too busy and crowded for any sort of enjoyment.  You'll get better pictures from the outside than you will inside.  The highlight of my visit here was the gift shop!

title: Nice to wach
text: Nice place to see, l  personally didn't feel the need to do a tour. But the building is spectacular and is close to all the central areas of Rome so you can't miss it.

title: Very interesting
text: We visited this in October, booked a quick access ticket which did get us in a bit ahead of long queues but you still have to wait a bit. There is access for disabled which we appreciated for my elderly mother. We used the audio guide that you can buy inside, it was ok but I’ve used the guided tour before which I think is better, you get more from them.

title: Bof bof
text:
Tout d abord reservation obligatoire en se servant du site officiel du colisee ou a defaut celui du forum (billet commun).
La visite est relativement courte en 1h30 avec une absence totale d'informations. Soit vous avez un livre mais vous ne profitez pas dzs couleurs, nuances. Soit un guide mais vive les dollars. Soit libre en se renseignant avant.
Toute les parties renforcees ou reconstruites font que cela parait tres artificiel

title: Abandono
text:
3 horas de espera hasta entrar. Desorganización, exceso de aforo, precio excesivo para la visita del recinto, información insuficiente (folletos, paneles, etc.)
Muy mejorable en general, pero es Historia.

title: So totally ⒶⓋⒺⓇⒶⒼⒺ
text:
Hmmm.

I’ve been but wouldn’t bother going again. Ticked it off the list n’all.
My problem with this - and other things in Rome - has been that I really don’t feel like the city is making the most of what it’s got. More on this later...

We did a queue skip ticket and got there at about 8.15 and the queuing to go through the bag check (of sorts) was minimal. If you leave it much later than that though, the queuing looked pretty mega.

The coolest thing about the whole visit was seeing the place fairly deserted at sunrise-ish time. Walking away from the Colosseum at about 11 was so crowded it was pretty gross.

Even very early, it was very busy inside, and we were some of the first people in. I could not go in any direction without seeing a selfie stick, phone screen, walking through someone’s photo or finding myself ensconced in a loud American conversation. 

I had an audio guide but to be honest, watching scenes from the film Gladiator were more useful. It was pretty basic. I learned one fact which was that apparently the whole underground thing was initially filled with water and they had proper ship battles on it - cool. 

I kind of just feel like the whole thing could be done so much better in a more controlled and thoughtful manner. Sure, the ‘let everyone loose (nearly) everywhere’ approach is inclusive and probably keeps entry costs down, but it wasn’t the majestic, awe-inspiring experience one might expect. 

Be brave Romans - close it down, miss out on the millions and squillions of daily revenue for a bit and make it way better!

title: Gewaltig ... und voll
text: Das Kolosseum von aussen bewundern muss man! Muss man rein? Kaufte mein Ticket für Forum Romanum und Kolosseum um 1340 Uhr und sollte um 1420  ins Kolosseum. Ist nicht zu schaffen, wenn man sogleich das Forum Romanum besucht. Find ich frech.

title: Coliseum
text: The coliseum for me was a little disappointing its worth visiting but you should spend more time at the forum than coliseum because there is not much to do you can cover it in an hour or so..

title: Horrible wait times
text: Thought we would avoid the crowds in October, plus had the Roma Pass, which used to help you with the lines.  Nope.  One 2 hour line to get a ticket and time, and 2 hours more to get in.  We gave up and left.

title: можно и наружи посмотреть, видно, что внутри
text: во внутрь не попала, было закрыто. посмотрела снаружи через арки, все видно и так, хорошо, что не потратилась

title: Eher enttäuschend
text:
(Italienisch folgt)

Gut, dass wir die Tickets im voraus gekauft hatten und nicht anstehen mussten, sonst wäre unser Ärger noch größer gewesen. Die Ruine ist schon imposant, aber drinnen ist nicht viel mehr, als man von außen mitbekommt. Dürftige Infos über das Kolosseum, so gut wie nichts über die Gladiatoren und das Leben in Rom. 

Menomale che avevamo comprato il biglietto in anticipo è saltato la fila, altrimenti ci saremmo arrabbiate ancora di più. Guardarlo da fuori o da dentro non fa differenza sostanziale...ci sono pochissime informazioni sulla vita a Roma o i combattimenti dei gladiatori. Una delusione...

title: Huge historical place
text: We enjoyed a stroll here but it was a bit too sunny so we didnt stay long. The crowd was also a bit overwhelming.

title: Bello ma...
text:
Ci sono andata giovedì, il colosseo è sempre il colosseo ma quello che non va ci sta in torno.
Purtroppo Roma in questo periodo è un cantiere a cielo aperto pernenne quindi vuoi o non vuoi ci sono sempre il rumore dei cantieri in corso e il disturbo di vedere impalcature ovunque e aver strade bloccate per i lavori. Speriamo solo che questa cosa prima o poi terminerà.

title: Meraviglioso
text: Non mi è piaciuta la ristrutturazione, avrei preferito se avessero rivestito di marmo come è stato fatto almeno nella parte ristrutturata, così è troppo preciso e stona con il resto.

title: Visita con audioguía, sin grupo
text: La entrada al coliseo para mi no está bien señalizada y es medio caótica. Recomiendo llegar con anticipación! Mi entrada incluía el foro Romano y el palatino más un video previo explicativo. La audioguía es una aplicación q tenés que descargarte en tu celular. Si tenes iPhone hay que tener auriculares propios si o si!

title: Rom
text: Min dotter och jag skulle gå in på Colosseum, kö in i 3 timmar skulle få betala 1300:- för att komma in. Så tråkigt att få betala så mycket och att få stå i en så lång kö. Så vi tog en promenad runt byggnaden, det var vi nöjda med.

title: What you would  expect
text: I'm not sure taking a tour is any great advantage other than quicker entries.  Most of what you see inside you have already seen on tv. It was sad to me to see the destruction from pollution and stupid previous attempts at saving the structure.  I enjoyed viewing the outside more than the inside.  Such a world treasure deserves better care.

title: To many people.
text:
Colosseum is of course a very impossant building and history. 
I think it has way to many visitors. It is just as interesting to watch the bilding from the outside. If you enter, expect several queues and people everywhere.

title: Sad
text: Not like u expect they are slowly repairing it but not as it was but newer design doesn't fit in will old style more like a cyborg of its originality

title: Prachtig om te zien, een must see!
text: Vond de begeleiding/personeel niet vriendelijk. Maar door de vele toeristen was het er ook erg druk, je geduld wordt wel op de proef gesteld. Door de vele verkopers om je heen was de sfeer niet altijd wenselijk, beetje te veel aanwezig en lieten ons niet meteen met rust toen we aangaven nergens belangstelling voor te hebben. Zodra je door de poort bent is dit over.

title: Ponto turístico
text:
Não se pode deixar de ir conhecer um dos principais pontos turísticos de Roma e, quem sabe da Itália. É bonito, curioso e imponente... É legal estudar o lugar antes ou contratar um guia, assim se consegue absorver mais da energia do local.
Mas é um programa “turistão”:
Lotado, filas enormes e exige disposição física.
É legal de conhecer... mas precisa estar disposto e, preferencialmente comprar o ingresso pela internet.... ajuda a eliminar muito tempo em filas gigantes

title: Un monde fou, des travaux partout, un accueil impersonnel, finalement bien lieux à l’exterieur qu’à l’intérieur
text: Un monde fou, des travaux partout, un accueil impersonnel, finalement bien lieux à l’exterieur qu’à l’intérieur

title: Lange Warteschlange
text: Den Besuch wert , aber hinein nach ca 3 Std anstehen . schlecht. überall diese nervenden Schrottverkäufer. echt nervig .

title: Du monde, visite guidée indispensable.
text:
Je ne vous décris pas lieu c un incontournable.
En revanche pour bien en profiter, une visite guidée est indispenable: 3 chouettes seulement car pour avoir des  renseignements utiles ou une réservation sur le net c la galère. Pas grand grand-chose en français comme souvent à Rome...
Essayez en agence ?

title: You have to see it, but not the most interesting place
text: We did the underground tour with Walks of Italy.  The guide did an amazing job, but I did not find the Coliseum itself all that interesting for the amount of time we spent there. Palatine Hill was of more interest.

title: Si lo vas a ver, velo por fuera
text:
No sabría por donde empezar, si desde el desorden que se hace en las filas para poder comprar entrada o para poder entrar en sí. Lo más interesante es completamente visible desde fuera a menos de que seas una persona sumamente interesada en la arquitectura.
Lo más interesante del coliseo fueron los bustos dentro del mismo y la maqueta a escala que se encuentra ahí.
Sinceramente puedes disfrutar de esta maravilla recorriéndole por fuera y ahorrarte el costo de la entrada, tampoco sirve comprar entradas anticipadas debido a la desorganización.

title: Diaorganizzati!
text: Il colosseo non ha sicuramente bisogno di recensioni positive o negative. Il colosseo è unico al mondo e tutto il mondo ce lo invidia. Ed è proprio perché ci sono persone che arrivano da ogni parte del pianeta che bisogna rivedere l'organizzazione sugli ingressi. Credo che fare un po' di coda per visitare questo monumento sia più che lecito, ma fare più di 2 ore d coda con il biglietto in mano, ed aspettare così tanto tempo solo per entrare, bhe.... credo proprio che sia colpa di organizzatori poco capaci! Inoltre i cestini per i rifiuti sino quasi inesistenti e diventa complicato Non sporcare. ..... C'è molto da fare .......

title: Historia men mycket folk
text: Historisk ställe och fint men så mycket folk så vi valde att inte gå in, men att gå runt hela området är också charmigt.

title: Davvero bello!
text:
Se capitate a Roma non potete non fermarvi a visitarlo..ma una volta nella vita basta!! 
Con il biglietto da 12€ visitate la Arena, i fori Imperiali e il colle Palatino!!

title: 暑かった～めちゃ混み
text: 8月中旬に行きました。40度近い中、人がすごい！！朝8時過ぎにはすでに100人くらい並んでいました。結局、12時頃入場しました。建物が大きすぎて、人がとても小さく見えます。じっくり見たかったのですが、暑すぎて３０分くらいで退散！！

title: Better from the outside
text: Horribly busy. Timed entry with multi-ticket to Palatine and Forum.  Not made clear that my husband's useful penknife (corkscrew/bottleopener etc) was banned and so we lost it to the security never to be seen again.What is more the so called two day entry only works if you do the Colosseum the first day and the Palatine Hill and Forum the second. Also this too was not made clear so we were reused entry to the Forum on the second day as we had already been to the Palatine Hill in the afternoon of the first. All very confusing in the crowds, noise and heat.

title: Spectacular
text: But you don't miss much by going inside after enduring long lines even with a pre purchased ticket.  Do a walk about of the perimeter and be wowed at its immensity and  construction

title: Hade hoppats på mer
text: Såklart är det ett måste när man besöker rom, men till skillnad från Vatikanen olika turistmål gav besöket på coliseum en lätt känsla av att man önskat mer. Guidad tur är ett måste.

title: Visite
text:
Un bon plan pour visiter le Colisée..le forum .paladin .catacombes...avec les bus big bus..
Pas d attente..

title: Hassle trying to get free child ticket
text:
while the colosseum itself was obviously very impressive, was incredibly difficult trying to get in. i am 15, meaning i am entitled to a free ticket if i provide identification. we bought tix through big bus tours which was great. we skipped line and it was a breeze. asked lady working at big bus who led us there if my student id card (that had my name, d.o.b, photo, etc) would be ok and she said yes it would be fine. 

so we go to the desk we were told to go to in order to get my free ticket. handed over my id card and she basically said uh no this isnt id. my dad was very frustrated and despite my reserved personality, i voiced my frustration too. i said, this is literally called an id card like what more can we give. she said passports only. we were told to bring id, not explicitally passports so we had left them at airbnb to keep them safe since they are much more valuable than an id card which can be easily replaced. she pushed it back and we said again "it has my photo and my date of birth, we cant go back to get the passports now, the tour lady said it was fine.' she walked off in a huff and gave us the ticket but had so much attitude. these attractions really need to get their act together because we had many issues getting in to multiple places in rome and staff were not even respectful about it and had a real uppity attitude.

title: Not what I expected
text: I think i over-hyped it in my head, it wasn’t as grand as I had imagined it would be. It was worth the experience but not nearly as awe-Inspiring as other things in Rome

title: Too long waiting line
text: I think everyone knows Colosseum and I'm sure it would be very interesting visit it and see it from inside. But the line for entrance is too long (waiting several hours). It just doesn't worth it.

title: Overpriced and overcrowded
text: Constantly hassled by ticket touts and huge queues that dampened enthusiasm. Didn't bother going in in the end! But have been before and didn't over rate it then either. Other Colisseums in Rome that are free access btw.

title: The lines are ridiculous
text: Don't go unless you buy a skip the line ticket. It is ridiculous. Line up for 2 hours get inside then line up for another hour to get a ticket. Complete chaos! Colliseum obviously amazing but unless you have literally nothing better to do than queue up while on holiday don't do it!!!!

title: Primero me impacto....
text: Lo vimos de pasada al llegar a Roma que emoción.,!!!!  Desde chicos lo vemos en todos los libros. Teníamos excursión comprada. Pero sin guía al llegar ese día fue muy emocionante las calles q nos conducían a el. Ya q había columnas y edificios de aquella época. Tuvimos q esperar nuestro horario de ingreso  esta todo muy estrictamente controlado. Pero no nos entusiasmo mucho. Debimos tener guía. No me daban los espacios. Para algunas cosas q nos contaron.como por ejemplo las batallas en barco. En fin nos desilusionó un poco. Les recomiendo q compren la excursión con Guia. Afuera había a un alto costo y la gente también se quejaba porque eran solo 20 minutos. Fue mi experiencia.

title: Massive, Impressive but, oh goodness, the lines!
text: The Colosseum is of course a must for any traveler to Rome. Being able to learn about it's history and have some previous assumptions debunked was great. However, the lines were insane and we even had a scheduled entry time on a private tour. We still waited over an hour just to get through security. It was so slow and took up at least 1/3 of our tour time, we had to rush through other part of our tour because of the time drain here at the Colosseum. We love history so it was great to see nonetheless.

title: "OK"
text: It is still a big ruin and restauration works are possibly going on. A skip the line ticket works well as the crowds here can be very big. You can then go in fast, walk around take some pictures and get out again. One hour inside is more then enough time to see it.

title: Colosseum at Night
text: This tour was a waste of time and money. We did the day tour three years ago and thought it would be interesting to see it at night. It was awful. The meeting place was difficult to locate and required a great amount of walking before even getting to the Colosseum. There’s very little light to see anything, and the tour consisted mainly of three boring videos. Very few pictures were possible due to the darkness.  Do the day tour instead.

title: Interesting attraction - definately get skip the line tickets though - it took us 1.30 hours to get in
text: Interesting and well presented attraction, however - ques to get inside were lengthy - it took us 1.30 hours to get in.

title: Majestuoso
text:
No es ninguna novedad, el que yo diga, que es un monumento majestuoso. Escribo esta opinión, porque creo que es importante para los que pasen por Roma, que si van a visitar este grandioso monumento, lo hagan con un guía,
A no ser, que seáis unos eruditos en historia, puede ocurrir, que si no vamos acompañados de alguien que nos vaya contando la historia, no podemos sacarle todo el jugo a dicho monumento.

title: Confusion at its greatest
text: Really hard to find the ticket office. Three lines and no one knew where to stand. The answers of the officials were stand on the line (which one?). The staff who knew were we have to stand was at the beggining! Of the line. After going to the correct line everything was better. It is a huge place where you can see a part of Roman era.

title: HEADOUT TOURS IS A SCAM
text: Simply writing this review to add to the other horror stories of headout tours scamming people by not having their tour guide show up. I paid for skip the line tickets and showed up 30 minutes early to the meeting point at the arch of Constantine as instructed. After waiting for some time I start circling the arch as other group tours are coalescing, but the one with the supposed “Tours About” sign wasn’t there. Emailed customer service about a refund and they bold faced lied and said the guide was there and I was a no show. Don’t let these morally bereft crooks take your money, learn from mistakes and those of others who have been scammed

title: Historisk vingesus
text: Fantastisk at gense Colosseum. Man bliver overvældet af bygningen og historien bag. Desværre bliver man også nærmest overfaldet af gade sælgere,der konstant river i dig for at sælge noget skrammel til dig. Det burde der gøres noget ved,da det ødelægger oplevelsen 😏

title: Bien mais organisation à revoir ...
text:
Monument incontournable à Rome ! 

Le premier dimanche du mois l’accès au Colisée est gratuit (entrée qui comprend aussi celle du Forum Romain et du Mont Palatin), les autres jours les étudiants bénéficient d’une réduction (ne pas oublier sa student card). 

L’audio guide était pas mal, même si la feuille d’indications fournie avec était à mon goût incomplète/peu précise. 

Concernant le temps d’attente, la queue peut paraître longue mais elle avance assez vite. Nous avons attendus à peine 45 mins alors que les vendeurs de coupe-file indiquaient une queue de 3h...

title: Tour with audio
text: The tour was interesting and included the Palatine Hill. The number of tourists are a problem but what can you do?  The weather is very good this time of year. I can’t imagine doing it it summer.

title: Turistigt
text: Tog en guidad tur på tre timmar. Rekommenderas inte om man har små barn. Trångt och folk överallt. Äldre barn och vuxna uppskattar dock turen. Dock en cool upplevelse.

title: MAKE SURE YOU GET WHAT THEY PROMISE!!!
text: Colosseum tour operators offer a split guided tour between Colosseum and Palatine Hill. The problem is that the second part of the Tour, the first guide drops the group off to another guide who do not use audio, speaks poor English, and rushes through the second half. It's like they are two different companies. MAKE SURE you get a complete AUDIO-guided tour for both parts of the tour!

title: Disappointing
text: Whilst undoubtedly the largest arena in the world, it is far from the best preserved. Not much to see inside so I would suggest saving the entrance fee and the time spent queuing and visit the outside at night when it is illuminated. Looks spectacular! If you want to understand the world of the gladiator try the coliseum in Nimes instead.

title: Worth a visit but not as spectacular as I was expecting
text: I had been looking forward to visiting the Colosseum and it looked imposing as we walked towards it but after queuing for over an hour I must admit that I was a little disappointed. You can get a sense of the history within it but maybe it was just me as it just didn’t tick all of the boxes. I’m glad I went to see it as it’s got so much history around it (including the various ruins along the road as you approach the Colosseum) but if I go back to Rome there would be other places I visit instead

title: Sempre incantevole
text: Abbiamo alloggiato a due passi dal Colosseo ed ogni mattina, passeggiare con la famiglia nel parco di Traiano al Colle Oppio, ammirando il Colosseo non ha prezzo.

title: Un peu décevant
text:
C'est sans aucun doute la plus grande arène jamais construite mais actuellement en piteux état. On tente de sauver l'édifice par des travaux importants.
Pour le visiter, privilégier de vous y rendre tôt le matin pour éviter une foule nombreuse.

title: Bellissimo come sempre.
text:
Visitato troppo velocemente.
Ci vuole più tempo per godere di tale attrazione. ..
Noiosissimi gli attori vestiti da centurione.
Molto invadenti.
Se una foto con loro può valere 70 euro...
Ma per cosa?
Attenzione....vendono biglietti non regolari per visitare le bellezze di roma. 
Non sono autorizzati...potrebbero essere falsi.
Pieno di borseggiatori abilissimi anche se le forze del ordine sono attenti questi sono sempre più furbi....
Occhio alle borse zaini e camere...
Portate sempre tutto avanti a voi!!!
Speriamo di avervi aiutato.

title: Così non può funzionare
text:
Che dire ho dovuto fare una fila di più di un ora dopo aver acquistato il biglietto online 
Che dire questa purtroppo questa non è organizzazione 
Nessuno sapeva che fila dovevo fare e per questo sono stata io a chiedere in giro quale fosse la fila dei possessori di biglietti 
Dovete migliorare senza ombra di dubbio.

title: Beeindruckend und voll!
text: Die Menschenmassen Schrecken echt ab , aber da kann das Colosseum ja nichts zu! Die schiere Größe ist atemberaubend,  das ganze Drumherum ätzend! Zum Glück sind die „Gladiatoren- und Legionärs-Darsteller“ weg weil verboten! Die waren nicht auszuhalten! Aber jetzt reicht es auch mit Colosseum!

title: En travaux...
text: De nombreux échafaudages gâchent la vue, endroit très sale... Sans compter le manque de civisme de certains touristes... il ne vaut mieux pas payer les 12 euros demandés et contempler de l'extérieur...

title: Colosseum
text: Unfortunately there was a lot of work ongoing when we visited, so we didn't really get the "wow" feeling. It's smaller than I had pictured but when in Rome you have to visit the Colosseum.

title: Nightmare
text:
It is disorganised. There are no signs for queues so you could very well stand in the wrong queue just to be turned away.
Different days are free. You are best to go with an organised tour or do plenty of research regarding ticket options before you visit. Be sure to ask if your ticket option really does guarantee fast track. Those who have commented on walking tours that had to wait while the guide got tickets are probably not waiting anywhere near as long as the prepaid tickets which seem to move at the same pace as not tickets. 
If it is going to rain they could stop people entering until enough people leave and therefore the queue will stall.

title: Bien
text: No aporta mucho verlo por dentro realmente depende de tu imaginacion o de las historias que te cuenten, como muchos restos arquitectonicos esta bastante deteriorado aunque han intentado conservarlo al maximo. Obligado de ver dado que se considera una de las 7 maravillas del mundo pero yo diria que fue en su dia sin duda una de las 7 maravillas, hoy no en dia no estoy tan seguro.

title: Nice to see, nicer to stay away
text:
Yes. We get it. It’s a historical landmark, it has a rich story and is definitely worth learning about. That being said, the place is absolutely SWARMING with tourists, buses, cars and with that - scammers, street thieves and other questionable characters.

Unless you truly feel urged to see the colosseum with your very eyes, I would personally strongly recommend to stay away from that place and go read about it in Wikipedia while sitting in a nice café or rooftop bar (of which Rome has many!) somewhere else - far, far away from that place. Good luck!

title: Nice to see the Colleseum but it was very busy.
text: We visited the Colleseum via booking with Tiqets. It was all a bit chaotic, when we got into the Colleseum we were told to wait for 10 minutes, then shown were the rest rooms were and some of the attractions. Then to meet by the gate outside an hour later to visit Palantine Hill and the Forum. We had down loaded the audio guide to our phones. After about 45 minutes of looking around we had seen enough and decided to leave and miss the other parts of the trip. As we left a storm came in and rained really hard, so we found a nice cafe to have lunch and let the storm move away.

title: Vale pela história
text: Do lado de fora uma fila enorme, desorganização e falta de informação. Vc paga para ser mal tratado. Depois de quase 1 hora quando vc consegue entrar, que vc ver tudo aquilo q vc assistiu nos filmes e leu nos livros de história, aí vc esquece um pouco do perrengue que passou. Comprem antecipadamente pela internet

title: Pour la ballade
text: A voir juste pour la ballade, c'est beau et surtout incroyable comme beaucoup de chose mais juste en ballade

title: Hard work
text: Like every part of tourist Rome, this place is crawling with 'lookey-lookey' men pushing phone chargers, selfie-sticks, scarves and hats. They spoiled most of our trip. Fortunately, once you get into an attraction, they disappear.....you then get hundreds of other tourists, nightmare. Rome Council ought to get their act together to clean up the city - literally. I've never seen so much grafitti. And most of the streets feature horrible cobbles. Rome is very tiring. But it's done now. Good luck to future tourists, you'll need it.

title: Stay away from Headout
text:
I booked a Colosseum tour on 21-Sep-2019 from 2:30 pm. When I reached there , nobody was there.I called the number mentioned in the ticket . They assure me somebody will be there on time and request me to wait. Around 2:35 pm when I called them up, they told "there is no tour for Colosseum at 2:30". You check with Headout and sort this out.
I was in a big trouble, I requested the local tour organiser to send me email mentioning that there is no such tour. They emailed me back.
I returned from tour but still there is no refund and I am struggling.
Please do not book tour from headout. There are n numbers of good tour organiser (like City Wonders, walks italy spain and greece ). Don't use Headout else be prepare for last minute embarrassment.

title: Colosseum
text:
The Colosseum was wonderful ! But, DONT buy your tickets here !!!
We paid $148.00 for 4 tickets, we were "7 minutes late" for our tour due to not being able to find the place to pick the tickets up (seriously we were running like we were on the amazing race) and they said our tickets had EXPIRED !!! UGH !!!
So.... not wanting to miss out on the Colosseum, we ended up having to pay for tickets again at the gate anyways. We truly enjoyed the Colosseum. 
Just DONT buy Tickets here !

title: Ovviamente non mi riferisco all'opera archologica ma all'organizzazione
text: Ci tengo a far presente che nonostante avessimo il biglietto acquistato da tempo perché gruppo con guida e l'entrata fosse per le 15,50, siamo entrati con circa 45 minuti di ritardo facendo un'allucinante fila sotto il sole. Incapacità dei custodi che stanno all'ingresso che non sanno cosa devono fare ma sicuramente non dipenderà da loro che sono buttati come i gladiatori nell'arena. Over booking vergognoso!!!

title: Less than the hye
text: Don't get me wrong - the Colosseum is amazing to see, but buying tickets and going inside was somewhat disappointing, although you should do it once if you have the time (side note - we weren't able to tour the lower areas, and I've heard the night tours are great).  We had a Roma Pass to help avoid the lines, but there are just way too many people.  We were only there for about an hour.  If you have a short stay, I'd avoid going inside the Colosseum and instead spend more time in the Forum

title: Utter rip off - 2 day ticket
text: Bought a 2 day ticket to the Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palantine Hill - found out that you do not get to choose when you visit. Utter rip off - BE AWARE THAT YOUR VISIT TO THE COLOSSEUM IS TIMED!!!!

title: Imposantes Bauwerk
text: Für Brot und Spiele (heute: Hartz4 und Fußball) war den Imperatoren nichts zu groß oder zu teuer um die Zufriedenheit des Volkes zu erhalten. Heute ist es angesagter Anziehungspunkt für Menschenmassen. Der Eintritt lohnt sich m.E. nicht Innen ist alles leer und kaputt.

title: Poor management by colosseum
text: Today we paid for skip the line tours of the colosseum. On arrival with our tour it was announced that there were too many people in there and the gates to the public closed. We had to wait an hour to enter. This is far from skip the line. Even City Wonders tours were shocked that so many tickets could be sold on a day when they know how many people are allowed in at one time. Very disappointed as your was then rushed to finish on time.

title: Pessima organizzazione
text:
Assolutamente disorganizzato, chi non compra il biglietto online salta fila (minimo 20€ a persona) deve fare ore di fila interminabile (sembra non andare nemmeno avanti) sotto al sole, senza uno straccio di indicazione su quale sia indicativamente il tempo d'attesa (e nessuno a cui chiedere, del resto). Fatto così non ne vale la pena.
MAI PIÙ.

title: Made in Rome Tours
text: The tour itself is excellent and booking a guided tour of this kind is an absolute must to avoid the queues and to cover three sites in one excursion - Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Forum.  However, our party was much larger than we had anticipated and although our guide spoke English adequately, he was often difficult to follow and  although attentive and inviting questions he was prone to ramble a bit.  Several of our group confessed to switching off for periods of time.  Having to use ear pieces throughout  didn't help - although necessary it meant that greater care was needed to provide clearer explanations and more information than we received.  That said, our guide was really nice, and the overall experience was good - I would rate it 3.5 if I could!

title: Visita  bastante confortable.
text: Dentro de la enorme multitud de visitantes, entramos con relativa comodidad. El punto de encuentro coincidió con el indicado y no fue difícil de encontrar. El horario respectado.

title: Décevant
text: Je m’attendais à une visite plus complète tant dans les explications que dans les espaces visités . Je me faisais une joie d’entrer dans cette arène mais je n’ai pas appris grand de plus

title: Riesiges und ansehnliches Gemäuer
text: Wir haben uns es nur von aussen angesehen, weil uns die schlange davor zu lang war, aber auch das hat ausgereicht um sich einen Eindruck zu machen was unsere Vorfahren damals geleistet haben!

title: Selfie Central
text: Surprisingly poor information on the history of this amazing building and overrun with young couples taking selfies!!

title: Poor customer services
text:
We chose to queue/wait in line to enter rather than pay expensive tour guide prices. After getting through security we were herded/corralled into a large group and held for over half an hour because the colosseum was full, all the whole tour guided tours were still being allowed to access ahead of those of us who were being held, no attempt was made by staff to inform us when we would be allowed entry.

Staff dismissed any attempt to get answers to as when we would be allowed entry, even supervisors dismissed concerns of those of us being held. 

Only after demanding to be allowed to leave the colosseum was anything done to relieve the situation.

Advise visitors to buy tickets on line before visiting but people with prepaid tickets were also herded/corralled with the group who had queued.

Organisation - poor
Site - excellent

title: Muito bonito
text:
Correu mal a compra do bilhete online 
Comprei com visita a arena e guia e afinal o guia não faz parte do staff do monumento e por isso tem de ser contratado por nós. Fiquei a ver a arena ao longe apesar de paga. Informação pouco esclarecedora nos site da empresa de venda de bilhetes (coopculture)
O coliseu é muito bonito mas ficamos desiludidos por ficarmos com a visita pela metade...

title: Personale totalmente impreparato
text: Alle 10:45, dopo aver fatto i biglietti, ci siamo recati all'inizio della fila per chiedere informazioni al personale sulla fila corretta da seguire, indicando che in biglietteria ci hanno dato come orario di ingresso le 10:55 (cerchiando addirittura l'orario in modo che fosse ancora piú visibile). Il ragazzo dopo aver controllato il biglietto ci ha mandato in una fila chilometrica. Sorpresi da tale scelta, ci siamo di nuovo avvicinati e abbiamo chiesto a un'altra ragazza, la quale ci ha fatto istantaneamente entrare. Se fosse stato per il primo ragazzo avremmo sprecato minimo MINIMO un'ora (se non due) di tempo inutile. Capisco che é difficile lavorare in situazioni in cui c'é cosí tanta folla, ma per piacere scegliete personale adatto. Personale cosí impreparato é la rovina del turismo.

title: Worth seeing
text: It’s a must see obviously. However I do think the authorities could invest in more toilets and of a better standard . The signage around the place could also be improved and there could be many more displays and narrative to share the history and some films with 3D images of the colosseum with seating in certain areas would be very helpful.

title: Pauvre Colisée, le laisser à l’abandon est inacceptable
text: Magnifique joyaux de la Rome antique, laissé à l’abandon , rénovation invisible pourtant beaucoup d’argent récolté pour la visite.

title: Unpopular opinion
text: It sucks. It really does. Or at least it did for us. Me and my girlfriend waited for hours (after we got a “skip the line” ticket) just to see 10 000 people walking in circle (literally) taking pictures of metal.They were renovating the colosseum so there was nothing to see, it was all covered in metal and there were actual construction workers with their power drills walking around. We literally payed €45 to go in and get out 2 minutes later. Do yourself a favor and go to the Vatican.

title: Pouco impressionante
text: Sendo um dos símbolos de Roma, a expectativa é grande mas ao chegar perto apercebemo-nos que não é nada de extraordinário e que está francamente em mau estado. Na minha opinião não vale a entrada

title: Skip the line Colosseum including palatine Hill and Forum
text: Booked through Viator.com and tickets came through from a company called Dream Tourism. Badly named. Initially good communication re change of meeting point, and emphasising to arrive by 9am for the 9.30am tour. But office was locked and when we rung, told to arrive at 9.15, at which point we were put on a sofa and told to wait. Operator constantly on phone. Out time slot elapsed and eventually we were taken to a general meeting point where we were linked up with a guide. I am glad the other lady was found a Spanish speaking group, everyone else in our group was recruited off the street and when we numbered twelve we were given to a guide and had to queue for approximately 1 1/2 hours in hot sun, being passed by offical tours in the express queue. photo shows the empty queues used by official operators. We eventually cleared security at 11.45 (for a 9.30 tour) and everybody including the guide had lost enthusiasm. We got an abbreviated 15 min tour and our guide (who would not give us his name) was off, leaving us to look for another guide (Jill) at 1pm. She collected a number of waifs and strays from other groups and gave us a good tour of the Palatine hill. All most unprofessional, loved the sights but all I could say is don’t book through Viator. In fairness the trip we booked with them and was assigned to City wonders the day before was fantastic, Christian was a wonderful guide, full of passion for art and we loved it.

title: Жаркие развалины
text: Это все, конечно, монументально и прекрасно, но не вздумайте ходить туда в жару - протянете ножки. А так, очень хорошая организация входа, Билеты покупайте онлайн, нам купили на ресепшн и в принципе интереснее окрестности. Только нужно подобать правильную погоду!

title: Разовая экскурсия
text: Конечно же посетить Колизей это маст хев при посещении Рима, но куча народу, куча камней, какой-то сомнительный аудио гид, не оставили каких-то впечатлений. Возможно попасть на экскурсию с хорошим гидом, я ещё раз соглашусь, но если ещё раз приеду, то лучше потрачу время на блужданиях в Палатине, там хорошая теретория, тоже куча камней есть где побродить, что-то посмотреть.

title: Lugar emblemático de la ciudad de Roma.
text: Es un edificio histórico que le gustará a aquellos viajeros que les interesen las ruinas y merece la pena verlo.

title: Clairebear2323
text: Was ok think the photos you see are photoshoped haha  looked alot more weather beaten than I imagined glad I went thought.

title: Da vedere ma non esaltante
text: Certamente la visita al Colosseo è d'obbligo, però troppo caos, troppa gente, in tutta la piana del Colosseo non c'è un bagno (solo dentro dopo ore di fila); i lavori dentro non aiutano, le impalcature neanche, non so la sensazione è un monumento lasciato andare a se stesso, soprattutto dentro

title: Taxi
text: We only went around by cab he was brilliant charge 15 euros from our hotelwhich was only a 15 minute walk from Vatican City

title: Horrible organisation
text: I made a reservation in time so I will not stay and wait hours at the entrance and when i arrived there no one from staff really knew English or wanted to help me. I was shocked by this, The Colosseum is beautiful but the horrible staff and the workers on the last level really pissed me off.

title: Shame!
text:
This is an amazing piece of history. It is well worth a visit; it's absolutely stunning. The views across the Forum are spectacular.
However, numbers should be limited further, it is almost impossible to move in the place. Signage is poor and many parts are closed. 
There is a single, small Portakabin housing the only toilets: the stench coming from them is terrible, there are clearly not enough for the thousands of visitors (my guess would be about 5 cubicles) and the queue for the loo was ridiculous. 
It is worth noting that you can't walk all the way round in a circle due to some areas being closed. This makes for an awful long walk to try to get out as the directional signs did not take this into account.
For those who find walking difficult, there are lots and lots of steep stairs and a single lift, so be prepared.
It's a shame, this is an iconic piece of history and I should imagine that virtually everyone who visits Rome comes to see The Colosseum. It should therefore be far better organised to give a much more user friendly experience, particularly, when one takes into consideration the money they must be taking in admission fees!

title: Long waiting for average experience
text:
We did not purchase the ticket in advance and we waited for at least one and half hour to buy the ticket. Actually to be honest, there weren't that much to see.
I do believe that you may as well just take the photos from the outside. 
That's just my personal view.

title: Be careful which ticket line you wait in!
text:
The experience of being in the Colosseum was amazing however staff could be nicer and more organized.  When getting into the ticket line there are NO VISIBLE signes over the 2 designated lines.  Stood in the left line as both right & left looks equal in size.  Waited over an hour to get to the from of the lone to see a VERY SMALL sign at waist heigt for both lines saying "pre-purchased ticketes" and the right was "needing to purchase tickets"  was then made to get to the back of the right line. Waited over 2 hours.  Once in the covered part of the tix line waiting to purchase the staff was beyond rude to those in the line about the wait times.  
Its best to but the "skip the line" tickets for sure!!bLesson learned the hard way

title: Not sure.
text:
Booked a skip the line tour which was a good idea, this takes you to the arena floor and on a platform.
There is lots of work going on to retain the walls high up, these are covered in scaffolding and on the area floor there is work taking place below ground so the entire area is covered in scaffold again.
I think with hindsight I would have kept the mystery of the arena and stayed outside where it is much more impressive.

title: Colosseo di sera
text: Avevo sempre visto il Colosseo di giorno ...anche di sera ha il suo fascino. Ovviamente è chiuso e si vede solo dall'esterno

title: The Gladiators
text:
Nice historical place. Too busy, the line the day we visited the Colosseum was long. 
Once inside you go back through history...and you remember the film The gladiator,my favorite one

title: Colosseum tickets and lines
text: Didn’t pre book until day before and realised all the skip the line tickets either were sold out or marked up to ridiculously high prices. Lines were very long at Colosseum but not at the forum or hill so we lined up, got our tickets for the 3 sites(€12) and the lady gave us the time 12.15 and said go to Colosseum then and skip straight to security check! Except when we went there they said sorry everyone that isn’t in a tour has to line up and we waited another hour anyway. By the time we went in and looked out there was no line... Colosseum has free water to fill up so bring a bottle and be ready for some amazing history!

title: pericoloso
text: mura pericolanti, calcinacci che cadono addosso. il signor colosseo dovrebbe decidersi a ristrutturarlo. sembra vecchio di 2000 anni

title: Somewhat disappointing
text: My first time to Rome and was somewhat disappointed in this and some other attractions in that there was so much scaffolding and construction equipment around that it totally distracted from your reason for wanting to see it, felt more like being in a construction site.  Very unfortunate.

title: Impressionante, mas apinhado
text: O coliseu é impressionante pela sua dimensão, magnificência e história. Há, infelizmente, demasiada gente. Não se consegue usufruir da visita sossegadamente.

title: Left Behind by Guide
text: Barbara was a good guide but she left us behind in the middle of the tour. I couldn't get down the stairs fast enough to keep up with the group because I'm disabled, and she walked off and left us. We had headsets and recd a call from the office threatening to keep my driver license if we didn't return their headsets. It's a big place and we walked there from their office. We got lost coming back. Tried calling but a rude man wouldn't help us. Use another company. Go early to avoid the crowds.

title: Very Long Queues
text: We went early and didn't buy pre paid tickets. Chose also not to do a guided tour but it took nearly 2 hours to get through to the start and it was so packed it was hard to see anything. We took a audio set for 5 euros and it had only 6 stations on it for information. Underwhelmed would be my feeling....maybe better in the middle of winter, but it felt badly organised and chaotic and perhaps a bit unsafe with crowd control too.

title: Tour piacevole ma il resto no
text: Da buoni calabresi ci facciamo fare il tour. La guida è molto brava un romanaccio ex galeotto molto simpatico. Il Colosseo vero e proprio invece è inutile da vedere perché è una specie di stadio fatiscente. Parlano di tirare giù sansiro che è messo bene e il colosseo no? Io non capisco perché dobbiamo tenere questi edifici degradati quando io ci potrei costruire delle palazzine nuove essendo soprattutto calabrese.

I mean it was OK- and interesting- waiting in line for maybe 1.5 hours was worth it- only because it costed 2euros to get in (EU resident between 18 and 25). There was about a billion people inside- AND construction was being done- so we were a little dissappointed. But I guess its just one of those things! Now I can say been there, done that. Won't go again. But- it was interesting to see!

Après, quand on est à l’intérieur, c’est fabuleux. Il y a de bonnes explications ( mais surtout en anglais), des maquettes explicatives et divers objets. Un monument que l’on se doit de voir avant de quitter Rome.

title: Beautiful Tourist Trap
text: The Colosseum is beautiful, but it’s bogged down with huge crowds and scam artists. Beware anyone trying to talk to you because they at best want to sell you something, they want to make it seem like they’re friendly and want to give you a free bracelet, or they just want to take your wallet. Definitely do a skip the line ticket. The colosseum itself is wonderful, but try to go in the early morning to avoid crowds.
