title: Don’t waste your time or money with Tiqets!
text:
Let me start off by saying that the Colosseum is definitely worth visiting at least once in your life. My two-star rating isn’t a reflection of the site but, rather, of the company Tiqets, which was the company we used to skip the line at the Colosseum.

Tiqets promised that we would skip the line and gain entry into the Colosseum and then the Roman Forum at Palatine Hill afterwards. Since we were in Rome only for several hours because it was a stop on a cruise, we were running on a very tight schedule in order to get back to the boat on time. Tiqets did help us to get into the Colosseum relatively quickly, which is why I rated them with any stars at all. (However, they did also say that you couldn’t bring backpacks into the Colosseum and plenty of visitors had backpacks.)

Our reservation was for 1:15. The Tiqets agent said that we would have time to see the Colosseum and then we would meet up outside the Colosseum at 2:45 to head over to the Roman Forum together. We told the agent about our tight schedule and said we would need to head over sooner since we had a train to catch to go back to the port. She said that we could probably meet up with the earlier group to go in. We ended up getting to the meeting point at about 2:25, with no other group to be found. Then 2:45 came and went. Still no Tiqets agent. (And we had four people in our group, so we scouted out the whole area for any Tiqets representative; there was no one.) At 2:50, we called the company to ask where the representative was; the person who answered the phone said that the person must be on their way so just to wait a little longer. 3:00 came — and nothing. Finally, after waiting even longer, we gave up. We tried to enter the Roman Forum on our own with our Tiqets ticket and were told that we needed to be escorted by a Tiqets representative, as the “ticket” was actually a voucher and not a ticket at all. (Go figure — “Tiqets” only offers vouchers.) So, we never made it into the Roman Forum after all.

After getting back from our trip, we contacted Tiqets and explained the situation, asking for a refund since we didn’t get what we paid for and it was because of Tiqets’ error. The reply was that the agent was where they were supposed to be and we weren’t in the right spot. When I assured the “customer service” representative that we were in the correct meeting spot and that there were other people in our group who were also looking for the representative around 2:45, first I was told that we were in the wrong spot (we weren’t) and then I was told that we would not receive any refund because they didn’t hear a complaint from anyone else. Now, I can’t speak about anyone else’s experience or timetable — maybe people took more time in the Colosseum than we did — but what I do know is that we did not get what we paid for, and when I informed the company, they made no attempt to rectify the situation. “You should have called us,” they said. When I told them I had and to check their call logs, they simply ignored that and said they understand this situation is frustrating but cannot offer a refund. While I am not able to get my money back, I can at least let other people know about the situation so you don’t waste your time (and money) with this company. Either look for another company to skip the line at the Colosseum or just allow extra time to wait in the regular line. This frustration just isn’t worth it.

title: Average
text: I came here after me & my husband booked a long weekend away to Rome for my birthday & it’s always somewhere I wanted to visit. It is such a beautiful building & would definitely recommend to go see it at least once but wouldn’t return as prices are ridiculous & the people certainly put me off. I first got told when asked about prices that it would be 12 euros but would have to wait in a que for 2hours so I could go to vip & pay 25 euros instead & wait just half hour so decided on that but when I went to purchase my ticket they told me the next cheapest option would be 75 euros not 25 as vip u would have a tour guide with u so paid that, too then be told u only get to visit the two floors & if u wanted the full tour it would be over 100 euros so left it at the 75 euros. The guy who did the tour was ok but u didn’t get too see much at all & it was over pretty quickly so wouldn’t ever go again. Plus the Italian ppl are just so rude & ignorant, barging in to u & no apologies whatsoever!

title: Apto para turistas
text: El coliseo por dentro es una pena ya que dependiendo de lo que quieras ver, debes pagar varias veces. Sólo te puedes hacer una idea de lo que fue, teniendo en cuenta que sólo es original el mármol. No lo recomiendo.

title: Poor guide
text: The guide was very clinical in her presentations period we overheard other guys bringing the history the life period unfortunately ours was more of a archaeologist teaching a class

title: Rome - August 2019
text: I think my hopes were too high.  But the smaller version in Pula, Croatia provided a better tour and seemed to provide guests with more information about the lives of the people during that era versus the recorded walk through that was provided for the Colosseum.

title: Overpriced and Over Rated!
text: As usual Security Guards at the entry gate are rude and thoughtless. It isn't  a language or cultural difference. They simply don't understand the meaning of manners or what a boost tourism is for their economy. I saw what I wanted to see without putting up with their behavior.

title: A little disappointed by the inside
text: Personally I was disappointed by the inside of the colloseum. Having gone through all the fuss inside, even with a guided tour ticket that got you in faster, I was unimpressed with how little you can see. You're only really allowed to walk around it and I feel like I could have guessed what it looked like from the outside. There aren't any exhibits or anything like that to help you get a feel for what it used to be like. You just get the guides explanation and I feel like they really downplayed some of the antics the would have gone on in there!

title: Te veel mensen
text: Vandaag naar het colosseum geweest! Heel erg mooi!, maar om naar binnen te komen zouden we 2 uur moeten wachten omdat er een grote rij stond, dat hebben we dus niet gedaan! Ook staan er veel verkopers rond het colloseum dat was ook vervelend. Verder was het mooi om te zien van de buitenkant!

title: Fila interminabile per entrare
text: OVUNQUE VAI devi pagare prenotare e se paghi una guida si apre un mondo, con salta coda ecc ecc, altrimenti rimani fuori.... Prezzo nella media a roma

title: Magnifique mais que de l'extérieur
text:
A faire sans hésiter ! Somptueux ! 
N'hésitez pas a y aller pour faire tout le tour. 

La visite intérieure n'est pas obligatoire, il n'y a plus grand chose a voir a l'intérieur, tout est détruit. Cela vous évitera en plus des heures de queue !

title: Walking tour of the Palantine Hill and Colosseum
text:
We took the trek with our guide Sylvia from Grays On Line. Sylvia was a fantastic guide, really knew her stuff and kept the group on the march over a very lengthy tour.

Highly recommend a tour with her if you get the chance.

title: Rien de vraiment fou à l'intérieur
text:
Si vous avez pas vraiment beaucoup d'argent rester à l'extérieur

C'est largement en ruine seul un guide vous apporte un petit plus encore une large partie peut se trouver sur les chaînes historique sur YouTube

title: Guided tour of Colosseum
text:
Spent a morning viewing this amazing site
Guided tour gave us a quick entry but other than that the guide was boring. Rambled on, usually off topic. We went to see the Colosseum not to hear the whole history of the Roman Empire. Would have preferred to look around ourselves. Not really worth the extra. He was so bad we didn't continue with the tour to Palatine Hill and Roman Forum.
We bailed and went for a cup of tea

title: Het is wat verouderd
text:
Volgens mij is de naam Colosseum een verbastering van het woord kolossaal.
Want het was er erg druk en het lijkt erop dat er sinds vroeger niet veel is is veranderd.
De mensen worden als schaapjes bijeen gedreven om vervolgens als een stoet door de controle te gaan.
Eenmaal binnen gaat het schuifelend achter elkaar aan als een grote polonaise. De kans om een foto te maken zonder iemand anders erop bestaat bijna niet. 
Hierna verlaat je als stoet de arena weer.
Wel kun je nu zeggen dat je er bent geweest en eenmaal thuis laat je mensen foto’s van Google zien omdat je ze zelf niet zo mooi kunt maken.
Kortom het viel mij wat tegen, maar gelukkig hebben we de foto’s nog.

title: Colisée
text: Il reste un monument emblématique de Rome à faire mais il n'y a pas grand chose à voir : il est tres abimé ou il faudrait une application qui reconstitue l'espace que l'on voit tel qu'il était.

title: Viel wat tegen
text: Misschien hadden wij wat teveel verwachtingen, maar wij vonden de staat van het Collosseum wat tegen vallen. Er zijn betere in Italië te vinden. Het is mooi voor een keertje, maar na 10 minuten hadden we het eigenlijk wel gezien.

title: Massenauftrieb
text: Die Menschenmassen vermiesen einen Besuch dieses monumentalen Bauwerks der Menschheitsgeschichte. Die Stadtverwaltung muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, die Horden der Besucher zu organisieren. Die Riesengruppen der Kreuzfahrtschiffe sind ein weiteres Problem!

title: И что здесь такого????
text: И что здесь такого???? Люди стоят часами на жаре, чтобы зайти, пройти по трибунам? По Рома пас вход был бесплатным, но дали проход только через 3 часа, ни туда и ни сюда, походил по Палатию, вот туда стоит сходить, а от Колизея только разочарование

title: Audiotour war nicht zu empfehlen
text:
Wir waren gleich um 8:30 zur Öffnungszeit, am Kolosseum. Schon jetzt füllten sich die Eingänge mit Touristen. Ich empfehle unbedingt ein Ticket vorab zu buchen. Unser Hotel hat das für uns übernommen.
Wir hatten eine Audiotour. Diese fand ich persönlich nicht sehr gut. Viele Dinge wurden gar nicht angesprochen. Eine Tour mit Guide ist sicherlich besser. Gerade bei so einer beeindruckenden Sehenswürdigkeit, würde ich das persönliche bevorzugen.

title: Organisation nulle
text:
Le site internet indique de venir une heure avant l'heure d'entrée au moment de la réservation. Nous sommes donc arrivés a 7h30 pour 8h30. Sur place aucune indication, aucun agent tout est fermé. Arrivée des premiers employés pour ventes de billet a 8h10 et aucune infos avant 8h35! Plusieurs files se créent aussi devant la billetterie que devant l'entrée. Des personnes de 9h30 rentrent en même que nous... audioguides revenant a pratiquement 1€ l'information (5€50 pour 6 point infos).
Nombreuses maquettes et objet trouvé grace au fouilles mais aucune explication en français. Certes le site est magnifique mais l'ogranisation est vraiment nulle pour un site de cet ampleur.

title: Colosseum Visit
text:
Very amazing place to visit...
Even it is a hot weather but worth it..
People are friendly, specially our Tour Guide Renata.

title: Se debe visitar
text: Un sitio clave en Roma que desmerece por la gran afluencia de personas y las largas colas para entrar. Es recomendable comprar la entrada para evitarlas

title: No es la mejor época
text: Es segunda vez que voy al Coliseo y como siempre se ve impresionante, pero en esta fecha están realizando muchos arreglos dentro y fuera de este, y queda la sensación de estar dentro de una obra de construcción. Insisto, el Coliseo por si solo siempre es un encanto, pero quizás no está en su mejor momento.

title: Ni fu ni fa
text:
Un monumento importante evidentemente, pero bajo mi opinión no merece la pena gastarse el di nero y perder el tiempo de cola. 
Necesita restauración urgente y no esta demasiado bien conservado. Si es la primera vez que vas a Roma puedes ir a verlo pero por compromiso no por su majestuosidad por dentro. Por fuera genial, y gratis.

title: It’s a must see but...
text: Unless you have a guide there’s little to understand about the building’s past. It can be crowded and different tickets provide access only to particular areas, so what you see may be limited. However, you have to go, so...

title: Wonderful
text:
We ore booked our tickets which was a hassle from the beginning. We arrived very early and picked up our tickets.
Once inside we opted for the sound system not with video it was informative but there was a lack of signs to tell you where to go.
Leave your sets on the way out not back at the start as we did, again it was confusing.
I

title: Sempre affascinante
text: Regge bene l'anfiteatro Flavio. Un acquazzone lo ha allagato e non abbiamo potuto entrarci ma strutture ben più moderne si riducono peggio con molto meno! Per fortuna è un luogo che si gode anche e sopratutto dall'esterno! Sempre una gran organizzazione e una gran folla!

title: Druk
text:
Ontzettend druk, het was bijna file lopen en dat was alleen nog maar buitenom.
Niet binnen geweest.
Heel veel opdringerige verkopers, die je niet aan moet kijken of in gaan op hun praatjes, je raakt ze haast niet weer kwijt.
Dit maakt een bezoek onplezierig, in tegenstelling tot de trevi fontein en de Spaanse trappen.

title: It's the Skydome
text: Or any number of contemporary football fields in any large city of the globe. It's a ruin in a state of semi-perpetual repair. If you arrive at early or later hours just line up for tickets. It takes a couple hours to tour maximum. We did an exterior "skip the line" type tour and ended up walking 2 blocks away just to pay and start the tour. Waste of time! Did I mention 150 Euros for 3 adults and 2 (free entry age) kids. 100 Euros too much for this stadium and no game was playing the day we were here. It's warn-out Roman concrete. Nothing spectacular what so ever. Palintine area is way more significant but it has been looted by the Vatican. Coluseum is a tourist trap oven. About 30th on my list of top sites - of which about 15 others are in Rome.

title: A voir mais sans plus...
text: Heureusement que le Colisée a commencé à être rénové car quand on vois l’état de tout les site historique de la ville on se dit que c’est trop tard pour être entretenu....en effet , on peux encore heureusement se faire une idée de la vie à l’époque romaine mais ne comptez pas voir encore ne serais ce qu’une seule statue en place car il n’y en a plus...le Colisée comme tous les monuments historiques de la ville on été au fur et à mesure des siècles pillés et l’état n’a jamais pensé à dépenser trop de budget pour entretenir se patrimoine . .....dommage.

title: Roma - Colosseum
text: The line wasn’t too long, but very hot in August.  A lot of ticket scalpers...just say no!  I recommend going either really early or a different month, maybe late September.  Avoid October, since we’re told a lot of tourist come to see the Pope in October. Bring water for everyone in your group and eat before you go. To see this with your own eyes is remarkable. If you have bad knees, be careful...the steps are very steep!

title: Great,  but too hot
text:
We entered the Colosseum.
This is what we can say because we saw the inside, but probably, you don't need to get in if you don't have time.
It's not so different from what you would expect from outside.
I found the Palatine hills more interesting.

title: NO LONGER FREE 1st SUNDAYS OF THE MONTH
text:
Queued for an hour this morning having read on “il-colosseum.it” that museums in Rome, including the colosseum/forum, are free on the first Sunday of every month. 

Got to the ticket office and asked to pay €12pp. Apparently the above website is not the official website. MIBAC is the official one but good luck navigating that. 

According to staff the free visits ended in January (yet reviews on here in March suggest free sundays?!).

Now there are just selected dates that are offered free which celebrate national holidays etc.

title: Maffia
text: Normally the visit is free, as mentioned on their website the first sunday of every month. So I got in line today, Sunday, September 1st. Waited for a while and then they decided it was not free today... So they do whatever they want. It’s just a scam and I didn’t pay the ticket off course. Stay away from it.

title: Un peu décevant
text: Entre les travaux dehors et ceux dedans c’est un peu comme visiter un chantier. Certes cela reste impressionnant mais ... presque plus apprécié le forum ...

title: Déçu
text: Magnifique a l'extérieur, vide à l'intérieur, un monument à voir mais l'entrée est excessivement chère pour ce qu'il y a à voir dedans

title: Interesting landmark, service not too good!
text: The colloseum is quite impressive and doesn’t really need further explanation. The service though, not too good. It was a very hot summer day and there was only one toilet building to be found. That’s not nearly enough for the amount of people visiting the colloseum during summer. Also there’s only two water fountains at the colloseum to fill your water bottles. Service could be a lot better, cherish your tourists a little bit more!

userLocation.name: Capelle aan den IJssel, The Netherlands

title: Tres intéressant mais?
text: Je me suis rendu à la place indiqué pour débuter la visite. J'arrive 30 minutes plus tôt. J'attends et jattends. Une fille du personnel m'indique en anglais (je parle tres peu anglais) de me mettre en file. Mais quelle file? Elle me dit de rester sur place. J'attends et j'attends encore pour m'apercevoir que le groupe est parti. Très en colère (je déteste d'être comme ça en vacances). Elle me dit que c'est moi le responsable car je dois comprendre l'anglais. Incompétente la (je mentionne pas son nom ar politesse). Heureusement un garçon tres compétent du nom de Alain a reporter ma visite en français le lendemain. Lui il était très compétent et patients avec moi.  Le lendemain visite extraordinaire et un guide extraordinaire(archéologue). En résumé, n'attender en haut des marche telle qu'indiquer dans les directives, rester en bas près des guides.ça va éviter des problèmes.

title: Ticket touts swarm in and sell you everything
text:
This was our first thing to visit in day one, it’s boiling as height of summer. It’s busy. I was not happy about being approached about 20 times with my kids, the men selling everything, kept high fiving my son and then not letting go of his hand. The scam is they give you a bracelet and say it’s free because they love your county, then he places one on my daughters hand and then asks for money to feed his kids....it’s awful. Where are the security measures? You see police with machine guns stood about, but this is like a swarm of bees, it’s just really overwhelming and intrusive. Although I was safe with my husband who is not about to allow any nonsense it’s just not good. All the way down the steps they are there and get used to it they are all the landmarks and sights. 
The queue was massive it’s hot and there no shade at all, you think there maybe enough money from the billions of people to place some shade/parasols/canopy’s about. 
We headed to the Palestine Hill entrance and for our ticket there for the sights- TIP this was worth the walk as then you walk back to colosseum and can walk right in, no queues! 
So the place was amazing, and to think what happened there. We got the audio guides provided by them (didn’t bother with guided tours) but these had no map, no structure, no signs about which way to walk. We found all the sights poorly signposted, and in user friendly. Having said that was good for the kids to hear a bit more history. The big group guided tours take up all the room everywhere. They stop in all the shaded parts. Half the people looked hot and bored. I think we got away with a bit of a grind there! 
I think in all amazing to see, considering the age and history there is there I found it all a bit taken for granted? The road surrounding are terrible and not kept nice. The dodgy sellers and pick pockets are not a nice attraction- get rid of them. We saw undercover police corner a seller in a car and seize his phone and bag, but this was a car in the pedestrian area where there were hundreds and hundreds of people walking. I just think if they could make the perimeter larger and somehow stop this so close to the attraction it would be a better experience. 
Again staff very unhelpful and rude much like at all the attractions. What a shame. 
Would have been nice to see some ‘Romans’ and ‘gladiators’ even if they stayed in the shade or walked about where the massive queues were. Even a simulation of noises at the games and lions roaring at times. 
Maximus would be disappointed he died in vein and this is what his history is about!

title: Overhyped
text: Colosseum is known worldwide, but when you go inside you can see nothing special. Better view is from Forum Romanum.

title: Crowded!
text:
The Colosseum is a historic and beautiful building in Rome, however it is unfortunately ruined by the number of tourists who swarm the premises, all ejecting their selfie-sticks into the air! The queue to get in is also unbearable, as people were waiting 2-3 hours to enter. Luckily, we booked a tour as part of Tiquets, which allowed us to jump the queue and gave us priority upon entry. If you are visiting the Colosseum, ensure you pay extra as part of a tour, otherwise you'll have no option other than standing queuing! (The tour itself is not regimented in nature, which is good).

The views from the Colosseum are very nice and this attraction is definitely worth visiting. However, the sheer volume of visitors there makes enjoying the overall experience somewhat difficult.

Finally, I would like to remark that the gent's toilets were very unappealing and needed a good clean to get rid of the disgusting smell wafting out the door.

title: Colas interminables
text:
La primera vez que estuve en Roma, solo lo vi por fuera. Esta vez me prometí a entrar ya que mucha gente me lo había recomendado.
Nosotros íbamos con la tarjeta Roma Pass, es genial esta tarjeta si vas a estar varios días.
En el Colosseum, había 3 colas:
- 1 para gente que no tenía nada
- 1 para gente con la Roma Pass y que había ido a la taquilla a coger hora
- 1 para la gente con la que tenía la hora reservada con antelación (esta era la más rápida)

En pleno agosto, con la sola que caía y teniendo algo de privilegio hicimos una cola de 2 h (teníamos hora a las 13.10) nos aconsejaron ir a la cola solo 30 min antes, pero al ver las colas que había, preferimos hacer cola y hasta las 15 aprox. no entramos.

Es un sitio muy bello, con unas vistas muy bonitas, la pena es que haya tanta gente y no se aprecie tanto toda la estructura.

Por lo que como en casi todas los sitios con más relevancia de Roma, aconsejamos ir a primera de la mañana

title: Super ticket with Ticketbar rip off. Not valid for colosseum.
text: I have bought a SUPER  ticket with a company called ticketbar. Only to pay €18 each plus €4 handling charge to be later told it's not valid for the colosseum. Only for forum and palatine. Then I find the 2 places I've bought it to see, are not really valid with the super ticket as you have to go on a guided tour to see the house of Augustus and house of Livia. So the ticket is a rip off. There are only 4 things I can go and see AND  I've been ripped off by ticketbar. What a waste of money!

title: Tourism exploitation
text:
We couldn’t wait to see the Colosseum and to be honest it’s a must whilst in Rome. However, we really felt that it ended up being a ‘ cattle herding experience ‘. We did the ‘ skip the queue’ as we thought it would reduce the pain of lining up in blistering heat ( almost 40 degrees that day). We were provided with headphone sets that were quite temperamental but dutifully followed our guide who I suppose did his best with the huge number of tourists he had. 
The history of the place is captivating but the experience of the tour was less than pleasant. I certainly felt vulnerable as we were packed in like sardines, if an emergency had occurred - it would have been disastrous. 
For anyone planning to visit- look at your options. There are loads and some are limited to levels that you can see. Also- visit at cooler times of day if possible or out of season. 
I know it was our choice to visit in height of season but surly public safety should be a concern at any time of year.

title: A tourist must see spot
text: We visited in August and used a company that offered skip the line access. Highly recommend using that perk as it is incredibly busy there.  It is a beautiful site to see, but so incredibly HOT and crowded with people!  There are guys walking area selling ice cold water, but they are not supposed to be selling in there & were getting chased by security.  You should definitely bring in your own water but if you forget, don’t pay more than 1 Euro for a bottle from these guys.  The best location for getting the iconic picture is in the Roman Forum.

title: Immancabile a Roma, da vedere.
text: Un pezzo di storia, assolutamente da visitare. Consiglio però di visitarlo con una guida in modo da poterlo visitare tutto. La visita singola infatti non permette l'accesso in alcune aree. L'unica pecca è il biglietto con orario che alla fine non serve a nulla perché si fa ugualmente la fila chilometrica.

title: L'attrazione più imponente al mondo circondata dall'incuria
text: Il Colosseo è senza alcun dubbio l'edificio romano più attraente e significativo di Roma, ne è simbolo e ne è l'attrazione più visitata, perciò si può affermare con certezza che (solamente) dove sia il Colosseo sia un'area splendida, mantenuta divinamente. Purtroppo le vicinissime aree circostanti sia sotto l'aspetto urbanistico ma (e più importante) l'aspetto sicurezza, calano moltissimo: pessime strade, edifici consumati, illuminazione inesistente e tanta, tanta sporcizia.

title: Size matters but so do crowds
text: Only saw it from the outside as even pre-booked tickets had a line that went almost halfway around the Colosseum. Another get there early experience or book a private tour.

title: Bonito

title: Avoid if at all possible!

we bought expensive service to VIATOR (no queue service+tickt+guide) 165 € instead of 24 € when buying directly.

When we arrives, no ticket, no client service, no assistance,.... : result we had to wait about 2 hours without assistance of the agency before taking decision to queue and buy our own ticket with two children !!!!

VIATOR take you money but do not provide the service...

Result : we could not see other location we were planning too and our child got ill of insulation.

Asking assistance to VIATOR, there anwer after 1 day is we shall re imburse tickets and that's all. Ill child : this is not important for VIATOR. Not being in position to appreciate the trip we did to visit Roma : this is not important for VIATOR !

I recommend not to use as very expensive and in our case, this was not honnest that VIATOR collected money but not provided the service

title: Attrape couillon ..
text:
Ne pas penser pouvoir y rentrer sans attendre plus de 3 heures quand on a pas de réservation.
Mal géré au niveau des files, toilettes accessible que si l’on paie bien sûr..

L’attente aura eu raison de nous et avons fait demi tour au bout de plus de 2h désespérées, sans compter les multitudes de racoleurs qui trônent autour de ce lieu afin de vendre de l’eau, des casquettes, et j’en passe !

Les groupes aussi attendent beaucoup je trouve,

title: No escojas civitatis!!!
text:
El Coliseo merece la pena sin duda  civitatis es un sacacuartos! A nosotros nos dejaron tirados por llegar cinco minutos tarde debido a que la estación de metro Lepanto estaba en obras y tuvimos que coger un autobús. Deberían tener en cuenta estas circunstancias excepcionales para dejar los típicos cinco minutos de cortesía.
Se quedaron con la pelas sin darte ninguna opción.

title: Η μεγάλη ουρά
text: Δεν φτάνει που είχε πολύ ουρά,δεν μας άφησαν να μπούμε και μέσα. Επειδή και κα0λα χρειαζόταν πριν ένα μήνα και μπούρδες. Στον Παρθενώνα μπαίνεις κατευθείαν. Αίσχος.

title: 이탈리아 최고의 랜드마크
text:
통합입장권을 구매해서 콜로세움, 포로로마노, 팔라티노 언덕까지 모두 갈 수 있습니다.
방문했을때 생각보다 관광객이 적은지(엄청난 무더위.....) 기다림 없이 구매가능했고 구매할때 콜로세움 입장 시간을 확인하기 바랍니다. 외부의 콜로세움은 일반적으로 아는 모습 그대로 멋있었지만 내부는 보수공사로 많은 철골구조물이 있어 아쉬웠습니다. 공사가 끝난 후 다시한번 방문해보고 싶네요.

title: Was not worth the buzz
text:
The Colosseum was a pretty disappointing visit and not worth the queue and all the buzz about it. There were a lot of scaffolding at the time of my visit, probably to facilitate restoration works. There were 2 queues - 1 for bag checks/security and the other for tickets which included entry to the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill.
I highly DO NOT recommend getting the skip the queue line because the queue was not that long. I was willing to wait in the queue because the price for the skip-the-line tickets was way too high. I noticed a lot of tour guides leading the tour groups which had bought the skip-the-line tickets and the tour leaders made it a point to show their groups that they had skipped the line because they paid higher- prized tickets. I don't see how the shorter wait time can be justified by the exorbitant skip-the-line ticket prices.

Bring water, you will get thirsty, especially in summer. Bring food to eat too in case you get hungry. There is no eating places within the vicinity of the Colloseum. We had to walk really far out of the Colloseum in order to grab lunch and the much- needed water, before continuing on to the Roman Forum. 

There will be people selling ice-cold water and hats there but I say, come prepared.

title: Trop de travaux autour !
text: On ne peut pas trop s’approcher ni faire de belles photos avec tout les travaux autour avec barrière etc!

title: Una disorganizzazione assurda
text: Non è possibile che ci siamo 2 persone a vendere i biglietti per entrare in una struttura così rinomata, è ovvio che poi si creino code assurde, una vergogna davvero, nemmeno in Somalia sono organizzati così male.

title: Exhausting and boring
text: I waited in line for almost an hour and it was extremely hot. When you get inside you have to wait in a line again if you haven’t purchased a ticket beforehand. The price is okay but only if you visit the Roman forum too. The price just for the Colosseum is too much. It is very underwhelming inside and a little bit overcrowded. There are too many tours happening at the same time and it is not easy to enjoy when you’re alone or with friends.

title: Un classique impressionnant
text: Avions billet coupe file - heureusement on est entré très rapidement. Impressionnant à voir quand on est à Rome mais les forum et palatine Hill nous ont encore plus impressionné, de là la note de 3

title: Visire
text: Une visite où il faut acheter son billet sur internet avec heure de réservation . Comme ça , inutile de faire la queue et d’arriver avant , c’est sympa , belle vue , j’aurai aimée trouver l’emplacement de la scène du film « la fureur du dragon » . C’était long, à éviter avec des petits , adapté aux fauteuils roulants .

title: Get your guide tout
text:
Fabio our tour guide was amazing, he has great knowledge and kept us entertained throughout the tour. 

It was incredibly hot so it was uncomfortable waiting around in the sun as it was very crowded. 

Too many sellers standing outside trying to sell water , fans etc. which wad quiet annoying. 

The colosseum is incredible and because of Fabio’s explanations and stories it was entertaining. 

Bring lots of water if you’re going in summer, wear comfortable shoes and hold your bags and phones toghtly

title: Shocking
text: It's all after falling down and the chariot race never happened. Julius Cesar was rumoured to turn up the day we were there but never showed.

title: Be prepared to queue
text:
Visited the Colosseum in July and although we arrived early morning we had to queue for 3 hours to get to ticket office.  My advice would be to pre book.
Be prepared as the toilets are a disgrace. 
Lift available for disabled or those not able to manage stairs.

title: Dommage
text: Malgré un pass à 113€ coupe fil nous avons du faire 2h30 d'attente très mauvais personnels pour la visite

title: Bad experience. Feel like I've been lied to.
text:
I couldn't find the meeting location by email, and by the time I was answered by the office on the phone, I was a 10-15 minutues late. They said it's "too late" to join and had to pay a ridiculous amount of money to reschedule.
But on the next day, I realized I was lied to. Because in reality, We have not started the actual tour until 30+ minutes in abd I could easily join the other day, which made me feel tricked.

And was the tour itself worth the wait? No. It was "meh"and the tour guude was ok at best. Not to mention the "exclusive" arena floor where we spent 5 minutes and was not worth it at all.

title: 期待度が高過ぎたのでしょうか？
text: 事前にガイドブックなどで拝見した通りのコロッセオでした。下調べし過ぎたのでしょうか？新鮮味に欠けてしまいました。アリーナにも行ってみたかったのですが、駄目でした。どうしてなのかわかりません。ガイド付きツアーの方のみ立ち入りが許されているのでしょうか？

title: Außen Hui, innen Pfui
text:
Ich kann mich vielen nur anschließen: Es lohnt sich nicht, hineinzugehen!
Lange Wartezeit (je nach Tageszeit in der prallen Sonne)!

Von außen ist das Gebäude wesentlich schöner und imposanter anzusehen als von innen!

title: The Colosseum is a must see.
text:
Full disclosure - I have been here before.
The tour is good.  They give you lots of history and the tour we went on took us down to the floor of the Colosseum.  As impressive as it was; it is not as impressive as the outside.  There is a park where the tour met that was perfect for pictures, a loaf of bread and a jug of wine, and relaxing.
The tour is good, the crowds are ridiculous, and the hike is tiring: of course this was our third day in Rome and we just saw the Forum.
There is quite a bit of walking so pace yourself.

title: Saca la entrada onlain
text:
Más allá de hablar del Coliseo que ya está todo dicho o escrito, yo recomiendo encarecidamente comprar las entradas online que, aunque son más caras, ganas en comodidad y salud.
Pasas como un rey/ reina por delante de una cola de más de 3 horas.
Compra las entradas con horario reservado lo más pronto posible si es verano y ve con una antelación de 1h para poder cangear tu entrada.

Sí tienes posibilidad visita el foro y palatino otro día para no tener empacho

title: Hot and crowded
text: We went in late July.  It was hot, crowded and expensive but what an amazing place.  My sense is that the historical Rome thing is probably best done out of high season .  However it is the most incredible place.  Takes your breath away

title: Kurztripp
text:
Viel zu viele Leute!
Abzocke wo man hinsieht!

Muss man nicht haben!
Zwar beeindruckend, doch übervoll!
Viele Taschendiebe!!!!!
Vorsicht

title: Décevant
text:
Lors de mon dernier voyage à Rome, il y a plus de 20 ans, j’avais été frustrée de ne pas avoir vu le Colisée .. alors cette fois ci ... je n’ai pas voulu le rater ! J’ai pris ma place la veille au Kiosque d’info qui se trouve face à la Basilique Saint Pierre ( très facile ! )
Nous arrivons, le ticket donné droit à une vague prison, le forum, le Mont palatin et le Colisée ...Tout ça pour 20-22 euros ... je ne sais plus ! Enfin bref, on commence par la prison .. il vous donne une tablette en début de visite (wahouuuu c’est moderne) ... et on voit que la visite est minutée .. 15 minutes ! Vous avez des explications lapidaires soit en anglais soit en espagnol ! 15 minutes ? On l’a fait en 8 minutes .. je vous laisse en tirer vos propres conclusions ;) ... puis, nous avions un billet pour le Colisée pour 15h30 .. et nous avions le droit d’entrer qu’a 15h ... pas une seconde avant ! Et enfin le Colisée ... mon monument rêvé.. et bien quelle  déception ! Des échafaudages , aucune trace de gradins .. bof bof ! Et attention à ne pas prendre de chaussures glissantes car l’escalier est raide ! Bref à admirer de loin , selon mon avis ! Mais à faire tout de même... mais attention à la déception .

title: So disappointed
text: Booked skip the line tickets with a guided tour.Was instructed to arrive 30 minutes to allow for queues.We ended up in a chaotic queue with dozens of people stuffing in .Italian chaos.Waited for 2 hours in baking hot sun and missed the guided tour.The security checks were amateur.

title: bezoek binnen zou ik niet meer doen
text:
Mijn bedenking na bezoek aan dit gebouw : breek uw huis gedeeltelijk af, laat hier een daar een muur staan , blaas er een laag stof over , zet er een hek rond , organiseer 'skip the line' toegang (nooit meer die toestanden  !!! )  en vraag inkom.  Rijk wordt je .... 
Nee , het Colosseum is een indrukwekkend gebouw maar de binnenkant biedt niet veel indrukken dan wat je aan de buitenkant al meekrijgt .

title: Colosseum
text: Tour not worth the wait. We joined a Skip the Line Tour when we arrived at the colosseum and paid 35Euros each. It was 11.30 and very hot. The queue to get in went all way round colosseum over 3 hours wait apparently. We did go nearer the front with other Skip the queue customers but still stood for 45 mins in the blazing sun, no shade until much nearer to the entrance. The guide did her best to give us all the info etc but even she was running out of things to say. When finally got in it was a quick march round and given 20 mins to look round ourselves before meeting second guide. It is a very old building much of which is gone need a good imagination to appreciate its former glory. Then stood outside another 30 mins waiting to go to palatine hill and forum. I think the outside of the colosseum does it justice not worth the queues. Skip it and go to Palatine Hill and Roman Forum they are amazing.

title: Cuanta historia
text: Hermoso lugar de la historia de italia un monumento que te hipnotiza, si podes paga tu entrada al Coliseo y al foro no te vas a arrepentir

title: If you love history go inside
text: If you want a picture, take it from the street, if you love history go inside; but if you only are looking for a picture take it from outside. Is a historic building

title: Expedia skip the line tour
text:
No map supplied, so how could I meet the tour at the correct place? So I missed the tour, how disappointing.
I even passed the tour going up the steps as They went Down. I asked to join, guide said no. Why???
I was only 3 minutes late at that stage!
Ripped off!

title: Visita ao Coliseu
text: Não gostei filas enormes, desorganizado , ninguém sabe informar onde entrar se fica no sol um tempão e no fim tirasse uma foto.

title: Over-hyped?
text: So we were looking forward to going to the Colosseum as, of course, it’s a major landmark in Rome. The day we visited, it was incredibly hot 🥵 , at about 40 degrees, so perhaps this is a factor in the fact that it wasn’t much to see? The Colosseum was amazing 😉 to look at from the outside and it was cool 😎 to know that you were looking at something so old... however, inside it wasn’t much to look at compared to the outside. In my opinion, I would just walk around the outside of the Colosseum and save paying the ticket 🎫 price.

title: Sim mas não (Ou nao mas sim)
text: Comprámos o Roma Pass e reservamos a hora da visita pelo que não fizemos fila absolutamente nenhuma (em agosto) para visitar. Ainda bem porque esperar ao sol e com o calor que estava, não iria ser fácil. Quanto ao Coliseu, é obviamente um local que merece a visita, pela sua sobrevivência ao passar dos séculos e por toda a sua história e histórias. A avaliação deve-se à aparente falta de cuidado com o monumento em si e ao número de visitantes que, apesar de limitados, impedem qualquer tentativa de imergir no contexto histórico do local. Impossível tentar imaginar a descrição feita por um guia da localização dos gladiadores, animais, ... quando há constantemente gente a pedir licença para tirar selfies ou a empurrar para ver algo que pode ver 3 ou 4 metros mais longe.

title: Bonito mas...
text:
Desorganização na entrada com um tempo de espera excessivo. O guichet das reservas devia estar melhor indicado. 
A bilheteira encerrou na hora de maior afluência. 
Mas o Coliseu em si é bonito.

title: Bueeeeno...
text: A ver, vale la pena visitarlo solo si vas con guía o tú mismo lo programas. Digamos que no hay mucho que ver. El foro, ya es un poco más innovador pero siguen siendo ruinas y escampado, mas pequeños letreros que te medio explican qué es cada cosa. Lo mejor en este caso es un tour.

title: Roma pass(ed barely)
text:
We got into the colosseum with the roma pass 48h.

Since the rule to have a timed reservation the explanations are unclear, to state it friendly.

How we got told to get in (websites included) :
-roma pass
-book reserved time slot
-get receipt of booking at 'a reserved counter at the roman forum ticket office' (romapass.it says so in the FAQ, also coopculture says '.. A receipt to be collected at the ticket desk' 
- 'it is strictly necessary to arrive at 30 before booked time' (also on coopculture.it)
-security check where no bottles are allowed (coopculture.it)
-scan pass
-inside

How we actually got in:
-bought roma pass
-reserved a slot on coopculture.it
-searched where the ticket desk was online: turns out to be a 12min hike. 
-once there it was closed (my bad, its closed on a Tuesday) 
-got in line 'reserved ticket' half an hour before booked time slot with roma pass, ID & email of comfirmation of booked time slot
-got told to come back later.. Twice.. 
-got in @10 minutes until booked time. 
-security check (with bottles they probably mean glass bottles because alot of ppl had their bottles with them) 
-they scanned pass
-done

I hope this will help someone who was as confused as me.

title: Снаружи сильно эффектнее чем внутри
text: Если есть цель немного сэкономить - посмотрите снаружи. Внутри ни о чем и толпа народу на входе. На мой взгляд лучше потратить деньги на какую-нибудь картинную галерею.

title: La foule
text: Trop trop de monde ..vraiment difficile de trouver une entrée sans attendre des heures mieux vaut le faire en visite accompagné sinon le chemin de croix vous attend ..

title: It‘s not worth the money!!!
text: The only good thing is that you get into the colosseum fast... the tour is not worth the money, because they basically tell you the same things over and over again. The sadest thing is that you don‘t have time to have a real look onto the colosseum, in the last give minutes we had the opportunity to rund through the colosseum and take some pictures...

title: Nunca mais
text:
Atendimento péssimo 
Comprei entradas online, acreditando wue não enfrentaria filas enormes, me apresentei no horário marcado, foi anunciado por meio de alto falantes que deveriamos esperar, pois atingiu o número máximo de pessoas visitando o monumento 
À espera foi de 55 minutos!!! Sob o calor de 36 graus!!
Detalhe: não tem nenhum bar vendendo agua por ali e nem dentro do Coliseu 
Absurdo !!

title: Tourist trap!!
text: Maybe I expected too much, but just a rip off, touts selling over priced tickets, and not able to view the interior with no charge!!.

title: Bello ma migliorabile
text: Ho fatto una visita con video guida perché non avevo prenotato X tempo la visita guidata del sotterraneo però credo che il livello non sia davvero all’altezza del monumento ! Peccato

title: Need a tour guide
text: Fascinating visit, but would have been more interesting with a knowledgeable tour guide.  We were under the impression we had booked a guided tour, but were instead just walked over to the entrance where we had priority “skip the line” privileges.

title: Its all in ruin
text: It sucks, the queve is long af even tough i had fast pass i had to stand in the sun with a group even tough i specificly ordered no guided tour. We spent 40 min in the scorching sun just to see something complety in ruins or covered with metalbars. Dont go to the Colosseum its really  a dissapointment

title: Bombarded by vendors along the way
text: Wear a hat, carry a water and hold a selfie stick on your way to this historical site. Otherwise you will be bombarded by Indian vendors following you trying to sell their goods. Didn’t make for a very pleasant walk on our first day in Rome.

title: Overhyped
text: One of the main reason we visited Rome was to visit the Colosseum. I was a little disappointed with our visit, we’ve been to a few collosseums in Europe which were fantastic museums/buildings and expected “the colosseum” to be fantastic but it wasn’t more of a overhype then anything else.I do think it’s more impressive from the outside then in. The man in the gift shop didn’t give me any change which was annoying so if this happens to you please make a fuss!On the upside there are plenty of water fountains in the colosseum for you to use. A few exhibitions but they weren’t very interesting. Could have got a audio guide and thinking back I would have preferred using that then just walking around as it would have been nice to known more information then what was given.

title: Not in August
text: I would say to Everybody. Come here in spring.... too much people and cola from kiosk (350ml) 3,5e. Not a good thing.

title: Filas demasiado largas a pleno sol
text:
Para ir hay que tomarse el tiempo de reservar con anticipación porque sino hay que hacer una fila interminable a pleno sol.
Cuando finalmente logramos entrar  estábamos agotados y derretidos

title: Muy bonito pero muy sucio
text: Es una lástima que sea todo tan bonito y lo tengan tan abandonado no sé dónde va a parar todo el dinero que se genera con el turismo se lo lleva la Mafia o que ?

title: Crowds Everywhere
text: We paid for a tour to "skip the lines" but found ourselves waiting repeatedly anyway.  Enjoyed the perspective on how old it really is, history of the area, and understanding that they really don't know for sure what it originally looked like.

title: Me esperaba mucho mas
text: Toda la parte de la arena está tapada por obras, por lo que lo que se puede ver es bastante poco, no merece la pena esperar esas colas.

title: Magnifique
text:
A visiter absolument! Quelle splendide architecture, des visionnaires ces romains.
Prendre son billet à  l'avance, victime de son succès la file d'attente peut être très  longue....

title: Me esperaba más..
text:
Impresiona un poco por dentro pero es mucho más bonito por fuera. 

Actualmente hay una exposición temporal y, personalmente, es lo mejor que tiene en su interior.

title: Von Außen imposanter als von Innen
text:
Ich hatte es mir besser vorgestellt 🤔
Mann muss schon viel Vorstellungskraft haben damit sich ein Bild ergibt wie es damals war

title: Roman Forum better than the Colosseum
text: Long hot queues await for the Colosseum. The enormity is amazing as is the history but I felt the Roman Amphitheater in Pula, Croatia was as if not more impressive. What is great is you get the Roman Forum (or old Roman Town) thrown in with the price of the ticket. This visit deserves a whole day. We used Rick Steves Audio guide to walk and compliment a great visit. Finish of with an ice cream and just enjoy the delights of Rome.

title: Esperava mais
text:
É uma atracao imperdivel para quem esta em Roma. 

Na porta tem um pessoal vendendo ingresso com guia e uma forma de furar a fila. 

De preferencia a esses ingressos, se nao, ficara 2h na fila para entrar. 

Dentro é legal, mas ok!
Esperava muito mais

title: Definitely an icon of Rome - but too much of a wait for us
text: It really is a must see - you can't come to Rome & not see the Colosseum.  However, if we'd wanted to see inside - the line was over 2 hours long.  We just didn't have the time to wait that long & had just been overwhelmed by crowds at the Vatican, so we chose to make the most of it from the outside - which was a great experience anyway.  Even from the outside it's pretty incredible.  The scale is hard to comprehend until you're actually there. There was a tree stump in the foreground which made for some good photo opportunities!

title: I was expecting more
text: Colosseum is so impressive. But it is for sure that (at least for me) it is more attractive from outside.

title: Ναι μεν αλλα....
text: Δεν ηταν αυτο που περιμεναμε. Ακριβη εισοδος και μεγαλη ουρα  αλλα αν κλεισεις απο πριν ολα καλα. Πηραμε τον οδηγο στα αγγλικα audio guide. Αλλα δεν υπηρχαν σαφεις οδηγιες. Σε καποιο σημειο που καναμε χρηση του ασανσερ δεν μπορουσαμε πια να ακολουθησουμε τα σημεια. Η αληθεια ειναι πως ειχαμε δει και το κολοσσαιο της τυνησιας οποτε δεν εντυπωσιαστηκαμε ιδιαιτερα. Ακριβα σουβενιρ στο καταστημα εντος.

title: Tour
text: We did the tour with early access and skip the line but didn’t realize how long the tour was(3+ hours). The sites were amazing and the tour guide was good just a little long for my liking and other agreed as well. Bathrooms are scarce. And it gets crowded later on the in the day. Had a great experience seeing the old ruins though.

title: Déception
text:
Heureuse d'avoir acheté mon billet avant et avoir pu éviter la queue.

Colisee en piteux état, rien d'extraordinaire à voir.

Je recommande vivement les arènes de Nîmes, seules à valoir le coup avec celles d'El Jam en Tunisie.

Les touristes s'y pressent mais ratent l'essentiel.

title: Avoid the main ticket line
text: Go to the much shorter line at the Roman Forum where you can get the exact same tickets.  Also the video/audio tour is a waste of money unless you know absolutely nothing about the colosseum.

title: Τεράστια ουρά, αλλά οικονομικά εισιτήρια
text: Μπορεί ως χώρος να έχει ενδιαφέρον, αλλά  για εμένα δεν είχε τόσο ενδιαφέρον, ώστε να αξίζουν οι δύο ώρες στην ουρά μέχρι να μπούμε επιτέλους μέσα. Από εκεί και πέρα αν είσαι φοιτητής οι τιμές εισόδου είναι πολύ καλές (μόνο 1€), ενώ αν σπουδάζεις αρχαιολογία μπαίνεις δωρεάν.

title: iconic building
text: Glad we've been there - but visit would have been a bit more comfortable if there had been somewhere to get a drink once we were inside.

title: confusione
text: attenzione ai borseggiatori//borseggiatrici. file interminabili anche se la bellezza del luogo mitiga tutto

title: Un peu déçu
text: Ce monument reste magnifique mais les travaux ( ce qui est normal) gâchent un peu le charme de cette merveille.

title: Disappointing
text: We had a group of 15 - teens & chaperones.  The general feeling of the kids was one of disappointment.  Currently the floor is all scaffolding & there is also a lot of scaffolding along the sides.  The group decided they wish they had only seen it from the outside & not wasted their time going inside.

title: Amazing but not essential
text: The Colosseum is breathtaking, from the outside the shear size of it and the fact it has stood as a pillar of Rome for over 2,000 years leaves you Wowed! Sadly, this is when your experience peaks. We asked staff to help us with our ticket meeting point, it was from a third party but the attitude to assist with any sort of entrance was rude and consisted of a lot of pointing and brushing us off. Once we got inside the wow factor stayed but was quickly given the thumb down by any staff member that perceived wonder for loitering, this resulted in a pretty rushed visit and a disappointing experience. I would advise anyone to visit the colosseum from the outside and get some great photos to show off the scale of this amazing ancient arena to everyone you know (there is a great bridge over the street to the left of the colosseum where you can get the whole arena in view). The inside is not essential but still a worthwhile experience if you don’t mind the above points.

title: Lots of tourists
text:
Unfortunately we couldn't manage to come inside of Colosseum. I haven't seen so many tourists at one spot!
If you are planning your trip to Rome, book your tickets online in advance

title: was nice but wouldnt go again
text: we had a guided tour could not here any think she was saying and didnt show us all of it better to do it on your own

title: Vacances à Rome
text: Le Colosseo reste un monument incontournable. Mais sachez que des Tours Operators ont acheté énormément de billets avec pour conséquence l'inutilité des billets coupe files. La mairie de Rome serait en train d'étudier le problème

title: Amazing views obviously
text: Unfortunately was so overcrowded with Africans trying to con or sell you things, many unofficial tours which leave you lost and out of pocket

title: Beautiful history, poorly managed
text: It is a shame such a beautiful piece of history is incompetently managed.  That being said it is a must see and do go early as it only gets worse as the day goes along.

title: Long lines
text: There is chaos all around the Coliseum. Might be worth to get your pic outside and skip the sweltering heat. Inside in lineups and crowds. The areas around the Coliseum such as the forum and Palestine Hill are a better walk.

title: Two time visit
text:
We’ve visit it first from
The outside, then paid 10 euros for internal tour. Although very interesting, there is nothing to see as it is all under construction

title: Beau à voir, mais haute saison à éviter
text: Un incontournable pour une première visite de Rome. Lieu juste époustouflant pour les passionnés d’histoire. Ne pas hésiter à prendre un guide pour n’en rater aucune miette. L’été : longue attente, il faut de la patience. Mais cela en vaut tout de même la peine.

title: Not the best
text: Getting to the Colosseum is difficult. The streets feel a little unsafe and there are a lot of people trying to sell you tickets and selfie sticks. We found that it was much more ruined than we though, and less impressive than we though. Other than saying we've been there, we unfortunately didn't take much else away from it.

title: Finger weg vom Anbieter “TICKETBAR”
text:
Eines vorweg: DAS KOLLOSEUM IST GROSSARTIG!

ABER:
Wir haben uns für ein skip-the-line-ticket entschieden. Auf der Internetseite “il-colosseo” konnten wir 2 auswählen, für den Zeitraum von 12:30 bis 13:00. Mittels Visa schnell bezahlt. Kurze Zeit später kam eine eMail von “ticketbar”: der ausgewählte Zeitraum ist nicht verfügbar! Ein link zum Auswählen eines neuen Zeitraums wurde gleich mitgeschickt. Einer zum Stornieren NICHT!
Also dem link gefolgt und neu ausgewählt: 13:30-14:00.
Erneut eine eMail: Zeitraum (obwohl auswählbar) nicht verfügbar!
nach dem 4.(!) Mal haben wir dann zwei Tickets um 17:00 bekommen. Eine Storno-Option wurde in keiner der eMails angeboten!

Auch wenn das Ticket ab dem ersten Besuch 2 Tage gilt, ist 1 Tag schon vorbei, wenn man erst um 17:00 rein darf und das Kolloseum/Forum Romanum/Pallatin schon um 19:15 zu sperrt!

Fazit:
-) Kolloseum auf jeden Fall!!! 
-) Die Tickets aber nicht über TICKETBAR oder “il-colosseo” buchen!!!

title: Do NOT USE HEADOUT TOURS FOR THIS ATTRACTION
text:
They were not at the meeting place at the appointed time and have refused to refund.  The meeting point was very crowded and we couldn't find the Tour, it must have been very poorly signposted, if it was there at all!!

Don't use this provider as it is a sham.

We wound up just using another at the front of the Colosseum and it was fine.

title: Atestafo
text: Mejor Compra las entradas en otra parte. Ten paciencia. Disfrútalo y lleva mucha Ágata contigo en verano.

title: Dificil de visitar
text: Obras no entorno, filas quilometricas, impossivel bater uma foto sem que tenha varias pessoas. Taxis cobram uma fortuna para fazer aguns quilometros, no quarteirão seguinte é metade do valor.

title: Mi aspettavo di più
text: Soprattutto all'interno, forse le aspettative era troppo alte per un monumento che comunque ha tanta storia.. meglio con una guida

title: Beware
text: Obviously this is on the bucket list of many people - as it was on mine. But time your visit - don’t go in June through August - you will wait hours or be exploited by tour guides who don’t truly have the history right. Very aggressive and unsavory grifters and pickpockets. Such a terrible shame.

title: Night time tour was disappointing
text:
We booked a tour through a third part, and their portion was awesome.  But when we arrived at the Colosseum for the nighttime arena floor and underground portion, we were required to use the Colosseum guide.

Unfortunately, our particular guide was not very good.  He was very dry in his presentation, he was repetitive, and the information he provided just wasn't interesting.  One example was when we reached a particular corridor, he spent five minutes telling us that people used to walk down this corridor, but sometimes animals might also use the corridor, and that the corridor could be used for people to both enter and exit, and that the animals could also be brought in or out of this corridor, but that it was mostly used by people, except when it was used by animals.  Also gladiators probably used the corridor to go from one place or the other.

After forty five minutes of that, and two short films that used "thusly" and "hither" WAY too many times, we decided to leave the tour before seeing the two main things we came to see - the arena floor and the underground.  We found a staff member and told her we had to leave.  One other couple asked the guide,  it he told them there wasn't a way to exit at that point of the tour.  Another family asked if they could join another group, and several people had taken off their headphones and were no longer listening to the guide.

Another disappointing part of the nighttime tour is the lack of lighting.  Of course it will be dark at night, but there is so little lighting inside that you can't really see anything at all.  Of course there shouldn't be much or it would ruin the ambience and historical feel of the arena, but they didn't apply that standard when they erected a large movie screen on the arena floor.   Just a tiny bit of lighting would have helped, but as it is you just don't get a feel for the size of the Colosseum.  

I'm sure there are great tours and some great guides.  We just didn't get one this time.

title: It is in renovation, but still very beautiful
text: We were surprised to see that the Colosseum was under renovation and that they are also planning to build a Metro under it! It is still a very beautiful place. The renovation is more for the consolidation rather than for changing its original style. Be aware of pickpockets.

so dont waste money and buy online ticket day(s) before

text: Già prima delle 8.30, orario di apertura, si formano dode all esterno che poi si risolvono velocemente. Il personale é molto disponibile ma il numero di persone in visita é veramente notevole. text: All exteriors are covered with scaffolding, due to (at least) external renovations, not good to visit.  Cannot take pictures.

text: I wish we had only gone to the main portion of the Colosseum. We paid for the tour of the underground and was disappointed to find that the one hour tour only went to a very small section of the underground. Didn't really think it worth it.

title: dışarının ihtişamını içeride yakalayamadık.
text: dışarda çok etkileyici olan bu yapıya girmek için rezervasyon gerekiyor, roma pass alıp girmek isteyen arkadaşlar varsa eğer lütfen rezervasyon yaptırmayı unutmasınlar aksi takdirde kesinlikle içeriye almıyorlar, bizim gezimiz kısa olduğu için yol üzerinde hintli bir arkadaş bizi çevirdi ve kişi başı 35€ rehber ile karşılığında içeri sokabileceğini söyledi. rehberimiz mi iyi değildi bilemiyorum ama içeride geçirdiğimiz yaklaşık 1, 1.30 saatimiz pek de verimli olmadı. aklınızın bi köşesinde olsun belki o parayı başka bir şekilde değerlendirmek isteyebilirsiniz.

title: Cancelled Reservation With No Explanation
text: I booked our tour months in advance to have the perfect tour and time, due to the heat in the middle of summer in Rome and they cancelled it, with no explanation, forcing me to book a different tour in the hottest part of the day, in direct sun, which was a 3 hour walking tour and almost caused heat stroke. I would never book with them again!

title: Ah, we wasted our time and money.
text: FULL to the brim with tour parties; we did not get to see what we paid for, and I could see more on the History Chanel than we saw here. Dangerous climbing up and down those stairways with so many people pushing and shoving. We went afternoon. Avoid that timeslot!

text:
Bestimmt sehenswert, wenn man die Geduld hat bei 35 C* 2 Stunden in einer Schlange zu stehen um in das Kolosseum zu kommen, oder wie im Vatikan dafür bezahlt an der Schlange vorbei geführt zu werden.

title: Interesting place but the staff could not organise a Mass at the Vatican.
text: We had purchased online two tickets for the Vatican. With a time slot of 10:40 On arriving , at 10:00, we saw huge queues of people. We asked somewhere where we should queue , showing them the email we had. They told us to join the long queue ( over 2 hrs ) so we did as told. We we got close to the ticket desk we saw there was two separate queues , one of us went off into the one lapelled reservation desk to ask.  we where told that this was the queue where’s where supposed to join and we had now missed our time slot and wouldn’t be allowed in. The woman at the desk said we can take the risk of the 10:40 ticket and see if the guards let us in round the corner or we could buy a new ticket for 1pm ( it was now 11:45 ) so another hour and a half waiting in the sun. We too the risk of the 10:40 ticket and where allowed in after explain the situation. Once inside everything was as expected but the organisation outside the place is atrocious.

title: Aktuell eine riesen Baustelle
text: Wir haben das Kolosseum im Regen und mit riesiger Baustelle besucht. Bis 2025 wird unter dem Kolosseum eine U-Bahnstation gebaut. Daher sind viele Teile des Kolosseums mit Verstrebungen und Stützen versehen. Dennoch ist es von Aussen ein beeindruckender Bau.

title: Very crowded and hot
text: Of course the Colosseum is an essential site to visit and it is truest amazing. But it is very crowded and busy and hot.

title: Muy bonito lugar
text: Muchísima gente en Julio y debes ir temprano para evitar el calor del medio día. Abren desde las 8:30am. Si reservas en línea tu entrada no tienes problemas ni que hacer muchas colas. Si quieres entrar a la arena debes de pagar un poco más. Prepárate para las escaleras!

title: Everything you expected
text: We went towards the end of the season in October and it was still very busy. We had not paid in advance or paid for fast track, but because we got there so early we got straight through with only a handful of people in the queue in front, as opposed to the fast track queue which was extremely long. The ‘colosseo’ itself is everything one imagines it to be. However, if you do not join a tour group you are limited to where you can go, for example only your groups go on the stage and at the highest point of the building. Although it was an amazing experience, it was just as you would picture it. You have to go when in Rome because it is a staple, but not somewhere I would go again. Fabulous overall!

title: Dream Visit Spoiled
text: Paid for an excursion from our cruise to visit one of the most famous historical sites in the world. However when we arrived we were constantly bombarded by street peddlers trying to con you in to buying bracelets , selfe sticks and other tacky items.allegedly tro help their poor family back in Kenya. This was a really sad day for us as we had really looked forward to the whole experience for years but instead eventually left the site due to the constant pestering every 30 seconds or so . Surely the local government and police can deal with this constant pestering , instead of looking on with their arms folded watching. Please be aware of this when you are planning any trip to this iconic site.

title: Υπερτιμημένο
text: Εντυπωσιακό το μέγεθος του φλαβιανου αμφιθεάτρου όπως ειναι το κανονικό του όνομα. Στο εσωτερικό του δεν εχουν μείνει και πολλά να δεις εκτός από τον σκελετό του μετά την απογύμνωση του από τους Πάπες και άλλους. Παρακολουθήσαμε ξενάγηση στα Αγγλικά με την επίσημη ξενάγηση αλλά μου φάνηκε βιαστικό ξεπετάγμα. Εξωτερικά μου άρεσε περισσότερο. Προτιμήστε να αφιερώσετε χρόνο σε λιγότερο γνωστά αξιοθέατα μακρυά από τις ορδές των τουριστών.

Simbolo della capitale assolutamente da vedere una volta nella vita. Il problema qui sta nei troppi venditori abusivi altamente insistenti di cui non bisogna assolutamente fidarsi e purtroppo troppi lavori in corso che non rendono la bellezza di tale monumento
