title: Walk the perimeter.
text: Much of the inside of the Colosseum is covered with scaffolding as it is undergoing major work.  Until this work is completed it is not worth going inside when there are so many other things to see in Rome.  Do walk around the outside perimetre, which has had a 3 year facelift.  You can see what it looked like before the work began, as some has been left original, and also the reconstructed parts, which return it to it’s former state.

title: impressive but not exciting
text: did not live up to the hype. it is hugely impressive for what it is and for surving through the ages but much of this tour was based on your imagining what it would have been like. a guide is crtical to explain what all the different thing were and their significance as what you are looking at is RUINS.

title: Vervallen, slecht onderhouden
text: Dit is een monument met historische waarde, een prachtig gebouw. Doordat het verval en slechte renovatie vind ik het een steeds minder mooi monument. Ik heb het 15 jaar geleden ook gezien en toen was het veel beter. Echt jammer! Ik vind het nu niet zo interessant meer.

title: Pititful experience but interesting visit.
text:
My family and I had pre-booked tickets online for a tour on the top floor of the Colosseum - 30 minutes before our tour began, we tried to search for the place we could collect our tickets. After a long time walking around, we found the place, where they told us our tour was canceled due to renovations on the top level. They provided us with a €20 refund, which was nice, and gave us tickets to a non-guided visit to the rest of the monument which was due an hour later.

We waited an hour in the shade outside when suddenly around 20 Indian (I presume) street-sellers started causing havoc. They carried bags of water bottles, selfie-sticks, hats, portable chargers (complete tat) etc...

They would constantly approach us and everyone else saying "water-water". And when you ignored them, they got angry and started getting rather shouty before walking away. 

For around 40 minutes around the area, awaiting our tour, these people bothered us. 

For those who would consider buying the water off them, they should be wary as they only charge €1 and the bottles they sell have their seal broken - presumably filling up used bottles at the nearby water fountains. 

These people usually hang around the Colosseum and the park nearby. They leave litter everywhere. Police don't care and honestly, after being approached every 5 minutes, it gave us a bad start for our first visit.

At one point, an old woman, roughly 60 years old; toothless, barefoot, hobbling with a stick, dressed in ragged clothes approached us with her hand out. She stood by us for roughly 3 minutes, begging for money - my family and I ignored her. She went to all the people sitting on the benches around the Colosseum before giving up with her huge purse (presumably full of money) on her shoulder and walking back past us saying "tutti merde" (for those who don't know what that means, it means "all s***". She then ran up the long stairs away from the Colosseum with great speed on her "injured" leg, walking stick in hand. We were glad that we didn't give her money after that.

Soon after, we went through security very quickly and avoided the 2 hours non-ticket queue. We looked around and it was very interesting but very busy.

All in all, it wasn't very enjoyable due to the beggars and streetsellers.

title: Roma pass scam
text: Wat een klucht! We kopen een Roma pass voor "skip the line", maar eens we hier aankomen moeten we een uur aanschuiven om een timeslot te boeken om dan drie uur later pas binnen te kunnen. 76 euro weggegooid. Geen tweede keer.

title: Family Vacay
text: While it is a must see because of the fountains beauty, historical significance, and to make the famous wish.  I rated this a 3 for several reasons: way too crowded and zero crowd control.  People are rude pushing and shoving to get to their picture and while there is security it is only to tell people not to sit on the fountain.  Plaza Navona was a much better experience.

title: Gestione pessima delle code
text:
Nonostante ci fossimo presentati alle 8.30 siamo entrati al Colosseo alle 10.30!
Lo scodamento dei visitatori è gestito in maniera pessima! Solo 2 casse aperte!
Il ragazzo gentilissimo alla cassa ci ha detto che è così tutti i giorni!

Vergognosa la gestione! Assolutamente da migliorare! Inviata lettera di lamentele all'amministrazione comunale della Capitale!

title: Meraviglia trasandata
text: A distanza di decenni mi ritrovo al cospetto di una delle meraviglie mondiali, purtroppo tristemente circondata da degrado, sporcizia, trasandatezza e inciviltà.....peccato!

title: Coliseo
text: Es algo muy lindo para disfrutar ver el atardecer hay bares para tomar algo cerquita y disfrutar las vistas de atardecer y sino la plaza también es buena opción para ver el coliseo en toda su dimensión excelente lugar para pasar el día conociendo todas las maravillas romanas

title: Disappointed
text: I came here expecting to see pugilistic bloodsport but instead I am baking in the sun with thousands of other tourists while some guy with a Greek accent or whatever talks about the Romans as if they were still relevant today. Also they didn't serve alcohol.

title: Colosseum in Rome
text:
The security at colosseum in Rome stole our watch on July 18, 2019 Very bad service
All guest check every. The management know that their staff not senserly

title: À voir parce que c'est monument historique mais sans plus
text:
C'est à voir de part sa taille et son histoire, néanmoins au vu du monde c'est un peu l usine. Nous avons pris colisee+forum+palatin. Je vous conseille de prendre les billets un peu plus loin, près de l entrée du forum romain, via in miranda, 40 min de queue à 11h30 au lieu de 3 ou 4h au colisee. Les visites en français sont à 11h et 12h. Sur internet ce n'est pas précisé. 
Le prix sont moins chers que sur internet. J avais vu sur internet à 33e avec accès à l arène sans visite guidee alors que sur place  c est 16e et en plus l accès à l'arène est fermé et sur internet ils ne le disent pas.les billets sont valables 2 jours, 1 entre forum+palatin et 1 pour le colisee. Nous avons commencé par le forum et palatin. C'est très grand prévoir au moins 1h30 pour faire le tour. Nous regrettons de pas avoir pris l audio guide pour cette partie. 
Au colisee, nous avions le vidéo audio guide qui  explique bien mais pas évident de se repérer quand on nous dit de regarder d'un côté ou de l autre.  Avec un guide qui raconte l histoire c'est mieux je pense.

title: Much confusion
text: My brother decided to use the Roma Card to pay for entry. However, you still have to wait in a line to schedule a visiting time, which was never mentioned. Combine this with poor labeling or instruction at the Colisseum. Get yor ticket online along with a scheduled time. When your scheduled time comes be at the east end entrence to go through security. Ignore the long lines of people purchasing tickets.

title: No need to go in. Believe me!
text: I spent hours and days researching what tickets are best to get into the Colosseum. From rip-off agencies that charge three times the official prices to the official website and all its many many ticket types. I went through hell getting the reservations because all my cards were being rejected. Then of course the queue and the dreadful so-called video guide. All in all we did the experience mainly to tick it off the to do list. But there is nothing that you can't experience from just standing outside and walking around this fabulous building. I know if you're looking for tickets, there is no way you believe me. I wouldn't have when I was desperate to get in! But the truth is that you can spend that money get in Gallery Borghese for instance which has fabulous treasures. Whatever you do avoid the video guide. It is a complete rip off.

title: Menschenmassen
text: Schade das man keine Chance hat das alles zu genießen. Ewige Warteschlangen in der ewigen Stadt. Bedrängt von hunderten fliegenden Händlern die einem alle 2 Sekunden etwas anderes andrehen wollen.

title: Çok kalabalık
text: Kolezyum yakınlarında C hattı metro çalışması var. Aynı zamanda kolezyumun kendi içinde de renovasyon olduğu için dışardan ve içerden görüntü pek de tatmin edici değil bana kalırsa.Arka planda kolezyum'un olduğu güzel bir fotoğraf çektirmek istiyorsanız Roma Forum bileti alın ve forumun hemen girişinde sağ yukarı tarafta kolezyum'u tam karşıdan kimselerin olmadığı bir noktada güzel bir fotoğrafı çektirin aynı zamanda roma forumu'nu da gezmiş olursunuz. Roma Pass olsa bile kolezyum önündeki uzun sırayı beklememiz gerektiği söylendi bunu da ekleyeyim.

title: Viaggio nella storia
text: È tutto molto bello e interessante,ma è inaccettabile che con.questo.caldo non mettano delle pensiline o.semplici tettoie in tela per la gente che fa la fila per il biglietto.oggi era da sentirsi male.1ora e mezza di fila sotto il sole cocente.

title: DON'T BOOK WITH TRAVELSPHERE!
text: We booked a £4500 holiday "Grand tour of Italy" with Travelsphere 6 months in advance. They waited until THE DAY OF THE TOUR to inform us via the tourguide that there was no possible chance of getting inside as to do that, you should book it back home in the UK. Once they took our money, they lost interest in us as customers. No one could pay us enough money to use Travelsphere again. Zero customer service skills. Also, for anyone who is disabled, forget Italy as they only want healthy visitors. no public toilets and no disabled toilets available in the whole country. BIG DISSAPOINTMENT. The colloseum would have been great to visit, had we had decent holiday company.

title: Good visit, terrible service
text: Pre-booked our visit, and it was a good time saver. The visit itself was disappointing. First of all, only certain tour groups can visit most of the locked areas. The worst experience was the audio guide rental. It costs €5.50, but you won’t get your money’s worth. It will give you only 7 narratives. We rented two audio guides and one stopped working a few minutes into our visit. I tried to return it and asked for my money back, and was quite rudely told no. Very typical Italian “customer service.”

title: A Spoiled Weekend
text:
What a disappointing weekend this turned out to be. 
Problems with the booking site led to us having to pay an extra £30 for our 3 day stay. 
The establishment was generally shabby. 
The Receptionist doubled as the chef on 2 of our 3 mornings and told us she couldn’t do poached eggs only ‘ordinary’ eggs. Ordinary being fried!! She also  told me to ‘cook’ my own toast. 
On our third morning she informed us she had no mushrooms because ‘chef had forgotten to buy them the previous day
She asked us if we wanted hot food in a tone that indicated she hoped we were going to say No. 
I would reluctantly give this establishment 1 star.

title: Entorno muy descuidado
text:
Para  un lugar tan importante llama la atención el descuido de los alrededores,  sucio, feo, no hay sombra.
Llegas y ya te quieres ir.
¡1 euro por entrar a un baño sucio!
Un lugar así merece mayor dedicación.

title: Hire a guide which will let you go inside
text: Our colosseum trip was with Cosmos tour.It was in June,extremely hot,bus parked like 15-20 min walk away and when we reached they give it to the local guide which they told us was giving us “Around” the collosium tour.What! Why? She said tourist are not allowed inside,which was a lie because we can see tourist inside. From going around the collasium is not worth it if you cannot go inside and understand whats all about. Cosmos ABig No,they cheated us.

title: Expensive and stressful
text: Visited on our first  day, as it was our top priority. Could not locate the  guide . Meeting point was the Arch of Constantine, which was too vague as it was a sea of people. Eventually after phoning for more clarification, we spotted the guides .By this time we had been standing around in the heat  as we were told to get there early.  Just before we went through security my sons girlfriend collapsed and had to be taken to the ambulance crew, so we had to abandon our tour. We waited for them to come out and then joined them for access to the Palatine and the Forum. No refund forthcoming. We tried again two days later with a different operator. All went well at first .Quick entry this time,and the guide was informative. However,we were supposed to have time to explore after the talk,but she took us through the turnstiles, then realised her mistake. She spoke to the guard on the gate we had just come through, but he would not let us back in, so no photo opportunities inside. She said she would take us on to the Palatine and the Forum which we had also paid for, or we could come back in an hour to join the next tour. We had already seen this on the previous visit, and we were not keen to stand in the heat for an hour, so we left. Unsatisfactory and disappointing.

title: Not so impressive as expected
text: The Colosseum was in restauration and not all visiting points were opened. The most interesting places arena and the rooms below were closed.

title: Tour with Discover Rome Tours
text:
The Colosseum itself is beautiful and amazing with rich history. But our experience was ruined by some unprofessionals. 
We bought the Colosseum tour on the spot from the guys selling the service. We were able to get the tour for 30€, which normally is 45-55€ on the internet. We thought we were lucky to save some money, but we were wrong because the tour was very disappointing for many reasons.
Our tour was on 27.06.2019 at about 11:55. We were told that the TOUR will be for 1 hour each INSIDE Colosseum and the Forums, but it was less than an hour in each. The tour started at 11:55 outside the Colosseum, he was just briefing about the Colosseum. We were still in line by 12:30, and it finished by 13:06. Utter disappointment!! We were then told to roam around ourselves, and meet outside the Colosseum for the next tour at 14:00. Our guide did gave some interesting facts in this short duration. Lucky for our guide, that I forgot his name. He was an old man. He passed a very racist remark against an Indian guy in the group, very very sad!!
The Forums tour started at 14:20 and finished at 14:47, again, under an hour.
In summary, these guys seemed scams and not professionals. Better to buy an expensive one, for a better experience.

title: Muss man Gesehen haben aber langt von aussen
text:
Innen liegt nur Schutt da kriegt man nix anderes zu sehen als von außen.
Und wenn Tickets kaufen dann vorher bei Get your Guide. kann man einfach an der Schlange vorbei laufen.
Von Kinderwagen wird angeraten aber kann man problemlos mit nehmen.

title: Bello..ma
text:
Il Colosseo? Emozionante! Storia allo stato puro! 
Peccato peró che tutto attorno regna il paradiso della sporcizia...

title: Visita
text: Local imponente mas nada preparado para receber turistas.  Nao tem locais de espera, nao tem bancos de jardim, nao tem sombras. Se vai com crianças ou idosos prepara-se bem antes de seguir para as filas...

title: Book a tour and ditch the guide!
text:
So as much as I love Italy...its not the most organised place in the world....  Whilst you can book online, its hard to know which site is official and unlike most other world heritage site, the colosseum is littered with agents who buy tickets in bulk, which means the official sales office sells out their maximum for the day and you end up haggling with agents for the best price for skip the line tickets.  On a 36 degree day, this is the last thing you want to be doing.  Skip the line tickets with a guide are still the best way to get in, but prepare to walk to the sales office, wait to make a payment and wait another hour till they put you in a group and another hour for the security line...still this is better than 4 hrs in general admission, but there are hundreds of groups and it is absolute chaos. 

That said, once you do get into the colosseum, its pretty phenomenal if, like me, its an architectural marvel you’ve always wanted to see, but my advice would be to ditch the guide at some point and take your time wondering through as they guides will try to get you in and out as quickly as possible.

title: טיול בקוליסאום
text: קודם כל מומלץ להזמין כרטיסים באינטרנט אחרת תחכו שעות בקור הזמנת כרטיסים מראש מקצרת את התהליך זמן ביקור היה מאוד חם המקום מיוחד

title: Ожидали большего
text: Руины, понятно, что история, но когда стоишь рядом из за толпы туристов, как то не вдохновляет. Сходить можно, но точно не стоит стоять в очередях

title: Be careful around here.
text:
We visited the site while doing a tour of Rome. To be honest we did not go into the building as we were told the queue were more than an hour long. It was a very hot day and there was no way we were standing in a queue in that heat for that length of time with small children. Outside the place was filled with people trying to sell you anything for a bottle of water to sun hats and I'd say if you were to ask the right person probably drugs as well. They were to put it mildly shady characters. They often didn't take no for an answer and I could see them being intimidating to more vulnerable people. 
All in all disappointing but it was good to see the outside if not nothing else.

title: Dpaura e delirio a Roma
text: Il Colosseo è sempre il Colosseo ma tra il cantiere per la metro, i millemila turisti che facevano la fila per entrare, i bagarini e i venditori ambulanti é meglio guardatelo dalla terrazza antistante o da Google maps

title: Skip the line scam from a Coloseum entrance Guide Employee
text: Not sure how this happened to us but it did. We asked for some help from one of the employees with a staff shirt on. He took us over to another employee because a small tour was about to start in 15 minutes for 35 euros per person. Well... were informed that we just missed that one but there was another starting up in 40 minutes with a small group of 12. We decided to wait. She was 1/2 an hour late. When it finally did start everyone seemed confused as to who should be on the tour. There ended up being 38 people. Again... let me reiterate that the man who made the sale had on a STAFF shirt. Our guide proceeded to start the information. We couldn't hear a thing. We stood in the hot sun for another 45 minutes trying to hear what she was saying. She seemed totally bored. She was not very good at her job. At this time we watched literally hundreds of people walk in ahead of us. When it was finally our turn to go through security I was screamed at by the security guard IN ITALIAN for doing something wrong. What is was... I am not sure. Once inside this horrible tour got hijacked several times because we couldn't follow such a large group. We along with another bunch of people bailed. What a huge disappointment. Buy your tickets at the ticket office on site. Wait for the lines to go down and get your own self guided audio tour.

title: Could be skipped
text: It is certainly a historic place and could seem part of the top things to do in Rome but if you had the chance to see other equivalent and well conserved theatres, especially in Verona or even Nimes in France, this is certainly going to disapoint you. Too many people there and most of it is gone in side. Needs a lot of imagination to figure how things were in the past...

title: Average
text: Colosseum was brilliant to see, but the queue to get in, and all the scaffolding all over the place let the visit down for us.

title: Beaucoup de monde

Lieu incontournable mais beaucoup de monde donc y aller de préférence le matin.

title: Buy the dang tour package
text:
We  chose to purchase the audio tour, and I really wish that we would have spent the extra money and gone with a Viatour or something because you could barely hear anything and it wasn't clearly marked what way you needed to walk. 

It is beautiful, but it felt more like being in a cattle chute with all of the other tourists than being in an ancient and awe inspiring structure. I suppose I could just pretend that I was there on the day of a popular spectacle, and chalk it up to part of the experience.

I would like to go back, because I feel like it should be better than it was.

title: Bien mais..
text: Le monument est magnifique et impressionnant mais le plus dérangeant ce sont les vendeurs à la sauvette qui viennent vous voir toutes les 30 secondes pour que vous leur achetiez des articles, sans compter sur 2 guignols déguisés en Gladiateurs qui veulent te forcer à payer pour prendre une photo avec eux. Nous avons bien sûr refusés et avons été insultés ... cela a un peu gâché notre plaisir de cette visite.

title: long queues! alas, still a must see
text:
now.... I suppose you dont ever feel like you can go to visit Rome and not go to the colleseum and I would have to agree. 

however, apparently they have just installed new metal detectors and i kid you not there are two! teo for 3000 people at a time inside the colleseum.... why cant they invest in more????!

we pre purchased tickets and this 'queue' was approx 1 hour to get in. the queue without tickets was 2hours. most of it was unshaded and particularly heavy going in the Italian summer heat especially with continuous Indian men attempting to sell u ice water (likely to have filled up from a tap rather than mineral....but who knows!), hats, fans and sun umbrellas.... it gets very annoying after a while.

there is no visable shops near by or inside for any snscks/other drinks.... nearest place is the metro station.

when in our queue we were offered a guided tour which was promised to skip the line for a discounted price of 35€. which was 20€ less than advertised price and included guided tour of Roman forum/Palentine hill too. 

so we paid.... then waited another HOUR in the groups line to get in. I suppose the only slight advantage was this was generally more shaded and included lots of interesting information by our tour guide whilst waiting in the queue. 

when you get inside obviously it's very interesting and guided tour was good to offer some interesting facts. 

I would recommend a very early visit or a very late one to beat the crowds and consider a guided tour.... 

colleseum need to sort their security lines out,surely they are raking the cash in!!!!!

:(

title: Amazing building ruined by too many people.
text: Beautiful building, horrible queue times, go very early. Even with the safety restriction on population inside the beauty is ruined in my honest opinion. Worth it if you can skip the longest queues.

title: Very little is original
text: We had a brilliant guide who we paid extra for from an excellent agency to get in early and bat the crowds. The structure is impressive and there are great photo opportunities. However, our guide explained that almost none of the structure is original, with much of what you see clearly being quite modern and recently put together. Apparently the underground section is being hastily built up with no reference to the past as quickly as possible so as to earn more tourist dollars, which is pretty depressing. With hindsight get your photos with the iconic outside and move on.

title: Colosseum visit
text: It was really good to see the monument, was very crowded, better to go with prior booking in skip the line tickets, was very hot though, better to go before sun during summer

title: Don't book with VIATOUR!
text: Paid over $300 CDN for a premium 'floor arena' access with a guide only to be told before we went in that due to high volume, we would NOT be able to have the tour we purchased.  I could have purchased the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Forum tickets for a total of 24 Euros for my whole family (and done the free downloadable Rick Steves audio guide).  Guides in Italy told us to take up the matter with Viatour at home. My first email complaint came back with 'sorry no refunds, sucks to be you', and then when pressed again, they offered $39 CDN.  Brutal. We'll never be able to get back to Italy as a family again so this was a real bummer.  If I had to do it again, I wouldn't bother with a tour guide, she even skimped on details of 'what the Gladiators experienced' fearing it was too gross for people to handle. THIS IS WHY I AM HERE...to learn this...

title: Skip the line tour with Headout - VIT Group - Chaotic - not recommendable
text:
After our first desaster with Headout for a Vatican Tour which they confirmed and later told us that it was not available, this was the second tour we booked with them and their operator VIT Group in this case. The start was a bit chaotic and the skip the line tour did not get off at 10:45 am as booked. We had to stand in queue for over an hour in the skip the line queue in 33 degrees to get in and had 3 different "guides" during this time. Headout never again

title: A ’Must-See’?
text:
Everyone has heard of the majestic Colosseum. Tourists visiting Rome often visit this building and my friend and I were no exception. We even booked a 3h tour for Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine during our four day trip to Rome, but more on that later.

When we arrived to the Colosseum we couldn’t be anything but amazed at the sight of the world-famous building. We took pictures outside and enjoyed the beautiful view. If you are planning a trip to Rome, I would strongly recommend to visit this almost 2000-year old building and take pictures on it alternatively on you in front of it. 

If you are interested in history, just like I am, you might also go on a guided tour inside the old building. While this absolutely is a fun experience and something that is on most people’s bucket lists, there are a few things that might be beneficial to know beforehand, so you know what to expect and can prepare yourself accordingly.

Firstly, the inside is not near as beautiful as the outside (in my opinion at least). Considering this building has survived hundreds of years, it is no surprise that it looks like a ruin. Being so hyped up these days, I thought Colosseum had somehow managed to survive better than all other equally as old buildings in the world (which might have been a stupid preconception on my behalf). If you enter with another mindset than mine, i.e. of it to be in a not-so-great condition, it will probably be easier to enjoy its historical value and beauty.

Another thing to prepare yourself for, when visiting Colosseum, is the long lines outside. We came with a guide, but we still had to wait in line more than 30 min. When you get to the end of the line you will also have to go through a security check, just like that on airports (with metal detectors etc.). Try therefore to bring as little as possible.

To make sure that you really appreciate the history of the building, I would recommend to read a bit about it on your own before the trip, since you can’t blindly count on your guide to tell you everything about it. Our guided tour for example only lasted 20 minutes inside of the Colosseum before heading out to the next place. 

Colosseum is probably the biggest tourist attraction in Rome and where tourists are pickpockets thrive. When I was in Rome I didn’t witness nor experience any pickpocketing, but you should be aware of its existence. Always try to have one hand on your bag and if possible have the zippers close to your body. Don’t make yourself an easier target by carrying things in your pockets either. What I did experience during my stay, though, was the people who flocked outside of tourist attractions like Colosseum. They sold everything from water bottles and sun hats to umbrellas and wristbands. Do not under any circumstances buy these, since the people who are selling them do it illegaly on the black market. If you are thirsty, try finding a supermarket or café and buy water there instead. These people can be pretty stubborn and if you sound hesistant they will notice and keep talking to you. The best way to avoid feeling harrased and/or stressed is to politely, but firmly, say ”No, no grazie”, which translates to ”No, no thank you”. If you do this as you shake your head and move away from them, they will quickly notice you aren’t an easy target and move on instead. Don’t be afraid of sounding a bit rude, it is important to be firm with them. 

If you can see past the downsides of the Colosseum, it is a fun experience and if you only have these facts in your mind when visiting I believe you will have a great time!

title: Wonderful historic site but beware the queues and rip-offs
text:
The Colosseum is a must see site in Rome. The site itself is awe-inspiring and well wirth several visits.

The organisation of visitors is, however, a shambles.

Firstly, you can expect to queue and queue.  You can book on tne Web. If you don't, even if you have tickets, you must queue at a ticket office, a couple of hundred metres from the Colosseum entry, to be issued with an entry time. You then have to queue to get in. Be warned, the issued entry time is pointless. It is not honoured. If you try to get to the gate on time, you are simply told to go back on the end of tne queue. Queing time on the day we visited was estimated to be 90 minutes to 2 hours. The queue has no shade or shelter. 

It is, however, a target for people offering guided tours. Their major sales pitch is that these tours enable you to "skip the queue". The first prices offered to us was 35 euros pp. Soon after, another seller wearing the same livery as the first offered tours for 30 euro pp. We accepted that offer. 

Did we "skip the queue"? Hardly!! We waited almost 20 minutes for tbe guided tour to commence then found ourselves in another queue, this one for guided tours. We were told breathlessly by our guided that we had "skipped the queue". The new queue we joined finally resulted in admission to the Colosseum after a further 35 minute wait. 

To be fair, our guided tour, once we got in, was very good. Our guide was personable and knowledgeable. She made it worth the 30 euro fee. 

The "skip the queue" sales pitch is, however,  almost fraudulent. 

If you decide to endure the normal queue in hot weather - it was 32C on the day we visited - then take good hats, sun screen and plenty of water.

title: Te toeristisch
text:
Wat te veel volk en vernieuwingen waardoor de authentieke atmosfeer verloren gaat. Blijft een machtig gebouw en een must see.

KOOP JE TICKET NIET IN HET COLOSEUM ZELF! Aan ingang van Palatino en Forum Romano koop je hetzelfde ticket maar een véél mindere wachtrij!

title: Nice but super crowded
text:
Indeed it is nice and you have to visit it, however I put 3 out of 5 as it is super crowded, the lineup takes over 3 hours.
Make sure you have enough of water, like a lot, as it’s quite hot and they are selling the water 5 EUR for 3 small bottles, so get with you some before you go.
We took the skip the line tour and it was super boring, not worth it, paid 70 EUR for 2 pax, once we get in, we left the tour guide lol not only us, as we bought it just to skip the line, I would say go, if the lineup is not long.

title: Non esiste il salta cods
text: L'ingresso al colosseo costa 12 euro. Non fatevi fregare dai romani furbacchioni che vi promettono di farvi saltare la fila al modico prezzo di 32€.. Bisogna passare attraverso i controlli e la fila tocca a tutti, guide comprese. Poi una volta all'interno vi dicono 4 cose in croce e vi congedano dopo mezz'ora lasciandovi con l'amaro in bocca e una netta sensazione di essere stati fregati! Entrateci per conto vostro e leggete la storia su wikipedia.

title: Hive of misinformation and disorganisation
text:
*Warning, I’m still jaded from this experience so take this with a grain of salt*

I’ve been to the Colosseum before. This was nothing like my experience with a guided tour. We booked the day before (you will need to book a time which you can do online or next to the Roman Forum). 

We arrived 10 minutes before our allotted time slot and were shown by someone wearing an ‘information’ singlet where the line to wait to get in was for people who had booked their time before hand. The line was in the sun, not moving and we were told would take up to 2 hours to get through. We waited 10 minutes before giving up. In that 10 minutes we were harassed and people tried to make us buy tours, water and junk. I would recommend going with a tour and looking up the tour company. If you do go independently, be prepared for a long wait and bring plenty of water, shade and sunscreen. Arrive at least an hour before your time or try and get in early!

title: Super busy And packed
text: A must view I guess but the hustle & bustle drives you crazy... skip the queue tickets still take ages due to security. Go early am or risk long delays.

title: Mala gestión,como todo en Roma
text:
No se puede dudar de la majestuosidad y la historia que este monumento arrastra,pero como casi todos los grandes lugares visitables de Roma,lo que más brilla es la mala gestión de todo.
Las cientos de agencias que ofrecen tours,la masificación,la suciedad que rodea a todo el monumento.....
Nosotros habíamos contratado con una agencia simplemente el acceso al Coliseo.Las que te ofrecen “skip the line “.....pués el skip the line supuso una hora y media de cola porque todo el mundo ofrece eso....así que para nada te evitas las colas.El control de seguridad....absurdo....todo el mundo pitaba al pasar,así que todo el mundo tiene que volver a pasar y te hacen hacerlo con los brazos cruzados por encima de la cabeza...perdón por lo que voy a decir pero parecíamos todos gilipollas.
Y luego dentro pués más masificación y más suciedad.
Una pena y todo gracias a una pésima gestión.
Me gustaría saber a donde va tanta tasa turística que te cobran aparte de lo que te cobran por acceder a estos sitios.

title: Comme en phogo
text: Ça ressemble beaucoup aux photos, mais c’est bondé de touristes ! 3 heures pour avoir un billet.. je ne suis pas rentrée

title: "deluso"
text:
Il colosseo è molto bello ed è un simbolo di roma. L'unica pecca è che è pieno di venditori ambulanti di acqua con ghiaccio.
Inoltre son furbi perchè una persona ci voleva far pagare €35 un'altra €30, un'altra ancora €25!!!! Però quelli erano venditori di biglietti "illegali". È molto disorganizzato :
C'è una fila di un'ora e mezza per chi non paga, un'altra per chi ha i biglietti da casa un'altra per chi fa i biglietti lí. La cosa inammissibile è che io che pago devo fare la fila!!
La nostra guida era frettolosa e diceva cose in romano!! Noi che siamo sardi non abbiamo capito niente!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
L'unica cosa bella è stato il colosseo

title: Splendeur passée
text:
Mais des ruines aujourd'hui!
Un gros tas de briques que les archéologues essayent de préserver. 
A vous de voir.

title: Ticket touts!!!
text:
The colosseum is literally right outside of the metro station and it took my breath away! 
What a wonderful site.
However you cannot move more than 5 steps without having a ticket tout in your face, or someone trying to sell you water, an umbrella, a hat etc etc.
This is stressful when you are also trying to navigate the huge crowds in 37 degree heat, while trying desperately to hold onto small children.

title: Ylibuukattua
text: Hieno kohde, mutta helteessä kesällä aivan mahdoton. Liput pitää varata ajoissa. Kaikenmaailman yrittäjiä ja huijareita pitää varoa.

title: הקולסאום - היזהרו
text:
הקולוסאום הא אתר היסטורי וממש פלא הנדסי לתקופתו, כל מי שניכנס לתוך המבנה הענק מרגיש מייד כמה הוא מגמד את כל הניכנסים אליו
הבעיה היא בכניסה חקולסאום, ימנם תורים מאוד ארוכים לרכישת כרטיסים וכניסה ובמקות נמצאות חברות רבות של מאכרים המציעות סיור מודרך תמורת תשלום גבוה
אם החלטתם בכל זאת לקחת סייור מודרך בידקו מחירים ועימדו על המקח!! אל תתנו למאכרים להלחיץ אתכם שהסיור מתחיל מייד או כל תירוץ אחר
יש מה ליראות והמקום מעניין מאוד ביחוד אם אתם חובבי היסטוריה

title: Worst tour guide ever
text: The colosseum was awesome.  Tour guide the worst.  Bruno.Think of your worst social studies teacher in Junior High school.

title: Intimidating
text: When me and my sister (both aged 20) visited Rome, the historical sites were beautiful and fantastic, but we found that the men were rather intimidating and forward with their sexual harassment. I rather disliked the wolf whistling and sinister whispering of “beautiful” or “ciao Bella” as we walked past, and I felt quite unsafe at times. Particularly the men flogging African bracelets would approach us and put the bracelets on our wrists without asking, saying they were free, then proceeding to ask us for money for the things we had not asked for, even holding onto my sister’s arm until we handed over €15. I would recommend travelling with a male companion if you can, but if that is not possible, always say that you’re married or in a relationship, even if this isn’t true, to try and avoid any dangerous situations.

title: Very interesting - but way too many people - takes a long time.
text:
We arrived at 0900 and stood in line 2 hours and 10 minutes by the time we got our tickets and audioguides.  Many "agents" were selling "skip the line" packages and tours for double and triple the price, but if you didn't get in those lines early you had about the same experience we did.  
The audioguides were good and very understandable.
Be careful of the temperatures and sun.  There is a handicapped elevator but everything else requires a lot of stair climbing.  Long lines for the womens' toilets.

title: Precioso pero mucha cola
text: El sitio es precioso, y si vas con guía y a demás te van contando la historia de los gladiadores y demás, todavía te gusta más. Pero la organización es malísima, nosotros tuvimos suerte y fuimos pronto por la mañana y solo tuvimos que esperar una hora y poco de cola y a la sombra...que eso fue toda una ventaja, pero los controles de seguridad son pesadisimos, y no tienen ningún sentido, como en los aeropuertos tienes que pasar tus pertenencias por el control, pero no entiendo que tengan tan pocas maquinas y tan poco personal gestionando la entrada. Cada día pasan miles por este monumento, deberían de buscar la manera de agilizar el tema.

title: Hemos perdido el día en una excursión absurda corriendo de un lado para otro y sin sentido. Mala no, malísima
text:
Una perdida de tiempo. El que mucho abarca, poco aprieta.
Tanto quieren vender para atraer a más gente que al final poco y mal es lo que dan. No lo recomendaré a nadie. Un autobús turístico les da mil vueltas. 
Es mi opinión y la de los que estaban a mí alrededor, aunque supongo que habrá gente encantada.
Por cierto te hacen pasar por tienda de souvenirs, "obligatoriamente" y dejan el mínimo tiempo para comer para que la gente no pueda buscar y así la mayoría elija el restaurante que ellos te "aconsejan".
Te llevan al Vaticano, pero  segun ellos la parada no es suficiente para esperar la cola, por lo que si quieres verlo, te venden unas entradas guiadas por 22 €, si no no pasas, porque según ellos hay más colas que tiempo de parada.
La pena no es el dinero, ya que la excursión no es cara, pero la verdad es que el día no lo recuperamos y es una lastima ya que en un crucero el tiempo es oro
Desde luego, nunca más con esta empresa.

title: Seen it once
text:
Rip off Rome at its best . Massive queues to get in ,€12 not to bad but we thought we would like to experience it at night . Boy were we surprised €99 for a night tour which is robbery. 
I would recommend going over a public holiday where entrance is free to most places . 
We got there early in the morning and was shocked to find people hounding customers in the queue for €15 to skip the line to a free event . It was good to see but i will never go back to dirty Italy again !

title: Moet je wel gezien hebben
text: Vooraf tickets gekocht, wat super makkelijk is. Als je opgegeven tijd er is, loop je zo langs de wachtrij . Veel opdringerige verkopers die maar blijven zeuren dat ze je zo naar binnen loodsen. Coloseum zelf ,veel in de steigers. Is natuurlijk een bijzondere historie, maar had er meer van verwacht. Wordt onder de voet gelopen door de tourguide's..

title: Roma. Ban plastic water bottles!
text: We have been looking forward to this trip for years only to find Roma don't pick up rubbish around their most visited sites. So disappointing to see so many staff standing around doing nothing when there were mountains of rubbish around them. Seriously what is wrong with this world. Do you hate it that much you can't pick up a bottle or two. Not ever coming back to filthy Roma!

title: Colosseum is amazing but Roma pass not worthy
text: Staff say different things. You go to the infopoint asking info. They tell you to reserve. You go to reserve. They tell you come back tomorrow and no need to reserve. You come back the next day and they tell you, you need to reserve. Not so organised system! We were passed from one station to another, and one queue to another. 🤦🏽‍♀️ Time’s wasted even after we organised everything well.

title: visita al Coliseo
text: Emocionante estar allí. No me pareciño buena la señalización para el audio-guía. No se entendía a qué se refería el audio. NO había números que coincidieran con el audio con lo cual decidi no escucharlo. Faltan indicaciones para entender el cicuito y como acceder a los distinto niveles, incluso la salida. Compre entradas por la web pero igua, tuve casi una hora en la cola. Mal indicado donde eran las colas. Muy desorganizado

title: Book tickets before your trip
text:
We missed out on this tour b/c we did not plan far enough ahead. Get your tickets before you leave. Last week we were there and could not get tix night before we wanted to go. Also, if you are Canadian know that people there for the most part do no appreciate tourists and let you know it.  We encountered many people who were out right rude from train staff to air B and B to vendors and people on trains as well. My teen daughter was pick pocketed, shoved and told to F off more than once  and good luck finding anyone at train italia to give you service they brush you off and the tickets have no info about platforms or where to get the trains and there are next to no staff to provide service. We regularly encountered people trying to rip us off from restaurants putting tap water into a bottle that said mineral water to taxi to train staff looking to line their own wallets...it was constant. 
As Canadians we are accustomed to people being courteous and respectful and honest. I've never been anywhere else in the world where I've encountered so many people who are rude and inconsiderate. We might just have had bad luck but I would not go back to Italy and we toured it top to bottom.

title: Trop de monde
text:
Un conseil : acheter le pass super qui donne accès au Forum, au Mont Palatin, à la maison d’Auguste et qui surtout vous évite des longues heures de queue au Colisée . 
Gratuit pour les moins de 18 ans et tarif très réduit pour les 18-25 ans .

title: decepção
text:
um dos lugares mais feios e mal cuidados que já fui na vida. 
Um desperdício entrar, pois o ingresso é caro, as filas são gigantescas (mesmo com ingressos comprados antes), e o staff é super desrespeitoso. 
Se quer ir, vá na porta, veja por fora, tire uma fotinha, e vá embora!

title: Nice day out
text: Unfortunately it was so hot on the day we went we queued for one and a half hours which wasn’t pleasant buying bottles of water for €2 each in the hot sun just to let you know they don’t allow any glass to be taken in at all. It’s the security that holds everyone up.  The gift shop is a bit pants. You will take some good pictures tho.

title: Не впечатлил
text: Ожидали увидеть большего. Вечная стройка, жара, толпы туристов. Дух не захватывало. Пантеону тоже не одна тысяча лет, однако его посещение доставило гораздо больше удовольствия. А здесь не было такого же ощущения как в Египте в Луксоре или при подходе к Петра в Иордании.

title: Çocukla zor!temmuzda ekstra zor!
text: Valla 40 derece sıcakta tepenizde güneşle dolaşmak çok akıllıca değil,mahşeri bir kalabalık , feci bir sıra , açıkcası pek bir şey anlamadık.

title: Sobre estimado
text: Muy sinceramente siento que hay que verlo, pero no es la gran cosa. Estoy de acuerdo que encierra legendarias historias, pero a mi parecer, no tiene nada que le quite el aliento a quien lo visite.

title: Buy your tickets online!!
text: Must do activity of Rome and it was very impressive, all of the information is presented well and the audio guide is accurate which is good. My recommendation is buy online prior to arriving, we waited in line for an hour and that was getting there at 8.35am. the organisation inside was a bit hap hazard with the security, ticketing and then separate audio guide handout. But still an interesting place to visit

title: 略為失望的朝聖之旅
text: 羅馬競技場一向都是眾旅遊者的必到地方，我們透過Coopculture這官方網站訂了從3樓或2樓觀看的旅遊團，到了競技場才得知該地方正在修建，整個導賞團也取消了。有關人員說通知電郵一早已經發出，但我們收不到任何通知，結果是自由參觀和部份退款。競技場內外的可觀性依然是10分高，但管理競技場的團隊他不是10分專業，成了一個小遺憾。希望有關方面盡快完成退款。

title: Güzel sayılır
text: Çok sıra bekliyorsunuz ve güvenlik çok kaba. Ayrıca restore çalışmaları başlamış. Bence orjinal hali kalmalıydı.

title: Pay for express entrance
text: Find a ticket office all over Rome and get express entry. You could pay for express entry at the colleagues however it will be more expensive. There are also a lot of sellers trying to push merchandise on you. Try bring your own water as the water that is sold to you there by the street sellers are reused and refilled.

title: Too crowded
text: It is beautiful monument but the lines are enormous definitely buy tickets online before visit. Should be better organized.

title: Very hot day, boring to see.
text: The colosseum was boring for me. My tour guide was monotone and it was so hot I started falling asleep.

title: Luna sul colosseo
text:
Bene la visita guidata, anche se mi  sembra un po caro: 25 € a persona.
Male l'organizzazione sul posto: nessun cartello indica l'ingresso. In internet dicono di presentarsi 1/2 ora prima della visita prenotata. Sul posto  dicono che basta 5 minuti prima. Poi avevo stampato il mio biglietto a casa:  non basta. Bisogna cambiarlo sul posto - facendo un altra fila. Ma è possibile???  NOn potete fare in modo che si entra con il biglietto stampato a casa?

title: À ne pas refaire
text:
À voir peut-être une fois ...
Intéressant mais sans plus.
Dans une ville comme Rome, beaucoup peut être fait avec moins d’attente.

title: visita turística
text:
El coliseo es una visita imprescindible en Roma, es espectacular. 
La pega son la gran cantidad de colas que hay que hacer aún teniendo el Roma Pass que se supone te acorta los tiempos.

title: Better in the expectation then in the reality
text:
Disabled beware, huge crowds, lots of information staff giving you differing places to go ( all but 1 wrong btw) 
Queues for the lift and when up you have issues seeing anything

title: الكولوسيوم حلبة المقاتلين التاريخية في روما
text:
ـ هو من أشهر معالم العالم وليس إيطاليا فحسب حلبة قتال المصارعين أو المقاتلين الكولوسيوم
ـ المدرج الروماني الشهير ويعود للقرن الأول الميلادي مبنى ضخم حلبة لقتال المصارعين 
ـ يقع في وسط مدينة روما في ميدان أو ساحة الكولوسيوم يمكن الوصل له بكافة وسائل النقل 
ـ يفتح الكولوسيوم العجيب عادة من الساعة 8:30 صباحاُ إلى الساعة 7:00 مساءً وغالباً مزدحم
ـ الحجز كان عن طريق الإنترنت ضمن قروب سياحي حتى أتجنب الزحام ويكون لك مرشد للمعلومات
ـ توجهت في اليوم المحدد لمكتب الحجوزات أعلى الكولوسيوم وبعد تجمع القروب تم التوجه للمكان
ـ تم توزيع علينا سماعات وجهاز باللغة الإنجليزية لسماع المرشد حيث يشرح لنا المعلومات عن الكولوسيوم
ـ توجهنا للمكان وكان المرشد يحمل علم وتم توزيع علينا ملصقات نلصقها وهي لتحديد أفراد القروب
ـ المبنى ضخم وكبير وتراه من مسافة بعيدة شكله دائري في فتحات كبيرة مكشوف من الأعلى 
ـ عند البوابه تعطلنا قليلاُ لجلب التذاكر للمرشد حتى دخلنا وعند الدخول كان هناك نقطة تفتيش 
ـ بمجرد الدخول تجولنا في الطابق الأرضي حيث إطلعنا على المبنى وحجاراته وبعض التماثيل
ـ المرشد السياحي كان يشرح كافة المعلومات عن المدرج العجيب ثم صعدنا بسلالم إلى الأعلى
ـ فوجدنا متحف للكولوسيوم يضم مجسمات وتحف وتماثيل ورسومات وآثار يشرحها المرشد السياحي
ـ الصعود بالسلالم ليس أمر بسيط متعب قليلاً ويحتاج لقوة وحذر للوصول إلى المكان المطلوب
ـ المكان مزدحم بتفاوت الناس بعض الأماكن شديدة الإزدحام وبعضها جيد لكن عليك بمسايرة المرشد
ـ خلال التجول تصور وتلتقط أجمل الصور لهذا المبنى الجميل القديم التاريخي ومن كل الزوايا والجهات
ـ بعد الإنتهاء من المتحف في الأعلى تنزل وتتجول في جميع جهات الكولوسيوم وتنظر للمناظر الجميله
ـ المكان مكشوف في غالبه يجب مراعاة عوامل الجو الحر وشدة الشمس أو الأمطار وغيره من الأمور
ـ بعد الإنتهاء من الجولة الداخلية في الكولوسيوم تسلم الجهاز للمرشد وتخرج للخارج وفق رغبتك 
ـ في الخارج تجد باعه متجولين لبيع الأطعمه والماء والهدايا التذكاريه وتشاهد عروض وفنانين أيضاُ
ـ في الساحة الخارجية للكولوسيوم تلتقط صور جميلة للمبنى وما حوله من آثار ومعالم تاريخية جميلة
ـ عموماً الذهاب لداخل الكولوسيوم قد يكون ممل بعض الشي للأطفال وإحرص لا تتركهم وتنشغل بالتصوير
ـ الذهاب لساحة الكولوسيوم والإكتفاء بالتصوير من الخارج وعدم الدخول أجده أفضل من وجهة نظري

title: Coliseum
text:
We had made “skip the line” reservations before we went. 
I was so disappointed! The crowds were still immense and everyone had “skip the line” tickets. It was HOT, crowded and a waste of time. Poorly organized. Lots of poor people hawking cheap souvenirs, water, promising they could be your personal tour guide. It was enough to see it from outside and listen to my “Rick Steves” audio tape on the Coluseum.

title: Always an iconic place to visit BUT....
text:
I’ve been to the Colosseum many times over the years- as a teen, in College, with my husband and with kids. Over the years I have seen crowds increase drastically to a point where the experience become less memorable- or at least less memorable for the right reasons. Crowds are crazy large, especially in season, and lines are long. Many tour groups come to visit the Colosseum and crowd the plaza in front. 
Having said that, the Colosseum is still fascinating. The views in the early morning hours before the crowds arrive or late in the evening when tourists leave are spectacular. 
Entering the Colosseum is a bucket list item, but if you can, try to go off season to minimize crowds.

title: Not worth the 2 hour queue
text: My girlfriend and I arrived at around 12 midday and were immediately hounded by tour guides who persistently asked if we had tickets and wanted to “skip the line” for €30 or so euros each. If it’s your first time you’d think they work for the Colosseum because they all have “staff” written on their shirts and vests but do not be fooled. They only want your money. It’s actually a Guided Tour and not a fast track, there is no such thing as “skip the line”. They claim you can join the tour and then once you are in you can leave the tour but in actual fact you cannot. We decided to do our own thing and wait in the line in the blistering 37 degree heat for 2 hours. Yes it was exactly 2 hours. While in the queue the same guides will ask you if you still want to skip the line because they clearly have amnesia and forget they’ve spoken to you. We spent just over an hour in the Colosseum before leaving as we saw everything. There isn’t much to see other than the inside of the colosseum (only 2 floors) and some of the sculptures and models. If you are considering it this summer please bring lots of water and sun cream as there is no escaping the heat. People will try and sell you water but it doesn’t last and there is a fountain inside but there was a long queue to fill up. All in all it was a good experience for a few pictures and to learn something new but not at this time of year in the heat.

title: Un coliseo en decadencia
text:
Desde fuera resulta imponente y sera la mejor foto y el mejor recuerdo.
Mucha obra, mucha suciedad vieja, mucha gente pocos servicios para ser verano y falta sombra en los accesos.
Ponganse a trabajar en brindar mejor servicio  al turista que los financia.

title: Lugar impactante, organización deja que desear
text:
El lugar es impactante por donde se lo mire, su majestuosidad, la arquitectura, su historia.

La organización? Un desastre... Poco ayuda para disfrutar del lugar... para colmo, tuve que sacrificar mi Victorinox..., por error la dejé en mi mochila y salió en el escáner, un guardia a los gritos (innecesariamente) diciendo que la tire o salga, ya que no hay ningún lugar donde dejar pertenencias (el ingreso al Coliseo está limitado a 3000 personas en el interior, digamos que un 10% necesite dejar algo..., 300 casilleros?, no es mucho no?)..., obviamente que el cartel estaba junto al escáner, no al inicio de la cola... 
Compramos la audioguia, solo 6 puntos de interés, nada más que 6 puntos??! 
Ya en el Foro Romano (lo comento acá porque la entrada es la misma) en el templo de Rómulo, la entrada estaba dividida en dos y un grupo de personas detenido en uno, pensamos que era un grupo o tour así que entramos por el otro lado..., de muy mala manera nos dijeron que esa era la cola y que entrábamos por la salida..., tanto cuestan tres carteles? Uno que diga entrada, otro salida, y otro espere su turno en la fila? Si es mucho, con los dos primeros sería suficiente...

title: Mucho que desear
text:
Aunque es cierto que es un atractivo con arquitectura e historia increíble, no fue para nada lo que esperaba.

Al llegar compramos los boletos con una mujer que vendía las entradas junto con un recorrido al coliseo, palacio palatino y foro romano. No valió para nada lo que costaba, puesto que el guía que nos asignaron para el recorrido del Coliseo no explicó absolutamente nada relevante, estuvo comiendo durante todo el recorrido y escupía su basura... 

Mientras dábamos el recorrido comenzó a llover y después a granizar, lo que también impidió el poder apreciarlo bien, pero las cuestiones climatológicas jamás se controlan. En cuanto al Coliseo en sí, no me agradó que la mayor parte estuviera cubierta, desconozco si estaba en restauración o algo así. Es un atractivo increíblemente bello, pero me quedé con una mala experiencia esta vez debido al recorrido que no debí haber pagado...

Recomendación: elijan bien a su guía.

title: Recorrido regular
text:
La visita guiada que nos ofrecieron dejó mucho que desear, el guía se la pasaba gritando “family” para poder identificar al grupo, además hacía comentarios sobre el lugar poco relevantes, y su manera de justificarlo era que “no era un recorrido comercial donde te mostraban lo que todo el mundo sabe”. Se me hizo de mal gusto que estuviera comiendo mientras hablaba y explicaba. Pero eso si, era muy amable y saludaba a todas las personas que veía, hablaba en muchos idiomas. Por lo mismo era difícil seguirle el hilo de lo que contaba, mezclaba muchas palabras en idiomas distintos y su dicción era muy inaudible. En general aprendí muy poco del lugar pero lo disfruté. 
Tip: para una buena foto panorámica del coliseo recomiendo tomarla desde el Templo de Venus en el Foro Romano.

title: 壮大な歴史を感じる遺産
text:
巨大な建造物は圧倒的！
外観だけではなく中に入りローマの遺跡を感じることができる。
入場予約が無いと長蛇の列に並ぶことになります。

title: "Esperas eternas"
text: El coliseo es uno de los principales puntos turísticos que uno tiene que ir a ver si va a Roma, debido a su belleza de infraestructura y lleno de historia, sin embargo tenga ¡cuidado con los tours! que se encuentran a fueras del lugar, debido a que tienen mala organización y te pueden llegar a cobrar dos veces sin que te des cuenta. Tristemente me di cuenta al regresar a mi país y ver el cargo dos veces. Le aconsejo que elija un buen guía, debido a que iba con mis compañeros de clase y más personas, el guía no se esforzaba en explicar la historia, se entretenía fácilmente con las demás personas. A pesar de que te venden el tour sin hacer fila, es imposible, la fila es inevitable y la organización dentro del coliseo es un desastre. Les sugiero visitar el coliseo en tiempo aproximado de 3 horas.

title: 3000 maximum tourist limit so hard to skip the line in the peak season
text: Our family booked the skip the line tickets but were shocked of how many people were there who were supposed to "skip the line" as well. The Colosseum was packed of tourists from all over the world, in the hot June summer afternoon, we were holding the skip line tickets but still waited for more than one hour, then our kids collapsed we can't join the tour anymore. The tour guide just told us to follow him because it's out of his control of queue. Later when we try to join the 2nd part of the tour, we lost of the group when transferred to the 2nd venue, as there were just too many people and too many groups so we wasted half year and wasted money but get nothing, just sun burnt and sickness. I hope the tour operator could let people know there are 3000 people limit so you can't always skip the line as we been told.

title: לחובבי הסטוריה
text: יש המון הסטוריה במקום ,ביחד עם הקולוסיאום ניתן לבקר גם בגבעת פלאטין ובפורום. היינו במזג אוויר חם במיוחד שהקשה על הטיול,מומלץ להגיע לאזור במזג אוויר נוח

title: Colas interminables
text:
Nosotros compramos la Roma Card 48 h. No sirve para nada. Nosotros nos presentamos allí y resulta que no puedes entrar sin hacer una reserva online.
Por otro lado, las vistas desde fuera muy bonitas

title: Wat een super irritante “skip the line” mensen
text:
Wij laatste dag naar Colosseum. 100m ervoor al die irritante verkopers om in groepen erin te gaan. Denk 50 die het vragen en maar door blijven zeuren. We gingen in de kaarten rij staan en die word gewoon vast gezet zodat je bijna naar zo een irritant persoon gaat. Stonden half uur en niks vooruit. We zijn er weg gegaan. Jammer maar helaas. Als ze zo klanten moeten trekken voor een begeleidende toer. Dan maar een rondje erom heen wat ook mooi is. 
Maar moet je erheen? Ja. Maar erin? Ik weet het niet. Door die irritante mensen wil je er snel weg.

title: Coliseo Romano
text: Es visita obligada si se visita por primera vez, pero en lo personal no me gustó. En mi visita, nos agarró la lluvia con granizo lo cual hizo que el recorrido fuera algo incómodo. No pagaría por visitarlo una segunda vez.

title: COLISEO
text: No tuve una buena experiencia en el atractivo debido al cambio climático, nos llovió y granizó a los 20 minutos de haber llegado al recorrido el cual lo tuvimos que interrumpir, nuestro guía de turista no fue nada agradable se la pasaba gritando y su manera de hablar no era nada entendible. Si visitas el atractivo por primera vez si recomiendo pagarlo para vivir la experiencia sin embargo yo no volvería a pagar para entrar una segunda vez.

title: Semester
text: Fantastiskt! Ett ställe att besöka under vistelse i Rom. Se och hör historiens vingslag, njut av stadens puls, samtidigt med njutningen av semesterlugnets sköna inverkan!

title: Filas, filas e filas
text: Atração obrigatória mas as filas são intermináveis. Os arredores são cheios de imigrantes e eles podem ser muito perigosos. Cuidado.Lá dentro é seguro e muito interessante. Não vá no fim do dia, não dá tempo de ver tudo.

title: Essential but hectic
text:
As you would expect with one of the main attractions in Rome, it’s extremely hectic.  Definitely book in advance, we used our Roma passes and had skip the line, which saved lots of time and queueing in the sun.  There are lots of officials around to direct you and they are really helpful. Beware of pickpockets, we had 2 near misses and were being vigilant. Lock your bags. 
There is water available to fill up your drink bottles from public taps.

title: Más bonito por fuera que por dentro.
text: Sinceramente veo más bonito el Coliseo por fuera que por dentro.... la verdad que te llevas un poco una desilusión... pero bueno hay que visitarlo. Para ser un monumento tan visitado y lo que cuesta la entrada deberían estar mejor cuidado y limpio sus alrededores...

title: ATTENTION A TICKETBAR
text:
Quand vous êtes sur le site du Colisée et que vous voulez réserver des places c'est TICKETBAR qui est proposé. Il propose des dates et des horaires qui n'existent pas mais encaisse bien la totalité de votre achat. Il vous propose de payer 7€ de plus par personne pour pouvoir avoir l'horaire de votre choix, ce sont des menteurs et des voleurs, à éviter et à fuir absolument. Nous attendons le remboursement avec inquiétude.
TICKETBAR donne une image déplorable du Colisée, de Rome, il devrait être plus contrôle. Quel dommage d'arnaquer les gens qui souhaitent visiter cette belle ville de Rome.

title: Beaucoup de monde, peu d'immersion
text: J'ai eu beaucoup de mal à m'immerger dans ce que devait être le Colisée à l'antiquité, la faute au manque d'information peut-être, ou à la foule trop nombreuse. Une partie exposition sympa, mais en-dehors de ça, un peu déçu par la "vue" intérieure. Je crois que la vue extérieure m'aurait même suffi...

title: Een tegenvaller
text: Na het lange wachten binnengeraakt in het Colosseum. Maar eigenlijk viel dit tegen. Een derde van de muren stond in de steigers en het middenplein stond ook vol met stellingen. Je betaalt veel inkomgeld voor wat je maar te zien krijgt.

title: A pillaged monument...
text: I bought the guided tour for the coliseum, the roman forum and the Palantino. The guided tour was not worth it, in my opinion the skip the line ticket is enough. The coliseum is a big building but in ruins, its great to be inside and imagine how it was on its glory days but other than that i dont see any other reason to visit. I prefer the roman forum and the palantino visit, all ruins but with much more to see. I was on the coliseum 45 minutes and it was too much. If you are wondering why i used pillaged is because after the earth quake that destroyed a big part of the coliseum the marble was all stollen  to other buildings like the saint peters basilica, thats the reason of all those holes on the coliseum..

title: Colosseum Tour
text: The Colosseum is pretty amazing.  The history and age of the structure is unreal.  We took a 3rd party tour which was really good.  We were there on a unseasonably hot early June day.  The place is SUPER busy.  People EVERYWHERE.  Everywhere you walk outside there are people try to sell you stuff and they don’t take no for an answer.  I would think with security issues and crowd control the group that runs the Colosseum would be more thorough and organized for the mass of people.

title: Attente interminable ...
text: Le monument est magnifique mais il mériterait quelques panneaux explicatifs. L’énorme point noir est l’absence d’information quant à la procédure pour y rentrer. 1h de queue à la caisse des forums romains pour penser un billet cumulatif puis à nouveau plus d’une heure d’attente au Colisée alors que nous avions ce billet ça fait beaucoup.

title: Okay
text: It was okay. Just a bunch of rocks and people. Not very much to see unless you really like history i guess

title: Estafa!!!
text: Saque las entradas online a través de COP Culture donde pone que la entrada es válida para dos días consecutivos, cuál es mi sorpresa que al llegar el día después de la fecha indicada me dicen que no es válido y que sólo es válido dos días para El Palatino-Foro Romano. Deberían especificar ese dato en las entradas me sentí un poco estafada. Por lo demás todo bien, tened en cuenta ese dato

title: Colosseum
text: The Colosseum is under repair and renovation which made it difficult to see some of the features.  It was also very crowded.

title: Visita Guiada
text: Contratamos un tour en español de Tours About del Coliseo, el Palatino y el Foro por medio de HeadoutApp. Los lugares son impresionantes y es una parada obligatoria si uno esta en Roma pero no recomendaría hacerlo con Tours About ya que la guía hablaba muy mal en español y fue poco clara, sinceramente eramos 4 personas y  a ninguno de los 4 le quedo ni el 75% de la información ya que no se le entendía y ademas no lo hacia interesante.

title: Not that fantastic
text:
Must see? Not really. Better invest your time in having good food in a nice restaurant.
15 Minutes waiting if you have online tickets.

title: Katastrophe
text: Schlechte Organsation, pampige Touristen, ewige Wartezeiten- und das alles für so gut wie nichts. Von außen ist das Colosseum schöner als von innen und das Gerangel vor dem Eingang erinnert an die Gladiatorenkämpfe. Kein Ort mit Kindern, kein Ort im Juni, kein Ort für Rom- Liebhaber. Nur im April oder Oktober wird´s besser. Ansonsten ein echter Horror.

title: Imponerende arkitektur.
text: Ventet i cirka 25min på å kjøpe billetter, og det var én time før stengetid. Godt skiltet og selvsagt et imponerende syn!

title: Trångt
text: Området var helt anpassat för turister. Om du vill se något måste du betala. Området var även avspärrat med ett fult staket som förstörde hela bilden.

title: Più bello fuori che dentro!
text: Abbiamo fatto una lunghissima fila per poter entrare, ma all'interno abbiamo avuto tutti la stessa sensazione di delusione: ce lo aspettavamo più grande, o più curato nelle spiegazioni. Non abbiamo potuto visitare l'arena perché i biglietti erano esauriti e in parte le impalcature dei lavori hanno un po' rovinato l'effetto atteso.

title: schlechte dukumentation
text: leider gibt es keinerlei erläuterungen im colosseum. man ist auf audio guide oder führung angewiesen. bilder wie es mal war gibt es nicht, oder schautafeln.

title: Mixed Feelings
text: When you travel half way around the world, you feel like you need to make sure you see the Colosseum.  We took the underground tour thinking it would be a great small group tour.  Honestly, our tour guide, Amid< was great but when we got to the Colosseum, their tour guide had to take over.  It was 100 degrees (38c) and it was extremely crowded.  The Colosseum guide was so slow and repeated herself so many times, we almost left the tour.  She could have finished her tour in half the time.  That would have given us more time in the other stops.  If you really want to see the Colosseum, I suggest downloading a walking tour and doing it yourself.  You can decide how much time and you can direct yourself away from the crowds.  Also, the people outside the attraction need to be tamed.  They harass everyone who is trying to get into the complex.

title: Ugh...no one told us
text: They have a new system that even if you have the Roma passes you have to make a reservation.  So we had to stand in that line for 1.5-2 hrs in the hot sun.  So it turned into a very long hot day.  Once we were inside it was okay, but we were so unprepared for the extra time without water, food, bathrooms that we all felt yucky and weren't able to really appreciate what we were looking at.

title: Very very busy
text: I toured the colosseum over tenYears ago.  You are required to go through a metal detector and it was very crowded. We had our own tour guide for thirty of us.  Bring your own water..they sell it for two euros a bottle but it was icy cold.

title: Ancient "Zoo"
text: Being in Rome for the first time I had to see the Colosseum, but it was a zoo. A bazillion people and blistering temperatures made the experience much less enjoyable than I would have hoped. Next time, if there is, I'll come in the off season.

title: Disastro
text:
Il monumento più importante d’Italia 
Disorganizzazione totale 
Sporcizia 
Brutte recinzioni buttate dappertutto a caso
Biglietteria completamente caotica dopo la sicurezza
Imbarazzante

title: Hot and disappointing
text: EVERYONE had skip the line tickets,  so that's excited in the very hot sun... no shade to be had . Ok, it's dramatic, huge, impressive etc.,  but the audio tour is not worth the money. The large tour groups make it difficult for those not in groups to move around. Limited access to the structure was frustrating. Of course you have to go, but be prepared for limited pleasure.

title: Overrun
text: The area around the Colosseum is completely overrun with people selling you tours, souvenirs and God knows what else, and they are in your face constantly. Construction in the area has only made it worse. Plan on walking by, take a few pictures, and keep moving.

title: Une file interminable
text: Nous avons fait 2h30 de queue sous un soleil de plomb, puis rentré avec près d'une heure de retard par rapport à l'horaire indiqué. Mauvaise organisation du staff, pas de possibilité d'attente à l'ombre, difficile pour les parents avec enfants. Même avec les billets coupe fil, attente pour la sécurité à l'entrée qui gâche toute la journée et la visite du colisée.

title: Rome in summer
text:
Very nice to see such place ,  war , history and  gladiators .
Problem was too difficult to obtain an access even with fast track ticket .
Dont trust the offices outside .

title: This is a circus.
text:
I bought tickets online ahead of time for my family of 12 adults and 3 infants.  I paid for tickets for the infants at the 18-25 rate so that I wouldn't have to stand in line to show the infants to the ticket counter for free infant tickets.
It didn't help that it was 34C / 94F that day, but when I stood in line in the sun to collect my tickets, the agent wouldn't release the 3 infant tickets without seeing the infants.  So I had to leave the line and go get the babies.  Took an extra 45 minutes.
The exterior area of the Colosseum is a zoo.  Hustlers, street vendors, hordes of tourists and long lines...combine that with virtually no shade and high temperatures, and you have a destination with little enjoyment.  
While I appreciated the historic value of the Colosseum, I did not enjoy the visit and will likely never return unless it is during winter.
I enjoyed the walk through the Forum much more.   
The Colosseum is not a destination to which you want to take infants during summer.

title: Wonderful but ruined
text: This is my second trip to the Colosseum and I can't help but be wowed by it. The thing that ruins it though, along with every tourist spot in Rome are the people trying to sell you fast track tickets, water, hats and the worst of them all.. the guys who trick you into putting your hand out for them to slap a bracket on it. I had already bought my tickets online and was hoping for a stress free day but found myself getting really frustrated and angry with the constant questions and offerings whilst we waited 45minutes for our allocated time slot. So much so I almost walked away from the place being so put off by the people around me. Even though i decided to stay and went in, it was only a quick walk around it and then I left feeling annoyed from the constant badgering. After we left more badgering came our way from a guy trying to sell fast track tickets and then we had a bunch of African men jump from a wall trying to ask us where we were from and as we carried on walking 2 of them followed us with one man grabbing my partner's arm. This sort of thing massively ruins Rome. It's such a shame because it's such a beautiful place with such amazing history and it is just being ruined by this activity that goes on around these tourist hotspots.

title: Bien mais un peu deceptif
text: Le monument est magnifique, autant de l’extérieur que de l’intérieur. Nous avions des billets achetés en avance et n’avons donc pas trop attendu. Un peu déçus cependant du manque de signalétique (nous n’avons pas trouvé l’accès au dernier étage) et d’y a partie sur les gladiateurs et/ou le fonctionnement des combats (ou alors nous ne l’avons pas trouvée..).

title: Programa de índio 1!!!
text:
Uma completa falta de respeito aos turistas!!! Uma obra prima que ultrapassa os séculos repleto de história e cultura cujo acesso e visita ultrapassa qualquer nível de resistência e paciência!!! Apesar de ter comprado os ingressos com antecedência pelo site, no chamado fura fila, tive de esperar para entrar por mais de uma hora ao sol de 31 graus. Não há informações claras ou  sinalização adequada no local, e os funcionários do Coliseu apenas controlam as entradas e a triagem através dos turistas através do detector de metais. Não existe nenhum tipo de abrigo ou cobertura para as pessoas que estão na fila, não observei preferência à entrada para idosos ou crianças pequenas de colo, na verdade é um passeio que não recomendado para os mesmos pois é necessário subir inúmeros degraus. Os guias que conduzem os grupos geram grande confusão e muitas vezes se aglomeram à frente das obras impedindo a visualização daqueles que não fazem do mesmo grupo.
Levem água, guarda-sol, um lanchinho e muita paciência.

title: Decepção
text: Compramos na porta do Coliseu um combo de tour guiado com agência oficial para Coliseu e Paladino/Foro Romano, cuja responsavel é Angela, mas caímos em um golpe!! Nos foi dito q primeiro fariamos o Paladino e Foro Romano, mas só fizemos o Foro Romano, muito corrido(1h) e não fizemos Palladino, sob pretexto de que "perderiamos  o horário do Coliseu"... mas o pior estava por vir... Fomos obrigados a encarar longa fila, pois não havia "fura-fila", como prometido e o "tour guiado" é uma bobagem de 10m. Golpe puro! Melhor comprar no site.

title: Colosseo in restauro
text: Colosseo bello da vedere ma il restauro esterno e la pulizia lasciano a desiderare! Anche L illuminazione non è un granché e la costruzione della nuova linea della metro rovina tutto

title: Colapsado
text: Esperamos mucho tiempo venir a Roma pero está tan abarrotado de gente que no se puede disfrutar, y no solo por los turistas los vendedores ambulantes son una pesadilla que deberían prohibir!! Es terrible como uno no puede ni admirar tranquilo un monumento porque se acercan a cada rato a vender algo y molestan mucho! Además vi a varios tirando basura en las inmediaciones, muy sucio Roma, no quedaron ganas de regresar.

title: Magique
text: Magique de l'extérieur  et bien suffisant!Selon moi inutile de payer pour visite de l'intérieur (ce qu il en reste et travaux en cours),même avec le fameux billet coupe fil, on attend encore et encore.....profitez des differentes faces exterieures de jour comme de nuit et la magie opère.....et c est gratuit.....

title: Scam!!!!
text: We payed 120 Euros for a two part tour. After the first portion of our tour we were instructed to make our way back to the starting point which was about half a mile away to meet with a new guide what we've never meet before. After going on a scavenger hunt looking for this company for over an hour we finally gave up. All they gave us for proof of purchase was a green sticker to put on your shirt that eventually flew off. Good thing i took a picture of it as i was afraid that would happen. This is an absolute scam. Such a beautiful place tarnished by money hungry skum. I will never come back here again. Beware!!!

title: You have to visit but dont expect much
text:
It was part of our rome tour to visit the Colosseum. I recommend going to it with a tour guide because:

1- you will enter fast
2- without the history of the place you will be lost

In summary: let it be a part of other tour but don't expect much.

title: Disappointed visit
text: We were disappointed with our visit to the colosseum, luckily we didn't have to wait in line since we pre booked our tickets because it wasn't worth the wait. The building is impressive from the outside but the inside was in renovation and crowded with tourist. All unavoidable but made our visit disappointing.

title: Absoluter Geheimtipp!
text:
Kennt kaum einer. Ist aber auch ein bisschen kaputt.
Leider waren zu unsererseits die Schlangenfreunde-Rom on Tour, deswegen steht man trotzdem 1,5 Stunden - aber das muss Zufall und Pech gewesen sein.

Wer Staub und Selfiesticks mag - wird das Kolosseum lieben!

title: No es para tanto
text: El audio guía flojo y es algo que tardas 30min como mucho. Esta bueno pero no es algo que te mata. Recomiendo pagar entrada verlo y ver el video que muestran y es suficiente. No paguen de mas.

title: The Colosseum is great but pick your guided tour wiht care. Promise of fast track queue is a swizz
text: The monument is staggering. There are lots of people but nce you get inside not too bad. Some interesting exbits showing how the place looked and was used all that tie ago. HOWEVER, there are plenty of people touting for Jump the Queue Guided Tours but beware. It is not fifteen mins it was more like 30 mins and remember all the while the people who run the budiling itself restrict entry when visitor numbers are deemed unsafe at which point the guides just shrug thier hsoulders and say its beyond thier control. And I have to say our particular guide was crap. We handed in our headphoned guides and went in by ourselves to see around the place. Overall, worth a visit but remember whatever way you pay there will be delays.

title: A bit underwhelming and disappointing
text:
We bought Skip the Line tickets on Head out for €17 each. This didn’t include a tour, perhaps this is where we went wrong..
We arrived at 10:15 and entered the colosseum at 10:55. The wait was for security only.
We spent around an hour here as there really wasn’t much to occupy us.
I can only recall about 3 or 4 information sections on the history of the colosseum. 
There was no public museum of any kind either which is unusual for a point of interest within Europe. It was very crowded and very hot too making it not  pleasurable to walk around .  
The shop was a size of post stamp and really didn’t have many souvenirs .. 
The theatre was also undergoing restoration on the ground floor.. 

I think €17 per person is expensive , at least an Audio guide should be included in the price . 

As for outside the colosseum..the lack of police presence is appalling . 
We were constantly being harassed by ticket street sellers who proceeded to follow and continue to shout at us despite saying “no thank you, we have tickets” 
We were trying to cross the traffic light controlled crossing to be met with about 5 ticket sellers blocking our pathway so we had to dodge and dive to carry onto the entrance . 
I felt sorry for the genuine workers at the colosseum who were trying to organise the crowds but people were just ignoring them because they thought they were street sellers .
The amount of times I heard “ I am not trying to sell you a ticket , I work here” was just ridiculous . 
We were in wrong queue twice as it was pretty chaotic  ! 

I’m bittersweet about the colosseum, I think I’d rather visit in the winter time and take a tour guide .

title: Be careful when you book with Headouts Eome
text: wel. In Rome if you want to skip lies at Colyseum or Musei vaticani you have to be the prey of the zillions of agencies that sell sip the line  tickets.you just have to look for the cheapes. all of them oofer thes ame services.that is a metting point and a transfer to the entries fo the 2 monuments.We acrually had a big problem with Headout Rome as the meeting point they advertise in internet is not correct.Luckily enough there was a telephone number numer if their booking confirmation,So I could call and learn where the real meeting point was,after that, we got the usual service.Skip the line is necessary in Rome.. Many times the access to Colyseum and Vatican will be denied when there are too many people inside.pls note that while access to Sr.Peter 's church is free,soemtimes acess is denied for religious ceremonies.. and in any case lines are long as there are security checking point s,.

title: Beautiful place, but a lot of people
text: We liked the visit with 3 kids. Since our kids don’t understand English, would be nice to have e.g. electronic guide in our own language.

title: Только не в июне/июле и не в обед!!
text: Самой плохой идеей было прийти к колизею в обед! Тысячи туристов и +43 на солнце = "успех". Вокруг Колизея практически вся его "фотогеничная" часть закрыта строительным забором - рядом активно строят метро.
