Внутрь попасть было вообще нереально - я так и не нашла где эта очередь на вход заканчивается))))

title: Entrée refusée
text:
Entrée refusée car pass expirée de 30 min, sachant que nous avions du réserve le matin au mont palatin à une heure qui leur convenez, mais à l’arrivée sur site nous avons était refouler car le pass était expiré , voilà la mentalité des italiens du côté du business,

Une honte

title: Чисто поставить галочку
text: Одна из самых распиаренных достопримечательностей в мире, но по факту ничего особенного. В Риме много других интересных мест)

title: Plasticcolosseo
text: Ma scusate davanti ad una bellezza simile guardate in terra? Una vergogna per tutti !plastica sporcizia sono ovunque

title: Colosseum
text: I would not recommend going into the colosseum it is much more interesting from the outside and you won’t be herded inside like we were. I would not do this again as I felt it was a waste of money. We couldn’t wait to get out of there. Save your money for some good eats!

title: Massively Underwhelming...but you go to check if off the list, I guess
text:
The most impressive view of the Colosseum is from outside, and from other view points around the city. 

We chose to be part of a larger tour group with Skip the Line access (which you get anytime you take a tour and don't just show up). The structure itself was ok to walk through but completely underwhelming considering the tourism hype that surrounds it. It's old. It's massive. It's a circle with a lot of restoration work being done and lots of other tourists just following along with the massive hoard of people inside. 

The experience might be better during the off-season, if there are less crowds, but for me, it was not worth paying for the tour to see and definitely would not have been worth standing in line for 2 hours to get a ticket on the spot to walk around by ourselves without a tour. I highly recommend only seeing it from the outside and if scheduling a refundable tour later during your trip. If you feel after a few days that you still really want to see the inside, then take the tour. If not, cancel the tour.

title: Очереди
text: Какое-то полуразрушенное строение,  ничего особенного. И очень большие очереди на вход. Лучше погулять вокруг.

title: Ha külön vettük volna a jegyet nem pedig Roma Pass-al akkor most idegesebb lennék
text:
Rengeteg önjelölt idegenvezető még így szezon kezdetén is, mindenki minden lépésben elakart nekünk adni valamit.
Mega extrém módszerekkel, hideg vizet 2€-ért, karkötőket és csetresz szarokat 3-5€-ért. Nagyon gyenge, belépéshez még Roma Pass-al is időpont kell a Forum Romanum irodától.
Mi 12-kor kértünk időpontot, du 5-re kaptunk.
Mikor odamentünk fast line vonalon 8 perc alatt beengedtek, de a rengeteg csoport és tömegtől szinte lehetetlen volt élvezni is egyáltalán a látványt. 30 perc séta, 15 db fotó, 20 perc padon ülés után ki is jöttünk...

title: BEWARE of Oasis Holidays Group!
text: I purchased skip the line tickets for the Colosseum from this agency a month and a half before the date I needed them.  Four days before my scheduled time slot, I received an email that due to a technical error, my tickets were unavailable.  Now I am without tickets.  Unprofessional and unethical.

title: Be prepared
text: Lines were incredibly long, we weren’t able to get in. They’re doing major restoration to the building. I suggest booking a tour to beat the lines. Bring an umbrella or hat as there is no shade whatsoever. Not much to see or do once inside. I rated average because of the lines.

title: Esperava mais!
text: Ou a minha espectativa era muito alta ou devido a puder estar em obras não fiquei nada amante do espaço interior..  o exterior é mais interessante!! Ainda assim comprar o bilhete antecipadamente acho compensatório!!

title: Bezoek wordt steeds lastiger
text: De toegang tot deze icoon wordt steeds lastiger. Lange wachtende rijen en vliegveld controles. Dit maakt dat steeds meer bedrijven zich specialiseren om je tegen een hoge prijs de toegang te faciliteren. Binnen is er steeds minder te zien. De restauratie werkzaamheden van het ondergrondse deel maken ieder zicht hierop moeilijk. Een zijwand is geheel afgeschermd oor stalen steigers. Kortom veel geld voor weinig waar. Maar het Colosseum blijft natuurlijk een icoon.

title: Boring
text: Too many visitors and people trying to sell you things you,don’t need.      Queues are way too long.   You can’t even look up without someone selling you a queue buster deal which is a complete con.   Also very dirty

title: Let BIG letdown
text: Soooo. I would just like to state that the Colosseum it’s self is just amazing ....that’s the only good part of this review . I have never seen so much trash littered round what is one of the biggest tourist attractions of the world ....police with machine guns easily out number any people employed to pickup plastic bottles . Unfortunately Rome is not a very clean place .....and Romans don’t seem to care .

title: very crowded
text: A very crowded place, which actually is not that great since the arena etc is still getting renovated.

title: Colosseum
text: Expensive, guides spend a lot of time on history there are so many tourists and not a lot to see  but still worth the visit at least so you can say you have been.

title: ÄLÄ osta ennakkoon
text: Koko rakennuksen ympärys täynnä fast-track/guided tour-kaupustelijoita, joilta saa halvemmalla kierrot kuin ennakkoon tilatessa. Itse sain yht20€ jonon ohitukset ja opas-kierrokset sekä colosseumiin että forumiin, kun netistä ostettuna puhuttais about 50-80€...

title: Harc
text: Colosseum. Ezt egyszer mindenkinek látnia kell. De egyszer bőven elég. Bejutás az online előre váltott jeggyel az igazi. Helyszínen is lehet időpontot foglalni, de kicsit időigényes. És persze a bejutás is kb 20-30 perc. Érdemes kora reggel nyitásra menni. A sok árus és fogdmegember hihetetlenül idegesítő. És élmény romboló. Igazából én többet vártam tőle. Jelenleg nem lehet az alsó szinteket bejárni. Viszont az jó, hogy vannak bent kutak így inni mindig lehet vizet! Mindennek ellenére egyszer meg kell nézni.

title: A bit confusing
text: The information given in the Colosseum Tour was great, BUT...the entire area is very confusing to follow.  We had earphones and an audio tour, BUT...we couldn't locate the numbers inside the Colosseum reflecting where we needed to be.  We met other tourists with the same problem.  We kept asking where the numbers were that would match what was being said on the audio tape.  Very disappointing

title: Colosseum visit
text: A must see in Rome. It is a huge help paying tour guides, as they do have a separate queue. It can take quite long to get in from the normal queue. They are found in abundance there.

title: Impressive but crowded.
text: Long queues for security and payment. The cashier ignored us for two or three minutes while he counted and made little piles of coins on his desk. Not our money, he was just ignorant!

title: Beware, Beware of Headout
text: Booked and paid for colosseum guided tour but didn’t receive tickets, emailed them and they eventually replied that due to a glitch we had missed out and they couldn’t provide alternate tickets before we flew out. Still waiting for a refund

title: Μονομαχία στην πολυκοσμία.
text:
Πραγματικά βλέπαμε τον κόσμο των γκρουπ που τους πήγαιναν τρέχοντας, να μπουν ,να δουν και να βγουν και χαρήκαμε που δεν ειχαμε κλείσει κάποια ξενάγηση. Ούτε skip the line ούτε τίποτα δεν θα έκανε ευχάριστη την επίσκεψη μας.
Παρόλα αυτά ειναι επιβλητικό και όμορφο. μεγαλοπρεπες και τεραστιο!!!

title: Cansativo
text:
Interessante ver esse monumento e projetar como era a diversão naquele tempo. 
Não é passeio para se fazer com bebê, carrinho, bolsas. Muita escada e muitas filas.

title: Fraude
text: Estuvimos llamando al teléfono de incidencias que tenían para decirles que llegábamos muy justos de hora pues no pasaba ningún autobús y no nos lo cogieron.Después de coger un taxi para llegar a tiempo cuando llegamos nadie se hizo responsable de nada y nos perdimos la visita. No nos ofrecieron volver otro día, no nos dejaron entrar para llegar a su encuentro. Vergonzoso! No contrateis con esta gente nada.

title: Restoration of Colosseo diminished it's ancient appeal
text: I commend the efforts of the Roman government  in restoring the ancient buildings to provide more stability for the safety of the tourist entering these historical sites. Aesthetically speaking, it appears to be modern and losses its sense of history. It could have been better, if the restored portion exactly replicated the original section. Just a thought.

title: Not a great one
text: Colosseum is a world wonder. But I didn't feel it so  good a visit. Firstly it is very crowded. Secondly not much to see inside.But when in Rome its a must visit due to its historical importance

title: La déception !
text:
À ma grande déception le Colisée est actuellement en travaux ce qui enlève énormément de son charme.
De plus rien n'est expliqué quant à l'histoire même de celui-ci. 
Aussi vous ne pouvez pas faire de photos partout ni comme vous le voulez.. 
Si vous souhaitez quand même le visiter, n'hésitez vraiment pas à acheter un coupe-file sur internet ou vous attendrez entre 2h & 3h pour entrer dans le monument.

title: ÇHARGÉ D'HISTOIRE !! 👀...MAIS 🙁
text:
Un site incontournable,  mais bien plus beau de L'extérieur 🙁. Sans un pass coupe file vous aurez 2/3h d'attente. 
Je trouve qu'avec 6 millons de visiteurs  /an et une rentrée de 💰💰€€, le site pourrait être mis plus en valeure. Bref... un peu déçu. 🙁

title: Interesting
text: Ofcourse you need to see the colosseum while in Rome but i mean i wouldn't take a ticket to see it from the inside unless i am very interested about the history of the place or architecture, otherwise it would be a bunch of huge stones, stairways and crowds.

title: Coup de chance
text:
Nous avons visité le jour où c’était gratuit, sans queue... il y a tout de même une nuée de vendeurs de coupe-file qui ont tenté de nous filer leur camelote... 
j’étais avec des personnes handicapées et l’une d’elle a dit: « chouette monument dommage qu’il soit si mal entretenu, ça tombe en ruines » 
Note basse à cause des marchands de coupe-file.

title: It was so busy
text: So many people, a really long line and a lot of "staff members" trying to sell tours. the Colosseum it very impressive.

title: So so tour guide
text: Overall we enjoyed this tour the sites are amazing and it’s nice to have an explanation about what we were seeing. However our tour guide did not speak English very well so we couldn’t understand much of what they were saying. As we approach the Colosseum the lines were very long. Our guide reacted in a way that made us think that we would be waiting a long time, which we did, but we wouldn’t have noticed if the guide had been calm about it.

title: Majestuoso por fuera
text:
Me impresionó al encontrarmelo al salir del metro. La verdad es que es una belleza. Finamente me di cuenta de que la parte interior no me impresionó tanto.
La parte negativa de todo esto es que hay muchísima gente que dice que solo quiere darte información pero lo que hace es liarte y engañarte. El primer día lo perdí y me fui porqué le creí a un hombre que me dijo que tenía que hacer dos horas de cola no sé dónde.  Está mal señalizado y eso no es fácil para un sitio tan masificado. El caso es que hay que coger hora para entrar.  Nosotros llevabamos el Roma Pass y lo que hicimos fue hacer fila en el Foro Romano para entrar y allí mismo nos asignaban una hora para el Coliseo.  Tuvimos dos horas para pasear por el Foro y el Palatino antes de hacer los 45 minutos casi de cola para El Colsieo. En definitiva, es un clásico de Roma que hay que ver una vez en la vida, pero sabes que vas estar haciendo colas un rato.

title: Historia
text: Es emocionante verlo de cerca, sientes que la historia sobre ti, el pasaje de piazza Venezia es muy hermoso

title: Mejor mirá Gladiador
text: Si bien es una visita indispensable bajá ya mismo las expectativas. Hordas asiáticas, altas temperaturas y conglomerados de superpoblación no van a hacer de este paseo lo mejor que te podía pasar. 3 minutos para la foto, apurate porque tenemos que cumplir un horario y chau me voy con el próximo contigente van a ser palabras que vas a escuchar en tu guía.

title: El Coliseo es soberbio
text: No se puede creer lo que es el Coliseo. Lo malo fue que la pagina de Tripadvisor me derivó para comprar entradas a la empresa Dream Tourism Ltd y me atendió un tal Md Ashiq Mazumdert (Chairman) quien me hizo ir a retirar la entrada y no me la dió. Me dijo que me la iba a enviar por mail pero tuve que reclamarle por telefono para que me la enviara. Yo compré con audioguía pero me envió solo la entrada básica. Muy mal por parte de Tripadvisor esto de recomendar gente o empresas poco serias.

title: Way too crowded!
text: I‘ve been here a couple of times, but I think I‘ll skip it next time. Even though you have a ticket with a reservation time, you have to wait for more than one hour in the sun because they let too many people in. If it‘s your first time in Rome, you probably need to accept that, but it‘s not worth doing it for a second or third or .... time.

title: Very impressive from the outside
text: It is very busy even when you have a card for skip the line, you have to make an appointment for a special time and then you will find another line.

title: GRAN MONUMENTO / VISITA DIFÍCIL
text: Si bien es un monumento de visita obligada tengo que decir que el sistema de venta de tickets, con diferentes operadores es un poco cáotico. Hace falta comprar con mucha antelación. Y una vez logras entrar la visita está muy mal indicada y de tres audífonos que pagamos solo funcionaba uno.

title: Vi mistede vores booking
text: Vi havde bestilt Colosseum Fast Track hjemmefra ved Rome Tour via viator. Det var udover entré til Colosseum også entré til Forum Romanum samt til Palatiner Højen. Vi fik padge på til billetterne ved turistkontoret, men pludselig fik vi at vide, der ikke var flere billetter til Colosseum den dag. Vi ville få pengene retur, men vi ville jo ind på Colesseum mm. Stor skuffelse, at der bliver solgt fler billetter, end der er plads til.

title: Massenweise Touristen
text:
Die Menschenmassen sind schon aus weiter Ferne sichtbar, anstehen in der Schlange zum Eintritt dauert zum Teil mehrere Stunden, dazwischen wird man permanent von irgendwelchen „Tourguides“ angelabert die einem Tickets ohne Wartezeit verkaufen wollen.
Kurz stehenbleiben und sich das Teil ansehen ist nicht, es hängen in kürzester Zeit alle möglichen Typen an einem die was auch immer verkaufen wollen.
Tipp: Schauts Euch aus dem Bus an oder klettert auf den Hügel davor und schaut von da oben - aber gebt Euch nicht dieses gottverdammte Gewühle, den Innenraum zu sehen war bei uns Top of the List - wir habens gelassen !!

title: 世界的に有名
text: 思っていた以上に多くの人が当日券の列に並んでいました。予約はしていくべきです。外観は写真で見るより立派でしたが、中はまあまあな感じ。自撮り棒や水、帽子を売っている人が沢山います。無視しました。

title: Another example of “over tourism”
text: Sooooo many people! Such long queues even with prepurchase! Travel has become too cheap, so that you can’t see anything for the crowds, and it is killing the planet. I’m probably not travelling too much after this.

title: 羅馬競技場
text:
在羅馬競技場的附近有超多景點，我是在復活節假期前往，超級無敵多人，如果沒有提早預訂入場，排隊入場一天大概只能有一個景點！雖然預約費要4歐，但還是強烈建議要參觀的人先預約！此外，競技場旁邊有個景點「帕拉丁山」據說風景比競技場美！
競技場周圍有很多販售手環、自拍棒的人，如果不買一定要強烈拒絕對方！

title: Agobios, colas y posers
text: 12€ la visita conjunta coliseo+foro. Razonable precio. Siendo aconsejable la compra anticipada, eso no te libra de guardar colas largas, atosigadas por legiones de buscavidas, vendedores de tours, agua, baratijas.... información útil: si usted  es de los que viven el momento, compren la entrada en el foro(menos cola) y si no disponen de muchos días en la Ciudad, vean el coliseo por fuera, aunque les quede la espinita de no poder presumir ante sus amistades de haber estado en la arena. Lean mas libros de historia y menos cuentos de los tours que explican pelotudeces. Disfruten de la gastronomía Romana. Si aún así deciden entrar provean 1 hora par el coliseo (una vez dentro) y dos para el foro, sumándole las colas y sufrimientos varios. La peregrinación a La Meca esta mejor organizada que este parque temático en el que se ha convertido  el centro antiguo de Roma

title: Must see, but...missing a trick
text:
Absolutely amazing. I just felt there was a lack of simple explanation. Running through which emperor or pope was in power and when does not depict the scene when in full splendour. 
We want to see how it looked and what happened. 
The funniest was seeing an American guy read to his 3yr old in a pray the dates that maximise whocares but whatever to whoever. 10 minutes the kid endured.

title: Slightly Disappointed
text: Something I have wanted to see for a long time but felt it was a bit of a let down in all honesty and looks far better and more impressive in pictures.  Although visited in May it was still crazy busy and would recommend booking well in advance to avoid long lines. The only tickets I could get were with an audio guide which suited me as I wanted some more information. However, the audio guide actually provided very little useful information. The main irritation I had were with all the touts trying to sell selfie-sticks/umbrellas etc and the guys offering skip the line tickets every step we took which drove me mad! Overall glad I went but probably wouldn’t return.

title: Male organizzato!
text: Ci sono tornata dopo anni e non ho visto migliorie anzi... Me lo aspettavo più curato e con possibilità di servizi maggiori.

title: Must see, but not to enter
text: The Colosseum is a must see, but a lot of people want that and therefore it is very very crowded. We didn’t enter it, because it was also under construction.

title: Deturpato dall'amministrazione.
text: Sono tornata oggi al Colosseo dopo qualche anno, e lo sgomento è stato grande! I pannelli per i lavori della metro C occupano la visuale di una delle 7 meraviglie del mondo, e questo, secondo me, è una cosa ineccepibile. Ovviamente la maestosità del Colosseo e la sua bellezza riescono, fortunatamente, a distogliere lo sguardo da quello scempio!

title: No Grazie!
text: Be prepared to be harassed by your peddlers every 10 seconds and reply “No Grazie” endlessly. Online tickets still take half a day to see inside. We didn’t bother and spent our day visiting many other places rather than load a full day just queuing to get inside.

title: Disappointing, but worth a visit
text:
The Colosseum looks far better from a distance than close up. In fact the closer you get the more disappointing it is. A part from its sheer size and the knowledge that the Romans basically emptied out Jerusalem to help fund its building, there isnt a lot that can be characterised as aesthetically pleasing to the eye. Even the marble was ripped out of it by a Rennaisance Pope to make steps in the Vatican. It looks like a derelict football stadium in some respects. So if you are contemplating queing up for hours to go inside I would think twice about it.
To add to the picture of a sense of disappointment I must mention the huge number of hawkers trying to sell you selfie sticks, power for your mobile, or even scarves. I lost count of the number of times someone tried to press a selfie stick into my hand. They are unlicensed but the police have no control over them. Then there are those trying to sell you a 'get into the Colosseum quicker' tour. Be warned, you do get an alloted slot but it is not an instant queue jump, you still have to queue!
Not surprising there are masses and masses of tourists which further detracts from the experience as you can be pushed and jostled by tours of people. Amongst the most annnoying are those holding up their flags so their entourages can follow them like sheep. These flags can sometimes impede you from taking that one picture of the Colosseum youve been patiently waiting to take. If you climb up the stone stairs near the Colosseum, you get a better overall view of it and the best place for taking pictures, if you can avoid the mainly east european female posers standing precariously on the wall taking selfies of themselves with the Colosseum in the background.

title: Colosseum do’s and don’ts
text: When in Rome, of course, you must see the Colosseum. But,  to avoid extremely long lines, get a tour guide. Otherwise, you stand in line for an hour or more just to get a time to enter the Colosseum, then another long wait to enter. I bought a Roma Pass when I arrived in Rome, but it didn’t help avoid lines.

title: Would be great without the touts/ con artists and millions of skip the line/ tour sellers
text:
If you could view the Colosseum alone or when there are no tourists it would be amazing and magical. We visited in May so not quite peak season and I cannot imagine visiting in the summer months given how many tourists we encountered. 
Aside from the tourists there are touts and pan handlers everywhere selling tickets/ raincoats/ tacky souvenirs. It can feel threatening and you get fed up with saying no thank you. Although some may be genuine we came across a few who tried to engage in conversations in a friendly manner asking where we were from etc we found it hard to walk away or get rid of them and when we did they shock our hand and put some bracelets in which they then wanted €1 each for. Once we had been conned the first time we spent the time looking out for and avoiding which was not the most relaxing tourist activity and took away from the beauty of Rome. 
We did not pay to enter because we only had a day in Rome and the queues were large. It is certainly impressive from the outside and is undergoing restoration so some of it is obstructed by cranes however worth walking to given that it has such heritage in Rome. 
My advice would be to get up and go early am to get some good pictures.

title: What to avoid at the Colloseum
text: We loved the tour of this extraordinary piece of ancient architecture. It is what happened afterwards that was disappointing and left a bad taste in our mouths. When we came out of the Colloseum we noticed 3 blokes dressed up, 2 as gladiators and 1 as Caesar. They were posing with the tourists for photos so the girls encouraged me to go have my photo taken with them. I knew it would probably cost a few euros but what the heck. So I asked the bloke how much, he said "Not much" so I guessed about €30, since there were 3 of them. They posed and then 2 moved on and I was left with one of the older gladiators, he said €40 So I got my wallet out and pulled out 2 €20's he was standing right over me, he said to give him €40 more for each of them. All up I handed over €130 I was too intimidated to stand up to him. Yes I know you will all say I was an idiot, but unless you were there you cannot know how menacing someone like that can be. I went back to my friends who were horrified and we immediately decided to go find a policeman and try and get some of my money back. 2 of my friends chased the blokes and cornered them saying unless they gave back €100 We would be going to the police, they eventually coughed up the money after my friends said we would put it all over social media.  I am writing this, although very self humiliating for being so stupid, to let others know about these charlatans at the tourist sites. I will try to attach the photos

title: A must to view but not necessarily to come in
text: In this visit we settled for a pic from outside and walked around it, the area is in renovations they are fixing the metro or something else and they were building the road for some sort of competition so it was very crowded and not comfortable to walk around.

title: Gigantesque
text: Tres impressionnant mais le personnel du colisee pas ttes cooperatif. Mais c est a voir car toute l histoire de Rome est relié a ce batiment qui est tout simplement incroyable.

title: Beauty is from afar
text: Many might not agree with me but I feel the beauty of this is from afar or in pictures. When you are right there I feel it is not in awe as I expected it to be. But nevertheless it is a must see and experience it yourself.

title: いつも観光客二にぎあう
text: 何度来ても建物は変わらないがね観光客は多い、船の時間の゛関係で、外観だげたったが、、昔見学した時、、、コロッセウム中に入り大きいさがよくわかる。

title: Trevligt
text: Trevlig utflykt , jag var bara utanför. Roligt att se. På kvällen och på dagen två olika upplevelser. Spårvagn nr 3 går direkt från Trastevere till Colosseum.

title: Great place but . . .
text:
Along with other places in Rome the Coliseum or Colosseum is plagued by the ubiquitous 'lucky lucky' men. Quite simply, their prevalence ruins any enjoyment that one might get from such a world heritage site.

Stand still for a second and someone has either put a bracelet on you and is demanding cash, or they are trying to sell you tat and junk that you don't want or they are insisting that you buy a tour from them even though all official advice is not to. Meantime some of Rome's finest (ie some of the various police forces) stand around doing nothing - or to put it another way, pestering tourists is condoned. 

Queue's to get in to any of the sites are horrendous, I saw people turned away because their 'tickets' were forgeries or fakes and quite simply I will not be going back until the Roman authorities decide that they will take some action to remove the pestilence that plagues their city.

Subsequent to my visit I was advised that the only way to deal with the people is top avoid eye contact and not speak. Personally I don't fancy a day of constant vigilance and rancour.

title: Queued a while with skip the line tickets!
text: Of course the colosseum is worth a visit but I’d skip on the guided tour as there isn’t a great amount to see and our tour guide wasn’t the best if I’m honest. He lacked any amount of motivation and he was difficult to understand. The parts we could understand were a bit boring to be honest. He wasn’t helped by the torrential rain but he could have had a bit more energy. We ended up queuing in the rain for a while and took ages to get through security so the skip the line tickets aren’t all that great. Apparently it is an hour and a half or more wait without them though while it took around 40 mins for us to actually get in. The colosseum  itself is incredible and so worth a visit, however there was so much construction / scaffolding work going on that it was slightly underwhelming.

title: Offre visite express Colisée à 9h à éviter!
text: Si vous souhaitez visiter le Colisée en français ne prenez pas de billet pour 9h par getyourguide. L'organisateur avec lequel travail le tour-opérateur n'a jamais de guide avant 10h30!!!! L'operation Colisée express à 9h00 est donc une offre à éviter si vous ne voulez pas être déçus!!!

title: NO compren su tour a traves de Free Tour Rome!
text: Fecha de compra 03/02/2019. Costo 45 Euros. Dia del tour 30/05/2019 - Horario 11.30 Hs.. El dia anterior te mandan un mail pidiendote que llegues al menos 30' antes de tu tour. Llegue a las 10.50. Resulta que me dieron un voucher para que vaya a otra agencia porque mi tour habia cambiado a las 13.00 Hs.. Esta agencia es Roman Empire. Cuando llego alli me dicen que la agencia a traves de la cual compre mi ticket, les habia avisado a las 11.19 que tenian una pasajera. Motivo por el cual no tenian cupo para las 13.00. Finalmente sali a las dos y me sumaron a un contingente de jubilados, claramente con un ritmo diferente al mio. Le sugiero no comprar sus paseos con esta gente. Son desprolijos, desorganizados y me han mentido. Un tour de medio dia, me tomo el dia completo. Pesimo...

title: Hot Hot Hot
text: The most important thing you should know when visiting the Colosseum is it’s extremely busy and very very hot ,  not to mention there are large amount of people selling items on the street, mostly cheap souvenirs and sorry but you will have to watch your pockets because there are small children sent to do pickpocketing.  Yeah on the bright side it is a amazing piece of history if you have a chance to go inside I recommended the tour is about an hour long .

title: Guided tour was a scam
text: The tour guide was unhelpful and for the cost we paid for the tour, it’s just not worth it. You can walk around by yourself without a guide and the experience might be more enjoyable.

title: a pity
text: this historic sight is awesome but disappointing as having been before I was sorry at the now restricted areas. I paid for fast track only to find there was little or no benefit. The guided tour whisked us round in three hours and in a manner that meant we had little or no time to view whatever took our particular interest.

title: Spoilt by street hawkers
text: An inspiring momument and naturally crowded , but the experience was spoilt by the number of street hawkers selling cheap souvenirs , bus tours or 'beat the line' tickets ( despite being sold out online ). Every few feet we were met with someone trying to sell us something and if this is one of the wonders of the world , they should control the number of street hawkers.

title: Iconic but also Heavy negative energy
text: Of course the colosseum is iconic place to visit and learn about!  We’ve been there before and this time with a cool guide Marco from Velvety Europe travel. When we truly realize what took place in these walls, it’s horrific that the slaughter of humans & animals is celebrate.  these games were sooo sick.  It’s got a very dark energy for those who are aware.  In the future, I’d rather admire it from afar, at night, lit up - and hope we don’t repeat such past pain & mistakes as a human race.

title: Von außen besser als von innen
text:
Klingt komisch dieser Titel aber ich habe mich selber gewundert.
Zuerst ein Ticket gekauft das zeitlich begrenzt war. Dann 2h auf Einlass gewartet und ungefähr 100x angesprochen worden ob ich Karte will oder Regenschirm oder Poncho oder Armband und „hey friend where do you come from“.
Dann wie Schafherde durch das Colosseum gelaufen. Die interessanten Bereiche weiter oben und weiter unten sind ausschließlich für Gruppen reserviert. 
Wahrscheinlich hat man zuviele Filme gesehen um etwas neues zu lernen.  Direkt neben dem Aufzug für hilfsbedürftige Personen ein Film über das Coloseum bei dem Bilder lebendig gemacht wurden. Gut um endlich einmal der Schafherde zu entfliehen und wieder daran erinnert zu werden dass das Colosseum kein Allinclusiv Club war. 
Hier sind viele Menschen gestorben um die Römer zu belustigen und zu unterhalten.
Ich war nach dem Besuch eher enttäuscht.
Vielleicht lag es auch daran dass zuviele fliegende Händler in der Wartezeit einfach nerven.

title: Wait times ridiculous
text:
I would not recommend buying tickets to this event....I purchased advance tickets through a company called Tiqets....I had to wait over 1 hour to redeem the tickets and was then given a time slot of over 3.5 hours later to come back and wait in line with only 2 hours left in the day.
I ended up not going in the Colosseum and Tiqets refused to refund me my money....don’t bother it is not worth it

title: TICKETBAR: Time not available, working on refund
text:
This is a review of Ticketbar, not the Colosseum itself. 

So Ticketbar lets me see all times, then select your time for skip the line Colosseum tickets. 

After booking my time (early morning) I received an e-mail (maybe 8 days latter) that the morning times are not available, and I have to select a different time. I don't want a different time, so I am currently working to get a refund. This has been very difficult so far and I am not confident. 

Also, after I ordered, a message was included that my daughter (10 years old) would need to have her age checked before going in. Does this mean that we would have to wait in line anyway? If so forget it.

title: Impressionnant
text: Le gigantisme du monument impressionne et se passe à l'extérieur. Visite inutile et blindée de monde

title: Historiens vingslag
text: En guide är nog ett "måste" om man ska besöka Colloseum. Vi bokade en guidad tur på Colloseum och Forum romanum. Det tog ca.3 timmar men var verkligen intressant och lärorikt. Det är väldigt viktigt att ta reda på var den guidade turen startar. Kolla upp det noga innan ni beger er till Colloseum.  Det är ju hysteriskt på utsidan och en mängd olika guidade turer.

title: Visit at night
text: Outside looked fine; the inside nothing like I'd thought it would be.  Lots of repairs being done and changes made.  Looks great at night with the lights on inside. Plus, you avoid all the people trying to sell you junk.  Did a tour which was included with the Pantheon one.

title: Może i ciekawe ale
text: Miejsce na pewno ciekawe ale przez ilość naganiaczy robi się męczące. Za długo tam nie byliśmy bo tej ilości ludzi nie da się zaskceptować.

title: Not my style
text:
The headline does not fit the marvelous collosseum. I just saw it from outside and I can only guess how big and supercool it looks like naturally from the inside.

My complaint goes more to: first, all the annoying people asking you for tickets to not stay in line. They are absolutely not listening if you say no. Doing everything they can to get you into a deal you don’t want. 
Second, the line of waiting people is almost endless. I know a lot people wanna watch and see. But is there no way to limit the visiting time? Or is it already limited? 
I guess I will never see it from the inside in real as I never gonna go there again. I really enjoyed Rome, just couldn’t enjoy that mass of people and I am a bit disappointed that the waiting time to entrance would top everything I ever seen. 100% not recommended for people that don’t want to wait 3 hours in line for entry. Maybe I choosen a rushing time... however.

title: Preço mais caro sem motivo
text: É uma bela construção histórica, principalmente quando nos deparamos ao chegar. O decepcionante foi que, embora a data em que fomos constasse como mais cara no site, a parte da arena estava em reforma e não foi possível visualizar e nem ir até os labirintos, sem contar o fato de que determinadas áreas só são permitidas se você estiver com grupo guiado.

title: Victime de son succès
text:
Ah le Colisée, ce monument mythique de Rome...
Il est magnifique vu de l'extérieur, mais assez simple une fois à l'intérieur.
Etant intéressé par l'histoire, je trouve qu'il manque d'affiches informatives comme dans les musées afin de vraiment pouvoir s'intéresser au lieu.
Aujourd'hui, cela ressemble plus à un lieu dans lequel les gens viennent uniquement pour être pris en photo, sans même s'intéresser à son histoire et au lieu en lui-même...
J'ajouterai également qu'il est énormément visité et que si vous voulez y entrer, je vous conseille vivement de réserver suffisamment à l'avance, car les places s'en vont incroyablement vite !

title: No sorprende.
text: Lo hemos visto tantas veces en tantos sitios, que te conoces el interior mejor que tu propia casa. Sé que ir a Roma y no pasar por el Coliseo puede resultar una estupidez, pero las colas son larguísimas y no vas a encontrarte con nada que no hayas visto ya. Vale, pensarás que eso pasa en todas partes, pero no; la Piedad de Miguel Ángel en San Pedro o la tumba de Julio II también las has visto en los libros, pero no se aprecia la belleza de una o de otra a través de una simple fotografía.

title: Be ready for long lines!
text: The lines and the number of people were incredible. So many tour group options and some are probably more reputable than others. Be prepared to be approached by individuals selling “stuff”.  Our tour guide spoke very broken English—difficult to understand, and we spent a good portion of the tour standing in an archway listening to her presentation.  The place is worth seeing but if you are pressed for time, I would skip the tour and just look from the outside.

title: Prendre le coupe file
text:
On avait acheté nos billets avant de partir pour éviter les longues files d’attente. Suite à un problème d’avion nous n’avons pas pu y aller le jour de l’arrivée mais le lendemain ! Les billets pour entrer dans le Colisée n’étaient plus valables bien qu’il soit noté sur le billet valable deux jours ! (Concerne uniquement le mont palatin !).
Rachat de deux billets ! Par chance qqn de l’accueil nous a fait passer en coupe file quand même car nous avions nos anciens billets avec nous. 
Prise de l’audio guide (6€ de plus). 
Et c’est parti pour déambuler dans le Colisée. Il manque d’explication, l’audio guide est sommaire il faudrait des photos de reconstitution de l’époque pour mieux s’imaginer les gradins, la fosse, etc ... 
le bâtiment est cependant beau à visiter mais une visite guidée est surment la meilleure solution pour éviter de passer à côté !

title: utrolig hektisk
text:
Super imponerende bygningsværk. 
UTROLIG mange turist informanter der ville sælge billetter, ulideligt faktisk.

title: 3 hours line up
text:
This monument is very interesting and as an icon of Rome must be seen. line up are huge (in May!) and there are people trying to sell you stuff every 5 feet. some of them quite aggressively...
Not sure if it's worth the hassle of standing in line for hours (skip the line has another line up still very long!). best seen for free from outside.

title: You have to do it if in Rome, still massively overrated.
text: Sure, it's thousands of years old, has a story and its place as a historical attraction, but it's nothing impressive, easily the least liked of our Rome visit. I wont say it's boring but u wouldnt feel like u never want to leave the place, u just keep wondering when will it end. Nothing displayed inside really impressed me so much, something that i havent seen elsewhere. Still i said i was at the Colosseum, meh.

title: Shocking
text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY Totally unorganized unprofessional run on incompetence. No one knows what they are doing

title: Visita aburrida
text: Contratamos una visita guiada y la chica, era simpática pero las explicaciones nos aburrieron un montón, falta de pasión era como leer un libro de historia

title: Ir para fazer o check
text:
Longas filas e muita gente lá dentro mas não estraga o valor histórico do edifício.
Não amei mas acho obrigatória a ida.
Muito vendedor cá fora

title: Nice from the outside
text: Visited the colosseum on our trip to Rome as this is a must do. We did not purchase tickets to go inside and we are glad we didn’t! It was very very busy and lots of scaffolding and building work going on inside which didn’t make it very attractive to look at. The outside was very pretty. Only downside is the men outside contstantly hassling you to buy things but guess you get that everywhere

title: Veel bouwvakkers
text: Het kost te veel moeite om binnen te komen voor wat je er uiteindelijk voor krijgt. We hadden vooral zicht op steigers en bouwvakkers. Daarnaast is het zo druk dat je geen tijd hebt om te genieten.

title: Раскрученный атракцион
text: Не самое главное место в Риме, куда надо стоять в очереди, тратить своё время и не увидеть множество достопримечательностей не вошедших в путеводитель. Не стоит особого внимания, достаточно осмотреть снаружи!

title: 立派な建造物でしたが
text: スケールの大きさに驚き！しかし、なんだか悲しくなってくる。ヒトと動物のどれほどの命が失われていったのか…。しかも見世物として。それを想うと気持ちが沈む。負の遺産？

title: Nice day out
text: When areas are closed. You can go around in half an hour. Unless you pay for a tour guide which we did not.

title: Scandaleux: avis aux voyageurs ATTENTION
text:
Avis aux voyageurs....

On vous vend un Omniapass avec Roma Pass,  un accès coupe-file pour le Colisée alors que le quota de place affecté à ce pass, est épuisé depuis un mois!!!

Mais, on vous dit aimablement que vous pouvez y aller mais avec un guide privé !!! Donc, vous payez 2 fois l'accès. Bien entendu, vous ne pouvez demander un remboursement partiel ou l'accès gratuit à un autre site. À vous de vérifier sur internet le calendrier de l'accessibilité au Colisée avant d'acheter le Romapass qui perd de ce fait une grande partie de son intérêt !!

À ce jour pas d'accès au Colisée avant le 18 juin donc ATTENTION!!

L'Omnicard pour l'accès au Vatican qui comprend aussi le Romapass mérite un calcul et des précautions surtout pour le tarif de 113euros  pour 72 heures. Toutes les visites se font sans guide et il vous faudra télécharger des applis. 

N'oubliez pas de prendre vos écouteurs car vous ne pouvez pas écouter les commentaires sans vous faire mal voir!!! Pas d'explications (ou peu) sur les sites

title: Recomendable pero solamente por fuera
text: Por dentro en Mayo está en obras, no se puede apreciar nada. Entiendo que se tenga que restaurar pero no se disfruta lo suficiente. Compramos las entradas en el garito que hay enfrente, una chica simpátiquisima. Hicimos poca cola. Incluía el foro romano y palatino, que si que era bonito.

title: Very crowded and difficult to get in
text: The Colosseum is unique and well wort a visit, but be aware that it is not simple to get in.  If you book online you will be pushed to buy a very expensive 'skip-the-line' guided tour.  You will bve shepherded around te sites at the group's pace not yours. The basic ticket includes the Colosseum, the Forum and the Palatine Hill, valid for one entry each but over two days, so you need to plan.  Best advice is to get to a ticket booth early as queues can be long. The complexity and variety of ticket options means that people spend ages choosing and buying tickets.  You will get a timed entry to te Colosseum, so more queues unless you buy the ticket there.  Despite the timed slots, there are large crowds in the venue - best bet is to go early or late, but time slots sell out early on the day.

title: Obiekt przereklamowany.
text:
Koloseum i kolejne rzymskie rozczarowanie
Większe wrażenie zrobiło na mnie "koloseum" w El-Jem i to śmiało polecam. Jeżeli masz już bilet do Koloseum to wcale nie znaczy że: po pierwsze wejdziesz do niego, bo tak zwany bilet dwudniowy (Koloseum i Forum) oznacza, że najpierw masz zwiedzić Koloseum, a drugiego dnia Forum, odwrotnie się nie da. po drugie nie zwiedzisz całego (fajnie brzmi) Koloseum ale na przykład tylko jedno piętro i po trzecie nie licz na fajne fotki bo tak w środku jak i na zewnątrz remont, remont, remont. Ale być w Rzymie i nie odwiedzić Koloseum... wybór należy do Ciebie.

title: Costo eccessivo
text: Il costo di 12,00 per entrare al Colosseo a me è sembrato eccessivo. Ancora più brutto è il fatto che si aggirano persone pronte a farti saltare la fila per l'entrata per la modica cifra di 30,00 euro. Assurdo!

title: Visite
text:
Même avec un coupe fil, vous devez passer par une agence avec guide pour y pénétrer d'où attente globale d 1/2 heure
Sans coupe fil, vous abandonnez sans doute étant le temps d'attente 
Une fois à l'intérieur , à moins d'aimer les échafaudages, vous serez sans doute déçus
Bref pas à la hauteur de sa renommée et de votre attente

title: To bussy with con artists everywhere
text: Waste of time trying to get. The thousands of tourism traps have made it a hell hole to visit. One of the worst places for tourist con men I have visited. Every 10 seconds someone rammed something in my face to buy and I have visited Marrakech which was a walk in the park compared to the Colosseum.

title: Good
text: Peninggalan kuno di kota Roma, wisata wajib jika berkunjung ke Roma. Saya sarankan Anda hati-hati disini karena banyak oknum yang akan menjebak Anda. Anda harus berhati-hati dengan orang yang menawarkan Anda gelang atau orang yang menawarkan Anda untuk berfoto dengannya menggunakan kostum gladiator. Mereka akan meminta uang untuk itu.

title: Incredible outside
text: This construction is really beautiful from outside day and night. It doesn’t have too much amazing things inside. Museum isn’t something special.

title: Badly organised.
text: The people that run the security here are a nightmare. Long long queues and though at one time I would have to take off my wedding ring! Full of unwanted street sellers who do not leave you alone and there seems to be no control over them.

title: Slecht georganiseerd
text:
Het gebouw zelf en dergelijke is natuurlijk een 5 waard. Maar de organisatie is een nul.
Had op voorhand tickets geboekt (De website is ook onoverzichtelijk, pas op dat je de juist tickets koopt, je hebt groepstickets en individuele, en dit is niet eenvoudig zichtbaar)  maar omdat als je met kinderen wil gaan (gratis) moesten we apart aanschuiven aan een loket om de tickets terug op te halen. Dit aanschuiven duurde ook meer dan 1 uur, terwijl je overal leest dat het max 15 min is (we waren wel in een drukke periode in de paasweek).
Rond het gebouw werden we nog eens misleid door iemand van "Skip the line" organisatie (heb niet met deze mensen gewerkt, maar zou ook niet aanbevelen daar met te werken).
Nadat we onze tickets hadden moesten we nog de juiste lijn vinden om snel toegang te krijgen. Staat heel slecht aangeduid, maar na wat rondvraag toch in de juiste (snelle) lijn terechtgekomen om de site te bezoeken.
Organisatie van Colosseum kan zeker nog wat leren van het Vaticaans museum, waar de ingang beter geregeld is.

Daarna nog het forum Romanum bezocht (maak zeker dat je genoeg drinken en eten mee hebt aangezien er binnen praktisch niets verkocht wordt).

title: Attention réservation
text:
Magnifique de l'extérieur malgré des travaux à côté pour le métro par contre attention pour visiter l'intérieur réservation obligatoire depuis mars.
Nous avons pris le roma pass a l'aéroport et on nous l'a pas signaler, il aurait fallut rajouter les 2€ obligatoire pour la réservation et l'heure de visite pour rentrée.
Donc attention réservation sur le net, ou part téléphone coût 2€ car sur place il y a une queue au guichet monstrueuse et bien souvent c'est complet 15 jours à l'avance.
Bonne visite

title: Magnifique mais PAs très bien indique pour se repérer
text:
Nous avions réserver en ligne nos billets mais nous avons eu du mal à trouver le lieu de rendez vous 
Il n y a rien pour se restaurer aux alentours 
Sinon Le monument est majestueux et ç est à faire

title: grande, da vedere...ma non organizzato
text: la nostra visita con i ragazzi al colosseo e fori imperiali .....grande bella istruttiva ma...organizzzazione poca: infatti pur con i biglietti acquistati online ci hanno indirizzati ad una coda non esatta per csmbiare i biglietti, dopo 30 minuti di coda sotto il sole un altro addetto ci informa che quella non è la cassa giusta...andiamo in altra cassa dove dicono che dobbiamo tornare alla prima cassa.....ci siamo un pò alterati ma alla gin fine siamo riusciti entrare....bellissimo peccato il roblema iniziale che potrebbe esere risolto con diversi tornelli all'entrrata dove viene letto il biglietto acquistato con orario d'ingresso, subito dopo i controlli metal detector....forse si eviterebbero delle lunghe file e si potrebbero diluire le visite in base al numero delle prenotazioni....stessa cosa per i fori imperiali....potrebbe essere fattibile? questa è la mia "povera" idea

title: Beware of the hucksters
text: We had only a day in Rome & wanted to go tour colosseum.  The minute you get close there are ‘your touts/skip the line’ hucksters salivating at opportunity to relieve you of your hard earned money.  My friend & I were totally turned off & as we’d try to disengage & walk away they’d follow. Fortunately we are a couple of ornery old birds.  We got caught in a downpour whilst in line & hucksters with umbrellas & plastic ponchos emerged. It takes away from enjoyment & I wish colosseum or Rome would regulate or crack down on this nonsense.  We chose to stand in line for 12 euro tix.

title: Expected more
text:
Don't bother with "skip-the-line" or the ticket touts. We got there around 08:30 and gained our tickets at the entrance at 09:20. Don't bother with the audio guide it costs extra and the amount of information provided is pitiful. You also have to join another queue to pick up your audioguide. If you do chose to take the audioguide too then make sure that you book and pay for it at the main ticket point. Otherwise your request to purchase the audioguide at the audioguide booth will be rejected.

Palatine Hill and the Forum are included in the Colosseum ticket price.

Signage again is diabolical.

And you will have to pay extra for a ticket to get onto the floor of the Colosseum.

Entry price €12 per person plus €5.50 per person for the audioguide. The audioguide only works for the Colosseum

title: Trop de monde
text: Heureusement il est superbe de l’exterieur! Nous avions acheté nos billets sur internet mais avons du faire la queue pour obtenir un horaire de visite...vu la foule nous sommes partis...

title: Rome Colosseum Scam / Robbery Alert
text:
Hi all,

This is my first time visiting Italy. Solo traveler. On my first day (yesterday) I visited the Colosseum. After getting my online-reserved tickets from the office, I was approached by a black man wearing blue (similar to staff at colosseum) offering a “free” wrist bracelet and handshake. He was full of smiles and persistent. While I refused the bracelet I stupidly fell for the handshake, thinking that’ll get rid of him. The handshake became a forceful drag to the side fence and cornered off by three other black men demanding money. I was punched in the left arm and chest. They took all my cash, walked away and continued on approaching other tourists.

This all happened at 2pm in bright daylight right in front of the colosseum. I went and found a police who was nearby and pointed them out to her immediately after it happened. She apologised that this happened, she simply showed me how to find the closest police station and said I should report this, then walked on.

It seems to be an organised scheme. As I walked around the colosseum, I saw more black men approaching people with the same bracelets. This was also happening in front of the Castel Sant’Angelo where I went to later that afternoon.

Luckily I was able to walk away with just a bruised arm and lost only money. So I thought I’d share this with anyone visiting the Colosseum and Castel Sant’Angelo area. If approached by men of the above description, AVOID at all cost, don’t even bother giving them your eye contact or speak to them. Walk away.

PLEASE BE CAREFUL everyone.

Stay safe~

title: Boek niet via rome-museum.com
text: Slechte ervaring. Tickets via deze site geboekt. Werden door de bewaking niet toegelaten in de wachtrij. Op hun aangeven achteraan moeten sluiten en daardoor veel te laat binnen en gids gemist. Dit is echt een rip off.

title: Erreur de date
text:
Nous nous sommes dans la date de visite : 1 jour plus tôt que prévu.
Nous avons passé les contrôles et le flash code de notre réservation sur internet est passé aux tourniquets !!!!
Ce n’est qu’une fois à la visite guidée, que la guide nous a refusé la visite.
Le flash code ayant été validé, on ne nous a pas autorisé à revenir le lendemain....

title: Even with skip the line a long cue
text: So busy, and bad signing. We’ve made a reservation and have to pick it up at the other side. After picking up the tickets, we had to go in line, but it was soooo long. Waiting time 40 min, before we were in. A lot of restaurations and work inside.

title: Cancelled Tour
text: I booked 2 tickets for an upper tour to take place on May 3, 2019 at 1:35.  When we arrived to take the tour we were told the tour had been cancelled.  This was a strange event as we had booked the tour through what we thought was the official site for Colosseum tours, Coop Culture.  We were told we would receive a credit refund the following week.  Of course the credit refund has not been processed.

title: Smaller than imagined
text: we had purchased an OMNIA Card to see this and it allowed us in but to see the pit and dungeons where the slaves lived and fought you had to pay extra which was a pit of a disappointment. A bit of a walk from the metro at Vittorio Emanuele, would recommend TERMINI for this and the Forum

title: 混雑してます
text:
お昼過ぎに到着で、入り口は長蛇の列でした。
チケットは買ってなく2時間待ちだそうです。
オンライン予約でもチケット引き換えに並ぶとか。
現地の観光ガイドが寄ってきて一人30€のツアーならすぐ入れるとの勧誘がありましたがやめました。
数年前はこんなに混んでなかったので、安易な考えでした。
外観だけ写真を撮って終わりました。
入るなら朝一でオンライン予約したほうがいいと思います。

title: Estafa
text: Compras la entrada anticipada y con hora para entrar, cuando llegas al sitio resulta que tienes una cola de tres horas, venden más entradas que aforo una pérdida de tiempo y dinero te tratan como ganado que va al matadero, no compres entradas vas a tirar el dinero

title: Arnaque
text: On vous accoste de tous les côtés pour vous vendre des prestations soyez vigilants beaucoup f arnaques

title: Beware
text: We book a Rome tour/transfer.  The tour guide did not show up.  We called and Viator never contacted him to book the tour.  I am very unhappy.  I gues one needs to quadruple check everything viator commits to.   They are refunding the tour but nothing for our angst and aggravation

title: Impressive structure
text: No doubt about it the historic structure is impressive.  Constant attention by the army of workers continue to maintain the structure and that is to be applauded.  But be prepared to be jostled pushed ordered about as you try to navigate through.  Selfie stick weilding modern day gladiators everywhere.  Ride staff monitoring the admission line.  I wouldn't bother paying to skip the line with a group as by the time U wait for the tour to start .... Listen to 30min waffle outside ... Still wait further at the "skip the line" gate ... Despite the tour operators scare tactics of a 2 hour line without them ... You will be in and enjoying the inside just as quickly.  Download info on the place before hand because most tours are 25 persons plus listening in a group surrounding a quietly spoken "guide" reciting what they googled, whilst surrounded by 100s of similar sheep/tourists.  Don't fall for the .... Only 14 or 15 in yr group routine either .... Thats an outright lie.  My advise ... Go .... Research .... Take water and stand in line 😀

title: Gidsen worden steeds slechter
text: Ik ben hier nu al een paar keer geweest en de rondleidingen gaan er zwaar op achteruit. Het gebouw zelf is natuurlijk prachtig en hier schuilen veel verhalen, maar deze krijg je niet te horen van de gidsen. Ik zou zeggen; koop een gidsboek en verlaat de gidsgroep zodra je binnen bent. Met gids is het immers 20 á 30min aanschuiven, zonder gids is dit als 3u op een goeie dag.

title: Good but not brilliant
text:
Whilst an iconic place to visit and we really enjoyed the history there are two things I feel compelled to mention 
1. The toilets were a disgrace- they could do much better
2. Self guided audio was on a phone. Personally we would have preferred headphones as it was difficult to see the screen and signage was very poor too

A must see attraction though.

title: Historique par le manque d'organisation et les heures d'attentes
text:
Billets réservés sur internet = 2 heures d'attentes pour récupérer le ticket d’entrée, pas d'autre solution, incroyable !!! + attente pour rentrée car le nombre de visiteur est limitè dans le Colisèe
Attention les billets internet évitent uniquement la première attente pour ceux qui n'ont pas réservés !!!!
Harcelés continuellement par les vendeurs à la sauvette. 
Plus beau de l’extérieur que de l’intérieur, surfait !!!
L'historique est exceptionnel, mais l’intérieur est vide.

title: 1 hour? Not quite
text: This tour seemed like a scam. We got there at 2:45. The tour was to begin at 3. At 3:00 we were taken to  another man who said we were waiting for two other people. Then we were handed off to a woman who we paid for our entrance tickets. She then handed us off to a man who combined us with two other people. They were booked at 3:30. He then passed us on to a woman who was the actual guide. At that point they merged us with more people scheduled for a later time until almost an hour passed and were were now a group of 20, it seemed they booked every 10 minutes and added people until we all got angry and tired of waiting! At 4 we began the tour! At 4 it should have ended!!! The tour itself was disorganized. This was a mess. We could not have been more disappointed and felt taken advantage of. Do not take this tour!

title: Colosseum
text: Not with the €30 entry ticket.  Best to take a picture from the outside and move on.  Lots of people and the skip the line tickets sold takes just as long to get in

title: Prachtig deels gerestaureerd gebouw
text: Geweldig om het gebouw “mee te maken” maar wat een enorme mensenmassa die zijn best doet om binnen te komen.

title: 朝
text:
朝早くに行けば空いているかな？と思いホテルを8時台にでてテルミニ駅に行くと、、
朝の通勤ラッシュで地下鉄は混み合っていました。

コロッセオもチケットを買う行列が9時前には出来ていました。
セキュリティチェックがあるから仕方ないみたいです。

title: Cancelled by Tour Company
text: It rained the night before we were to go on this tour so it was cancelled.  I understand that's standard as the Colosseum can flood.  We were disappointed that there were no more daytime tours available that fit our schedule (first week of May 2019). However, we were able to book an night tour directly with CityWonders that was spectacular.

title: Interesting to see
text: We booked a tour in advance and were happy we did.  We learned all about the history of the Colosseum which we felt was important to understand.  Our guide was very knowledgable and thankfully, the place wasn't too crowded when we went later in the afternoon.  The place is full of so much history that when in Rome, it is a must see.

title: Man muss es wohl gesehen haben....
text: Ich bin ehrlich, von außen sieht es wirklich schöner aus, als es von innen dann ist. Hätte ich mich anstellen müssen und eine lange Wartezeit in Kauf nehmen müssen, hätte ich mich sicherlich im Nachhinein geärgert. Lohnenswert ist doch mehr der Besuch des Forum Romanum, der hat uns mehr begeistert Und ist im Eintrittspreis erhalten.

title: Mi aspettavo di più
text:
Bello da vedere, niente da dire, maestoso e imponente, e va visto almeno una volta, ma mi ha deluso un pochino, rispetto a quello
che ho sempre visto in televisione o sulla stampa. Mi aspettavo qualcosa in più, inoltre troppi ambulanti che non lasciano nemmeno camminare, per vendere i caribatteria o l'attrezzo per fare i selfie.

title: Roma more like hora!
text:
This was the first thing we did on our trip to Rome and the worst experience. Let me make it clear that we only saw the outside and did not enter the colosseum.
We got there on the metro which was easy enough even to non Italian speakers but when we got out of the station it very very busy and we were accosted by tour guides and guys from Africa (we know this because they told us) who try to put bracelets on your wrist as a gift then ask you for money.
We saw a tour guide that seemed official but this was a scam too at 40€ each and the price kept going up! The queue to get into the coliseum seemed very long but it is hard to gauge how quickly it was moving. 
What we did in the end was read an online blog that suggested going to the Palatine hill gate which sold tickets to both and had shorter queue. Here we paid 17€ for entry to both but in the end the palatine hill was so amazing we didn’t bother with the colosseum and we are both not sure we missed anything.
Apart from this great city and a lovely break.

title: Beautiful place and full of history
text: Beautiful place and full of history but make sure you book a Skip a line tour to visit. it is always packed and most likely you'll wait a long time to go in

title: Lägg pengarna på annat!
text: Räcker med besök utanför. Vi betalade 12 euro för 1 vuxen och 1 18åring. Då ingick colosseum, palatinen och Forte Romana.Stod i vanliga kön tog ca 1 timme kl 13 den 12 maj. Fick pris på 35-55 euro på gå före i kön. Men glad att vi skippade. Kanske varit bra med guide men Google är fantastiskt.

title: Crowded
text: Very nice to go bit a little bit busy. I prefer to go in the last hour. THe toilets are a little nasty but thats just a little - for the great building.

title: Viator Tour - Colosseum, Pantheon and Roman Forum Tour
text: We had a horrific experience booking with Viator.com.  We booked our tour weeks in advance, received confirmation and then on the day of the tour we went to the place where the confirmation requested and the tour guide never showed up!  I have been trying and trying to get in touch with Viator via the customer service numbers and they are not the correct numbers.  This seems like a giant SCAM!  I recommend you never book with Viator.com!

title: Colosseo
text: Bellissimo senza ombra di dubbio ma fuori e per tutta Roma sti tizi che ti vogliono vendere il bastone per il selfie, il carica cellulare, l'altro con una specie di foulard a quadri. Via uno e ne arriva subito un'altro.

title: Overrated
text: We bought our tickets advanced so we didn't have to wait. There is nothing interesting inside, it's enough to see it from outside, not loosing/missing anything if you are not visiting.

title: Mea tours is meh
text: Tour guide was well educated however seemed unenthusiastic in the material. Maybe they were just having a bad day. Don't know for sure.  Had much better tours with other companies.

title: Hyper décevant
text:
Une organisation déplorable, des dizaines de vendeurs à la sauvette qui constamment vous approchent pour vous vendre leurs babioles (à la limite du harcèlement).

Le Roma Pass ne vous fait bénéficier du coupe-file pour le Colisée que si vous réservez en ligne et comme nous n'en avions pas été informés nous avons dû faire la queue pour réserver le ticket d'entrée (à un guichet à 200m) puis refaire la queue pendant 1h pour rentrer dans le Colisée à l'heure indiquée. 

À l'intérieur nous voulions prendre les audio-guides et on nous dit qu'ils fallaient les réserver sauf que JAMAIS personne ne nous a mentionné ce détail. Ils ne vous le disent qu'après 1h d'attente et quand vous êtes déjà à l'intérieur. Après avoir insisté nous réussissons à les obtenir pour finalement découvrir qu'il ne contient que 7 malheureuses pistes audio qui ne vous apprennent rien.

Pour un monument aussi beau et chargé d'histoire c'est juste minable. Ça me fait de la peine de dire ça mais passez votre chemin la visite de l'intérieur ne vaut vraiment pas le coût (à part si vous comptez prendre un guide dans ce cas ce sera sûrement plus intéressant). Contentez vous de prendre des photos de l'extérieur et ne perdez pas votre temps dans cette machine à fric.

J'espère qu'un jour Rome offrira au Colisée une organisation et une visite dignes de lui.

title: Arnaque & Déception
text:
Entre une organisation désastreuse et des vendeurs à la sauvette trop nombreux et insistants (à la limite du harcèlement), le Colisée aura été notre pire expérience à Rome.

Le Roma Pass est une vaste blague puisque le coupe-file supposément inclus ne vous permettra pas de passer en priorité, tandis que les réservations effectuées simplement en ligne vous passeront devant pendant des heures. À noter également l'existence de plusieurs files d'attentes, chacune aussi mal indiquée que les autres par un personnel mal formé et ne sachant pas répondre à une simple question ou vous aiguiller vers la bonne file.

De plus, l'audioguide n'est pas délivré à qui le souhaite: il faut le réserver (absolument RIEN ne vous l'indiquera avant) et il vous en coûtera 6€ par audioguide, tout ça pour 7 courtes pistes audio qui ne vous apprendront rien. Et dire que nous avons dû insister 10mn pour l'obtenir sur place ...

Pour s'en servir ainsi, la Rome actuelle ne mérite pas le Colisée. C'est malheureux à dire mais restez à l'extérieur et prenez quelques photos avant de passer votre chemin.

NB: Pour visiter le souterrain, comptez encore 15€ de plus (comme si ça n'était pas déjà assez cher comme ça). Nous ne l'avons pas fait.

Colisée (extérieur): 4/5
Colisée (intérieur): 2/5
Organisation: 0/5
Intérêt: 2/5
Déception: 5/5

title: visite moyenne
text: visite moyenne car se qui gâche la visite sont les travaux à  l'intérieur.  Sachez que si vous prenez vos billets à  même  à  l avance billet coupe file sachez que vous risquer d avoir une attente de 3h ils sont changés  les règles depuis peu et se sont bien gardés  de le dire donc vous avez vos billets mais vous n avez pas de guichet prioritaire donc vous faites comme les autres vous attendez.

title: A voir mais uniquement avec un guide
text:
Nous avons acheté des billets coupe-file, mais nous avons déjà fait une heure et demi de queue pour obtenir ses billets. La visite avec l'audioguide n'est pas suffisamment organisée pour être très intéressante. Nous vous conseillons de réserver avec un guide qui parle votre langue.
A voir tout de même

title: Throngs of people, long lines
text: It was very interesting, but dealing with the lines, heat, all the people as a little much.  Thankfully met a couple from Manchester England that made it much more bearable.

title: Tout ça, pour ça !
text: Une file d’attente à n’en plus finir pour voir des vieilles pierres en ruine. En 20 minutes, la visite du Colisée est faite, alors qu’il y a plusieurs heures d’attente. Le coupe file est vivement recommandé.

title: It's okay
text: It's cool to see but not much to do around it. I personally didn't go inside. Just took a picture of it outside and that's about it.

title: Crowded out
text:
We got there at 1030 am and the line was at 3 hours !
That makes it impossible to do with edgy teenagers in tow
We had to pass on seeing the inside , pity

The “guides” are a real bother , trying to sell you no wait entrance which is a scam

title: Beeindruckend
text:
Mit einer geführten Tour für mehr Hintergrundwisse top. 

Die Straßenverkäufer nerven total!!! Dafür zwei Punkte Abzug

title: Abîmé mais toujours impressionnant
text: A l’exception des murailles, le monument est , il faut le dire, fortement abîmé. Et n’était-ce les reconstitutions en 3D, on a du mal à imaginer l’arène ainsi que les splendides gradins circulaires. L’ouvrage laisse tout de même transparaitre la haute technicité de ses bâtisseurs. Fermez les yeux et imaginer les combats de gladiateurs et les clameurs des foules déchaînées.

title: Queues interminables, organisation inexistante
text:
Il y a au moins 5 queues différentes et des explications contradictoires sur celles à prendre
Résultat: nous avons perdu 2 heures à attendre pour rien!
Et le site ne vaut pas ces attentes dans ces multiples queues

title: Monumento magnifico in esterno!
text: Molto bello questo monumento che fa da sfondo a innumerevoli cartoline e fotografie. Non altrettanto interessante la visita all'interno in quanto resta bene poco. Consigliato con guida

title: Organised chaos
text: I know it’s stereotypical to say the Italians are a bit chaotic but our visit to the colosseum made us think maybe there is some truth in this. We arrived at 10.30 for our 11.00 tour but were sent from one end of the colosseum to the other (there are many entrances) and back again by the official staff meant arrived late and missed the tour. We wandered around the colosseum which unfortunately resembled a building site with so much scaffolding everywhere. Not impressed

title: Gigantesque mais déçu
text:
Le Colisée en impose clairement! 
Par contre étant en travaux cela perd de son charme ...
Le pass forum + Colisée est un gain de temps non négligeable. 
La proximité de l’arrêt de métro est très appréciable.

title: Intéressant mais un peu décevant à cause de la foule
text: le Colisée reçoit chaque jour beaucoup de visiteurs. L'achat d'un pass permet de gagner un peu de temps. Il faut privilégier les visites de fin de journée (si possible après 18h) car les groupes seront déjà passés.

title: Toute une histoire
text:
Lieu emblématique de l histoire italienne c est impressionnant à découvrir mais quel dommage cette queue a attendre même avec un coupe fil .
Et lés travail de rénovation sont tellement dommage car ça gâche ce monument qui devrait encore plus beau

title: Crowded
text: Nearly snapped a few time because off the sellers walking around,everywere.it was very enoying!Abit crowded,even in early may!i guess getting a guide will get you inside at half the time than on your own.i think the visit inside,was too rushed and not worth the price.we even didnt find the next guide,too the next guided tour,so we just walked around by our self instead.remember to have very good walking shoes on!deff a place you have to visit,before its gone forever

title: Prachtig ruïne: maar die 'skip the line' tickets zijn belachelijk
text: Wij informeerden bij de Toeristen Informatie over het bezoeken van het Colosseum. Daar waren ze níet behulpzaam. Ze hielpen helemaal niet. Dus moesten wij online op zoek naar toegangskaartjes. We kochten een kaartje voor het Colosseum. Dit was een digitaal kaartje met een QR code. Een "skip the line" ticket. Maar hiervoor moet je wel 1,5 uur in de rij. Daarna krijg je een tijdslot waarop je de andere rijen voorbij mag. Super slécht georganiseerd. Maar de ruïne zelf is toch de moeite waard om te bezoeken.

title: Underwhelming
text: Stunning from the outside underwhelming  once in. However staff and handling thousands of visitors each day excellent despite high security. Very good exhibitions inside. Very crowded viewing platforms. Possibly more room once current work is finished.

title: Decu
text:
Déçu par rapport au palatino et au forum romain...
Réserver les places par internet en avance vous évitera de faire la queue (jusqu'à plus de 2h) et vous permettra de payer moins cher !

title: Long queue for 'skip the line' queue !?!
text:
Booked in advance to 'skip the line' so we wouldn't have to queue for long - how wrong we were!! We got there in plenty of time before our allotted time but we still had to queue for nearly ONE HOUR to get in!  Total chaos, absolutely packed, although there were plenty of staff around to assist.  It then started pouring with rain (which didn't help obviously).
Once inside, we looked around but were not as amazed as we thought we'd be.  There was lots of scaffolding and 'renovations' being made which totally spoiled it. 
It acutally looked more impressive from outside.

title: Long bloody and cruel history
text: This has a nice gallery on the 1st floor. There are many broken pieces kept for display with little information. The only good thing i found is the model of Colosseum. They charges 12 euros for adult but restrict from entering in re-constructed area. They charge much more for entering in that area. The charges are not worth. This place has a long bloody and cruel history, i do not see any point in contributing its re-construction.

title: Обман с билетами
text: Пришли к Колизею в 10ч,очередь за билетами огромная, на улице жара. До этого читала,что общий билет можно взять также в кассе неподалеку,на входе в Пантеон. Там тоже была очередь,но значительно меньше. Стоим. Зашли в Пантеон в 12ч, на билете мелко написано,что билет действует 2 дня, а Колизей обведен и стоит 13-20. Нам на кассе по англ.сказали,что в Колизей нужно успеть до этого времени зайти. Мы решили,раз на билете написано 2 дня действует, обойдет сегодня Пантеон и Римский форум,а завтра с утра в Колизей. Территории огромные, красота. Ходили часа 3,не меньше. Жара, устали, проголодались. Пришли на следующий день до 9-00, к открытию Колизея,встали в очередь для тех,у кого есть билет. Подходит мужчина,смотрит у каждого билет. Говорит нам,что наш билет не действителен. Нужно было вчера до 13-20 попасть в Колизей, а 2 дня билет действует на Пантеон и форум. И мы такие были не одни. Говорит нам,покупайте новый билет (12 евро с каждого). Мы вчера даже физически не успели бы в Колизей до 13-20,т.к.Мы в Пантеон только в 12ч зашли. Короче,развод сплошной для туристов.

title: Troppa inciviltà
text: Troppa inciviltà, troppi ambulanyi, troppi abusivi. Roma dovrebbe essete un'altra cosa. Estirpare ambulanti e abusivi è cpmplicato ma andrebbe fatto e subito.

title: Travelers Beware
text:
I'd like to preface this review by saying that the tour itself was very good.

The purpose for the poor review is to warn other travelers to be cautious if booking tours through TripAdvisor. Not once on our trip to Italy, but twice, TripAdvisor changed the date and time of two different tours. One morning we walked across the city to find out a tour we had booked had been changed to the next day. The very next morning we again walked across the city to find out TripAdvisor had rescheduled our tour time for 2 hours later and we were turned away by the tour guides and told to come back, despite having confirmation emails proving what we had booked and paid for.

Both tours were booked through TripAdvisor, they were two different tours, and they were booked by two different people (one by me and one by my husband). 

You can imagine the disappointment and frustration as we had to cancel and move around other booked tours to accommodate these last minute changes.

Good luck!

title: Book a tour to guarantee entry
text:
We had a tour booked for 10am and as we entered it was announced on loud speakers that they were at capacity and would not be allowing anymore to enter. The queues outside were massive, hundreds of people must have been disappointed. 
It’s worth booking a tour so you jump the queues but also you do get to hear some history which puts it all into perspective. 
We booked the entry to palatine hill and the ronin forum also. This was great as again you got to jump the queues. 
My only comment is that they give you too long inside the Colloseum. 1.5 hours is not needed and would be much better spent on the other venues that have so much to explore. 
All in all though it was a great day and really helps you feel you have seen the history of Rome.

title: Disappointed
text: We were really looking forward to seeing the colosseum but unfortunately we found there to be no signage as to were to go. We had pre booked a slot to visit but still had to queue a bit. Security is crazy and then on entering I wish I hadn’t bothered, much better to just view it from the outside. Also the annoying sellers outside are really off putting, so rude and insistent. Won’t be returning ever.

title: Helt ok
text: Dålig skyltning vilket ledde till att vi stod i fel kö trots att vi frågat fem olika personer om vart vi skulle stå. Detta gjorde att vi missade vår guidning. Dock plus i kanten att de fixade så vi fick gå en senare tur. Mäktigt att se och få höra historien. Rekommenderar att betala lite extra för en guidad tur. Sevärt men inte ett av Roms bästa guldkorn. Man blev fort mättad av alla intryck och historia.

title: Mi aspettavo di più
text: Mi aspettavo mooooolto di più dall'emblema di roma e del suo impero. Straordinaria però, la mostra all'interno dell'anfiteatro veramente eccellente.

title: Wow!
text: All the things i have studied in school and seen in books came to life when I visited the colosseum.  It was an amazing experience.  So why the 3 star review?  Poor maintenance of grounds, filthy bathrooms, and graffiti.  It's a shame that maintenace and up-keep of this treasure isn't a top priority of the government.

title: Vergognoso
text:
Lascio tre pallini e non zero solo perchè vederlo ne vale certamente la pena però è scandaloso quello che c'è fuori, la piazza è in mano ai bagarini che ti tormentano e ti dissuadono dal fare il biglietto alla biglietteria del Colosseo perchè ci sono code di ore mentre con loro pagando il doppio ti fanno passare subito e tutto questo è legale!!!
PER CASO abbiamo scoperto che andando alla biglietteria del Palatino e del Foro con un unico biglietto puoi avere anche l'entrata programmata al Colosseo così salti la coda e passi subito.

title: Caos coliseo
text:
Hola!!
Menudo caos este puente en el coliseo.
Tras pasar una 1 y media de cola en los foros romanos nos dan la visita para el coliseo a las 5.
La cola de la gente con entrada era 3 veces mas larga que la cola sin entrada.
Con lo cual. Para que quieres sacar antes la entrada si sigues estando en cola?

title: Lindo lugar, en conservación
text: Compre la entrada para poder entrar a la arena, ingresé a el Coliseo como cualquier persona que compro su entrada pero a la arena me dijeron que no podía entrar. La señorita que cortaba el acceso de mal forma me dijo que me vaya a mí casa, porque ese día no me iba a dejar entrar. Pésima atención del personal.  Eso si, cobrar me cobraron. Solo pudimos hacer la visita a la parte común y para colmo no se podía ver casi nada porque estaba en reparación o en obra. Fuimos el 30/4, nuestro horario de ingreso era 16.50 hs, el 1/5 no trabajaban. Muy mal trato.

title: Не то
text: Прекратите превращать историческое место в трэш А что за метрополитен в центре города где скоро все разрушится??? Власти Рима подумайте об этом, Хватит откатываться

title: Te duur voor wat je ziet.
text:
Hele lange wachtrijen, security controle enz.
Niet het mooiste colloseum ter wereld, dat van Pula is veel mooier onderhouden.

title: Impressive on the outside, disappointing on the inside.
text:
Unfortunately, the interior has been devastated over the centuries and it looks more like a ruin than a remain of once impressive structure. It is difficult to picture in your head how it really looked like once upon a time and tons of scaffolding doesn't help.
This rating isn't even influenced by an annoying entry procedure which needs to be mentioned: we had to wait in a line for a full hour although we had skip the line tickets bought online, weeks in advance.

title: Organisation à revoir!
text:
Nous avons acheté nos places pour le Colisée tôt le matin vers le Forum. La file d’attente était déjà assez longue, mais une fois les billets obtenus nous avions rdv 2h plus tard au Colisée pour la visite. Nous arrivons à l’heure indiquée et là, surprise nous devons à nouveau refaire une énorme queue. Incompréhension. Une fois arrivés au bout de la file, celle-ci se divise en deux et nous fait passer d’un côté spécial et plus rapide pour les gens ayant déjà les tickets. Pourquoi ne pas avoir AU PRÉALABLE fait une file d’attente pour les gens ayant déjà les tickets? Nous avons attendu avec des gens n’ayant pas encore leur ticket (et ce, après avoir été baladé de file d’attente en file d’attente par le staff). Prévoyez une bonne partie de votre journée à attendre. 
Le Colisée reste tout de même un monument incontournable à voir. Allez y également l’admirer de nuit.

title: Décevant
text: Franchement c'est un peu décevant. C'est évidement à voir mais l'entrée est très chère pour un site bondé de monde toute la journée. On peut très bien en faire le tour par l'extérieur et avoir une idée suffisante

title: Très bon
text:
Gabriel guide italien qui parle très bien français. Des anecdotes qui nous captivent et nous fait comprendre la place que tenait le colisée. Les enfants participent grâce à ses questions
Excellente visite grâce à ce guide.

title: Aussen- Umrundung
text: Bei 3 Stunden Wartezeit und Regen war es leider nicht möglich Eintritt zu bekommen. Ansonsten schon sehr interessant.

title: Hard to appreciate the magnificence when amongst hoards of tourists.
text:
I definitely recommend going to the Colosseum but lowering your expectations when doing so, so as not to be too disappointed.  It is a magnificent site, and certainly worth seeing, however the hoards of tourists make it exceptionally difficult to really appreciate what you are seeing and experiencing.

Finding the right queue is quite a challenge, since they are so long that you can't see the sign at the front of them.  We had a Roma pass and had booked our timed slot online.  Stood in the queue only to find we had to exchange our timed slot for a ticket.  Stood in that queue, exchanged our ticket, then went back to the next queue - what a faff!
