Navigating around the Colosseum we did Rick Steve's audio tour which was great, saved us queuing (and paying) for an audio guide also.  It was raining the day we went so there were a lot of umbrellas to dodge but we were still able to get reasonable views of most things.

The biggest negative is the guided tours.  There are huge groups going through that make it exceptionally hard for anyone else to get a look in.  One tour guide even physically bumped me out of the way when I was reading an information sign so that her group could see it!  Would be fantastic if they limited the number of guided groups or scheduled them for specific days so that the rest of us can avoid them.

title: DO NOT USE HEADOUT
text: Wished we had read reviews about Headout tours prior to booking. Really really poor tour guide and we left halfway through. English was very poor to the extent we could not understand him and he gave wrong information. It's ok though as Headout are happy with this sub standard poor performance and have told us such in an email.

title: Non prendete la guida "Romana"
text: Sono stata con la mia famiglia per Pasqua...pessimo periodo ma lo sapevamo. Arriviamo al Colosseo e ci mettiamo in fila. Arriva subito ù  signore dicendoci che la fila per entrare era di un'ora e mezza, che con lui potevamo saltare la fila e avere una guida...sennò il Colosseo è solo marmo. Per la modica cifra di 35 euro a persona ci faceva anche andare ai Fori ed al Palatino. Per farla breve: fila di 45 minuti, biglietto entrata di 12 euro a testa, compreso Fori e Palatino, e se volevamo c'era l'audioguida con 5 euro in più. Entrate da soli, non fidatevi. Hanno fatto più fila di noi quelli che lo hanno seguito.

title: Bien organisé mais contenu décevant
text:
La gestion du flux des visiteurs est très bien organisée mais le contenu de la visite du Colisée s’est avérée plutôt décevante car pas grand chose à voir. 
Cette visite ne me semble pas être une priorité.

title: À faire mais avec guide
text: Nous avons du faire 1h45 de queue avant de pouvoir accéder au monument. Une fois sur place on nous informe qu’il n’y a plus d’audio guide disponible et que nous devrions faire la visite par nos propres moyens. Une fois à l’intérieur nous avons pu flâner à notre guise dans le monument. C’est quelque chose à faire mais mieux vaut réserver à l’avance et une visite guidée me paraît un gros plus.

title: Overcrowded
text:
Was looking forward to visiting this historic place. Had jump the que tickets and a guide. Despite this we felt we were being hearded through the crowds visiting this place. Toilet facilities over used and inadequate for the crowds. 
Amazing building from the past, where many people and animals lost their lives. Sad fact! Glad that efforts are being made to preserve the building for the future. Depite all, this is a must see in Rome.

title: Imprescindible
text: Un imprescindible al venir a Roma. No obstante le doy 3 puntos porque tuve que hacer teniendo el Roma pass una cola de mas de una hora bajo la lluvia porque ahora te tienen que dar una hora de visita aunque tengas pase prioritario.

title: Pas d audio guide disponible
text: Déçu qu'en arrivant pour le colisee il n'y avait pas d'audio guide de disponible ! Pensez à réserver le votre en avance

title: Päivä menee jonottaessa
text: Pakollinen kohde tietysti kuten myös miljoonalle muulle päivässä, ostettiin opastetulle kierrokselle liput pakosta kun tuntui ettei muute pääse edes sisään. Skip the line liput ja silti melkein tunti jonoteltiin.

title: A découvrir forcément mais ..
text: A forcément visiter . C est un endroit assez incroyable et tellement âgé que ça paraît irréel . Mon conseil : prenez les coupes files sinon vous en avez pr des heures . Même si l organisation parait un peu hasardeuse par moment cela est très pratique . Il y a un gros manque d explications du site ( pr ça que c est mieux av un guide ) . Il y a un monde fou donc ce n est pas une visite très agréable . A faire 1 fois dans sa vie ...

title: Must have Seen mit Abstrichen
text: Das Kolosseum muss man bei einem Rombesuch natürlich gesehen haben. Daher haben wir vor der Reise online Tickets gekauft. Trotzdem über 1 h in der Schlange gestanden, dann erst eine Zeit für den Einlass erhalten. Der war 3 Stunden später. Also wollten wir das Forum Romanum anschauen. Dort aber auch eine Schlange vor den Sicherheitskontrollen. Als wir dann zum angegebenen Zeitpunkt zum Einlass sind , mussten wir wieder 45 min warten. Wir hatten für die Besichtigung einen Audioguide. Die Audioguideführung war schlecht ausgeschildert und die Infos waren spärlich. Das hatten wir am nächsten Tag im Vatikan deutlich besser. Da merkt man dann doch die über 1000 jährige Erfahrung im Geld verdienen und im begeistern der Massen.

title: Meglio da fuori
text: Dopo un bel po' di fila (ma sapevamo), una volta entrati siamo stati decisamente delusi...molto meglio da fuori ammirarne l'imponenza e la bellezza. Riguardo la fila fuori...varie persone non dello staff ufficiale provano (e spesso riescono) a vendere a più del doppio un biglietto d'entrata dicendo che ti mandano dentro con una guida: tutto vero, peró non sai in che lingua parla la guida.

title: colisee en mai
text: Ne pas faire de visite en famille ou en couple pendant le weekend du 1 er ! C’est l’horreur absolu , meme si vous disposer de bon pre-payés il y a tellement de monde que ca en devient ridicule!

title: 入場チケットが無い場合には...
text:
音声ガイドが付いていない入場チケットに関してですが、午前8時30分からの開場なので、午前8時前から並ぶとスムーズに入場できます。午前8時を過ぎると、大混雑に巻き込まれます。それ以外は、インターネットによる時間帯予約をおすすめします。なお、個人レーンは3列（外側から時間帯予約、事前チケット、当日券）あり、一番内側が当日券を購入するレーンです。
なお、ライトアップされた夜の外観が一番綺麗だと思いました。なお、治安の関係上、
午後9時頃までが安全かと思います。

title: Déçue
text:
Le colisee est en restauration, tres mal indiqué pour recuperer nos reservations.
Audio guide sans interet .... si vois ne pouvez pas y rentrer ce n'est pas bien grave

title: Great but ticketing is s nightmare
text: Queues are endless, pre-booking abused by professional resellers which hampers the mood and excitement about the building. In the building directions could be clearer

title: İçeride değişik bir şey yok
text: Bence içerisi ile dışarısı arasında çok bir fark yok. Ama görkemli bir tarihi eser. Biletinizi internetten alın. Ve/veya Roma Forumu ile kombin yapın..

title: Good looking on the outside, but the inside..
text:
The visit at the Colosseum was ok.
The building looks way better on the outside than on the inside.
At the entrance you have the 'airport' type of checking the backpacks, etc.
You have 2 levels, one at the base in the arena and one above, where you can partially circle the place and take a photo. 
I can't really say that I will remember the place after a few days, nothing memorable besides its history.

title: Average
text: No doubt the Colosseum is amazing and great, but there is not a lot to do there and you pretty much just stand in a few places while the guide explains it to you, nothing you didn't already know, maybe it was the tour.

title: Usine à fric
text: Disneyland ! c'est bon quoi, avec les milliards qu'ils font ici, ils pourraient peut être investir dans l'organisation, même pour le Colisée, 3 heures de file d'attente ne valent pas la peine. Harcelés de toutes parts par les compagnies qui veulent vous vendre des entrées, puis par les vendeurs à la sauvette qui vous mettent dans les mains des bracelets cadeaux qu'il faut payer ensuite... dommage , ce site exceptionnel n'est plus qu'une attraction pour le bétail que vous êtes, bonne visite les cochons, moi je me la fait virtuel sur google au calme.. Rome est devenu une pompe à fric, c'est dégeulasse pour César qui n'en profite même pas :) Et puis c'est hors de prix, un scandal !

title: No use Viator / Don’t use Viator
text:
El tour del Coliseo que ofrece Tripadvisor es a través de Viator. Reservamos un tour pequeño (no más de 10 personas) del Coliseo, el Foro y el Palatino. Fue un tour con 30 personas, del Coliseo y el Foro. El operador Grayline Tours no asumió responsabilidad alguna y Viator jamás respondió.

The Colisseum tour offered by Tripadvisor is through Viator. We reserved a Small Group tour for the Colisseum, the Forum and the Palatine. It was a 30 person tour of the Colisseum and the Palatine. The tour operator, Grayline Tours, took no responsability and Viator helpline never answered.

title: Bien pour un selfie
text: Le monument est mythique donc il faut y aller. Mais beaucoup de monde et l’intérieur n’est pas impressionnant. Il a été pillé pendant des siècles et il reste l’impression globale et les vestiges. Cher et beaucoup de queue. Un bon selfie et de bonnes photos à l’extérieur suffisent. On a pris un billet coupe-file et un guide pour ne pas faire les 2 heures de queue.. vraiment l’extérieur suffit. Rome regorge d’autres endroits et monuments magnifiques

title: Tour civitatis
text:
El tour al coliseo con Alessandro muy mal. 
Muy desproporcionado el precio con la calidad del guía. De los peores tours que he realizado. Se perdía en cosas sin importancia para apenas explicar lo relevante.

title: Busy Busy and be prepared for long waits
text: The queues and crowds really over shadowed our enjoyment of the place itself. We arrived at about 10.30 and had to queue for 1.5hrs just to get tickets.  We then had to wait in another queue for over an hour to get into the place. It was packed!! The place itself is impressive (although I have seen better preserved roman theatres in Turkey) but the visit was overshadowed by the queues and the staff's/organisation's apparent disregard for the visitors by only putting a couple of pay booths on.  If you get there at about 9am (or earlier) you may have a better experience. Don't expect to do both the Colosseam and the Forum in one day as there are also big queues at the Forum. One other point - whilst buying tickets on line in advance will undoubtedly save some of the queuing you will still have to wait in long lines to get in.

title: Non né vale la pena
text: Dopo 2 ore di coda ho pagato 12 euro sono entrato e sono rimasto un po' deluso,gran parte della base e' coperta da una tettoia per lavori non si vede niente,e alcuni passaggi sono riservati ai gruppi non vale la pena fare una coda del genere per questo .meghio vederla da fuori fa più effetto

title: Don't waste your money
text: Biggest dissapointment in all of Rome. Queues were 2 hours long to get in then metal detectors airport style checks to get in, and inside its a dissapointment outside is the bit you need to see and that's free ticket also includes forum Palatine which is across the road and same thing queues again and security again. My advice walk round the outside and spend your €12 on lunch

title: Bien
text:
Le site est toujours aussi captivant, dommage qu’il t’ai toujours des travaux sur place. 
Pour la part je préfère visiter les jardins, surtout lorsqu’il fait beau. 
Éviter les visites organisée, une vrai galère.

title: Roma pas
text:
Colosseum prachtig 
Maar via Roma pas een drama 
We werden echt van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd 
De 1zei je moet een tijd reserveren dus stuurt ergens heen 
Kom je daar nee je moet daar zijn 
En jawel na 5verschillende plekken en een half uurtje verder stonden we toch zonder tijdreservatie binnen 
En ondanks onze frustratie hebben we er toch van kunnen genieten

title: Не впечатлил
text:
По телевизору казался более монументальным. В реальности... нет, он не мелкий, но и грандиозности не ощющается. Либо мы присытелись немного...
Фантазия не показывает картинок гладиаторских боев. Однако очень интересны принятые здесь инженерные решения. К примеру, заполняемость 50-55 тыс чел, люди могли покинуть его в течении всего 5 минут. 
Много фактов о жизни гладиаторов. Голливуд их переврал почти полностью. 

Народу, конечно, много.

title: Estáfa
text: Nos hicieron pagar dos veces la entrada ya que la que nos vendió la entrada en el foro romano no nos explico que teníamos que ir antes al coliseo. Ojo con esto. No era el único que le pasó.

title: Beau mais trop de monde
text:
Déçue car trop de monde. Machine à touristes, tout est envahi de personnes, faire visite avec guide, 
Ja n’a Pas vue james bond

title: Nice from distance
text:
Well, from distance it looks like a symbol of Rome, but when you come closer, it looks like a fish bone. Nothing magnificent and amazing.
And great crews of people.

title: Hay que verlo
text: Personalmente me mobilizó mas la acropolis en Atenas.Pero no se puede pasar por Roma y no ir a verlo.Aconsejo tour sin colas

title: ぼったくりミサンガ売りの男、最低でした
text:
コロッセオからフォロ・ロマーノにいく途中の道で、紳士風のイタリア人の男が声をかけてきました。「カワイイネー」「オオサカー」「ナガトモー、ホンダー」などと日本語を並べながら、フレンドリーに話しかけてきたので、笑いながら会話をしていました。フォロ・ロマーノのセキュリティの入り口付近に差し掛かると、人が少なくなってきたからか、「トモダチー」と言いながら、手にミサンガを巻きつけてきました。ミサンガを巻く速さは手馴れたもので、あっという間なので、予備知識がないと振り切れないと思います。
ミサンガを巻いている間に、別の男が来て金を払えといってきます。別の男は、日に焼けて帽子を深めにかぶった小さめ男でした。紳士的な男は、こいつがボスと言っていました。
一つ25ユーロといってきました。2人分だから50ユーロだ、と。ノーと拒否をすると、すでに隣で夫が払った後で、男はグッバイと言って立ち去りました。
本当に最低だと思いました。
あまりにも腹が立ったので、もう一度現場に戻り、その男たちの写真を撮りに行きました。写真を撮ろうとしたら、また日本人カップルを狙って楽しげに声をかけていたので、「この人ミサンガを高額で売ってくるので気をつけてください」と言っておきました。
そして写真も撮りました。そうしたら、ボスと言われていた男がバカヤローと言っていました。お前がバカヤローですよ。
本当にせっかくの楽しい旅が台無しになるので、もっとこの情報を日本人に広めたいです。写真も載せます。この人最低です。ボスの写真は撮れませんでした。

title: Abaixo das expectativas
text:
A minha ideia era de um espaço imponente mas estando lá dentro não parece assim tão imponente. Tinha ideia de ser muito maior.
Mesmo com os bilhetes comprados antecipadamente, a espera na fila é muito grande pois quase toda a gente tem os bilhetes antecipados.

title: Ok, underwhelming
text: Very interesting, but was somewhat underwhelmed. Perhaps I was too hungover. The history of the place is remarkable, and the surrounding locations are stunning.

title: Hunger Game
text: Lots of scammers, law enforcer too nice, can’t even bite or no teeth so scammers are free, and forcefully take advantage of tourist. Not worth the risk. Just the same site as you will see in pictures & movies. I hope Rome government does something about this! Your making few BILLIONS OF USD, and perhaps this is 80% of you GDP, TOURISM, so please protect tourist otherwise, expect growth in this industry to be flat, and it should further diminish moving forward. Local are good people, scammers are the illegal overseas workers selling all sorts of stuff or making friends, and accusing you of racist if you do not shake hands with them. In my country, you touch me, il send you to jail! Do not make handshake or talk to strangers in this area! Chances are you will be robbed before you know it.

title: Poorly organized
text:
Booking platform for official site is flawed.  Booked once and was notified a week later that there was a website error and that my booking was not confirmed 
so I lost the level of tour I wanted by the time I needed to rebook. I Booked a guided tour with access to the top level. When I arrived I was told that the to level had been closed for repairs and I should have received an email. No email. They said I'd get a refund, but that should have been processed as soon as they closed the top level a week ago. I was not offered another guided tour. The crowds were terrible and security not present. I wouldn't return.

title: Intéressant mais un peu décevant
text:
Après 2 heures de file d'attente interminables du fait des vendeurs de bouteilles d'eau, perches à selfie et billet coupe file "skip the line " 😤 insistants,  nous avons accès au Colisée.
Tarif: 12 € pour les + 18 ans avec accès au Mont Palatin valable 2 jours.gratuit le 1er dimanche du mois.
Cela nous laisse le temps de le contempler extérieurement et bizarrement je m'attendais à un monument plus imposant. Cela reste le plus grand amphithéâtre romain.
A l'intérieur ma déception se poursuit: il faut avoir beaucoup d'imagination pour imaginer quel édifice cela pouvait être à l'époque romaine (plus de gradin mais des pentes, plus de statue).
Les oeuvres et la maquette exposées dans les couloirs permettent cependant de se projeter.

title: Не впечатлил!
text:
Заказывала экскурсии в Колизей через Tez-Тour, так как за 2 недели билеты туда через сайт было уже не купить. К слову, НИКОГДА НЕ заказывайте экскурсии в Tez-Тour, компания отвратительно их организовывает и вообще чуть не продинамили меня, гид не встречал с табличкой у входа, пришлось полчаса вызванивать и искать гида, который попросту не брал трубку, хотя на месте я была за 30 минут до самой экскурсии, пришлось понервничать.

В Колизей всегда очереди, даже из групп, поэтому спокойно покупайте билет через сайт и приходите сюда во второй половине дня, утром и днем - толпы!

Экскурсия была на 12:00, в Колизей мы попали примерно в 12:40, то есть 40 минут стояли в очереди из групп. Я присоединилась в 12:30 и часть экскурсии пропустила. На входе работает система безопасности и сканируют ваши сумки, что тоже создает очередь. С экскурсией по Колизею ходили час, там есть небольшая экспозиция, демонстрируют каменные бюсты, просто камни, макеты Колизея до разрушения, картины, видео с предполагаемыми представлениями и тд... Мы ходили по первому и второму этажу, видела людей, которые поднимались и выше, но наша экскурсия это не позволила. Еще там открываются красивые виды на город и арку Константина. 

Лично меня Колизей не впечатлил, показался слишком маленьким, да и смотреть внутри особо нечего, только представлять, каким Колизей был раньше. Это можно делать и по фото... Но если есть желание прикоснуться к древности - Welcom!

title: Have a ticket? Means nothing
text:
You queue for your ticket.
You then queue to get in.
Expect queues!!
The audio guide I had in English wasn’t that good and it was very confusing about where you had to go.

The outside is amazing but the inside looks like a building site.

title: Colosseum, Roman forum and Palatin Hill
text: TICKETSTATION SRL at Piazza d'Aracoeli, 16 is the worst! When we got there before 3 pm on April 24 they said that they need to reschedule, its very difficult to do that since we had limited time. They did not apologize at all for the inconvenience. Part of the reason we book this tours ahead is because we don't want to worry about this type of situation on the day itself. On the resceheduled day April 26 we show up in that location tickets were not there and we were directed to go get them somewhere else. Again, very disorganized and unprofessional! There were no audio guide, no hosted entry which was mentioned in the inclusions! Again look out for the TICKETSTATION SRL Piazza d'Aracoeli, 16..if the venue is there please DO NOT buy this tour.

title: Amazing cultural place.
text: Too crowded. Line to get in, two and a half hours. Pro guides  constantly fightinh  to get you in, very annoying. Hard to just walk around, due to the crowd.

title: Headout Tours
text:
Avoid, avoid, avoid this tour company. 
We were booked to get into the colosseum at 9. It took until 9.50.
Our tour guide regaled us with a whole load of rubbish. Lines like, "Nero, only 16, not so bad. He just made mistakes because he was so young and he had a mother like that." 
And he continued to witter on about meaningless crap.
What did his tour want to know? Basic facts. Where did the emperor sit when the colosseum had events? Is the concrete you see under the bricks the original stuff and how did they make it? 
A good tour guide doesn't endlessly talk. They give you time to think, take photos, ask questions. They let you go look at the exhibits and shops.
Oh, plus he lost 5 people going through security.
That stuff happens if you have no flag, no badges for your group that identify you, and you are so busy trying to prove you could teach at a university (he couldn't) that you forget you're a tour guide.
So a 90 minute tour took ages. Many of us removed our ear pieces. 
We all ended up at Palantine and the forum much later than we needed to and so got drenched.
90 minutes is 90 minutes, Headout Tours. People have other plans. Sort your lives out or rename yourselves Headupbum Tours.

title: pas très attirant
text:
Ce monument historique est en parti démoli de l'intérieur comme de l'extérieur. Partout on voit des trous dans la stucture comme s'il y avait eu bonbardement durant la guerre.
C'est probablement des décorations ou statues qui ont été enlevées au fil des ans.
Chose certaines ce n'est pas très joli en plus l'intérieur est vide . on dirait une ruine.

title: Headout Tours, Avoid at all costs
text:
I booked a guided tour of the Colosseum with Headout Tours. I noticed that the price had shot up as I booked it. Upon investigation I had also bought tickets for the Palatine and the Fort which doubled the cost. However I still though it was a decent deal so went along with it.
Upon our arrival we accompanied the guide to the Colosseum. He was very informative and enthusiastic. If this was all I had paid for then I would have thoroughly recommended this tour. However At the end of the tour we were told that we would have to wait for the tickets to the other attractions. As we had a train booked this was an issue (not sure why they couldn't just give us the tickets at the start). 
Anyway we eventually got the tickets and then proceeded to the Palatine. After queuing for 20 minutes we got to the front only to be told that the tickets were duplicates and had already been used. We were therefore not allowed in. 
I returned to the office and was offered new tickets. I was not prepared to return with what could be further fake tickets and therefore requested a refund. They initially offered me 5 Euros each which I declined. Eventually I accepted 10 Euros each, which was less than I paid.
My advise don't bother with Headout tours

title: Bello ma.. che peccato!
text:
Uno dei simboli di Roma, non ha certo bisogno di presentazioni: imponente, maestoso, unico.
Ma l 'atmosfera è stata completamente rovinata da una disorganizzazione davvero incredibile. Coda interminabile per chi aveva già prenotato l'ingresso: io avevo l'ingresso alle 950 ma, nonostante fossi arrivato alle 840, sono riuscito a entrare solo dopo le 13! L'addetta in cassa ha avuto il coraggio di dirmi che gli orari vanno rispettati e io ero in super ritardo! ma io ero in coda più di un'ora prima dell'ingresso previsto, solo che avevo davanti così tante persone che non sono riuscito ad arrivare al mio turno in tempo  per l'orario stabilito. Comunque poche casse operative per affrontare le lunghissime file di visitatori in attesa, inoltre gli addetti alle informazioni davano indicazioni diverse e molto superficiali sull'accesso con Roma Pass. Insomma capisco che il numero dei turisti è molto elevato ma qui regna la confusione più totale. Peccato perché il luogo in sè è assolutamente da visitare

title: Décevant
text: Quand on connaît les arènes de Nîmes qui sont en parfait état (gradins, piste...) comment ne pas être déçu par le colisée : C'est une ruine : aucun gradin n'est encore debout, tout est en friche, certaines pierres tiennent par des systèmes D. On a juste l'impression qu'aucun entretien n'est fait pour préserver cet édifice qui pourrait effectivement être grandiose.

title: Druk!
text: Prachtig en indrukwekkend, maar de duizenden toeristen en opdringerige verkopers maakten de ervaring onplezierig. Enkele weken per jaar is het Colosseum 's avonds open voor kleine groepen, en die tour was wél erg mooi.

title: Just to see, no more
text:
I've been there and nothing to do except looking around and walk.
nice to be there at the sunset if you want to take photos.

title: Very Busy Place
text:
Extremely busy place and long long queues to get in so take extra time on hand or just go around and see it from outside only. 
A not to be missed place when in Rome.

title: Very disorganized
text: Poor signage long queues very disorganized needs to get their act together.Changed their booking criteria batter we bought tickets.

title: Una joya de la humanidad muy mal administrada
text: El Coliseo es sin duda un lugar que hay que visitar!  La cantidad de visitantes interesados en entrar, lo harían el sueño de cualquier administrador de empresas o parques temáticos! Lo increíble es lo confuso del proceso para hacer tu visita y lo tardado y tortuoso que resulta la espera! Vale la pena hacer la visita guiada! Y por favor no sedas a comprar a oportunistas abusivos que complican y encarecen la experiencia.

title: Sopravvalutato
text: Colosseo esternamente imponente e maestoso, per la visita interna non vale la pena fare non moltissima coda..

title: L’usine à touristes !
text: Des wagons de touristes se déversent dans le Colisée. Entrer sans un coupe fil est illusoire. Trop d’options de visites toutes payantes. Du racolage pour des guides touristiques. Les travaux à l’intérieur qui gâchent la vue ... franchement de l’extérieur c’est pas mal aussi

title: Outside better than inside
text: I was not thrilled with Colloseum because you really can't see anything special. Rough stones, many of which have been renovated - very little have been preserved since ancient times. We were there for half an hour, some parts we passed twice. Buy tickets over the Internet, because in that case, you are going to the fast line.

title: Gestione pessima
text: Sul monumento niente da dire, sulla gestione di chi dovrebbe garantirne le visite veramente uno schifo! Ore di coda nonostante la prenotazione online, allora mi chiedo a cosa serva.

title: Coopcultura si vergoni!
text: Premetto che il Colosseo è magnifico, ma la mia recensione è riferita a Coopcultura, l'associazione che gestisce in modo osceno l'affluenza al sito.  2 ore di coda per acquistare il biglietto e prenotare l'orario d'ingresso per poi, presentandosi all'ora prenotata, dover fare un'altra ora e mezza di coda per entrare, nessun cartello, addetti che non hanno la minima idea di dove indirizzare la gente, visitatori da tutto il mondo disorientati e arrabbiati. Vergogna!

title: keine Chance
text: Trotz Romcard mit bevorzugtem Zugang hat man kaum eine Chance, ins Kolloseum zu gelangen. Man hätte sich Stundenlang in der Sonne an einer Kasse anstellen müssen, um erstmal einen Termin für den Zutritt zu bekommen.

title: Désolant
text:
Désolant 
Le Colisée ferai bien de revoir son organisation pour la vente des billets 
A l'heure de l'informatique les italiens sont encore au bon vieux guichet qui décourage tellement l'attente est insupportable.
Mais ce n'est pas tout même avec un billet vous avez droit à une attente aussi longue pour rentrer dans le Colisée. 
Et en plus pour couronner le tout le touriste est pourchassé par des bandes organisées qui soi disant pour la modique somme de 40 e vous propose un coupe file alors que les billets sont vendus 18€ sur internet.
Toutes ses troupes organisées raflent une grande partie des billets et le touriste est condamné à attendre des heures ou se faire flouer!

title: Déception en avril 2019
text: Si le lieu est incroyable et chargé d’histoire, l’organisation de la visite, elle, est une déception sans nom ! L’attente est très très longue, même avec coupe-file. Le personnel est très désagréable à l’intérieur et aux portiques de contrôle surtout. On ne sait pas où aller et on ne comprend pas toujours les indications en anglais des « informateurs » d’origine indienne par exemple qui ne semblent pas savoir eux-mêmes où aller. Beaucoup de vendeurs à la sauvette à qui on dit non et qui reviennent trois, quatre fois vous revoir et qui jouent au chat et à la souris avec la police. Je ne m’attendais vraiment pas à cela... C’est devenu très touristique et on ne peut pas apprécier cette visite avec tout le monde qu’il y a.

title: Mi aspettavo di più
text: Sarò  l' unica ma me lo aspettavo più  maestoso ed imponente. Certo, ha il suo fascino, ma lo immaginavo diverso. Comunque bello.

title: Organizzazione
text:
Un pallino solo e dovuto all'organizzazione del sistema.
Assurdo compri Roma card che ti dà diritto a due ingressi a tua scelta tu pensi di avere già un biglietto di entrata e invece no devi fare una coda di due ore per fare un iglietto centinaia e centinaia di persone in coda con solo tre casse funzionanti e non è finita qui una volta acquistato il biglietto ora e mezza di coda per far vedere che tu hai un biglietto e quindi potrei entrare
Interno del Colosseo merita la visita Peccato per l'organizzazione

title: Interesting
text: The line is long... the tour guides rip you off... but once inside it was interesting. Not what you expected but the second floor is best. You can see and read many things.

title: עמוס מאוד בתיירים ומהגרים
text:
מקום מהמם ביופיו
לצערי עמוס בתיירים ובעיקר עמוס במהגרים שלא מפסיקים לנסות למכור לך פריטים
ממליץ לא להגיע בשעות העומס ולהגיע בערב
תהנו

title: Site exceptionnel mais surpeuplé
text:
On a pris le soin de venir à 8h30 pour éviter au maximum le monde et on a eu raison car en sortant à 11h, c’etaIt la folie.
Sinon le Colysée est un site magnifique qui vaut vraiment le coup. On a pris des audio-guides qui sont pas mal bien qu’il faille un peu de temps pour comprendre comment ça marche et où se situer.
Pour avoir fait de nombreux monuments, on a été impressionné par la piètre qualité d’organisation du site. En plus de la surpopulation des touristes et des vendeurs ambulants (environ une proposition toutes les 10 secondes), cette désorganisation nuit à la qualité et à l’intere du site.

title: Beware of renovations
text: I had booked a guided tour of the Belvedere area of the Colosseum on the co op website (official website). Having turned up on time I was told that the Belvedere area is being renovated so my guided tour was cancelled. They did not email me at any point to tell me this. I asked how long has it been closed and I was told about a month and it won’t be opening until June. Just be careful when booking on the official website. I would recommend booking with an outside company instead. We had no guided tour of the colosseum and for the Roman Forum I downloaded Rick Steves tour which was great !

title: Not very organised
text:
Recently visited in April - was very busy and lots of long lines that were part of the group tours so don’t be fooled in waiting in them.

Lots of men and women trying To sell tickets and skip the que tickets (just get in line and buy them inside or online in advance).

Also lots of people selling junk such as selfie sticks so be prepared to tell them to go away!!!

I was sold the wrong ticket - I booked over the phone and spoke to the official ticket office, they sold me the tour which requires a Roma Pass. So I had to pay again when I arrived as I do not have a Roma pass. Luckily it’s only 4 euros but do double check that they are selling you the correct ticket If you ring up, seems like a bit of a reoccurrence from what I’ve read.

If you’re from a country in the EU or have said Roma pass you get in for 2 euros each which is VERY CHEAP.

Magnificent architecture to look at and is really breathtakingly big.

It’s a beautiful piece of history - just ran poorly by a company.

title: Can’t enjoy when being harassed
text: We didn’t go in, only viewed from the outside. This is a must see if in Rome, but I rate it as a poor experience as the number of men trying to sell you junk was overwhelming. Yes they have these people all through Europe, but I have not seen it on this level. I couldn’t walk 10 steps without another shoving their selfie stick/umbrella/raincoat, etc. in my face. So horrible when you are just trying to stand and admire the Colosseum. I even got harassed by someone who apparently worked there who followed me trying to force me to buy a ticket to enter. What a tourist trap and very intimidating as a young female. The local authority should not allow this behaviour.

title: Imponente .
text: E' una delle attrazioni che meno mi affascina . Certo che se uno non la mai visto e' giusto vederlo una volta .

title: Arnaque au billet coupe-file
text:
Achetez un billet coupe file et faite la queue pendant 2 heures! Achetez la roma-pass et faites la queue pendant 2 heures pour avoir un ticket "rendez-vous" pour entrer au Colisée  3 heures plus tard. 
Puis, pointez-vous au rendez-vous et faites encore la queue pendant une heure!!!
Victime de son succès, le Colisée  permet toutes les ARNAQUES !

title: Un ENFER !!!
text:
Malgré un pass coupe file OMNIA CARD réservé sur le net, nous avons dû essuyer les plâtres d'une nouvelle grande DÉSORGANISATION romaine mise en place depuis le 1er Mars 2019. Après 2H00 d'attente pour obtenir le Graal le matin (ticket avec horaire de visite), nous avons obtenu une visite pour 14H45... arrivés à 14H30 on nous annonce que nous ne pouvons entrer et on nous demande de faire une nouvelle queue d'environ 3H00 !!! Nous décidons de quitter les lieux et revenons à 17H30 avec ce même ticket avant de pouvoir ENFIN entrer !!!
Les pass sont donc chers et totalement inutiles !!! Mefiez-vous !

title: Longue attente
text:
Une heure et demie de queue pour retirer nos billets coupe file... 
Sinon visite intéressante si vous avez des explications

title: Horas de espera mesmo com bilhete comprado
text:
Que péssima ideia. Filas (2h) para trocar o bilhete que comprei antecipadamente. 
Depois mesmo com reserva horas ainda por questões de segurança. 
Não se percebe com tanta experiência em turismo a péssima organização. Cheio de gente a vender Skip de line! Só pode ser por aproveitamento surreal!

title: Some advice?
text: Intended visiting inside the Colosseum but the queues were really long and as it was a hot day we decided to just have a look round the outside - yes we were pestered by touts promising quick entry for a hefty “bung” and were tempted.  However,  my wife and her sister have visited before and said that actually you get more of an impression form the exterior compared to what’s inside and so that really made the decision for us and in my opinion she’s right.  Currently there’s also a lot of construction going on around the top end of Via Imperiali (Metro station being built) and that’s a distraction.  You’ll also be hit by hordes of ticket touts/water/hat/scarf sellers.  I would add that if you are tempted by the offer of “skip the line/guided tours” then I suggest bartering - we found prices dropped if you dithered or walked away!

title: Uno spettacolo!!!!
text: Un vero spettacolo storico.... Rovinato peró da un organizzazione incompetente!! Prenotato online.... Pagato di più per saltare la fila.... O almeno aspettare di meno... Invece non si capisce dove entrare... Dove mettersi in fila..... Un disastro...... Il Colosseo é da 10....lo staff da 1!!!

title: Nice but thats it
text: Long lines if you don’t order online, nice to see this piece of history but that’s it, you go and you get out

title: Better from the outside
text: The one thing I wish someone would have told me before I went to Rome was “Dont waste your time getting into the Colosseum”.  I mean its cool and all but the architecture is more impressive from the outside, and the stress of getting inside is not worth any level of cool it is.  The place is filled with pick pockets, con artists and hustlers. It’s poorly organized and a complete throng of people.  See it — from Palatine Hill - or walk around the outside.

title: Skip the waiting line, but stay over one hour in line to get your tickets...!
text:
Typical italian unorganised and completely unlogical way of letting people think, that they do not have to wait in line to get into the Colosseum of Rome!!!
We booked online tickets with audio tour for our family of 4. With the printed voucher in hand, we had to go to the ticket boot for the Forum Romanum, although the vouchers were for the Colosseum... After having waited over an hour to get our prepaid vouchers converted to actual tickets, we had to wait another 2 hours before we could actually get into the Collosseum. There again massive waiting lines of people with timed entrance tickets like us...
We ended up giving our tickets away for free, because we did not want to waist any more time to see the Colosseum from the inside...
It’s like they say: italians are not very good at getting things organised, but their food is great...
DO NOT THINK THAT A JUMP THE WAITING CUE TICKET ACTUALLY MEANS THAT YOU JUMP THE CUE, we actually waited several hours without getting inside at all...!

title: Buy your tickets beforehand
text:
OK, this is a must see when visiting Rome. 
As the Colosseum can only hold so many people at a time you need to book this in advance. 
Buying tickets are pretty easy on the website and there are a lot of different options you can chose from. 
Also, please note, that your tickets for the Colosseum are also valid for the Roman Forum & Palatine Hill (something we didn't actually do, gutted!) 

We had a 2pm slot and arrived super early. There are a lot of staff members around who can point you in the right direction for the queues or trying to sell you tickets. 
It was as expected very busy!! 

When it is your time to go into the Colosseum you have approx. 30 minutes to join the queue, if you do not get in the queue between this time then you will have to buy another ticket. 
Once you have joined the queue, whether or not because we had individual tickets with no tour, we didn't have to queue for anything it was a swift in & through security. 

Although it is something to visit, because I didn't really get what I was looking at I would advise anyone to book a tour or purchase the audio guides which are located at the entrance (we didn't see these until we wanted to leave).

title: Histoire
text: Il vaut mieux le voir de loin sans entrer à l'intérieur. C'est un lieu qui reflète l'histoire de l'époque où on s'amusait en condamnant les gladiateurs et les animaux à mort.

title: "Priority line" is a scam.
text: Like the title says, their so-called "priority line" is a scam. It's the longest line. Not a priority. If you want priority, book a guided/group tour. When I hear "priority" I think "fast" or "a line that's shorter than the standard" at the very least. Nice building but the priority line is a bloody scam and nothing else.

title: Must-see, but disorganised ticket buying
text: Looking every part a ruin due to centuries of neglect, with most interesting parts out of bounds due to archaeological investigations, you should still go. Interesting exhibitions on the upper level, but the remainder benefits from a guided tour. Attempting to buy tickets on the day is possible but the queuing system is poorly signed and poorly devised. On site toilets are sub-standard. Decent value though.

title: Pas top !
text:
Le Colisée est magnifique; 
Mais les visites ne sont pas extraordinaires ! 
Beaucoup de monde, pas assez d’explications 
Lors de notre visite le Colisée était en travaux donc beaucoup de mal à se projeter.

title: La queue et la foule n'en valent pas la chandelle...
text: Regarder le Colisée de dehors est largement suffisant à mon sens...TROP de foule et TROP d'attente pour voir un Colisée dépouillé de ses gradins et autres ornements...je ne recommande pas la visite intérieure de ce site...

title: Must visit if you are in Rome for the first time, but for the second time, maybe not.
text:
I visited  in Colosseum for the first time  almost 20 years ago. At that time, it was great to see the colosseum without a long long queue.. Now the situation is totally different. 

Around 11 o'clock, there was a very long queue to buy a ticket. I do not know how long will it take to buy a tickets, someone told us that  it might take 2 hours. there,  some guys tried to sell us * skip the line ticket* with a guide. Ticket costs normally 12 euro, but the ' skip the line ticket' costs 40 euro. But my family did not  want to wait for a long time, so we decided to buy the skip the line tickets.

So we did not have to wait for 2 hours  to enter, but they had some  problems with group -enter- arrangements, so we had to wait for 30 minutes outside..it was very hot and sunny day.
 
The colosseum itself was great, big and magnificent. But 'skip the line 'was not worked very  well, so we had to wait another 30 minutes to enter the Foro Romano after the visiting Colosseum. They did not get   enough tickets for all people in the group, although all of us paid 40 euros! I could not believe that.

Anyway, without a guide, we could not enter the Foro Romano, so we had to wait until they solved the problems.  I understand Italian  language, so I knew why we could not enter. 

The second time in the Colosseum was very stressful, that was enough. For me 40 euro was very expensive and too much to  asked. I would recommend you to go there early in the morning and get normal ticket which price is only 12 euro, or you may reserve tickets on line in advance. But you may have to wait for some time to enter anyway.

title: Tour eiffel
text: Attention Arnaque avec headout !!! Ne surtout pas réserver avec eux. Ils font payer plus cher et avec rien au bout. Il n'y avait personne au point de rencontre et impossible de rentrer car ce qui.ous est envoyé par mail ne correspond pas à un vrai billet. Je me suis faite arnaqué de 126 euros pour 4 pour ne pas pouvoir monter.

title: Typical "thing" to see in any major city
text: Check, we saw it.  Outside was impressive but the inside, so so.  Much scaffolding as work is being done to unearth the lower level.  We were much more impressed with the Roman Forum.

title: Trop de monde, pas pu visiter
text: Attente, beaucoup trop longue, pour obtenir des billets. Il y a toujours trop de personnes qui visitent. L'organisation devrait être modifiée et changée, car perte de temps.

title: Mercato
text: La bellezza del monumento viene offuscata dai tantissimi venditori abusivi che ci girano intorno e che cercano di rifilarti qualsiasi cosa

title: Don’t use “Get Your Guide”
text: We, like thousands of others, thought we would “skip the line” at the Colosseum. We were at the meeting place 45 minutes early just to receive our little sticker, then meet our guide with a group of 20. Honestly the guide was fine, but the “tour” itself took 2.5 hours. Believe me you are not getting any bonus tour time, you are standing around, in a line, or waiting for your group’s time slot to go in. Out of the entire time spent, we were looking at the actual inside of the colosseum for maybe 1/2 hour. What a disappointment. We have had some great experiences in Rome, but this will leave a bit of a bad taste. By the end of the tour we were so thankful it was over, and had taken maybe 8 photos. BS marketing and they never tell you the truth, even when asked outright. I would think twice before using this company.

title: Crowded and overrated
text: We bought a combined ticket for the Palatine hill and the Colosseum for 12 euros. There are a lot of people in front of the Colosseum, who will try to offer you skip the line tickets for 35 euros. Do not agree - it is too expensive. If you go to the Palatine ticket office, the queue there is smaller and you can buy a ticket for both attractions at a much cheaper price. In the afternoon the queue for the Colosseum is not that long and there is a different queue for people with tickets. The Colosseum is well preserved, but pretty crowded and does not offer much, except for a good view of the Palatine hill. It might be interesting for children. Personally, for me 30 minutes were more than enough.

title: Overpriced All Access Roman Guy Tour
text: I do not have any issue paying if the value is worth it - there was just something missing from the Roman guy tour. Sadly, I am just not sure what it was....The company youtube videos are amazing, and I really got a feel that they had their act together. I paid extra for the underground, top levels etc. While I paid for this access, I wish I knew that their tour guide does not do the tour within the Colosseum. The handing in of the Roman Guy listening device to take another device from the Colossuem- stupid waste of time. This is more an issue with the colosseum staff than Roman guy. The tour leaves you feeling like you could have gotten more information. Steps are steep & not for anyone with any sort of mobility issue(s), bad knees, hips etc.  Anyway, for what was paid, I think we should have at least received a snack after the colosseum tour ended - we were starving.

title: 'Skip the line' - to then have to get in more lines. Pfft.
text:
Yes, a tick off of the bucket list, but wow was it hassle getting in, and was it worth it?...

Lines were incredibly long and we were getting conflicting information from 'helpers'. We had pre-ordered tickets on the official website, though had to collect these tickets as we had the 18-24 EU citizen reduced entry. It was only after the 3rd person we'd asked with a staff lanyard on, that we found out that we had to queue for an hour up at the ticket office behind a tree to the side. 

The queue wasn't the worst of it, the constant selfie-stick, powerbank and water bottle sellers coming around really grated on me. No toilets or anything outside it seemed. 

Once we had our tickets we then had to wait until 30 mins before our entry time to then queue up again, to go through security. Then queues at the toilets inside (which were pretty awful). Then queues to get through the ticket gates. Once in, it's impressive but so much of it is being restored. The entire centre part is covered in plastic sheeting and scaffolding, really detracting from the experience. 

We then left after maybe 20 minutes inside, and then spent considerably longer exploring the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, which was definitely a better experience - luckily this was included in our ticket. 

So all in all, my advice would be to just admire the colosseum from the outside, spend the time you'll waste queueing up here exploring other gems in Rome.

title: Did not book a tour
text: We did a "skip the line" tour last minute.  Too many people and no headphones.  Take the time to book ahead.   So crowded could not enjoy and did not get the history we would have liked.  Beautiful structure and would have loved to learn more about it.

title: Знаковое место
text: Быть в Риме и не увидеть Колизей наверное не возможно. Людей много и на обзорных площадках. Очереди кругом. Везде и всюду портят впечатление о величественности сооружения.

title: Historisk grunn
text:
Vi tok undergrunnsbanen fra nærmeste stopp Ottavino fra der vi bodde nær Vatikanstaten. Vi måtte skifte linje på stasjon Termini der vi gikk av på stasjon Colosseo som ligger like ved Colosseum.
Vi kjøpte en kombinert billett, der vi først var innom en svær park som inneholdt en masse severdigheter, som paletinerhøyden, Forum Romanum osv. Det som var merkelig var at vi i billetten fikk et besøkstidspunkt for å gå inn på Colosseum. Etter at vi hadde vært et par timer i parken gikk vi ut og bort til Colosseum. Men det viste seg at vi ikke fikk komme inn der før om et par timer. En merkelig ordning som gjorde at vi var nødt til å slå i hjel et par timer. I området rundt Colosseum krydde det av selgere, tiggere og folk som ville guide deg rundt. Vi fant heldigvis en liten rolig bar like i nærheten. Da vi endelig kom oss inn i Colosseum var følelsen at det var greit å ha vært der og sett det, men ikke verdt alt oppstyret med å komme inn.

title: che tristezza
text: quanto caos, quanta sporcizia. eppure è sempre una visione mozzafiato. non ce la meritiamo. invece di tanti sbarramenti di ferro, ci vorrebbero tanti ma tanti vigili a fare multe a chiunque si azzardasse a buttare per terra anche un solo mozzicone di sigaretta. la legge c'è, bisogna farla rispettare.

title: Le Colisée quoi
text:
Des arènes... Celle de Nîmes sont tout aussi belles.... 
Une queue interminables qui nous a fait renoncer ...

title: Muy interesante
text: Mal organizada la entrada y visita, es una pena pero no evitas las largas colas ni con tickets comprados con antelación ni sin ellos

title: Skip the Queue - Or not - headout tours
text:
In our case it was definitely not, paid 180 euro for the tour of the colosseum and hill. A fair amount and a lot more than the official ticket office.
The guide appeared to have limited knowledge, I gleaned this much from the fact that they barely spoke during the 50 minute wait that it took us to get into the palantine. Yes you read that correctly, 50 minutes, our tour started at 2.30 and we spent the next 50 minutes queuing. Not what I expected from a skip the queue tour.

Very disappointed and left without sticking around for the rest of the tour which after 50mins was going to be severely curtailed anyway.

I’d recommend booking official tickets in advance so you don’t need to chance your arm with these sharks.

title: Hektisk!
text: Pågående selgere og utrolig stressende sted. Følte oss jaget rundt, sto absolutt ikke til forventningene.

title: Engaño
text:
El jueves 18 Abril teníamos contratado un tour por Roma que incluía visita guiada y entradas por Foro, Coliseo y Palatino con un precio de 40€ persona. 

 Un día antes nos notifican de la visita se adelanta media hora por seguridad ya que ese mismo día hay un vía Crucis en el Coliseo.

 Nos presentamos a tiempo, primero nos llevan al Foro, empieza la visita con normalidad pero a los 5 minutos el guía recibe varias llamadas de la agencia en las que le dicen que debemos empezar por el Coliseo , el guía  intenta solucionar esto con los responsables de seguridad con intención de que nos dejen salir al Coliseo y volver al Foro y Palatino a lo que le dicen que no. Así que el guía retoma la visita al Foro pero con un ritmo acelerado y menos tranquilo.
Después de esto nos enseñan  el Coliseo con todo detalle.

A las 12 concluye una visita con los incumplimientos de:

La duración de la misma ya que en vez de 3 h nos dedican apenas 2h.

La visita al Palatino que no se realiza. Y previamente habíamos contratado un servicio de guía de 3 horas.

Civitatis nos ha ofrecido una visita al Palatino el día siguiente a las 8.30h de la mañana cuándo ya tenemos contratadas y pagadas otras visitas.

title: amazing architecture
text:
Fascinating to finally see in person! pre-book tickets though! The 'skip the que' line moved just as fast as the normal line, so no point paying extra money for 'skip the que'. 
Very crowded, would recommend availing of the tour!

title: Du temps !
text: Attente 3h pour acheter les tickets. Racoleurs pour acheter une visite guidée USANTS, une fois entré très mauvais fléchage sur le site.

title: Entradas COLISEO con MUSEMENT
text:
Una gran estafa.
Compré 2 entradas para el Colioseo, Palatino y Foro romano por algo más de 50€. Resulta que el documento que envían no son las entradas, sino unos tickets que deben cambiarse en un supuesto punto de encuentro. Nos perdimos, no encontramos el punto de encuentro y al entrar al Coliseo nos dijeron que esos tickets no servían. Contacté con la empresa y me dijeron que podría reunirme con el siguiente grupo. Media hora antes de la fijada para el punto de encuentro, estuve en la Piazza del Colosseo que se supone que era el punto de encuentro y no apareció nadie. Llamé a la compañía, y me atendió en español una señora muy borde que después de tenerme 20 minutos al teléfono, me colgó. Por lo que no pudimos visitar el Coliseo ni recuperé los 51€. Muy deficiente. NO LO RECOMIENDO

title: Don‘t buy skip the line with Ticketbar
text: Ticketbar is total scam. They sell timeslots that are sold out, take your money and don‘t give instructions how to get your money back. They force us into taking timeslots that are not possible for us due to other sightseeing program.

title: Great place but book tickets beforehand
text:
Pros
Fab historic place to visit
They do night tours which look amazing
Audio guide is very good

Cons
We queued 2hrs..... 1hr was moving. The next hr we watched as security allowed the groups and pre booked tix in....we were c 10 people from security so it was infuriating waiting in the same place, near the engrave, for 60 mins!!
Toilets - huge queue

I'm glad we went, and on a day that was overcast - so perfect weather for it.

Tip to visitors- buy tickets in advance!!

Tip to management - let people from the normal queue in more regularly.
Look into more toilets

I'm glad I visited but I don't need to visit it again

title: Crowds.. crowds and more crowds but still impressive structure
text: Impressive structure, we took a tour but no needed can be done on your own.  Beware, very crowded and  not really easy for  elderly persons and people will push you.  In addition baby carriages also being pushed and they will shove you out of the way.

title: It’s big, It’s impressive, it’s the Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheatre)
text:
I’ve dreamt of visiting this site for decades, long before Russel Crow made it a 21st century must-see Hollywood hit-list, it’s been a mecca for all history geeks like myself.

I’ve been, I’ve seen,  and I have conquered the mighty structure, but I have some advice for you:
a) BOOK tickets, go to the official website, nominate your day/time, and if you want, pre-order an audioguide.
b) Do NOT go with a guide, especially the ones loitering outside. The guided tours are a mass group affair that will not offer you chance to soak in the atmosphere, instead encouraging you to keep up and keep moving - hence it’s a ‘tour’ of the amphitheatre. I’m not saying that all guides are bad, but, if you want to take your time and explore, they aren’t what you want.
c) BOOK tickets, no, it really is important - if you book you get skip-the-line, and the lines are MASSIVE, it’s not just about the ticket, it’s about not wasting valuable time waiting for the security check, after waiting to buy a ticket. Instead, you’re inside the Colosseum, soaking in the history.
d) Don’t be discouraged if you feel a little cheated when you get in there because it’s not quite what you expected. This is an ancient building, not a Hollywood film-set. It’s a ruin, the outside being the most dramatic, the underground and Belvedere sections are off-limits to most visitors, so you’ll only get a glimpse of the reconstructed stage area of the arena, and a small patch of what the seating was like.
e) close your eyes and IMAGINE what it was like in the day. Hear the roar of the crowd, feel the energy of the gladiators and animals as they came out on the arena. This isn’t make-believe, it happened, there, at your feet. This is real history.

title: Colosseum
text: OK, I get it. Its a world heritage site and is gonna be busy - but bloody hell! its total chaos. Find a guide and then just go with the flow and after about an hour you are in. Hard to see anything just way too many people. one of the the top 10 places you want to visit but not worth the hassle.

title: Dissapointed
text: In the pictures it looks better. Even if you had the tickets taken in advanced there were very long waiting lines.

title: Not worth the wait
text: Waited 1 hour 30 minutes to get a ticket in a queue that really wasn’t very long. No clue why it took so long to buy a ticket. Once I finally got into the colosseum itself, walking around it was near impossible due to the high volume of tour groups clogging up any space to walk around. In my opinion, although the building is impressive to witness once inside, there is barely any historical information about the place unless you want to pay for an audio guide and the amount of people inside makes it hard to appreciate the place.

title: Lovely but be careful
text: Is better to buy tickets online with skip the line. Beautiful structure really enjoyed it but wish I booked a guided tour with arena and underground too, but be careful with the scammers around the colloseum they will steal of you!

title: Overrated
text: My family ( myself, husband, 9 year old & 16 year old) visited the colosseum. We made the mistake of not getting tickets ahead of time. Actually, I tried to buy them online but the official website wasn't working. When we got there it was ridiculously crowded. There were no signs showing where to buy tickets. We spent a lot of time walking around trying to find the ticket line. There are a lot of tour people trying to get you to pay for their 35 Euro tickets instead of the 12 euro regular tickets. There were also a ton of people trying to sell you water and assorted junk. There's no one around telling them to leave so you just have to ignore them. The ticket lines & security lines are poorly run, not at all organized. I would have been better off just getting pictures of the colosseum from the Roman Forum. Luckily your ticket gets you into the Roman Forum which was amazing.

title: Organisation inexistante visite gâchée
text:
Organisation déplorable !
Cela ne sert à rien d’acheter vos billets sur internet et de payer le surcoût 
En effet 3h de queue sous un soleil de plomb
Mauvais renseignements du staff
Il n’y a que 2 caisses coupe file ouvertes donc 3 h de queue
Le staff du colisee devrait prendre exemple sur le Vatican où tout est carré 
Le problème au Colisee c’est qu’ils ne tiennent pas compte de l’heure de réservation tout le monde vient en même temps!
A revoir d’urgence!!!!

title: Неплохо!
text:
В колизей стоит невероят6ая очередь. Если заказываете билеты онлайн, то стоите тоже в очереди но в 5 раз меньше ( она проходит за 10 мин) так как у всех, как и в аэропонту проверяют наличие подозрительных предметов, заставляют проходить через сканер итд.
Сам Колизей удивляет и восхищает. Но повторюсь снова, чтоб прочувствовать полной мерой, нужно информационно подготовиться к посещению- почитать за него, поссотреть методику строительства, то6да только будет интересно посмотреть это и воочию убедиться, что и в древние времена много можно было реализовать. Если приехал спонтанно, то скорее будет неинтересно смотреть на "кусок камня".

title: Tourist trap
text: Colosseum is an awesome place and important for history. It is being spoiled as it is a chaotic place where tourists become victims as the place is out of control.

title: Che caos!
text:
Dopo quattro giorni passati a passeggiare per Roma, ammirarne le sue bellezze ed assaggiarne la cucina, abbiamo deciso di chiudere con una visita prenotata online del colosseo e dei fori. Non potevamo fare scelta peggiore! Che caos, disorganizzazione, sporcizia. File caotiche, turisti abbandonati a se stessi nel totale disrispetto delle antichità da cui erano circondati. Una guida inglese ha addirittura consigliato al suo gruppo di andarsi a bere una bottiglia di vino sull'altare della patria, vista stupenda e nessun controllo, ha detto!!!
Sconsigliato soprattutto a chi ha bambini per cui non c'è niente per rendere la visita più interessante.

title: So many people
text: It is really a beatiful place. The colloseum is gigantic and when I'v seen it. It reminded me of the movie gladiator. The only problem is that you have to have a reservation. There is only a small chance getting in because of the number of people around. Especially in Easter.

title: Nothing special at all!
text: Colosseum is a great monument, well known and respectful without a doubt. It is nice outside as you see it, especially during the night. But inside it has nothing at all to show! I respect monuments and their history but I didn’t expect the colosseum could be so indifferent. If I had another chance, I would waste my time to visit it from the inside. Also, book your tickets online, otherwise there is a long queue.

title: Zu teuer, zu viele Leute, zu viel von wenig
text: Obwohl das Kolosseum zweifelsohne vom ein imposanter Bau ist, zuwenig aufregendes im Innern. Eine Ruine halt.

title: Amazing site - BUT terrible customer service
text:
We had pre-booked a guided tour online before reaching Italy.  When we reached our AirBNB at Rome the evening before our scheduled trip, we learnt that the Rome Marathon will be held the next day. It will start and end at the colosseum, so all roads will be closed. We therefore set off early and walked 4 km (not an easy feat when you have a kid with you). Google Map gave misleading info that there were some detoured buses running (caused us to walk an extra km). But the main problem arose when we reached Foro Romano and were stoppoed by the police. Basically, all pedestrian access were closed as well due to the Marathon till 3pm whereas our ticket for the guided tour was scheduled for 2:45pm! There were no clear guidance and after walking another 2km and trying all possible access points, we finally reached the ticket office at 2:55pm. I tried changing the tour time given the road closures but was told that it was our responsibility to reach on time. The biggest joke was when I asked what were our options - they said that our only option was to cancel the ticket without any refund!!!
We however later learnt that we can still enter and walk around even though we miss the guided tour.
It is unfair when you pay 40 Euros (2 adults + 1 kid) and get this sort of treatment.

title: Tjah
text: Ik had me er iets meer van voor gesteld. Schijnbaar hebben enkele gekken dit gebouw berooft van alle marmer, zidat het nu uitziet als een onafgewerkt gebouw , chapeau !!

title: Viaggio istruzione
text:
Il monumento, per chi lo vede la prima volta, è imprescindibile, ma purtroppo è sempre molto affollato; inoltre vi sono lungaggini per i controlli di sicurezza al momento di accedere. 
All’interno, nella galleria in quota, sono presenti frammenti di sculture, e modelli dell’edificio con schede tecniche esplicative ... ció che rimane della cavea sono le strutture in elevazione con le varie gallerie e la costruzione appare in tutta la sua condizione di rudere!
Migliore la facciata esterna, in particolare nella porzione recentemente ripulita. 
Bravo Della Valle! 😉😃

title: Neat to see but not that impressive
text: A ship load of steps inside and all are irregular, so you need to be able to climb up and down steps, there is an elevator but there is big line to use it.

title: Aggressive Staff Member!!
text: Unfortunately our tour was cancelled with no prior warning (via the official site) which was disappointing. We could still access the colosseum on our own. After accidentally taking a wrong turn, we ended up in the main arena which apparently was under a different ticket. We were approached by a female member of staff and told that we weren’t supposed to be in that area. She proceeded to shout at us extremely aggressively which was extremely uncalled for. There was a complete lack of signage.

title: You can see the best part from the outside
text: It's an easy add on with the combined Forum ticket, but the crowds are huge and the inside isn't nearly as cool as the outside. If you only have 1 day in Rome, you can skip this one since it's a pretty big time drain.

title: Bof, heureusement qu'il y a le forum romain
text:
Le colisée est probablement plus beau à voir de l'extérieur que de l'intérieur. Heureusement que la visite est groupée avec le forum romain qui est bien plus intéressant.
Pour les billets, essayez de les acheter en ligne ou de les prendre un jour au soir pour le lendemain, sinon n'aillez pas peur de faire la file.

title: Très mal organisé !
text: Le site est magnifique mais l'organisation déplorable, personne pour vous indiquer la bonne file, à la merci des guides qui vous font payer une fortune pour passer devant tout le monde !!!

title: Vey busy
text: Like most landmarks it’s helpful to get here early to try to beat the crowds. We had purchased a general entry ticket the day before so we got in a little early. In previous visits we were able to visit the ground area but this is cordoned off now and you can only visit if you purchased an expensive ‘see the colosseum’ ticket.

title: Poderia ser melhor
text:
Ninguém pode negar a fantástica experiência de estar num local que acumula tantos séculos de história.
  No entanto a organização , tanto quando se fala no acesso, quanto a progressão pelas áreas do Coliseu deixam a desejar.
 Não foi minha primeira visita e novamente sai com a sensação que não aproveitei totalmente a visita.

title: Édifice grandiose, mais...
text: Le voir de l extérieur aura suffit ! Sinon c'était 3 heures de queue ! On en a profité pour visiter d'autres sites, où il y a moins de monde !

title: Very crowded, even in February
text: We were in Rome for one day in February 2019. We enjoyed the city with its beautiful architecture. The Colosseum is huge and impressive. But there were so many people that it was almost impossible to rest for a short time and just enjoy the place. Many tourist guides tried to convince us to join one of the tours they offer. So we didn't feel very comfortable.

title: Esperava mais!
text:
Confesso que por ser um dos cartões postais de Roma eu esperava mais do famoso Coliseu!
Foi uma visita tão cansativa e um pouco decepcionante que acabei não indo ao Palatino e Foro Romano.
Acredito que vale a visita, pois não dá pra pensar em Roma sem Coliseu, mas vá preparado para ver um monte de ruínas e somente isso.
Vale também pelo lado histórico!

title: Le supplice du Colisée
text: Avec nos billets coupe fil en main, nous pensions échapper à la foule.. Bien m'en a pris. Vous avez le droit à 2h de queue afin d'y récupérer votre fameux billets sous une chaleur étouffante. La guichetière qui doit avoir oublier le mot amabilité de son dictionnaire vous indique l'heure de votre passage: 1h30 encore à patienter sous cette chaleur et encore pour 30 min de queue avant de finalement commencer votre visite. Cela perturbe fondamentalement votre visite et vous appréciez beaucoup moins ce lieu pourtant chargé d'histoire.

title: Be prepared to wait in line for tickets
text: Ticket line is at the Roman fort down the road and not at the Colosseum it self, long ques and staff that dont have a clue. Too many kinds of fast track tickets available and makes buying tickets a little hard. We had a Roma pass, didn't get told we would have to get tickets from the Fort until we got to the Colosseum (after we had just been to the fort) Que was big but waited and lots of people didn't know if they were in the correct que or not. Got to the counter to be told " you just walk in" and we told him that we tried that and got sent here for tickets!! After a few chats with a colleague and another 10mins waiting she said for him to give us our tickets. Which we were then booked in for 1545. So had about 2 hours wait. We arrived in our que (again) and went into the far left que and fast tracked ourselves in. Be prepared to be bag searched and scanned everywhere you go in Rome. The Colosseum was ok, it had lots of work going on so a lot of the bottom was covered, it has been rebuilt and touched up.so much I'm not sure if any is original now. Out of all the wow moments in Rome this wasnt one of them. But your ticket to the Roman Fort Incs the ticket for the Colosseum so if your prepared to wait I'd say go for it

title: High expectations
text: It looks amazing from outside! And amazing at night but inside of it was not appealing, I dont know if it was because it was raining and we couldn’t access every point or it’s just how it is.

title: Beau à l'extérieur, un peu moins à l'intérieur
text: Ce monument est grandiose, et il faudrait vraiment faire la fine bouche pour ne pas s'émerveiller devant un tel ouvrage. A l'intérieur, il ne reste pas grand chose des gradins ni de l'arène. Mais pour celui qui a déjà vu le film Gladiator, c'est assez facile de se projeter 2000 ans en arrière! En revanche, quelle galère sur le parvis!!! Rien n'indique où se rendre pour acheter un billet ou bien où aller si comme moi vous avez fait votre réservation à l'avance par internet (il faut aller le long du forum où se trouve des caisses) Comparé au musée du Vatican où tout est carré, ici c'est le bor***. Enfin que dire des vendeurs ambulants et des pseudos guides qui vous accostent tous les 5 mètres...?

title: Lo esperaba más imponente...
text: Está bien, nada más... una horita de visita es más que suficiente, vale por su historia, pero tampoco hay mucho que ver en realidad.

title: sort of boring
text: not much to see inside that you didn't already understand from the outside.  Romapass made it very easy to see with absolutely no line

title: Was great to see, but be careful how you organise your trip to here.
text:
Was an excellent site to see of course. We had Roma passes but was advised you had to pre book for entry and it was fully booked for the next 3 weeks. We found this strange and went along anyway. When we arrived there was a large que this true. The Roma pass wasn’t really great for this site in my opinion. There is lots of people pushing guided tours out side. We went with this option and it was 25euros per person. We waited around 10mins then the guide took us through a cue jump and then through security. I just walk away from the guide at this point and went and seen it on my accord which a recommend. 
All in all a great landmark to have seen.

title: crowded but worth a visit
text: buy your ticket online in advance, be there by the suggested time - you'll have to queue to validate your ticket, but way less than you'd have to buy your ticket on the spot. there will be a lot of tourists and a lot of ppl trying to sell tickets and offer you guided tours, so if you don't want any of that, just be polite but strong-minded and go ahead. :) keep in mind that there are areas (top floor and the arena) which are only accessible for groups on guided tours.

title: The iconic Roman ruin but the queues were too much for an older man.
text: It's hard to give a review about one of the worlds most famous ruins so I will give it from a personal perspective being a reasonably fit man of 70 yrs but some foot issues (don't like standing still for too long). I first visited the colosseum back in 1970 when the world was a very different place. No, or little security and less people due to the cost of air travel back then. I recall as a student being able to walk about inside with little restrictions and probably a small fee. We had a Roma Pass and an Omnia pass which is well worth having for the round Rome tour bus alone. Even with the Roma pass to give us a discount entry we were advised by one of the numerous information people that it would be two hours to get inside. We were then offered a personal tour at 55Euro each, which would still have involved a queue but frankly we were sceptical having had the same  sort of offer at the Vatican Museum.  We opted to walk up the steep stairs beside and just look at the outside. Have they really boarded up one of the floors so you can't look into the interior? So, you have to book well in advance, get there early in the day and just be prepared to have the stamina for the queue and take water. As always beware of the numerous touts which approach as soon as you look hesitant.  I repeat this is just the opinion of an older man.

title: Disappointing
text: Smaller than I expected. As amphitheatres go (from an academic POV) not very well preserved at all. Definitely worth going to if you're in Rome to cross off your bucket list. More impressive Roman remains out there. You're not allowed in with sun lotion or any spray bottles, which they confiscated from me very aggressively. Surrounded by scammers so you have no idea who actually works there. You can't actually get into most areas. Some parts you can get into if you pay lots for a tour. Gift shop was criminally expensive. Overall, a rather unpleasant experience.

title: Advise not to use the toilet here.
text: Plan ahead and pay extra to go with a guide and get a skip the line tickets (about £35 ea)... can also do this on the fly, subject to availability. Awesome to envisage being where gladiators actually fought. Sadly let down by chronic lack of toilets..think there is only one which very small, old and over subscribed..even men have to queue to use the disgusting urinals.

title: Druk en overschat
text: Het Colosseum is wereldberoemd. Maar erg druk, lang wachten vanwege de beveiliging. We hebben mooiere arena’s gezien, in Nimes en Arles bijvoorbeeld. Het Colosseum is wel prachtig om te zien van buiten, maar binnen viel het een beetje tegen. We zouden niet meer in de rij gaan.

title: Roma pass avec visite réservée ??? Ne vous loupez pas !!!
text:
Ne comptez que sur vous-même si d'aventure vous avez réservé de cette manière !!! 

Tout est là pour vous perdre !!! Méli-mélo de files... Personnel peu enclin à vous renseigner ou vous aiguillant mal... Et finalement... Vive la file durant plus d'une heure et la perte de votre entrée "privilège"...

title: Pas grand chose à voir
text:
Bien que l'édifice soit très bien conservé (du moins en partie), il n'y a pas grand chose à voir.
Toutefois, c'est très impressionnant, et il faut faire oeuvre d'imagination pour se rendre ce qu'il représentait à l'époque.
Passage obligatoire (tout de même)

title: Tak
text: Nie ukrywajmy trzeba to zobaczyć. Moja teściowa była tam 22 lata temu tyle się nasłuchałam o tym, ze jest tam mnóstwo kotów i to takie super jest. Chciałabym zwiedzić to właśnie wtedy. Kiedyś nie było to ogrodzone, można było zajrzeć w każdy kat. Teraz niestety czułam się jak w labiryncie, wszędzie zakaz wchodzenia.

title: ”skip the line”
text:
Gjorde misstaget att köpa guidad tur på plats, alla dessa försäljare med ”skip the line”.
Vi stod en timme i kö o sen fick vi en mkt enkel guidad tur (som man redan visste allt om) och sen var guiden tvungen att skynda vidare till kommande (lurade) grupp. 
Så köp innan eller gå vanliga kön (billigare och tog tydligen inte längre tid än vår)
Annars ett mkt intressant ställe.

title: Beau monument
text:
Il faut le voir mais y entrer ? Une vraie question a se poser.
Monument majestueux à l histoire incroyable. Un incourtanble de Rome

title: einzigartig!
text: das kolosseum muss man gesehen haben, wenigstens von außen! lange warteschlangen, bei kurztripp unmöglich sich stundenlange anzustellen. besonders viele afrikanische händler die recht aufdringlich und lässtig werden!

title: Pensavo meglio..
text:
Sinceramente forse perché monumento nominato sempre l'ho trovato meno bello di quello che pensavo
Mi é piaciuto molto di più il Pantheon... meraviglioso...il Campidoglio... spettacolare

title: It is the colosseum
text: Literally everything and exactly what you would expect from reading online. It's cool and worth seeing, I guess.. Can get the feel for it just by walking around outside.

title: Duda entrada coliseo
text: Buenas tardes, pues tengo una gran duda, voy con mi pareja a visitar el coliseo dentro de dos semanas , tenemos los tickets programados para las 16:30  horas, pero nos gustaría visitar por la mañana el foro-palatino, lo que pasa que no sabemos si existe esa posibilidad ya que nosotros tenemos el ticket con la reserva para las 16:40 y no sabemos si el primer uso hay que hacerlo a esa hora y después ya visitar el foro-palatino, alguien nos puede ayudar por favor? Es muy importante para el itinerario, muchisimas gracias

title: Atracción turística
text: En sí el coliseo es alucinante. La verdad es que hay mucho personal para atender tus dudas y guiarte y una vez dentro también está acondicionado para ir con personas mayores con movilidad reducida. Lo malo que en Italia parece que cambian las normas como mejor les conviene. Según decían en su página oficial el primer domingo de mes la entrada a muchos monumentos es gratuita, pues cuando llegamos allí el primer domingo de mes de abril no fue así. Lamentable

title: Better on the outside than inside
text:
Quite disappointed. Not sure what i was expecting. Was very grand inside and im glad i saw it but its not something i would do again. Not enough to do. Can only walk around a perimeter on 2 levels other than a couple of shops and a exhibition area on the 2nd floor. 
Glad i did but wont do it again. A spectacle from the outside.

title: Colosseum
text: Ihan ok paikka. Ehkä odotukset oli kovat, niin paikka ei vastannut leffoista saatuja kuvia. Hieno paikka kuitenkin. Jono oli satoja metrejä pitkä, mutta veti kohtuu hyvin. Kantsii varata vettä ja syötävää jonotuksen ajaksi. Silti ehdoton täytyy nähdä paikka Roomassa.

title: View from the outside
text: We had planned one of the deluxe tours of the Colusseum... but due to the Rome marathon , disrupting ALL modes of transport especially Trams, busses and road access, even taxis had problems.....so only had time to view from the outside...still EXTrEmELY impressive

title: Timed entry!!!!!
text: We were pleasantly surprised to learn that they'd begun requiring a timed entry (no extra fee), so no overly long wait as we’d expected.  This was my third time here, and it’s still just okay.  I do love the ruins for showing the construction, but I prefer visiting functioning arenas like Nimes or Verona.  A friend found the underground tour interesting, so that might’ve been a better option for me.

title: Che mattinate felici ho trascorso al Colosseo, perduto in qualche anfratto di questa rovina immensa! (Stendhal)
text:
Il venerabile Beda  cantava : “Quandiu stabit Colysaeus  stabit et Roma;quando cadet Colysaeus cadet et Roma; quando cadet  Roma cadet et mundus “ .  Ho visitato il  più grande monumento della romanità in occasione della settimana della cultura ( Marzo 2019 ).Giunto fino a noi in condizioni abbastanza buone malgrado le innumerevoli vicissitudini storiche: gli spogli dei secoli passati  lo avevano ridotto a una mera cava di materiale a buon mercato che solo l’intervento di Raffaello nel 1515 , nominato da Leone X “ ispettore generale delle belle arti”,   pose fine a tale scempio. I pochi eruditi si avventuravano di giorno fra le rovine,misurando e  studiando quelle antiche pietre, scuola e modello della novella rinascimentale architettura. La notte era luogo di mali affari, il  celebre orafo Benvenuto Cellini racconta nella biografia scritta da se stesso medesimo, di quando durante una seduta spiritica accompagnato da uno stregone  originario di Norcia venne inseguito da una brigata di demoni.
Oggi  il monumento cade, sotto i demoni di una scellerata “ valorizzazione”;  mero contenitore di  dubbiosi eventi  e   di mostre organizzate dai soliti  manager della cultura ,  che  lo hanno ridotto e svilito  a bottega,  ove esporre qualsiasi tipo di mercanzia. Se per caso  come nella settimana della cultura,  vi fosse una gratuità allora si chiude bottega :  si nega la possibilità di visitare la mostra in corso ,limitando la visita all’essenziale. Questa la logica della nuova era dei “ciandala” venuti  su dal mercato,  che denigrano il passato prerogativa  di pochi reazionari intellettuali ,  oggi fanno la conta dei milioni di visitatori paganti.
Il Colosseo è ancora lì : ormai reso illeggibile per chi volesse  meditare o approfondire l’aspetto storico- archeologico : assediato da interminabili file ,invaso da migliaia di persone vocianti  che dovrebbero secondo le intenzioni , essere appagate dal mero “ obolo” versato , in nome di una pseudo- cultura  del consenso … poi verso l’uscita e avanti un altro !

title: Business bien rôdé
text: Vous avez de l'argent? Tant mieux!parce que quand on vient en Italie vaut mieux en avoir... et beaucoup. Entre les parkings à 2 et 3 euros de l'heure, des billets que l'on prend pour le Colisée pour 2 jours mais oups vous n êtes pas au check point? Dommage vous devez repayer vos tickets. Ah bah oui parce qu il y a un check point pour le Colisée. Vous voulez rire? Le billet de 2 jours est valable à partir du moment où vous vous présentez au check point 🤣🤣🤣. Après l heure c est plus l heure. Sauf que ce n est précisé nulle part! Oh et des taxes de séjour ? Je vous en parle? 4jours à La périphérie de Rome: 42euros pour 2 adultes et 2 enfants! Ça va, non? Les routes en bon état? 🤣🤣🤣🤣 En colère? Oui car ce voyage on l a fait pour nos enfants. Spécialement pour voir le Colisée. Que l on ne verra pas finalement. Un pays où on passe notre temps à payer.
