Arrêtons de nous plaindre: la France est fantastique!

title: Colosseum
text: I was really sad to it so crowded.  But got good photos. I didn't go inside because I felt like it was commercialized soo I didn't want to ruin my idea about it.

title: Städtetrip
text:
Furchtbar voll !
Selbst ernannte Tourguides vermiesen dort den Aufenthalt.
Haben ein Ticket mit festen Zeitfenster gekauft, sieht dann aber am Kolloseum anders aus.
Dort wird muss man sich wieder in eine Reihe neu anstellen.
Dann kommen zwielichtige Gestalten und bieten “Skip the line” für Extrageld an, voll Verarsche !
Am Eingang wird dann mit der Security der Betrag geteilt.
Haben wir mehrfach dankend abgelehnt !
Kolloseum checkt und abgehakt !
Brauchen wir nicht mehr !

title: Colosseum underground and panoramic view tour
text: The tour costs more than the general admission tour but was disappointing due to the renovations/work that is currently going on. Our tour guide also asked that I sit out the panoramic view portion because  I am slower than  everyone  due  to  a bad  hip. I was  quite  shocked  by her request since  I paid  for  the tour  and  was  keeping  up  just  as  the  last  one  to  reach  each  tier. I asked  my  husband  to  go  ahead  and  go  on  without me so  he  could  at  least see what we  paid for. I was  not  offered  any type of  partial  compensation considering this  was  the type  guides request and  not  my  choice. Very  disappointing and  rude

title: ローマパス優先入場終了でした
text:
ローマパスを買うと入場が優先されるという事で購入しましたが、今は変更になり、ローマパスを購入後WEB予約が必要という事です。
WEB予約は早ければ翌日から予約出来ますが混雑時は3.4日後から予約可能という事で… 
ローマパスを買ったのに使えませんでした。

当日券をかなり並んで買うか、ローマパスを数日前に入手してWEB予約するか。

が必要とは知らなかったです。
日本からローマパスを入手してWEB予約してきた人がいました。
情報を詳しく掲載してほしいです。

title: Long lines.
text: You need to buy your tickets ahead of time or book a tour.  The wait was going to be 3 hours, so we didn't go in.

title: Organización nefasta
text: Visita viernes por la mañana. Cambiaron la ubicación de la zona de reserva de entradas. Los controladores muy bordes, groseros y rozando el abuso. Falta de información. Desorganizacion en las colas de entrada.

title: Köer....
text: Se upp. Långa köer både vid biljettförsäljning men ännu värre vid insläppet till Colosseum. Även tidigt på dagen. Många oseriösa säljare av biljetter. Och du ser ingen skillnad, eftersom de oseriösa har "idhandlingar" hängandes från halsen.

title: Gewoon langs lopen Is voldoende
text: Niet nodig om naar binnen te gaan. Let op voor de verkopers die je fast lane tickets verkopen. Over het ontstaan kun je zelf veel vinden op Internet.

title: Monumental !
text:
Très beau site, remarquable vue de l’extérieur, mais attention à l’intérieur rien à voir. 
Accès et billetterie très mal organisé. 
Aucun effort n’a été fait pour être replongé 
Dans le décor. Les audioguides sont inutiles car il n’y a que 6 explications, très sommaires. Nous avons regardé un documentaire en rentrant à la maison, beaucoup plus efficace pour avoir des explications sur ce magnifique site.

title: Strong sense of history
text: Much to see, very informative illustrations upstairs. Not too pricey if you don't take the tours. Very frustrating sellers around, they don't let you by without trying to sell their tours, always the best and the quickest way? Really.. Hard to know who is the official ticket sellers. But just go all the way to the fence by the building, take the line that says no ticket..

title: Disappointment
text:
We didn't go inside we just wanted to see it from the outside. The experience was ruined by people selling tours outside, very rude. Then you've got a ridiculous amount of what I presume are immigrants coming up to you every minute selling selfie sticks, chargers etc.

Also we walked there through a park where you can get a pretty good view of the Colosseum, the bins were overflowing with litter so much the surrounding areas were covered in rubbish as well. Piles of old Mcdonalds with flies sort of ruins the magic a little bit.

title: Busy
text:
One of the main attractions you need to visit while in Rome. 

It’s Not as big and as grand as I had in mind but apparently parts of the building was stolen to make others in the past which is why only certain parts looks amazing. 

It’s busy and apparently can get busier.  You can buy tickets to go in yourself but will have to que. even if u buy a fast track one. One quicker way is that there are tours groups just outside which costs about, I think €30( give or take) and they get you in faster. You get a little headset thing that the tour guide will speak to you through and well, guide you through the Colosseum. You also get to go to the Forum too included in the price which will cost you extra if you decided to go yourself.

title: Pas mal
text: Je recommande cet endroit pour ceux qui veulent admirer le Colisée. Malgré le tas de monde qu’il y a, il y a une bonne organisation, donc pas trop de file d’attente.

title: Meraviglioso e inaccessibile
text: Averlo aperto gratis al pubblico ci ha di fatto impedito di entrare, data la fila chilometrica per accedere. Per consentirlo a tutti non è di fatto per tutti. Preferisco pagare il biglietto

title: Cannot recommend.
text: I would  book this the day before you plan to visit. The booking company is not friendly, not helpful and will not change bookings. We booked our ticket for the same day we were to arrive in rome, and our plane was delayed 4 hours so we missed it. They refused to change it.

title: Peddlers everwhere
text: Be forewarned.  Lots of groups and peddlers all over.  The colosseum is neat, but it’s falling apart and, honestly, boring compared to the rest of Rome.

title: Not to miss...but plan ahead!
text: When in Rome this is a must see. And I feel terrible thinking or even writing this, but the whole experience of the day has tarnished my feelings about this place. I had bought a "skip the line" ticket and arrived before the opening only to realize that you still need to get a reservation time. Being sent up to Palatine Hill to wait in a security line there to get a reservation time ate up a lot of time. Waiting in a security line for an hour and a half was exhausting and confusing. As we got closer to the security screening we could see a good reason it was taking so long - NOBODY was prepared to have to take off their belts, and coats and watches etc. Having someone informing people to prepare would have made the process much quicker. We were here in March and it was warm but I could not imagine waiting that long in the summer heat. Once inside it was stunning. We stayed inside for 20 minutes tops which made the whole morning feel less worth the time. My advice - buy skip the line tickets, pay the extra 2 euro to get a reservation time and show up prior to opening or wait til later in the evening. OR go with a guide/audio guide and read up on the history of the place to make it the most interesting you can!

title: Desilusionado
text: Muy parecido a lo que hay actualmente en Merida, aunque con algunas columnas mas y mas espacio, pero totalmente desilusionado.

title: Historia convertida en negocio
text: Como monumento histórico, es un lugar imprescindible en la visita a Roma, pero si no vas como los borregos con visita de grupo no puedes acceder a la plataforma que simula la arena. Es decir, hay que pagar más para verlo todo y de eso no se avisa. Es incongruente, pues los grupos siempre molestan más y entorpecen y ralentizan el paso por cualquier lugar y eso es lo que pasa en esta atracción turística, que está plagada de grupos. Pero como pagan más, pues ya tienen ahí más negocio si cabe. Como todo en Roma.

title: Skip the Line Colosseum
text: Réservé avec Headout, une catastrophe en terme d’organisation... une visite prévue à 11h, qui a débuté 2h après, après avoir vu que j’etais enceinte! A fuir

title: Arnaque
text:
Arnaque - Voleur. Suite à une erreur de date pour une réservation sur un spectacle à Paris, nous avons appelé dans les 3 minutes! Ils ne répondent pas par téléphone et ensuite, ils vous disent qu'il fallait appeler. Aucun moyen pour les joindre!
A déconseiller.

title: Must see, but do your research
text: When you think you have done your research, do some more... The Colosseum is absolutely beautiful and, on its own, 5 stars. But some truths: booking/picking up the tickets was not clear. It had changed in the day before we arrived, in our case. There seems to be a different price, different booking method or hidden complexity for everyone who enters and was generally not well organised. Where to enter or whether to queue was not clear. Where to start a self-guided audio tour was not clear. For people with anxiety, a bit of a nightmare. Audio guide not worth it. But when you get past all that and find a quiet corner to yourself... amazing. And has to be done.

title: Rip off and over rated
text: Over rated and a rip off to be honest. Not really worth the hype I mean from outside it’s great but definitely not necessary to go inside etc

title: Great from the outside!
text:
So the Colluseum is a must see for any Rome visit. It is best seen on the outside, actually from the Roman Forum. On the inside it's 12 euro, normal admission, and 2 euro for students, which was awsome. The small gallery about the colloseum was really informative.

Unfortunately, it's quite unorganized and you can get easily lost. Also, normal admission doesn't get you entrance to the ground floor, the arena, and the terrace at the highest level. Those are for people with a guided tour only, which was dissappointing.
It's not worth 12 euro, but 2 euro it is. And also it gets you admission to the Roman Forum.

title: indrukwekkend maar te druk
text: ben er een jaar of 20 geleden ook al eens geweest en nu weer met mijn partner. Valt me vooral op dat het overal in Rome zo enorm druk is, voor het leuke natuurlijk te druk. Een groot deel van het coliseum staat in de steigers en er wordt veel aan gewerkt wat natuurlijk de beleving minder maakt

title: Looks amazing
text: I was a little underwhelmed with the inside. I think it looks so much more impressive from the outside.

title: “Skip the Line” tickets are a total scam
text: We were very excited to see the Colosseum. We bought our “Skip the Line” tickets online. Like millions of others, we were happy to pay more to avoid standing in line for hours. And just like millions of others, we were scammed. We stood in line for 15 minutes just to present our “Skip the Line” voucher. Without any explanation, our 10:30am entry had been changed to 11:40am. This occurred at 9:15am. We had made 3pm reservations to tour the Galleria Borghese, so we were concerned about the time, but not worried because we had “Skip the Line” tickets. There is an army of people wearing Skip The Line vests all around the Colosseum. You may think they are there to assist. Not so. They are there to try to sell “Skip the Line” tickets to unsuspecting visitors. One of them told us to get in the 2nd of 3 security lines. After standing in line for 45 minutes, we reached a checkpoint where out tickets were inspected. We were told we were too early, and to return no more than 15 minutes prior to our scheduled time. We vigorously protested, so they begrudgingly permitted us to proceed. We did actually arrive at the security gate at 11:45am. The line of visitors who had not purchased “Skip the Line” tickets got to security at nearly the same time. The line of people who had purchased guided tour tickets actually did skip the line and went directly to security. If you do purchase “Skip the Line” tickets, expect to wait in line for at least 90 minutes while being relentlessly hounded by numerous people selling water, hats, and Colosseum trinkets.

title: Mucho precio y mucha fila
text: El sitio es impresionante, pero soportar las filas, la mala organizacion, la malaeducacion del personal y pagar tal precio, es ridiculo para entrar en un espacio vacio donde hay que inaginarlo todo. Es ridiculo lo que hace internet, que parece que no entrar al Coliseo es no verlo y tital, lo impresionante es verlo en su totalidad y que aun este en pie. Lo de entrar es el negocio de sus patrocinadores.

title: Falta sinalização
text: Eu já tinha ido há 16 anos, porém meu marido foi pela primeira vez. Pegamos o áudio guia que nos deu uma ajuda, porém a falta de sinalização dentro do monumento é imensa.

title: Not as expected
text: This is a nice historic building, when arriving the entrance is not clear, there are no signs and lines for groups or people with/without tickets are not clearly defined. Inside was also super crowded, specially with school visits (noisy and chaotic). Compared to historic sites from the moment in time e.g. Persepolis this building does not have much to offer, specially that nice events didn't take place there.

title: Under Construction
text: I have been to the Colosseum before and you could see way down several levels to the bowels of the place. Now, except for a small area, it is covered with scaffolding, plywood, and scaffolding. Disappointing.

title: Don’t waste money on audio self guided tour
text: We were underwhelmed by the current colosseum museum.  We paid 35 euros for 2 entrance fees and 2 personal Audioguides. They give you a paper map,and it is very hard to know where to go to listen as the points and how to get to  floors are not well-marked. There are many areas only open to tour groups and not to individual paying tourists. The audio we listened to  was not that interesting and we would recommend signing up for a quality tour led by a guide if you go, instead of trying to do the self guided tour as it is not well executed. It was also very chaotic buying tickets for the entrance fee and you wait in unorganized lines. The museum area is not very well restored as they have let it decay for so many years. Hope they can bring it back to greater restoration and improve their museum support for individual tourists.

title: Haufenweise „Möchtegern-Guides“ und „Abzockverkäufer“
text: Das Colosseum ist schon ein beeindruckendes Gebäude, aus der Ferne toll anzuschauen. Aber kommt man in dessen Nähe wimmelt es nur von sogenannten Guides, die dich, für gute Bezahlung natürlich, schneller in das Innere des Colosseums bringen möchten - anscheinend. Außerdem wird man von Selfistickverkäufern und ähnlichem andauernd belästigt. Auch möchte einem ständig jemand Wasser verkaufen obwohl es das doch in einer Servicestation vor dem Colosseum umsonst und gekühlt gibt, was man hier natürlich positiv erwähnen muss. Gegen die vielen Nervensägen sollte die Stadt mal was machen. Ich kann nur empfehlen gemütlich über den Circus Maximus zu schlendern und das Colosseum aus einiger Entfernung von Außen zu betrachten.

title: Big, large place, terrible
text: The Colosseum is a most famous one to visit in the city Rome, it's larg place but a lot of people then you need more time stay in line to get the tickets, by the way coming constantly tour to sale ticket. Then you need time to explore around. It's easy to go there by public transport underground station "Colosseo"😀

title: Magnificent history
text:
The Colosseum is a must when visiting Rome.
The size and scale of the arena is inspirational.
If your into history then you wont fail to enjoy the Colosseum.
We purchased our tickets on line to save time.
There are many guys in T shirts with “Staff- Skip the line” on them and really they aren’t staff of the venue at all. Their job is to try to hook you up on one of the many guided tours. The prices do vary so don’t take the first pitch that comes along.
There is no doubt that the guides are worth their money but the prices we’re extremely high at €46 for a couple.
you could download the audio guide to your phone and pay the single ticket and listen on your headset whilst you walk around.
All in all a great experience even if a bit pricey.

title: Racket pour touristes
text:
Aucunes explications en français quand on parle pas anglais ni italien comment on fait. On achète un ticket ou il est mentionné 2 jours,donc vous croyez que c'est valable 2 jours et ben non.
En plus on peut pas faire dix mètres sans être interpellé par marchands ambulants.

title: Leuk maar niet meer dan dat.....
text: In 1979 daar voor het eerst geweest, nu weer en ook weer hetzelfde gevoel. Leuk maar niet speciaal. Heel erg druk, blij dat we tickets vooraf hadden geboekt eenmaal  daar nou ja historisch ja speciaal....nee. Weinig om te zien veel grandeur voor niets.

title: Just awful
text: The queue for tickets took over an hour. How complicated is it to ask for the right number of tickets and exchange them for money? After you’ve queued for over an hour you then get into another queue for security which is operated at a snail’s pace. I started in the queue at 9:37 and eventually got inside the Colosseum at 12:01. Just awful!

title: What a disappointment
text:
Once you swim the tide of touts, mess and  migrants trying to sell you junk,
there seems to be little control of the so called tour guides showing you one thing and selling you another. After listening to all the descriptions of the different tours there sounds like one option get the expensive all inclusive guided one. But only if you are serious, if not, it sounded like it wasn't worth the effort. We didn't go in the end. Even the historical aura of the place was ruined by the thronging masses and lack of cleanliness.

This was one of my places in to go along with the pyramids, Insert expletives here :(

title: Ojo
text:
El Coliseo es uno de los grandes de Roma y como tal, todo el mundo lo sabe.
Por eso está hasta los topes de gente( por lo menos en julio)
Las colas son descomunales y sobre todo hay que tener en cuenta que si se quiere bajar a la arena hay que pagar un plus y llevar un guía.
Nadie te avisa de esto al entrar.

title: Coliseo
text: Impresionante, aunque la entrada que se paga sólo sirve para un cierto nivel dentro del Coliseo, si quieres ir a otros niveles tienes que contratar guías y pagar más y más.

title: More needed
text: Although the Colosseum itself its jaw dropping I found that the lack of key information was quite frustrating. Unlike in the roman forum there isn't much literature dotted around so unless you have a tour guide or a video guide its pretty difficult to get all the information that makes it so special.

title: Trop cher pour ce que c'est
text: Seul le forum vaut le détour. Le Colisée est trop cher pour voir des travaux à l'intérieur et toujours faire payer plus le touriste pour des accès spéciaux. C'est moche avec tous les échafaudages à l'intérieur. La vue de l'extérieur est suffisante pas besoin de payer si cher pour voir l'intérieur

title: Per quanto ne valga la pena é complicato entrare...
text: Per fortuna abbiamo acquistato i biglietti online. Sarebbe stato sennò impossibile entrare al Colosseo ieri, domenica mattina, con 26 gradi. Code infinite e poco agevolate che scoraggiano l’entrata di un monumento storico che vale la pena vedere.

title: Gratuit avec le Roma Pass, mais pensez à réserver!
text: Nous avons voulu y aller le mardi matin, mais vu le monde (au moins 2 heures de file), nous y sommes allés le lendemain très tôt. Nous avons attendu une heure avant d'arriver au guichet. Donc, soit, vous y aller très tôt le matin, ou bien vous réservez on line un billet coupe-file. Le Roma Pass ne donne pas accès à la file rapide, il faut également réserver "on line" moyennant 2€ ... Il manque des informations en français, c'est dommage... Le bille vous donne aussi accès au Forum et au Palatin.

title: Lieu historique mais de plus en plus commercialisé
text: Le Colisée reste une merveille du monde à aller voir bien sûre toutefois je souhaite rebondir sur le fait que l'entrée à l’intérieur est payante (hors de prix et une queue immense) et qu'il n'est même plus possible d'y faire totalement le tour de l’extérieur car certains cotés sont bloqués par des gardes. Dommage, cela devrait rester un site public historique.

title: Ничего сверхестественного
text: Дважды посещала Колизей, думала, первый раз недопоняла. Все банально. Смысла нет входить во внутрь за дополнительную плату. Эмоции возникают, кода впервые ты видишь то, что на картинках изображают. Ждешь чего-то исторически необычного. Но... Все просто. Посмотреть, обзорку по Риму нужно, куда как раз и входит Колизей. Это классическая Италия, поэтому для расширения кругозора посетите. Не тратьте деньги и время. Лучше идите в Ватикан)!

title: Touts!
text: there are hundreds of touts trying to sell you a tour for 3 times the price, this made it really annoying to go anywhere near the main attractions as they were really pushy!

title: Organizzato malissimo
text: Hanno rovinato il colosseo , volevo andare sulla terrazza panoramica ma ci si poteva andare solo con la guida, che ingiustizia!

title: Coliseu
text: A compra de bilhetes é demorada, os indivíduos que circulam com coletes do Coliseu, tentam apenas vender o Roma Pass. Quando finalmente compramos os bilhetes não nos foi dado mais nenhum tipo de informação sobre o monumento. Para um postal de Roma como este a organização em torno dele deixa muito a desejar. Existem zonas que só podem ser visitadas com guia turístico, como por exemplo, a arena.

title: Skip the line guides group tour review
text: Unless you are a real history buff who wants a skewed story of the Roman's, don't get sucked in to the skip the line group tour. Check out the normal line first and assess for yourself. We spent more time outside listening to the guide, because they didn't already have an entry time like we were told, waited inline to get in just as long as the normal line, went to one viewpoint inside and the tour was over. Save your money and do the normal entry.

title: Must go but thats it
text: At least go once, better if you're interested in architecture, but the place is strangely yeerie and made me feel very cold

title: The Colosseum
text: I am very disappointed in my Trip Advisor tickets for this venue.  I always use trip advisor for things to do and restaurants.  Never disappointed until this trip.  We overpaid for a 10AM timed entry.  We were shuffled around from line to line.  Told to see different people and then finally told to walk a few blocks to a site that would verify our purchase and “issue” tickets.  We were then issued 11:25 tickets.  When we returned to the Colosseum we were told to wait in a line.  At 1230 we were admitted.  What a waste of time.  There was over a 100% mark up in the ticket price.  Had we bought tickets on site we would have been in in less than 15 minutes.  Again a bid waste of time, waste of money and much aggravation.

title: Nichts für babys
text:
Es war zwar schön endlich das Kolosseum zu besichtigen, jedoch ist es anscheinend immer völlig überlaufen. Die Schlangen wirken unendlich. Der Eintrittspreis ist jedoch völlig im Rahmen. 
Wir waren mit unserem Baby dort. Leider war es völlig überfordert vom Gedränge. Auch ist es geschichtlich noch nicht sonderlich interessiert.

title: Bastante desmejorado
text:
La verdad es que me decepciono un poco el coliseo, ya que cobran una entrada de eur 12 + la guia si uno quiere y esta re sucio y descuidado, los baños un desastre.
Es una visita que vale la pena, por su construcción e historia, pero con el valor que posee, la cantidad de gente que ingresa y lo que cobran lo deberían tener en perfectas condiciones.

title: La reserva de hora ni vale para nada
text: Teniendo hora reservada ingresamos en el Coliseo tras 2 horas de espera. El monumento es grandioso pero con verlo por fuera es suficiente añado la foto tomada desde el exterior por cierto cómo en todas las atracciones romanas no os libraremos de los atosigantes vendedores..un infieeno

title: Impressive peice of construction
text:
What a magnificent construction. Only saw the exterior but this was enough to gauge its grandeur.  The queues however were horrendous to access the inside and we did not have time. You can see quite a lot from the outside.
I think it is a must see if you are in Rome.

title: Terrible customer service !
text: We booked our ticket online . Showed up early , they check out online booking few times before we get to ticket office . At the cashier they told us gay we need to have a print of our ticket . They sent us off to the streets to get them printed .... had to wait in line again with little kids !absolutely  NO apology ......

title: Not great
text:
I really liked the Colosseum when I saw it.
Once inside I was dissapointed how it looked like. 
But this could be due to construction.

title: Colosseo
text: Bellissima giornata trascorsa al Colosseo. Secondo me il prezzo di ingresso è un po' troppo caro per quello che offre.Per il resto sempre bello in grande pezzo di storia

title: Caos
text: Impresionante monumento que es obligado visitar, pero que desluce por el desastre organizativo, el mogollón de gente y las decenas de pillos intentando hacer negocio. Una pena que el gobierno permita este desastre.

title: Inponente
text: Grande maestoso pura ingenieria una prova che erano molto più professionali nell'antichità che ora mi è piaciuto molto il servizio di sicurezza che c'è sia attorno al monumento  che all'interno del monumento non mi è piaciuto molto che è molto caro 12€ è alto ma d'altronde è un bisnes comunque inviterebbe molte più persone ad entrare non mi è piaciuto che ci sono molti lavori in corso credo non finiranno mai  comunque tutto sommato è positivo.

title: Pettymys
text: Mielestäni karmaiseva paikka. Ihan hulluna turisteja, kaikenlaisia kaupustelijoita ja jonottamista. Ulkoapäin rakennus on eittämättä hieno, sisällä ei mielestäni ollut tarjolla mitään mullistavaa.

title: Colosseum tour
text: booked a Viator through Tripadvisor - most disappointing tour we took while in Rome (and we did lots!) - Vatican/Sistine Chapel; Bus tour (2 days); Colosseum and Castel San Angelo.  All tours were well organized -  NOT the Colosseum tour - starting off - the directions to where you meet the tour director were awful (I had to call 4 times) - was told to "hurry up" when I called - as they had guests in front of them; the tour guide got lost - we couldn't hear her (the headphones were awful)  out of the 25 we started with after 2 hours - 11 pp left. This site needs some desperate attention, 2 lines to bring all the "tour" guests in - and a security check (FYI - the guard was asleep!!  Great security)   Cannot/will not recommend...don't waste your $$.

title: Molto bello ma molto sporco
text: E' un monumento simbolo di Roma nel mondo quindi andrebbe rispettato ,invece tra cartacce e altri rifiuti , venditori di cianfrusaglie in un numero esorbitante è impossibile goderselo in santa pace. Come del resto tutta Roma alla sua "Grande Bellezza" fa da contraltare ,credetemi non è retorica , la Grande Sporcizia e Incuria .PECCATO

title: Good but they need to police better due to street sellers
text: Enjoyed this visit. Some what marred by constant harressment outside to buy from “street sellers” trying to sell terrible souveniers.

title: Turister og facere
text: Et meget turistet område (selvf) men også rigtig mange pågående facere og sælgere fra forskellige bureauer.

title: Too many annoying street sellers
text: The building is obviously iconic, but our day was totally spoilt by the amount of nuisance street traders trying to sign you up to tours or buy stupid bits of tat, and the queues are unbelievable, even though we had bought a Roma card before our trip that was meant to fast track us into the colosseum, we still then was expected to queue to get an entry ticket. To be honest were so sick of being hassled by street traders we walked around this amazing structure and didn't bother to go in , we were quite disappointed not to go in but we could see from out side what we came to see. In the end the whole Colosseum experience really was huge disappointment.

title: Réservation BOOKING à exclure
text:
Ne réservez surtout pas vos billets via Booking pour le Colisée, l'entrée vous sera refusée, telle est ma mésaventure du 15 mars. En effet, les guichetiers nous ont indiqué refuser tous les billets via Booking pour l'entrée au Colisée.

Je me bat depuis pour en demander le remboursement, mais cela m'est refusé ! Pourtant j'étais une très bonne cliente Booking !

title: Beau site. Magnifique.
text: Un splendide lieu mais trop de queue. Nous n'avons pas envisagé de passer la journée dans une queue interminable autrement il faut payer des fortunes pour passer devant les autres. C'est dommage.

title: Weird, crowded and would not bother
text: Ok if you are a history buff and need to have your gladiator experience,then go here. For me, the energy was weird, lines super long (surprise) and the hawkers relentless. No I do not want to have my pic with a guy in costume, seriously. It was packed and weird and not worth the time it took to get there.

title: Infestato da venditori ambulanti
text:
Uno dei monumenti simbolo della città, merita di essere visitato ogni volta che si capita in città.
Peccato per l'eccessiva presenza di venditori abusivi che propongono ogni genere di prodotto, dal powerbank a scorciatoie saltafila, che operano serenamente nonostante la presenza delle Forze dell'Ordine in divisa.
Fate attenzione, ovviamente quello che propongono è diverso da quello che vi rifilano...

title: Disappointint
text: So many ticket touts and street sellers that can be very pushy and rude. Arrived around 3.30 and no tickets left so never managed to get inside unfortunately. Gutted! Only on a quick city break so no time to reschedule.

title: Interesting
text: The outside is more impressive,  it's worth a visit but the crowds make it kind of ridiculous. 1.5 hours of waiting right when it opened for a 20 minute visit. Roman forum is a little more worth the wait/time spent.

title: ΔΕ ΣΕ ΑΦΉΝΟΥΝ ΗΣΥΧΟ
text: Αυτό που ζήσαμε στο Κολοσσαίο ήταν απίστευτο!!!!!!! σε κάθε χιλιοστό (κυριολεκτώ) της βόλτας μας υπήρχε και ένας ,ευγενέστατα  ενοχλητικός, ξεναγός!!! Η εμπειρία ήταν τραυματική!! ΔΕ σε αφήνουν να απολαύσεις ΤΙ-ΠΟ-ΤΑ!! Δεν ξέρω αν υπάρχει κάποιος ανθρώπινος τρόπος να δεις αυτό το μοναδικό αξιοθέατο?? Αλλά αν ξαναπάω Ρώμη... το Κολοσσαίο , μάλλον, θα το αποφύγω!!!

title: Impressionnant
text: Cette oeuvre est spectaculaire. Mais les travaux de rénovation gâche un peu le plaisir et être patient pour l'entrée. Y aller de bonne heure...

title: A required stop
text: We did not buy tickets ahead of time so had to wait in line to buy them. Probably an hour wait.  We were approached a minimum of 50 times from aggressive sellers trying to get you to buy the tour to avoid the line.  They are so obnoxious and quite frankly ruin the entire experience.  I have been to the colosseum before and would not return had it not been for my teen age daughters that I wanted to see it.  Rome in general has become so over run with tourists and all the street scammers that it is not a place I care to return to.  You have to constantly fight thru the throngs of really rude tourists and groups who just walk wherever they want to oblivious to anyone around them..

title: Una pena
text: No nos gustó que estuviera tan deteriorado todo. Entiendo que tenga muchos años pero pienso que se debe mantener todo mucho mejor. Aun así por supuesto merece la pena visitarlo. Recomiendo comprar la entrada en el foro Romano para así evitar las colas en el coliseo.

title: CUIDADO CON LOS LADRONES
text:
Es la tercera vez que visito Roma y como siempre, el Coliseo impresiona. Poco puedo decir sobre una de las mejores Maravillas de Roma. Lo único que a pesar de lo cuidadosa que siempre soy en los viajes,  a la salida del Coliseo me robaron la cartera, en una bandolera que llevaba cruzada y debajo de la chaqueta. hay que tener mucho cuidado, especialmente allí porque está lleno de niños extranjeros que se dedican a sustraer de una forma generalizada. Fuimos muchos los que coincidimos en la comisaria. Yo os lo comento porque es uno de los grandes focos, donde actuan a sus anchas debido a la multitud. 
Por lo demás decir que volveré porque es uno de los sitios que más me gustan de Roma

title: Attention ticket entrée
text: Après 2 heures de file d attente nous prenons notre ticket pour le colisee et le forum romain. La. Personne au guichet ne nous informe pas que dessus il y a une. Heure pour la visite du colisee et vu le monde dedans nous sommes partis au forum en premier nous revenons au colisee vers 13h30 le monsieur nous dit que ce n est plus possible qu il y a une heure à respecter 😱 nous repartons au guichet pour leur expliquer et là nous sommes accueillis par une personne parlant français mais très désagréable qui nous traitait de menteuse que soit disant c était impossible que nous avions fait la queue ce matin pendant 2h. Très agressive elle vérifie nos tickets vois bien que l on a fait le forum le matin et nous dit je ne peux rien faire pour vous si vous voulez voir le colisee vous repayez. C est honteux tout ça pour rien avec toutes les 2 min des guides et des vendeurs qui viennent vous agresser 😠 tout ça pour rien blasée.

title: Precioso e inolvidable monumento
text: El Coliseo es una obra arquitectónica maravillosa que es visita obligada en Roma. No obstante, conviene tener en cuenta que, actualmente, la zona está en obras por la ampliación de un número considerable de estaciones de metro que afectan, de momento, a los accesos de la zona. Pero, aún así no te vayas de Roma si verlo. Como ya he dicho en otra aportación, Roma está actualmente muy vigilada. Hay numerosas cámaras, soldados, carabineris y la policía local de Roma. Pero mejor así, una ciudad segura, protegida y tranquila.

title: Imponente, porém mal cuidado
text:
É uma pena que o Coliseu esteja tão mal cuidado! 
Tudo muito sujo, filas imensas e poucas informações no local. O serviço deveria ser feito por uma empresa especializada em receptivo turístico.

title: Fantastic place spoilt by very pushy sales people
text:
The Colosseum is a fantastic piece of history and and great example of historic engineering 
However our visit was spoilt by the amount of people trying to sell us every thing from tickets to selfie sticks. The sales techniques were pushy bordering on very ruse, they would not take no for an answer and would follow us for yards trying to change our minds

title: Moet je gezien hebben, ook de binnenkant
text: Niet alleen de buitenkant is de moeite , ook de binnenkant is een must see. Aanschuiven en controles zorgen voor file, maar éénmaal binnen, vergeet je dit vlug.

title: Vendors spoil the experience
text:
The authorities really need to get a grip on the number of aggressive and persistent vendors that bombard you the minute you appear anywhere near the Colosseum. From pick pockets, selfie sticks, skip the line, etc they are everywhere. We only queued for 20 mins and it was free thanks to Culture Week. Once inside, it was a great place to see.

TOP TIP: Don't use ladies portacabin toilets inside. Floor flooded and not a nice place. Just outside and around the Colosseum, there is a clean toilet block costing 1 Euro.

If you're planning to do Forum afterwards, make sure you have sandwich/snacks and a drink. It's a huge place to walk around and can be tiring. Lots of peaceful places to sit quietly and rest. There are apparently vending machines dotted around the Forum but I didn't see any.

title: Mooi van buitenaf.
text: Colosseum is mooi om rond te wandelen aan de buitenzijde. Een bezoek binnenin vind ik eerder matig tot teleurstellend.

title: Smaller than expected
text: Visited here during culture week so did not have to pay. The usual ticket touts were around claiming the queue to get in was 2.5 hours. It took us around 30 minutes. Enjoyed the site but did it all in around an hour.

title: Hyped up too much
text:
Being a must thing to do during my visit to Rome. I couldn’t wait to get in. From the outside and from a distance it’s so pretty! It’s worth viewing from viewing points. Up close however....too many people. I always wondered why there’s a lot of sky in all the photos and it’s to crop out the swarms of tourists. 2 1/2hr que to get in. Luckily a tout got us “special tickets” for double the price so we could que jump. So we only had to que through security (thought this was a great feature though) which took around 30min. 

Touts everywhere and you don’t know who to believe as there’s so many who scam you. We saw a few being arrested! 

Once in...it’s just nothing special. There’s no signage to tell you what’s what and again it’s nothing amazing. I love historical buildings but it just really let me down. I might be in the minority hear though so it’s worth trying out yourself. 

Nice gift shop.

title: 無料デーのコロッセオ入場
text: 無料デー、ローマパス購入者は優先レーンで入場。チケット無しは7:30くらいから並んでいました。あっと言う間に長蛇の列でした。

title: Some important tips
text:
There are lot of reviews so let me just summarize my tips:
1. Book online if you can. It will cost you additional 2 eur but will help you to skip one line
2. People below 18 years are for free but you cannot get their ticket online - you can book it but you still have to queue to pick it up. It’s separate queue though than if you need to buy it (shorter)
3. Now this is where it gets confusing - forget getting your tickets at the booth across the colosseum, instead go directly to the entrance into colosseum queue. There is very confusing system with several different queues - one if you have ticket, one if you have reservation to pick up ticket, one to buy the ticket and one for tours. The irony of it all is that they all end up at the same security checks!! So if you don’t have a ticket, this will substantially save your time
4. Forget the video guide. It was a bit waste of money.

title: Couldn't wait
text:
Went on a free entry date,if you have 2 hours I would think to queue,then this is for you,but to pay as well ,don't waste your money.Go to the Opera in Verona you will see a Rome colosseum,and for a great night throw in a opera,see my review.
Verona is miles better than trudging around Rome.

title: Laat u niet vangen door verkopers
text: Laat jullie niet vangen door verkopers die zogezegd u de rij kan besparen om binnen te geraken . Wij zelf hebben een rond leiding gedaan we hebben even lang in de rij moeten staan wachten om binnen te geraken zoals de mensen zonder ticket . Het enige dat wel positief was dat je een uitleg krijgt van een gids die was wel goed . Die gids betaal je dan ook 10€ de persoon .

title: Klassisk sevärdhet
text: Visst var det otroligt häftigt att gå inne på Colosseum och höra guidens berättelser om de historiska händelserna som ägt rum här. Men galet mycket folk och ståhej kring biljetter och ”skip the line” och guider runt omkring innan man kom in i själva Colosseum....

title: Visita all Arena
text: Abbiamo prenotato salta la fila attraverso expedia, ma tt era tranne salta la fila! Il giro nell Arena comunque una volta entrati bisogna pagare un altro biglietto per accedere all anello superiore, una fila immensa per i bagni ! ( un indecenza) sporchi e poco funzionali con file sia per gli uomini che per le donne! Mi aspettavo in organizzazione migliore invece, così così!

title: Schauen und weitergehen
text:
Wer nicht als Geschichtsinteressierter unterwegs ist kann sich die 12 Euro Eintritt sparen und ne Doku drüber ansehen. Der Lerneffekt ist da größer. 
Für 12 Euro wäre ich enttäuscht gewesen. Ich meine der ganze Louvre kostet nur 15 Euro Eintritt und bietet wesentlich mehr. 
Das City Marketing in Rom ist halt echt gut...

Wie gesagt für Interessierte gut - aber zwingt eure Kinder nicht darein wenn ihr Ihnen das nicht spannend erklären könnt

title: The lines, man!
text:
Look, the Colisseum is a beautiful place. The stories, the architecture, the history, etc. is all great! But who in the hell wants to stand in line for 2 hours! We were here 5 minutes before opening time to avoid lines and GUESS WHAT?!

Terrible.
It’s worth it coming here after sundown and photographing the outside which is beautifully lit.

title: Good but average
text: The street hustlers really did ruin the experience. Nigerian men walking around with bracelets. Forcing them on your wrist then try to guilt trip you into giving them money. Spent most of the time avoiding hundreds of them. Also men dressed up asking for pictures with them and asking for a tip. The colosseum was good. Not really much to it. Pretty at night

title: Impressive Structure
text: The only reason we went to the Colosseum was because it came with the ticket for the Roman Forums. Overall a cheap purchase from a college student prospective. If you're a EU citizen it only costs 7.50 euros to see both attractions. If you're not an EU citizen, but between the ages of 18-15 then it's about 12 euros which still wasn't bad. We honestly would have paid 12 euros for the Roman Forums alone. The Colosseum was just a cool added bonus. The reason for the 3 star review is because we would have personally been just fine only going inside of the Roman Forums. The Colosseum is extremely impressive and a great piece of history to look at. However, the outside was enough for us. The inside was neat, but nothing extraordinary for us.

title: Esperienza negativa con Coopculture
text: È la terza volta che tento di visitarlo e la terza che Coopculture ne combina una delle sue. La prima: l'operatrice ha sbagliato ad inserire i dati, arrivo lì e non si trova la mia prenotazione, niente visita; la seconda: mi avvisano due giorni prima che per la Via Crucis la visita nottturna è annullata; la terza, tre giorni fa: prenoto una visita guidata in italiano, accedo, mi dicono dove aspettare, seguo le indicazioni (dove mi trovo c'è un cartello "Visite guidate", penso "OK, sono nel posto giusto") passano i minuti ma intorno a me ci sono solo inglesi. Vedo che arriva la guida, le chiedo e mi risponde che per l'italiano partono da un'altra parte. Mi dirigo lì chiedo agli addetti ma nessuno sa dirmi nulla. Morale: ho pagato una guida per visitare il Colosseo da solo.

title: Intéressant
text:
Musée dans les coulisses très instructifs.On peut presque se projeter à l'époque mais la projection s'estompe à la découverte de l'arène.Ne serait pas t' il judicieux d'en reconstituer une infime partie afin de se transporter à l'époque
Peut-être impossible à réaliser.Neanmoins un incontournable de Rome.

title: Lindo, porém, muito assédio dos vendedores ao redor
text: O lugar é lindo, te coloca dentro da história! Durante o dia os vendedores ao redor não param de oferecer serviços como tours privados, ingressos, câmbio... Incomoda.

title: Interesting but frustrating
text: We pre-booked tickets but joined the wrong queue because of poor signage and lack of staff to ask. We did enjoy when we got inside although it was frustrating that you could only visit such a small part.

title: Beautiful but lots of construction taking place
text: This place is beautiful. We paid €15 each to have a tour guide. She was very informative and gave insight to what the colosseum would have been like when it was in all its glory. Make sure you get a tour guide to beat the queues. Only 3 stars as there is a lot of work taking place inside and outside and you couldn’t get any real decent pictures without workers and machinery getting in the way

title: Zu viel kaputt
text: draußen ist die sich am schönsten. Xanten ist besser. Ist kein muss. Gibt schöne Plätze in Rom. Dann lieber den Eintritt in ein Glass Wein am Pantheon ausgeben.

title: Très beau mais...
text:
Point positif:
Le Colisée qui est majestueux et incontournable.

Point négatif:
L’organisation qui est une réelle catastrophe !!! 
Les informations ne sont jamais les mêmes en fonction de la personne du Staff à qui vous demandé.
Rien ne sert d’acheter les billets sur internet en espérant y accéder sans attendre. 
Vous devrez tout de même faire la queue au guichet pour retirer les billets grâce à vos voucher (nous avons attendu 1h30 avec un enfant de 3 ans). 
Vous pensez avoir fait le pire ... et non vous voilà reparti pour une deuxième file d’attente afin d’accéder maintenant à l’intérieur. Nous étions sur le point d’abandonner et se contenter de l’extérieur du monument.

L’accès en fauteuil roulant ou poussette est très compliqué voir impossible à certains endroits car les accès pavés sont d’époque et donc impraticables.
Les vendeurs de perches à selfies et autres gadgets sont insupportables.

Astuce: Nous y sommes allé le matin et avons constaté qu’à 14h la file était presque inexistante.
Attente au soleil, prévoyez de l’eau.

title: Honte à l'Italie / peccato per l'italia
text: Première visite de Rome et honte pour les individus à qui la ville de Rome permet de gérer les entrées pour le Colisée et le Palatin. Une arnaque bien huilée entre les rabatteurs qui promettent des visites immédiates en groupes avec guide, des vendeurs sans vergogne qui laissent les visiteurs dans l'attente d'un départ qui peut durer 2 h et surtout pour après faire la file, des guides qui touchent leurs enveloppes pour des visites expresses (surtout le Colisée qui mérite beaucoup mieux). Bref, achetez vos tickets sur internet, faites la file, ce n'est pas plus long et surtout ne faites pas travailler ces individus. La ville de Rome se rend complice de pratiques qui ne devraient plus exister, et salit la mémoire d'une partie de l'humanité et de son histoire.

title: Pas mal mais surpeuplé.
text:
Incontournable de Rome, le Colosseo vaut le détour même si la rénovation discutable et les travaux permanents rendent la visite imparfaite. 
Le gros souci est l’accès. Des milliers de touristes se pressent chaque jour et rien n’est vraiment indiqué. On se trompe de queue, on attend longtemps, de nombreuses personnes doublent. A l’arrivée, même avec des billets réservés à l’avance (fortement conseillé) plus d’une heure d’attente pour entrer. 
La visite est assez riche mais parfois confuse.

title: L’arnaque à la romaine!
text:
Cet avis ne porte pas sur le site mais sur les visites guidées en français qui sont proposées (à l’entrée du Colisée et en ligne).
PREMIERE ÉTAPE DE L’ARNAQUE (voir mon avis sur « Roman Empire Tours »): nous avions acheté via « HeadOut » des billets coupe-files Colisée-Forum-Palatin en ligne pour 44€/pers!!! Le RV est à 9h45 pour une visite à 10h. L’adresse donnée sur le billet n’est pas la bonne. Nous sommes un groupe et essayons d’appeler par téléphone pour expliquer notre retard, pas de réponse. Nous partons en courant, d’autres en taxi. Nous arrivons à 10h03 et « Luca » nous dit que c’est trop tard, qu’il ne peut rien pour nous, il refuse de nous intégrer à la visite suivante.
DEUXIÈME ÉTAPE DE L’ARNAQUE:
Nous arrivons et commençons à faire la queue. Des rabatteurs nous parlent et à 10h30, ayant peu avancé, nous payons auprès d’un jeune homme 30€/pers. pour une visite à 11h. Nous nous posons 1/2h en attendant. Le guide arrivera à 11h30!!! On était déjà un peu énervés et après 10 minutes d’intro, il nous ramène dans la queue « coupe file ». Nous sommes donc rentrés dans le Colisée à 13h!! Là, la visite fut brève et nous avons eu 10 minutes pour monter au 2e, prendre 2 photos et redescendre en courant pour retrouver le guide à 14h pour la suite. Et LÀ, SURPRISE... Le guide nous abandonne et nous laisse avec les rabatteurs qui nous disent qu’on doit attendre un autre groupe pour commencer la visite... Nous sommes déjà 40 (notre groupe de 15 + le groupe Roman Empire que nous avions loupé !!!)... On était dingue! Au bout de 40 minutes, on a fini par commencer la visite du Palatin et du forum avec un charmant guide de Roman Empire qui n’avait aucune information ou presque à nous donner. 
Conclusion: temps d’attente total: 4 heures ; temps de visite = 2h pour 138€!!!!
C’est scandaleux que la ville de Rome et l’office de tourisme laissent faire des arnaqueurs pareils! Petite précision: « Luca » de l’agence, qui disait ne rien pouvoir faire pour nous, est venu discuter avec ses collègues en fin de matinée...

title: Ristiriitainen kokemus
text:
Olen intohimoinen historianharrastaja ja kierrän kulttuurikohteita ja museoita paljon. Colosseum on ollut pitkään listalla.
Pahinta on loppumattomat jonot ja valtavat ihmismassat. Aamupäivällä lippujono oli vähintään tunnin mittainen. Päädyimme osallistumaan Gladiator Toursin opastettuun ryhmään, jolla pääsi jonojen ohi. Hinta oli 27 euroa per henkilö. Yleensä en edes harkitsisi opastettua kierrosta, mutta täällä jonottaminen olisi ollut järjetöntä. Lisäksi oppaiden kieli- ja ammattitaito oli iloinen positiivinen yllätys.
Colosseum itsessään on tietysti massiivinen ja merkittävä pala historiaa. Historiaa rakastavalle elämyksenä paikka oli kuitenkin jonkinasteinen pettymys valtavine väkijoukkoineen - mitään autenttista tunnelmaa siellä ei pääse kokemaan.
Lyhyesti: vältä jonot ostamalla opastettu kiertue paikan päällä, netistä etukäteen varatut kierrokset ovat tuplahintaisia.

title: Must see
text: This is a must see if you love history.  Go early though before it gets too crowded.  Honestly, I enjoyed the view of it from a distance more that actually being in there.

title: Biglietti salta cosa che non fanno saltare la coda
text: Compriamo i biglietti online salta coda in anticipo per poi trovarci il giorno stesso a dovere fare più fila di chi non aveva il biglietto perché “oggi va così, c’è troppa gente”. Vergognosa questa organizzazione approssimativa e molto italiana in cui fa comodo prendere il soldi in più del salta fila e poi lasciare le persone ad aspettare per di più dando risposte contrastanti con modi maleducati e irritati. Spero almeno che rimborsino la differenza...

title: The queues to get in were too long for us!
text: My husband and I were in Rome for a short trip to see the rugby, so the sights we fitted in around that were all a bonus. The view from the outside of the colosseum was enough for us (if you can ignore the hoarding and the building site right next to it) as the queue to get in was crazy. It was a Saturday though (although I’ve been many times before and have yet to find a quiet time!!). Beware of all of the “tour guides” trying to stop you to see you a tour starting with “don’t worry, I work here” then going off on a script of how paying to go in with them will mean you don’t have to queue for 1hr 30mins. There are loads of them and they won’t leave you alone (spoils it for those who really are just happy to see it from the outside). My advice would be to get there early and ignore all the people who approach you outside, even when you’re in the queue they won’t leave you alone!

title: Mobbed
text:
Booked jump the queue with gladiator entry, and it's not worth the cost. 
Basic entry with audio tour is the best way.

title: Visita ao Coliseu
text: Valeu o local mas muito mais pelo guia turístico, contratado ítalo-brasileiro de seu nome Paolo da Tour in the City, que no início complicou por termos chegado atrasados. Aconselho a ir directamente ao meeting point . O gps não funiciona por isso questionem à policia pelo endereço.

title: Remarkable building even in ruin
text: A must to see and walk around even if you opt to not wait in the inevitable lines.  We had a 3D Goggle view with our Italy Segway Tour-Rome to see how it looked in its heyday.

title: Must see, logistics could be improved
text: Colosseum is a must see attraction when in Rome with its impressive history. The entry system didn’t work as anticipated as even with the prebooked tickets we ended up spending plenty time queueing in the reserved tickets line plus took s while to find it.

title: A Victim of its own Success!!!
text:
Built between AD  69-79 the Colosseum positions itself as one of the worlds great sites. Undoubtably it should be, sadly, currently it is not.
We booked a tour online a week before to avoid the crowds. Upon arrival there are numerous entrances into the Colosseum which are badly signposted, leaving hundreds of people struggling to find the correct entrance whilst leaving themselves open to numerous individuals advertising themselves as tourist guides, many are not.
After finally going on our tour, the site is so crowded with tourists you are walking with hundreds of others all jostling to find a viewing spot. This is in late February - goodness knows what the Summer period must be like.
There is good news if you book to go to the upper tiers and the Hypogeum, probably 95% of tourists do not go there because you have to pay extra for access. The tour then becomes interesting, not many people and excellent views of the Colosseum and the Palatino and Roman Forum beyond.

title: Overrated overcrowded rip off attraction
text:
It was a bad decision to visit this place inside. First l wanted to buy just simple entry tickets through their website for £12 pp but this doesn’t give arena access. So l bought tickets online through a travel agency for €28 pp entry with arena access and Palatine Hill visit.  I was a bit sceptical about this purchase but collection of tickets surprisingly went well. They took us in with a guide as a group, about 20 people in one go.
First we went through arena access gate and got 15 minutes to take photos. We had to stay on the right side of the podium because another group was on the left. After this we could walk around on our own on the floors. We bought audio guide for €5, don’t do it, poor info wasted money. We walked to the other side where we find a smaller podium, which made it possible to be almost in the arena just like on the other side we paid for. So this is what l call rip off, anyway my bad, thus time l went for it.
In general you will find at least 1000 tourists inside, very crowded and it was not even high season. Nowhere to find a staff member if you have questions or need directions.
Outside lots of dodgy people are trying to sell you tickets, guided tours, African bracelet, selfie sticks, water etc. It’s hard to enjoy the site and view, l felt constantly harassed. Especially because pickpockets are everywhere, this stands for all other attractions, tube, restaurants, you are basically always on high alert and watch your belongings while trying to embrace the beauty of this wonderful city.
If you want to really enjoy Colosseum, go after sunset and take some awesome night pictures.

title: Watch Gladiator instead....
text: decided to visit as part of walking tour...was overcrowded...badly organised…..queues everywhere and going nowhere....lots of steps....to see basically lumps of stone....tour guides were like barking dogs telling people they couldn't go places etc....I was yelled at a couple of times....couldn't get out of there fast enough.

title: Beware
text: We went on Friday at 305pm and having gone through the collosseum found the other parts we had paid for access to (the forum and pallentine hill) were closed. Really poor. To be frank, you can get what you want from the collosseum by looking at it from the outside IMHO. Also the voice guide is a real waste of money. Rip off.

title: Hay que evaluar en la actualidad si vale la pena la larga espera para entrar
text:
Siendo el Colosseo un imperdible en Roma, la organización actual para la entrada está muy mal. Debido a regulaciones de seguridad por la contingencia actual, se debe pasar por chequeo de Rayos X y sensores de metal; esto se hace muy lento siendo las filas enormes y la espera de insufribles 2 a 3 horas para poder entrar a esta colosal belleza. No existe una señalética adecuada para que los visitantes se preparen para el chequeo (que es igual que en aeropuertos), por lo que, sumado a la impericia de los guardias, el proceso puede tardar varios minutos, enllenteciendo el avance de las filas de personas. El edificio mismo está muy bien conservado y señalizado siendo muy fácil entender lo que allí pasó. Lamentablemente lo pequeño de sus baños localizados inmediatamente después del chequeo, las largas filas para esperar el turno y lo precario de la instalación del container que los contiene, hacen insufrible también esta espera que puede perfectamente ser de 30 minutos. 
Todo lo anterior hace que la visita deba ser planificada para unas buenas 4-5 horas. El coliseo cierra a las 16:30 Hrs; a pesar de que por internet uno puede encontrar un horario más largo, los guardias evacúan el lugar a las 16:15 Hrs. 
Vale la pena? Sí; efectivamente lo vale. Siendo este circo uno tan importante en el mundo antiguo (no el único), impresiona ver cómo las cosas que hacía la gente hace 2000 años son las mismas que en la actualidad. De todos modos, es más impactante por fuera que por dentro; el visitante deberá evaluar sus tiempos y eventualmente, entrar sólo al Foro Romano y Palatino y evitar estas filas insufribles.
Siendo la visita al Colosseo una de las grandes atracciones de la ciudad, visita imperdible en Roma y maravilla estructural, es inconcebible que sólo existan 3 máquinas de rayos X a la entrada y no haya explicación a los turistas de cómo prepararse para el chequeo; esto no pasa en los aeropuertos, porque están muy bien organizados. La ciudad debería utilizar una parte del dinero recaudado para mejorar este punto. Tendrían muchísimos más visitantes de los que logran entrar en la actualidad.
He visitado el Coliseo romano antes y esto no pasaba; la entrada era muy expedita t los tickets se podían adquirir en la taquilla de adentro.

title: A lot of touts for a lovely day out
text:
I liked the colosseum. It’s a really cool building and you do have to visit if you’re in Rome. There are many viewing points if you’re willing to walk a little bit around. I don’t think you need the internal tours as a friend described it as “more of the same, but on the inside”. If you’re interested in it’s history and construction then maybe a tour would be for you, but for just appreciating the vast scale of the building you can get all of that from outside. 

The only downside is the touts and street vendors. There are literally hundreds of them. Selfie sticks, open-top bus rides, mobile phone chargers, average artwork, and bracelets. So many bracelets. It’s easy to avoid them, a polite “no thank you” keeps them away, and it does get frustrating after the 10th time, but not stressful at all. Beware of people asking “where are you from” as they are about to give you a bracelet and you really have to ignore them to not end up in a bitter dispute with them that can sometimes feel awkward to get out of. That’s their plan, it’s how they get you. 

Overall it’s a wonderful sight that must be seen, but keep your wits about you when you visit.

title: Mal conservé
text:
Le Colisée est plus beau de l'extérieur que de l'intérieur. 
Le bitume recouvre les allées, des reconstitutions jalonnent les couloirs. 
Le Colisée pourrait être mieux mis en valeur.

title: Histórico
text: Excelente ponto histórico, porém, muito lotado, cheio de filas, impossível visitar de forma tranquila! Vale a pena pela história, mas é uma visita bem turbulenta!

title: A voir absolument
text: Avec les billets réservés à l’avance (fortement conseillé) nous avons pu accéder rapidement à l’intérieur du Colisée. Nous avions réservé des audio guides qui ne nous ont pas été utiles. L’intérieur est un peu décevant et n’est pas indispensable à voir si on dispose de peu de temps. La vue extérieure est magnifique.

title: Touristique
text:
La galere pour vositer meme avec les pass et les audios guides....a changer 
Bref bien sûr c est le colise donc faut le voir

title: visite du colisée
text: attention si vous ne maîtrisez pas les langues étrangères, vous vous faites vite arnaquer. Les tickets d'entrée Colisée, palatin et forum vous obligent à effectuer la visite dans un certain sens et cela n'est pas bien expliqué au guichet. Du coup si vous avez dépassé une certaine heure, vous devez racheter un ticket!!! De plus il faut faire attention aux audioguides dont la batterie est souvent au 3/4 vide !!!

title: Ça va
text: C'est dommage que le monument soit en travaux à l'intérieur. Ça casse le charme. Après c'est toujours agréable de visiter un monument romain

title: Impresionante
text: Llegamos caminando e impresiona desde su primera vista . Conforme obscurecía la imagen se hacía más imponente . No ingresamos pero aún así vale la pena la visita

title: Poor Customer Service
text:
Be aware ...... 

Make sure you know where the tour starts as it’s not easily described on tickets, and in most cases when using City Wonders they have the meeting points away from the venue entrance. 

We booked a 1pm tour and found it hard to find the meeting point which was up a flight of a steep set of stairs opposite side of the road to the colosseum and one road back once at the top, not sign posted or easily visible, so we arrived 1310, 10 mins late. 

Ok so it was our fault I suppose that we were late for the tour as if we had of known that the meeting point was away from the land mark we would have left more time. 

However once we arrived we were told we was late and there is nothing that can be done, then we asked if there was a later tour they could put us on and in turn she said that the tour was fully booked? Not sure why 2 people could not be added to this group? 

There was no sympathy or understanding to our issue and we had paid €61 euro for the guided tour which was non refundable which I understand but, we should have been accommodated to the later tour? Which is not unreasonable to request. 

We then asked the question if there was space for the following day, which she replied yes at a cost of €50 euro for the two of us? This is ridiculous and outrageous.......... virtually the same price !!!!!!! 

With no choice and with frustration we decided to go to the colosseum ourselves and que for 40minutes to get in at a cost of €12 euro each and then paid €5 for the audio guided tour !!! 

So advice here is simple ........ 

Que up for 30-45 mins and pay €17 euro each and you can re enter with same ticket within two days if you wanted and go at your own pace with a audio tour, where as guided tour is over in 60mins.

title: Las filas son enormes
text: Solo lo vi desde afuera porque las fiilas eran enormes, realizamos una parada con la guia de europamundo.

title: Visita guiada
text:
Para lo único que sirvió la guía fue para hacernos entrar rápido solo eso.

Ingresamos al coliseo no dijo por donde se hiba y chao se fue  luego nos encontraba otra guia fuera pata hacernos entrar en el foro y el monte palatino. Eso nos limito el tiempo.

title: Grandiose !
text: À voir absolument...le seul bémol a été la fermeture du mont palatin à cause d'un grand vent ( ce que je comprends pour des raisons de sécurité ) et impossible de se faire rembourser ou revenir un autre jour pour finir la visite !

title: Nice to visit
text: It is an iconic place in Rome. So, I think it nice to visit if you already here. I don't think that buying a ticket is a must. After all, nice place to visit.

title: Fantastic sight but so so busy
text: We went in mid October on a rainy day so thought it would be quieter but it was still heaving all around. Plan on going first thing in the morning as assume it will be a bit quieter.

title: Non mi ha mai incantato
text: So che è un eresia ..ma troppa gente ..bello fuori ma dentro per me non ne vale la pena non mi emoziona ..contando la coda per entrare

title: A must see?
text: Visited during a very cold and windy day, the scale is impressive, the history is everywhere to be seen. However I can't help thinking that I have seen this all before and in greater detail in documentary.... Watch out for the hundreds of touts, tour guides and looky looky men try to help you part with your cash. Really in need of licenced tour operators working out of boths and a good gift shop. A café would sell out.

title: Da rivedere
text:
Bella location, forse un po' datata...
Sarebbero necessari alcuni lavori di ristrutturazione per ammodernarla...

title: Outside > inside
text:
Obviously you have to visit Colosseum if you are in Rome. It's a must see! Almost 2000 years old, and still standing. It took 10 years to build. Stones are missing in the walls due to an earthquake in the 1300th century, the tumbled stones were used to build houses. 
Honestly, I rather see Colosseum outside than inside. I've visited numerous arenas around Italy that are far more beautiful.

title: No es gran cosa
text: Está en el centro de la ciudad, si no se saca entrada antes hay que hacer fila, el precio es demasiado para lo que dura entrar, recorrerlo y sacar fotos. Los baños descuidados. Te revisan todo para entrar.

title: Wow
text:
one of the modern 7’wonders of the world however expensive to get in for what it is. 

Amazing from the outside - amazing looking inside considering when built ..... very expensive though

title: Franchement pas le coup de coeur
text: Extérieurement il est plus intéressant qu'à l’intérieur où tout est en restauration. On se dit qu'on se doit d'aller dedans, mais une fois qu'on y est, on n'a pas envie d'y rester longtemps : cela reste une ruine non animée ! Attention si vous souhaitez faire le mont Palatin à la suite qui ferme tôt en février.

title: Coliseum was great
text:
Coliseum was beautiful but tour guide was rushing us and wasn’t really explaining stuff 
So the money we gave was not worth it.

title: Overcrowded, overpriced tat
text: Daughter's bought us a ticket to visit the Colosseum. When we got there we were told the ticket expired at 12 noon - there was no mention of this on the ticket. The place is dirty, overcrowded and full of con artists trying to sell you a selfie stick or a guided tour. You really are better off looking at it online. It's basically an overcrowded derelict building.

title: Está Visto
text: Sem dúvida é um edifício imponente e com uma cultura e história riquíssima. è um dos sitios mais visitados de Itália e estavam multidões!!! aconselho sem duvida a pagarem a um guia para conhecerem a história. Caso não comprem bilhete com guia existe várias pessoas com coletes a porta do coliseu a oferecer esses serviços . Cuidado mais uma vez com as crianças, muita gente muita confusão... uma manhã não dá para ver o coliseu todo.

title: Disappointed
text:
Bombarded buy people selling skip the line tickets with a tour guide, after telling 7 or 8 people we wanted to do it by ourselves we were exhausted . 

Lots of work done and still plenty being done , would love to have see it in all its glory . 

If you go then go early . 

It’s a fantastic feat of engineering .

title: Beautiful monument, badly run
text:
Myself and my husband visited here during feb. We were both very impressed with the monument however it was chaotic. Once off the metro you are bombarded with ticket touts, tour guides, etc-its difficult to make out official guides. 
We reserved our tickets on line,which was a waste of time. There are 2 lines to collect tickets, which we actually moved fast through. One is for reserved tickets online, one is to buy tickets there and then. 

You can not queue up to go through security until 10mins before your entry time. 
So when we went to queue to go through security we were met with 3 lines-1.groups/tours, 2.prepaid tickets 3. Buy there and then.we spent 40mins in the queue, whereas people who only bought their ticket on the day had a much shorter line. 

We had also pre booked video audio guides- you collect these once past security, another 15min queue. Audio is enough, dont bother with the video. 

Toilets are a joke for the volume of people-a prefab with 6-8 toilets for women, again a 20min wait. 

For the amount of money this colosseum is turning over, i was expecting a lot more. 

Glad we went, but once was enough

title: Απο έξω φοβερό!!!
text: Δυστυχώς πολύ μικρότερο των προσδοκιών μου. Απο εξω ενα επιβλητικό κτίσμα, αλλά απο μέσα δεν αξίζει τα 12€ ανά άτομο...

title: too crowded with street sellers
text: too crowded and the line was long, we were hassled from start to finish and the inside was nowhere near impressive enough.give it a miss

title: Majestic (Crowds)
text:
The Colosseum is one of the busiest tourist attractions in Rome. Be sure to factor this into your visit, as queues can be enormous and slow moving. Be prepared to go through metal detectors and remove belongings from pockets, as this does speed up lines.

The building itself is impressive, however thorough enjoyment of this historical monument is hampered by the vast amount of tourists, as one might expect. The building is an immense feat of architecture. We found the tunnels underneath to be very interesting, as well as imagining what it would have looked like at its peak.

Your ticket does however, include timed entry to the Colosseum and to the Forum, which deserves more time and attention. The size of the Forum also makes it a happy escape from the crowds.

title: Imponente
text:
Um monumento imponente, embora muito degradado pelos anos, terramotos e pelo saque de materiais para outros locais.
Apesar de tudo, será sempre uma referência de Roma para visitar.

title: Get there early!
text: The Colosseum is an amazing Roman accomplishment.  However, get there early!  They close the gates to people who are not on tours at 3:30 p.m.  If possible, get "skip the line" tickets in advance.

title: Soddisfacente
text:
Arrivai al Colosseo per le 10.30, pensando che col Roma pass non dovessi stare li ore per fare la fila.. mi sbagliavo.. entrai alle 11.15. 
Una volta entrata i tour erano esauriti e quindi niente giro nei sotterani e al terzo livello.
Fatto ciò il Colosseo rimarrà sempre bellissimo

title: Unbelievable historical venue. Shame the tour company let us down.
text: The Colosseum is a must see venue much the same as 'Roman Empire' tour company is a must avoid Viator company. Poor tour guides miss sold us a 'skip the line' deal which started with a 30 minute delay waiting for the tickets to arrive followed by an hour long wait in a line we were meant to skip. Shame on you Viator for not looking after us.

title: Getting in is not obvious
text: Of course a magnificent building. Totally a must to visit. But why having to wait 1 hour to buy a ticket and another half hour for security? Just to sponsor, support those guides that give you a quicker entree at 3 times the price? Make sure you buy tickets via internet, but then it can still take 1,5 hrs to go through security. Later on the day is better....

title: Very busy and not much to see inside
text: Clearly the Colosseum is on everyone’s list on a first time trip to Rome. However be prepared to go early as it is extremely busy. Also we were disappointed with how much there was to see inside with little in the way of additional information on what is a truly historic sight. Further the audio guide was very short and sweet. Could be so much more.

title: A lot of history, too many tourists
text: Don't get me wrong I loved seeing the Colosseum, but wow there were SO MANY people! We went in February which is apparently the off season, but the line to get inside was still about 30 min - 45 min. I would recommend learning as much as you can about the history BEFORE you go so that you can just enjoy looking. Also, beware of all the scammers out in front of the Colosseum trying to sell you 'skip the line' tours. They aren't legit! And they are so annoying.

title: Nightmare. Never again. Not even if you PAID
text: So we did everything right. Bought online ahead of time for tour. Got there at 10 am for 1:30 tour. For tickets. A nightmare. No signage people everywhere bugging you for “skip the line “. FYI. Not possible.  Finally got tickets. 4 lines again told two different lines so stood 1/2 til got to front. Way to early and knew that but. Wanted to be sure right line when time came. Told correct line come back at 1.  Went ate lunch. Back 12:30. Would not let us In went back at 1. Not. Come back 1:15. Finally let us through only to stand in next line for scan of bag. By time got through our tour had left. Back to office. Offered maybe later no had to catch plan. Offered audio that I HATE. Only had 20 min.  A waste of a whole day. Look at a picture book and do something else !!! Crazy  unorganized. Horrible.

title: Not much interesting
text:
There is not much to see there; nothing much more than the history books and films.
You should visit the place if you have some excess, free time. Otherwise, save it for more interesting sites in Rome.

title: Muy mala organización para entrar
text: Todo y que es un lugar emblemático de Roma y de visita imprescindible sorprende la mala organización que tienen organizada para entrar. Tanto si has comprado las entradas online como si las compras allí (previa cola), después has de hacer colas inmensas para pasar el control de seguridad y después acceder a la entrada real. Las colas se entremezclan, las de grupos, las que tienen pase especial city Rome, los que tienen tickets, los que no lo tienen y lo comparan dentro... Mínimos, nulos carteles indicativos y un sin fin de guías oficiales/ no oficiales, personal de soporte que dan información contradictoria entre ellos. En fin, un verdadero caos y tres horas de espera para entrar, teniendo ya la entrada y en un mes de Febrero.

title: Decepcionante
text: Personalmente, fue uno de los monumentos que más me decepcionó de Roma. Sin embargo los alrededores me llamaron más la atención. Quizá se deba a que se ensalza demasiado.

title: Famous ruins with long queues
text: This historical monument was little bit boring even if stories behind all this are fascinating. The site includes stones after stones but there was also different exhibitions. Even if our visit was on February, there was long queues to the site. Good shoes for walking is good idea to walking and climbing.

title: Impressive, but...
text:
I was there on February in the morning. Thanks God! I can’t imagine late visit, like spring or summer.
In the morning (9 oclock) the queue was for cca ten to fifteen minutes, but when I came back, it was unbelievable! At it’s February... 
The whole impression was destroyed by the fence, which is everywhere. People were everywhere as well. In my opinion it is very noncelerated and I have strange feelings about the whole visit. It is very chaotic with quite bad marks. I didn’t even have the “wau” feeling, I wasn’t impress by the monument at all. And not because it is not magnifician, but the whole impression could be done better.

title: Grandiose de l'extérieur
text:
Le monument est superbe de nuit comme de jour. Je trouve que les monuments sont extrêmement bien mis en valeur la nuit dans tout Rome.
La visite de l'intérieur est moins impressionnante, trop de monde .
La personnel en face du Colisée renseignent très mal. Ils nous ont dit que tous les billets avaient été vendus et de revenir demain. .. alors qu' en caisse avec le roma pass il n'y a eu aucun problème. 
Par contre ils ont oublié de nous prévenir de la fermeture à 15h du Forum donc nous n'avons pas pu le visiter. ...quel dommage ! A choisir j'aurai préféré voir le forum à l'intérieur que le Colisée

title: Esperava mais
text: O coliseu não deixa de ser um símbolo forte da história Romana mas esperava mais deste edifício, tem pouco conteúdo e interação com os turistas.

title: A admirer depuis l'extérieur
text: L'extérieur est impressionnant, en revanche l'intérieur assez décevant en plus il est très difficile de trouver où échanger les vouchers payés sur internet puis l'endroit pour entrer dans le monument puis ensuite pour aller chercher les audioguides, bref allez-y bien en avance si vous voulez réellement visiter l'intérieur.

title: Impressive outside
text: The Romans certainly could build but like others my husband and I were a little disappointed by the unfinished nature of the inside.  It didn't at all look like I'd expected it would, based on the films (although I realise those were some time ago)!  Helpful tip: my husband hummed the Ben Hur theme song while I imagined chariots racing around inside - it certainly helped.

title: Visite
text:
Dommage en travaux a visiter dans 1 ans
Sinon belle endroit attention au resto piège à touristes à voir

title: Great on the outside
text:
My wife and I went here during our day visit to Rome.
We had booked tickets to go inside but were very disappointed.
Very little to see or do inside.

title: Décue par l'intérieur
text: Monument magnifique de l'extérieur mais déception à l'intérieur. On a du mal à s'imaginer les spectacles qui pouvaient avoir lieu avec la scène inexistante. File d'attente extrêmement longue la journée, je vous conseille d'y aller à 1/2 heure de la fermeture, ça suffira pour la visite et vous n'aurez pas beaucoup d'attente

title: Le Colisée est un chef d'oeuvre, mais ...
text: On ne contestera pas le fait que le Colisée est un chef d'oeuvre d'architecture et d'ingéniosité, mais force est de constater que le tourisme de masse enlève toute possibilité de bien l'appréhender. Deux possibilités pour le visiter, payer un prix honnête pour sa visite et celle du Forum Romain et faire une file interminable même en janvier ou  réserver des tickets ou pass (chers) qui permettent de couper en partie la file, car il reste une file pour les contrôles de sécurité. Une fois à l'intérieur, vous pouvez y rester autant que vous voulez certes, mais vous aurez tôt fait de déambuler comme tout le monde en jetant un oeil nonchalant sur l'exposition et l'arène centrale. Vous sortirez de l'endroit avec pour seule fierté, j'ai été voir le Colisée ! Tout ça pour ça ! Dans l'ensemble, il y a un manque cruel de panneaux didactiques quant on circule autour de l'arène et le monument me semble moyennement entretenu, en effet, des fougères notamment viennent pousser dans les parties basses et humides, risquant de dégrader un peu plus l'édifice ! Bref, le Colisée est un monument qu'il faut soutenir financièrement afin de le conserver au mieux, mais sa visite (intérieure) n'est peut-être pas une priorité, à moins d'une bonne visite guidée.

title: Nur von Außen lohnenswert
text:
Nachdem man sich durch die vielen Arbeiter des Colosseums bemüht, weil sie dich in allmählichen Sprachen ansprechen kann man Speef Tickets kaufen. 
Im Internet werden sie gerne für 19€ angeboten. Am Schalter dann für zwei Personen 28€ also bitte aufpassen. 
Sehr unorganisiert, die „Türsteher“ lassen einen 10 Minuten vor der gebuchten Zeit durch, während die „Anquatscher“ 15 Minuten vorher sagen. Laut Türsteher ist dies falsch, aber sie arbeiten ja auch nicht zusammen. 

Drinnen angekommen ist dies wirklich nicht sehr beeindruckend, vor allem wenn überall restauriert und gebaut wird. 

Wenn man reingeht, dann sollte man direkt eine Tour buchen, da man sonst nicht alles anschauen kann und sonst wie ein Pferd im Pferderennen nur im Kreis läuft.

title: Un must mais est ce bien utile ?
text: Le lieu vaut le détour pour son architecture magnifique et gigantesque... des hordes de touristes par milliers des les premières heures dont l'unique intérêt est de se prendre en selfie... un accueil spartiate glacial... un seul wc ... un lieu qui respire le sang de ces innocents donnés en pâture pour des jeux et faire rire le peuple... veni vedi mais pas apprécié particulièrement... l'audio guide n'apporte rien culturellement parlant si ce n'est des infos pour des touristes en mal d'infos dignes des dico pour incultes... bref le lieu vaut quand même le détour mais si  c'était à refaire on s'en passerait finalement

title: A ruined tourist trap, the touts make it stressful
text:
The Colloseum is a remarkable structure and well worth seeing. 

It’s a real shame though, that the outside is littered with touts who will not take no for an answer. 
They push, shove, get in your face and do not give up. 
Even when you’ve told them no 100 times they still come back to ask one last time.
